functions.name: 1/x
functions.description: Returns the inverse value. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: 10**x
functions.description: Returns the 10x value of the input signal. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: ALIAS
functions.description: Can be used in two scenarios- to give alias or alternate names to long net names or instance name paths, and to return the first value of a waveform result, for non-swept variables.

functions.name: DATA
functions.description: This is a basic data access function. It returns data for the specified node and analysis.

functions.name: ERC
functions.description: Defines the sequence of steps for performing an Electric Rule Checking (ERC). This function is invoked if you provide no overriding function. It checks the variables, the sequence of steps, such as netlisting (ercNetlist), and calls the ERC program for execution (ercSimout).

functions.name: IDC
functions.description: Returns the waveform representing the DC terminal current.

functions.name: IF
functions.description: Returns the waveform representing the ac sweep terminal current.

functions.name: IS
functions.description: Returns waveform representing the dc sweep terminal current.

functions.name: IT
functions.description: Returns waveform representing the transient sweep terminal current.

functions.name: LVS
functions.description: This is the primary function for LVS. It sets up all the actions needed to netlist the layout and schematics design as well as invoke LVS itself.

functions.name: MP
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified model parameter for the given instance.

functions.name: Mu
functions.description: Returns the alternative stability factor that indicates the minimum distance between the origin of the unit Smith chart and the load unstable region.

functions.name: Mu_prime
functions.description: Returns the alternative stability factor that indicates the minimum distance between the center of the unit Smith chart and the source unstable region.

functions.name: NG
functions.description: Returns the noise gain waveform.

functions.name: OP
functions.description: Returns the value of the operating point parameter for the specified instance.

functions.name: OPT
functions.description: Returns the transient operating point for the specified instance parameter.

functions.name: OS
functions.description: Returns the specified device parameter of the an instance from DC analysis data.

functions.name: OT
functions.description: Returns the specified device parameter of the given instance from the transient analysis data.

functions.name: PN
functions.description: Calculates the transient phase noise of the input waveforms in decibels (dBc/Hz). Phase noise is defined as the power spectral density of the absolute jitter of an input waveform.

functions.name: Rn
functions.description: Returns the equivalent noise resistance as a function of frequency. This function is available only on a 2-port network from that uses a S-Parameter analysis.

functions.name: SIMULATOR
functions.description: Returns the name of simulator.

functions.name: VAR
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified design variable.

functions.name: VDC
functions.description: Returns the dc voltage for the specified net.

functions.name: VF
functions.description: Returns the waveform representing the ac sweep net voltage.

functions.name: VN
functions.description: Returns the noise waveform specified in V/sqrt (Hz).

functions.name: VN2
functions.description: Returns the noise waveform in V^2/Hz.

functions.name: VNP
functions.description: Returns any single level noise parameter available in the PSF database.

functions.name: VNPP
functions.description: VNPP accesses any double level noise parameter available in the PSF database.

functions.name: VPD
functions.description: Returns the waveform representing phase difference between voltages at the two nets.

functions.name: VS
functions.description: Returns dc sweep waveform for the specified net.

functions.name: VT
functions.description: Returns the transient waveform for the specified net.

functions.name: aaSP
functions.description: Returns the S-Parameter waveform for a multi-port network for the specified port numbers. The S-Parameters describe the response of an N-port network to voltage signals at each port.

functions.name: abGetAssistant
functions.description: Returns the Annotation Browser window associated with the specified window.

functions.name: abGetCurrentIncompleteNetFilter
functions.description: Returns the incomplete net filter currently applied on the specified window. An incomplete net filter is used to control the display of incomplete net markers in the Connectivity tab of the Annotation Browser assistant by showing or hiding a subset of net names.

functions.name: abHiFindMarker
functions.description: In the specified window, selects the row corresponding to a marker in the Annotation Browser when the corresponding marker object is clicked in the layout canvas. Even though the marker object is selected in the layout canvas, this does not modify the selection in the canvas. If the corresponding marker is not displayed in the Annotation Browser due to the applied filtering, nothing is selected in the Annotation Browser. If a window ID is not specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: abSetColorOnSelection
functions.description: Sets the specified color as the highlight color for all selected rows in the Annotation Browser tree view.

functions.name: abSetIncompleteNetFilter
functions.description: Sets the specified incomplete net filter state for the specified list of nets in the given window. An incomplete net filter is used to control the display of incomplete net markers in the Connectivity tab of the Annotation Browser assistant by showing or hiding a subset of net names.

functions.name: abeBlockagesFromCellView
functions.description: Copies blockages from the specified layer in the current ABE session cellview to a new or existing ABE layer. Optional arguments restrict the copied blockages to the specified ABE layer. This function can be run immediately or added to the queue.

functions.name: abeBoundariesFromCellView
functions.description: Copies the boundaries from the current ABE session cellview to a new ABE layer or, optionally, an existing ABE layer. Optional arguments restrict the copied boundaries to a specified layer. This function can be run immediately or added to the queue.

functions.name: abeClearLayer
functions.description: Removes all the shapes on the ABE layer and frees the memory. This is useful for re-using ABE layers.

functions.name: abeDone
functions.description: Closes the current ABE session and frees all the memory that was used by ABE.

functions.name: abeElapsedTime
functions.description: Returns the elapsed time for the current ABE session.

functions.name: abeInit
functions.signature: abeInit(d_cellViewId[ ?doInterrupts g_interrupts ][ ?depth g_depth ][ ?threads g_threadCount ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Initializes an ABE session for the specified cellview. The ABE elapsed time clock is set to zero.

functions.name: abeIslandIterator
functions.description: Returns the island iterator for the rectangles and polygons on the ABE layer. Each entry is a list of points for a shape on the ABE layer.

functions.name: abeLayerAbut
functions.description: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer for ABE layer1 shapes that abut with shapes on ABE layer2.

functions.name: abeLayerAnd
functions.description: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer where shapes on ABE layer1 overlap shapes on ABE layer2.

functions.name: abeLayerAndNot
functions.description: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer where shapes on layer1 do not overlap shapes on layer2.

functions.name: abeLayerAvoid
functions.description: Adds shapes on the output layer for shapes on layer1 that are completely outside of, and have no abutting edges with, shapes on layer2.

functions.name: abeLayerFromCellView
functions.signature: abeLayerFromCellView(t_layerName[ ?bbox l_bbox ][ ?bBox l_bBox ][ ?purpose t_purposeName ][ ?excludePurpose l_purposeName ][ ?outLayer o_abeOutputLayer [ ?queue g_queue ] ][ ?maskColor g_maskColor ][ ?startLevel g_startLevel ][ ?stopLevel g_stopLevel ][ ?orientation g_orientation ][ ?onlyPinFig g_onlyPinFig ][ ?onlyVia g_onlyVia ])=> o_abeLayer / nil
functions.description: Copies the shapes from the specified layer in the current ABE session cellview to a new ABE layer or, optionally, an existing ABE layer. Optional arguments restrict the copied shapes to a specific area, purpose, mask color, or hierarchical depth. This function can be run immediately or added to the queue.

functions.name: abeLayerFromFigSet
functions.description: Adds the shapes from a FigSet to an existing ABE layer or a new ABE layer.

functions.name: abeLayerFromNet
functions.signature: abeLayerFromNet(t_layerNamet_netName[ ?outLayer o_abeOutputLayer ][ ?onlyPinFig g_onlyPinFig ][ ?onlyVia g_onlyVia ][ ?maskColor g_maskColor ])=> o_abeLayer / nil
functions.description: Adds the shapes from a net to an existing or new ABE layer. Logical connectivity is not preserved and therefore cannot be restored if the shapes are written back to the ABE session cellview.

functions.name: abeLayerFromShapes
functions.description: Creates an ABE layer with shapes from the given list.

functions.name: abeLayerGrow
functions.signature: abeLayerGrow(o_abeInputLayero_abeOutputLayer[ ?north g_sizeNorth ][ ?south g_sizeSouth ][ ?east g_sizeEast ][ ?west g_sizeWest][ ?queue g_queue ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer that are ABE input layer shapes that have been increased in size along one or more directions in the north, south, east, and/or west.

functions.name: abeLayerInside
functions.description: Adds ABE layer1 shapes that are completely inside an ABE layer2 shape to the ABE output layer. Coincident edges are considered inside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

functions.name: abeLayerMergeTiles
functions.description: Uses an existing ABE layer to recreate maximum tiles based on the specified orientation.

functions.name: abeLayerOr
functions.description: Adds shapes from the input ABE layer to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerOrPtArray
functions.description: Adds a polygon that is represented by a list of points to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerOutside
functions.description: Adds to the ABE output layer the ABE layer1 shapes that are completely outside the ABE layer2 shapes. Coincident edges are considered outside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

functions.name: abeLayerShrink
functions.signature: abeLayerShrink(o_abeInputLayero_abeOutputLayer[ ?north g_sizeNorth ][ ?south g_sizeSouth ][ ?east g_sizeEast ][ ?west g_sizeWest][ ?queue g_queue ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Decreases the size of shapes from the input ABE layer and outputs them to the ABE output layer. Shapes can be reduced by different distances in the north, south, east, and west directions.

functions.name: abeLayerSize
functions.description: Adds shapes that have been increased or decreased in size from the ABE input layer to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerStraddle
functions.description: Adds the ABE layer1 shapes that partially overlap an ABE layer2 shape to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerToBlockages
functions.signature: abeLayerToBlockages(o_abeInputLayert_layerName[ ?maskColor g_maskColor ][ ?blockageType g_blockageType ][ ?tiles g_tiles| ?noHoles g_noHoles ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Adds shapes as blockage objects from the ABE layer to the specified layer. Optional arguments specify a mask color and blockage type for the blockage objects, whether the shapes are copied without holes, and whether shapes are copied as tiles instead of islands.

functions.name: abeLayerToCellView
functions.signature: abeLayerToCellView(o_abeLayert_layerName[ ?tiles g_tiles| ?noHoles g_noHoles ][ ?purpose t_purposeName ][ ?maskColor g_maskColor ][ ?cell t_cellName ][ ?view t_viewName ][ ?cvId d_cellviewID ][ ?shapeIds { t | nil} })=> l_shapeIDs / t / nil
functions.description: Copies shapes from the ABE layer to the specified layer in the current ABE session cellview. Optional arguments specify the layer purpose, whether the shapes are copied without holes, and whether the shapes are copied as islands instead of primitive tiles.

functions.name: abeLayerToHilightSet
functions.description: Adds the rectangles and polygons on the specified ABE layer to the specified highlight set. Optional arguments specify whether the shapes are copied without holes, and whether the shapes are copied as primitive tiles instead of islands.

functions.name: abeLayerTouch
functions.description: Adds the ABE layer1 shapes that touch (completely overlap, partially overlap, or abut) an ABE layer2 shape to the ABE output layer.

functions.name: abeLayerXor
functions.description: Adds rectangles and polygons to the ABE output layer where ABE layer1 shapes and ABE layer2 shapes do not overlap.

functions.name: abeMTdebug
functions.description: Enables the output of additional messages to monitor progress when multithreading is used.

functions.name: abeNewLayer
functions.description: Creates a new ABE layer.

functions.name: abeRemoveLayer
functions.description: Removes the specified ABE layer.

functions.name: abeRunQueue
functions.description: Runs all the ABE operations that are queued for processing.

functions.name: abeShapesInside
functions.description: Returns a list of shapes from the inside list that are completely inside a shape from the outside list. Coincident edges are considered inside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

functions.name: abeShapesOutside
functions.description: Returns a list of shapes from the outside list that are completely outside of shapes from the inside list. Coincident edges are considered outside. Partially overlapping shapes are excluded.

functions.name: abeTileIterator
functions.description: Returns the tile iterator for the primitive rectangles and polygons on the ABE layer. The iterator can be restricted to a region of the layer.

functions.name: abs
functions.description: Returns the absolute value of a floating-point number or integer.

functions.name: absAbstract
functions.description: Runs the Abstract step for selected cells and creates an abstract view for those cells based on the options set using absSetBinOption.

functions.name: absAttachTechLib
functions.description: Attaches the named technology library to the current library.

functions.name: absCopyBinOptions
functions.signature: absCopyBinOptions(from_bin { Core | IO | Corner | Block | Ignore | user_bin_name }to_bin { Core | IO | Corner | Block | Ignore | user_bin_name })=> t / nil
functions.description: Copies bin option settings from one bin to another.

functions.name: absDeleteBin
functions.description: Deletes the named user bin. You cannot delete a system bin.

functions.name: absDeleteBinMoveCellsTo
functions.signature: absDeleteBinMoveCellsTo(name{ Core | IO | Corner | Block | Ignore | user_bin_name })=> t / nil
functions.description: Deletes a named user bin and moves any cells in that bin to another specified bin.

functions.name: absDeselectAllBins
functions.description: Deselects all currently selected bins.

functions.name: absDeselectBin
functions.description: Deselects a named bin.

functions.name: absDeselectBinFrom
functions.description: Deselects a range of bins. The deselection is done from top to bottom starting from the from bin. The from bin should be above the to bin the Bin pane, otherwise all bins listed after from are deselected.

functions.name: absDeselectCell
functions.description: Deselects a named cell.

functions.name: absDeselectCellFrom
functions.description: Deselects a range of cells. The deselection is done from top to bottom starting from the from cell. The from cell should be above the to cell the Cell pane, otherwise all cells listed after from are deselected.

functions.name: absDeselectCells
functions.description: Deselects all cells in the current bins.

functions.name: absDeselectCellsInList
functions.description: Deselects a list of cells that are not adjacent to each other in the Cell pane.

functions.name: absDisableUpdate
functions.description: Both the absDisableUpdate and absEnableUpdate functions are used to control whether or not the graphical user interface updates in response to changes in, for example, bin selection. This ensures that the GUI does not update unnecessarily when several events in a row are processed. This is inserted by Abstract Generator into the record file.

functions.name: absDistributeCells
functions.description: Distributes cells between bins according to the options set.

functions.name: absEnableUpdate
functions.description: Both the absEnableUpdate and absDisableUpdate functions are used to control whether or not the graphical user interface updates in response to changes in, for example, bin selection. This ensures that the GUI does not update unnecessarily when several events in a row are processed. This is inserted by Abstract Generator into the record file.

functions.name: absExit
functions.description: Closes Abstract Generator.

functions.name: absExportLEF
functions.description: Generates LEF files for cells in one or more bins. All exported LEF data is contained in the LEF filename.

functions.name: absExportOptions
functions.description: Save the options settings for the current session to a specified location.

functions.name: absExportReport
functions.description: Outputs a summary of the cells in your library to a report file.

functions.name: absExtract
functions.description: Runs connectivity extraction for the selected cells and creates an extracted view for these cells based on the options set using absSetBinOption.

functions.name: absGetBinOption
functions.description: Returns the value of a specified option in a given bin.

functions.name: absGetBinType
functions.description: Returns the type of the bin passed as an argument. Both system and user bins can be specified as arguments.

functions.name: absGetBins
functions.description: Displays the list of available bins. The list returned includes the five system bins as well as the user bins, if any.

functions.name: absGetCellProp
functions.description: Returns the specified property value for a cell.

functions.name: absGetLibrary
functions.description: Returns the name of the current library.

functions.name: absGetOption
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified global option.

functions.name: absGetSelectedBins
functions.description: Returns the list of bins selected in the Bin pane. The order of the bins in the list matches the order in which they appear in the Bin pane.

functions.name: absGetSelectedCells
functions.description: Returns the list of cells selected in the Cell pane. The cells might belong to different bins.

functions.name: absGetTerminalProp
functions.signature: absGetTerminalProp(cellterminalproperty { direction | termType | shape | netExpr | suppSensitivity | groundSensitivity })=> string
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified property for the specified terminal. Specify only cells that have already been processed by absPins. The Pins step generates the cell terminals.

functions.name: absImportCTLF
functions.description: Creates cellviews from CTLF logical data.

functions.name: absImportDEF
functions.description: Creates cellviews from DEF data.

functions.name: absImportGDS
functions.description: Creates cellviews from GDSII layout data.

functions.name: absImportLEF
functions.description: Creates cellviews from LEF data.

functions.name: absImportLogical
functions.description: Creates cellviews from existing logical information, typically represented in LIB or Verilog formats.

functions.name: absImportOasis
functions.description: Creates cellviews from OASIS data.

functions.name: absImportOptions
functions.description: Loads a previous session's saved options file from the specified location.

functions.name: absImportVerilog
functions.description: Creates cellviews from Verilog logical data.

functions.name: absMoveSelectedCellsToBin
functions.description: Moves any currently selected cells to a named bin. This can be one of the five system bins or a user-defined bin.

functions.name: absNewBin
functions.signature: absNewBin(name{ Core | IO | Corner | Block | Ignore })=> t / nil
functions.description: Creates a new user bin to store library cells.

functions.name: absPins
functions.description: Runs the Pins step for the selected cells and creates a pins view for those cells based on options set using absSetBinOption.

functions.name: absRenameBin
functions.description: Renames a previously created user bin.

functions.name: absRevalidateSelectedCells
functions.description: Revalidates all invalid views for cells selected in the Cell pane. If the view has an error or warning, this remains. The view status is no longer grayed out.

functions.name: absSelect
functions.description: Selects cells according to the specified options.

functions.name: absSelectAllBins
functions.description: Selects all the bins in the current library.

functions.name: absSelectBin
functions.description: Selects the named bin. This makes the specified bin current for use with other functions.

functions.name: absSelectBinFrom
functions.description: Selects a range of bins. The selection is made from top to bottom starting from the from bin. The from bin should be above the to bin the Bins pane, otherwise all bins listed after from are selected.

functions.name: absSelectCell
functions.description: Selects a single named cell.

functions.name: absSelectCellFrom
functions.description: Selects a range of cells. The selection is made from top to bottom starting from the from cell. The from cell should be above the to cell the Cell pane, otherwise all cells listed after from are selected.

functions.name: absSelectCells
functions.description: Selects all cells in the selected bins.

functions.name: absSelectCellsInList
functions.description: Selects a list of cells that are not adjacent to each other in the Cell pane.

functions.name: absSetBinOption
functions.description: Sets a value for a specified option in a specified bin.

functions.name: absSetCellProp
functions.description: Specifies a property value for a cell. The variables you can use for the value parameter depend on the property.

functions.name: absSetLibrary
functions.description: Specifies the library that you want to process through Abstract Generator. This involves either creating a new library and setting into it or setting into an existing library.

functions.name: absSetOption
functions.description: Sets values for all abstract generator global options. The SKILL function to apply the absSetOption settings is run after the absSetOption function has been set.

functions.name: absSetTerminalProp
functions.signature: absSetTerminalProp(cellterminalproperty { direction | termType | shape | netExpr | suppSensitivity | groundSensitivity }value)=> 0 / 1
functions.description: Specifies a terminal value for a cell. The variables you can use for the value parameter depend on the property setting.

functions.name: absSort
functions.description: Sets sort criteria for those cells in the current bin.

functions.name: absVerify
functions.description: Runs the Verify step for selected cells and creates a verify view for those cells based on the options set using absSetBinOption.

functions.name: absVersion
functions.description: Returns version, build, and operating system information.

functions.name: abs_jitter
functions.description: Calculates the absolute jitter values in the intput waveform for the given threshold. The output waveform can be expressed in degrees, radians, or unit intervals (UI). The absolute jitter can be plotted as a function of cycle number, crossing time, or reference clock time.

functions.name: ac
functions.description: Specifies an AC analysis.

functions.name: acdlArtPrintIncludedNetlist
functions.description: Controls how an included netlist is included in the main netlist file. This function can be overridden by user settings. If user-override is not specified, the included netlist is copied without any modification. However, if both acdlPrintIncludedNetlist and acdlArtPrintIncludedNetlist are defined, acdlPrintIncludedNetlist is called. acdlArtPrintIncludedNetlist is preferred because the file pointer is not closed and re-initialized.

functions.name: acdlCurrentInstName
functions.description: Maps instance names during hierarchical or flat netlisting.

functions.name: acos
functions.description: Returns the arc cosine of a floating-point number or integer.

functions.name: acosh
functions.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine or hyperbolic arc-cosine of a signal.

functions.name: add1
functions.description: Adds 1 to a floating-point number or integer.

functions.name: addCheck
functions.signature: addCheck(t_name[ ?sub t_sub ][ ?dev t_dev ][ ?devlist l_devlist ][ ?prim t_prim ][ ?mod t_mod ][ ?instparam t_instparam ][ ?modelparam t_modelparam ][ ?opparam t_opparam ][ ?parameter t_parameter ][ ?expression t_expression ][ ?min t_min ][ ?max t_max ][ ?regions t_regions ][ ?duration t_duration ][ ?message t_message ][ ?severity t_severity ][ ?analyses l_analyses ])=> t_name / nil
functions.description: Adds a new device check. Checks can be added to check a device parameter, a subcircuit parameter, a design variable or an expression. The scope of check is decided by the arguments ?sub, ?dev, ?mod, and ?prim. The ?min and ?max parameters can be used to set up the safe region if the parameter/expression being checked goes out of this region and a violation is reported.

functions.name: addDefstructClass
functions.description: Creates a class for the defstruct.

functions.name: addDependent
functions.description: Registers a dependent object for given object. SKILL checks if g_dependent already exists as a dependent of g_object (using the eqv operator), then g_dependent is not registered again and nil is returned.

functions.name: addPoint
functions.description: Adds the point to the enterfunction in the current window.

functions.name: addSubwindow
functions.description: Adds a subwindow to the current Waveform window and returns the number for the new subwindow, which is found in the upper right corner.

functions.name: addSubwindowTitle
functions.description: Adds a title to the current subwindow in the active window. The current subwindow is defined using the currentSubwindow command.

functions.name: addTitle
functions.description: Adds a title to the current active OCEAN window. The current window is defined using the currentWindow command.

functions.name: addToExportList
functions.description: Adds the specified symbols to the namespace export list. This function does not throw any errors if a symbol is already exported. You can export any symbol from your namespace.

functions.name: addToNamespace
functions.description: Adds and imports the given list of symbol names to the export list of the namespace t_namespaceName.

functions.name: addWaveLabel
functions.signature: addWaveLabel(x_waveIndexl_locationt_label[ ?textOffset g_textOffset ][ ?color x_color ][ ?justify t_justify ][ ?fontStyle t_fontStyle ][ ?height x_height ][ ?orient t_orient ][ ?drafting g_drafting ][ ?overBar g_overbar ])=> s_labelId / nil
functions.description: Attaches a label to the specified waveform curve in the current subwindow.

functions.name: addWindowLabel
functions.description: Displays a label in the current subwindow. The location for the label is specified with a list of two numbers between 0 and 1.

functions.name: adpInitFloorPlan
functions.signature: adpInitFloorplan(d_cvt_engine?all g_all?deleteClusterBndry g_deleteClusterBndry?deleteCluster g_deleteCluster?deleteBlockages g_deleteBlockages?prsvPlacementBkg g_prsvPlacementBkg?prsvRoutingBkg g_prsvRoutingBkg?prsvAreaHaloBkg g_prsvAreaHaloBkg?prsvFeedthruBkg g_prsvFeedthruBkg?prsvFillBkg g_prsvFillBkg?prsvPinBkg g_prsvPinBkg?prsvScreenBkg g_prsvScreenBkg?prsvSlotBkg g_prsvSlotBkg?prsvWiringBkg g_prsvWiringBkg?deleteWires g_deleteWires?deleteRows g_deleteRows?deleteFillers g_deleteFillers?fillerPrefix t_fillerPrefix?deleteShapes g_deleteShapes?prsvCircle g_prsvCircle?prsvDonut g_prsvDonut?prsvEllipse g_prsvEllipse?prsvPath g_prsvPath?prsvPolygon g_prsvPolygon?prsvRectangle g_prsvRectangle?deleteBndry g_deleteBndry?prsvAreaBndry g_prsvAreaBndry?prsvSnapBndry g_prsvSnapBndry?initGrid g_initGrid?designBndry g_designBndry?origin t_origin?aspectRatio f_aspectRatio?chipWidth f_chipWidth?chipHeight f_chipHeight?boundaryShapeType t_boundaryShapeType?boundaryPoints g_boundaryPoints?designArea f_designArea?initInstances g_initInstances?prsvIO g_prsvIO?prsvStd g_prsvStd?prsvMacro g_prsvMacro?prsvCustomCell g_prsvCustomCell?initPins g_initPins?prsvPlacedPin g_prsvPlacedPin?prsvFixedPin g_prsvFixedPin?prsvLockedPin g_prsvLockedPin?prsvFigGrp g_prsvFigGrp?window g_window)=> t / nil
functions.description: Initializes the floorplan of a design based on the options you specify. Most of the options being keywords, you need to specify only those parameters that you want to control. The parameters that you do not specify use the default values.

functions.name: adpnlSetEnv
functions.description: Sets a variable in the specified domain. If the environment variable does not exist in the domain, a variable is created.

functions.name: adtFFT
functions.description: Calculates the fast Fourier transform (FFT) of the specified list.

functions.name: adtIFFT
functions.description: Calculates the inverse discrete Fourier transform of the specified list.

functions.name: aedCopyCDF
functions.description: Opens the Copy Component CDF form.

functions.name: aedDeleteCDF
functions.description: Opens the Delete Component CDF form.

functions.name: aedEditCDF
functions.description: Opens the Edit CDF form to the specified library, cell, and CDF type. The library and cell names must be strings referring to an existing library or cell, and the CDF type must be effective, base, or user.

functions.name: aelCheckRange
functions.description: Determines if a number falls within a particular range of numbers.

functions.name: aelDisplayOPParam
functions.description: Returns a string list whose elements are the simParam of each of the instances being processed.

functions.name: aelEngNotation
functions.description: Reformats a given number into engineering notation.

functions.name: aelEnvCompile
functions.description: Compiles a given expression according to the evaluation mode set with aelEnvCreate and the state of globals for the given environment.Compiled expressions are references to dynamically allocated memory. There is no facility for extending their lifetime or visibility beyond the process in which they are created. Do not attempt to store them in a design database. Compiled expressions are invalidated and yield undefined results if you apply the aelEnvFreeCompExpr function to them, or if you destroy their associated environment with the env = nil expression.

functions.name: aelEnvCreate
functions.description: Creates and initializes an AEL environment.

functions.name: aelEnvExecute
functions.description: Executes the previously compiled AEL expression with the current global values of the environment in which it was compiled.

functions.name: aelEnvFreeCompExpr
functions.description: Frees the dynamically allocated memory used to store the compiled AEL expression.

functions.name: aelEnvGetErrStr
functions.description: Converts the error code currently stored in the all-AEL-wide error flag into an appropriate message.

functions.name: aelEnvGetGlobal
functions.description: Returns the current value of the named global, previously defined or deferred, in the given environment.

functions.name: aelEnvInterpret
functions.description: Compiles and executes the specified expression in a single step.

functions.name: ansCdlGetMultiplicity
functions.description: Controls how multiplicity (converting an instance into multiple instances connected in parallel) is handled for an instance in the design when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the master of the instance.

functions.name: ansCdlGetSegmentConnections
functions.description: This function is used to customize the auCdl netlist when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the device. It controls how connectivity information is written in the netlist for instances for which a multiplicity factor is specified using the m or M property. For example, if an instance with a connection list like ((termA netA) (termB netB)) has to be converted into two segments connected in series, the modified connection list for the first segment will be((termA netA) (termB tempnet_0)) and ((termA tempnet_0) (termB netB)) for the second segment. Define this function as a procedure in the .simrc file.

functions.name: ansCdlGetSegmentInfo
functions.description: This function is used to customize the auCdl netlist when the ansCdlHnlPrintInst function is specified as a netlist procedure in the CDF for the device. It returns the number of segments for an instance and the connection type (series, parallel, or user defined connection type name) between the segments. Define this function as a procedure in the .simrc file.

functions.name: asiCheck
functions.signature: asiCheck(o_analysis | o_anaOption | o_envOption | o_simOption | o_keepOptionr_form)=> t / nil
functions.description: Called by the environment to check values in the analysis and option fields.

functions.name: asiCheckAcEnabledWhenNoiseEnabled
functions.description: This method verifies that an AC analysis is enabled when a noise analysis is selected. If this is not the case, it displays an error message in the error dialog box of thw analysis form and sets the error status of the form. It is called during the form apply callback.

functions.name: asiCheckAnalysis
functions.description: Checking function for the analysis class. e.g. for Spectre simulator object it checks each field value in the environment, highlights any errors, returns t or nil. Can be used for different analog simulator analysis objects.

functions.name: asiCheckBlank
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is non-blank.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankInstExists
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a valid instance name.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankNetExists
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a valid net name.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankNumeric
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a numeric value.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankNumericGeq
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a numeric value greater than or equal to g_value.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankNumericGreater
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a numeric value greater than g_value.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankNumericLeq
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a numeric value less than or equal to g_value.

functions.name: asiCheckBlankNumericNequal
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a numeric value not equal to g_value.

functions.name: asiCheckDesignVariable
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a valid design variable.

functions.name: asiCheckDigitalSimulationSuccess
functions.description: Reports the success or failure of the simulation by looking at the digital simulator status file. Further, if no digital signals are saved by the user, this function updates the logFileVerilog file to indicate that no digital waveforms are available for viewing.

functions.name: asiCheckExpression
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is a valid expression.

functions.name: asiCheckExpressionGreater
functions.description: Verifies that the s_fieldName entry is an expression that evaluates to a value greater than g_value.

functions.name: asiCheckMultipleGreater
functions.description: Verifies that the value of the s_largerField entry is greater than that of the s_smallerField entry.

functions.name: asiCheckSimulationSuccess
functions.description: Determines if a simulation was successful.

functions.name: asiCloseOceanScript
functions.description: Closes the OCEAN script.

functions.name: asiConstructDigitalNetlist
functions.description: Constructs the digital netlist file for viewing.
