functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a copy of the specified ccCurve or ccPolyCurve rotated counterclockwise around the origin by a multiple of 90 degrees after optionally mirroring it across the X-axis or Y-axis. Mirroring also reverses the orientation of the curve.

functions.name: ccRemoveFigs
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Removes the database figures attached to the given ccShape.

functions.name: ccRenameFacet
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a copy of the specified facet with a different name.

functions.name: ccReversePolyCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a reversed copy of the given polyCurve, which is the polyCurve with the same geometry but in the opposite direction, which is from the end of the original polyCurve to its beginning.This function can be used to turn positive-closed polyCurves into negative polyCurves, and negative-closed polyCurves into positive polyCurves.

functions.name: ccSmoothenFig
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns the result of smoothening of the specified ccShape as a new transient ccSurface.

functions.name: ccSmoothenPolyCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a smoothened copy of the given ccPolyCurve.

functions.name: ccSpiralConnector
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a spiral connector that consists of an inner S-shaped figure of two joined circular bend connectors. Each endpoint of S is prolonged by a straight extension and then by N-turnings of a spiral circling around S.

functions.name: ccTransformFacet
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a transformed copy of the given ccFacet object.

functions.name: ccTransformPolyCurve
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Returns a transformed copy of the given ccPolyCurve.

functions.name: ccTromboneConnector
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a trombone-shaped connector that consists of five legs of given lengths, smoothly connected by waypoint connectors with the given gamma ratio and the minimum curvature radius.

functions.name: ccWaypointConnector
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a waypoint connector between the specified points with the given minimum curvature radius and the given portion (gamma) of the circular bending angle in the overall bending angle.If both ports are nil, then at least three waypoints must be specified as input. The connector starts at the first waypoint with the tangent given by the line between the first two waypoints and ends at the last waypoint with the tangent given by the line between the last two waypoints.If both ports are not nil, they specify the initial and the final points, tangents, and radiuses of the connector.If no waypoints are specified, the start and the end ports are connected by a curve connector.If a single waypoint is specified, it is connected to the start and the end ports by a pair of curve connectors with zero curvature at the waypoint.If two waypoints are specified, they are connected to each other with a straight line and to the start and the end ports with a pair of curve connectors with zero curvatures at the waypoints.If three or more waypoints are specified, they are connected to each other by a waypoint connector like in the case where both ports are nil and to the start and the end ports by a pair of curve connectors with zero curvature at the waypoints.It is an error to only specify one port as nil and the other port as not nil.The waypoint connector consists of a sequence of lines, circles, and clothoids. If the calculation of the waypoint connector can only be partially completed, then the result will only contain segments between the starting point and the point where the calculation failed.

functions.name: ccWideConnector
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Creates a specification of a path around the specified connector centerline with the width specified by a cubic spline function.

functions.name: ccpCopy
functions.signature: ccpCopy(q_srcq_dest[ g_overWrite ][ s_expFlag ][ l_copyViewTypeList ][ l_copyViewNameList ][ t_vNameSimExp ][ t_vNameSpace ][ s_whatToUpdate ][ q_updateLibList ][ g_addProp ][ g_existenceCheck ][ g_reReferenceCustomVias ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Copies source data to another location.

functions.name: ccpCopyConfig
functions.signature: ccpCopyConfig(G_srcG_dest[ g_overWrite ][ s_expFlag ][ q_copySkipLibList ][ l_copyViewTypeList ][ l_copyViewNameList ][ t_vNameSimExp ][ t_vNameSpace ][ s_whatToUpdate ][ q_updateLibList ][ g_addProp ][ g_existenceCheck ][ g_reReferenceCustomVias ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Copies a design configuration. Expansion is based on configuration rules specified in the expand.cfg file in the source configuration view.

functions.name: ccpCopyDesign
functions.signature: ccpCopyDesign(G_srcG_dest[ g_overWrite ][ s_expFlag ][ q_copySkipLibList ][ l_copyViewTypeList ][ l_copyViewNameList ][ t_vNameSimExp ][ t_vNameSpace ][ s_whatToUpdate ][ q_updateLibList ][ g_addProp ][ g_existenceCheck ][ g_reReferenceCustomVias ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Copies a design, after expanding it, to the destination library you specify.

functions.name: ccpCopyExactDesign
functions.signature: ccpCopyExactDesign(G_srcG_dest[ g_overWrite ][ s_expFlag ][ q_copySkipLibList ][ l_copyViewTypeList ][ l_copyViewNameList ][ t_vNameSimExp ][ t_vNameSpace ][ s_whatToUpdate ][ q_updateLibList ][ g_addProp ][ g_existenceCheck ][ g_reReferenceCustomVias ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Copies a design, after expanding it, to the destination library you specify. This function is similar to ccpCopyDesign, except that it copies only the exact design-it does not copy any views that are not used in the design.

functions.name: ccpDmHasRename
functions.description: Checks whether a specified design management system (DMS) is loaded and enabled for GDM renaming. The DMS can be loaded either by Virtuoso at startup or by previously made successful calls to the DM objects from SKILL functions such as ddGetObjDMSys, ddIsPathManaged, or gdmstatus.

functions.name: ccpDmRename
functions.signature: ccpDmRename(G_srcG_dest[ ?destLibPath t_destLibPath ][ ?whatToUpdate s_whatToUpdate ][ ?updateLibList q_updateLibList ][ ?existenceCheck x_existenceCheck ][ ?reReferenceCustomVias x_reReferenceCustomVias ][ ?tag t_tag ][ ?description t_description ][ ?xtraArgs t_xtraArgs ][ ?feedbackStyle x_feedbackStyle ][ ?limitChecks x_limitChecks ][ ?checkOnly g_checkOnly ][ ?returnGdmContext g_returnGdmContext ][ ?returnCcpResults g_returnCcpResults ][ ?feedbackCallback u_feedbackCallback ][ ?doneCallback u_doneCallback ][ ?gdmContextCallback u_gdmContextCallback ][ ?nconsTag l_nconsTag ][ ?dpl l_dpl ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Renames a specified gdmSpec object representing a cellview. The source object is deleted after a copy is created. When you copy a directory containing the cellview, all files in the directory are copied, regardless of whether they are co-managed or not.

functions.name: ccpExpand
functions.signature: ccpExpand(q_srcs_expFlag[ l_expandViewTypeList ][ l_expandViewNameList ][ t_vNameSimExp ][ t_vNameSpace ][ g_addProp ][ g_existenceCheck ][ g_reReferenceCustomVias ])=> q_expSpecList / nil
functions.description: Expands a list of source objects.

functions.name: ccpExpandConfig
functions.signature: ccpExpandConfig(G_srcs_expFlag[ q_expandSkipLibList ][ l_expandViewTypeList ][ l_expandViewNameList ][ t_vNameSimExp ][ t_vNameSpace ][ g_addProp ][ g_existenceCheck ][ g_reReferenceCustomVias ])=> q_expSpecList / nil
functions.description: Expands a configuration, based on configuration rules specified in the expand.cfg file in the source configuration view.

functions.name: ccpExpandDesign
functions.signature: ccpExpandDesign(G_srcs_expFlagq_expandSkipLibList[ l_expandViewTypeList ][ l_expandViewNameList ][ t_vNameSimExp ][ t_vNameSpace ][ g_addProp ][ g_existenceCheck ][ g_reReferenceCustomVias ])=> q_expSpecList / nil
functions.description: Expands a design, given a source cell or cellview gdmSpec object.

functions.name: ccpExpandExactDesign
functions.signature: ccpExpandExactDesign(G_srcs_expFlagq_expandSkipLibList[ l_expandViewTypeList ][ l_expandViewNameList ][ t_vNameSimExp ][ t_vNameSpace ][ g_addProp ][ g_existenceCheck ][ g_reReferenceCustomVias ])=> q_expSpecList / nil
functions.description: Expands a design, given a source cell or cellview gdmSpec object. This function is similar to ccpExpandDesign, except that the expansion list only includes those views that are used in the design.

functions.name: ccpGetAutoRename
functions.description: Gets the current status of the auto rename feature. Earlier, the status of this feature was controlled only by a single time evaluation of the CDS_COPY_AUTO_RENAME shell environment variable. This environment variable defines the initial status setting for this feature. Now, the ccpSetAutoRename function allows you to change the status after the startup initialization.

functions.name: ccpRegMonitor
functions.description: Registers the copy monitor that you create. A copy monitor is a program that displays the progress of the copy command while it is being executed.

functions.name: ccpRegTrigger
functions.description: Registers the copy trigger that you create. The copy trigger is called in the copy phase that you specify.

functions.name: ccpRemoveTrigger
functions.description: Removes the registered copy trigger function from the copy phase you specify.

functions.name: ccpRename
functions.signature: ccpRename(G_srcG_dest[ g_overWrite ][ s_expFlag ][ s_whatToUpdate ][ q_updateLibList ][ g_existenceCheck ][ g_reReferenceCustomVias ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Renames a library, cell, view, or file. The source library, cell, view, or file is copied, and then the original one is deleted. When you copy a directory (library, cell, or view), all the files in the directory are copied, regardless of whether they are co-managed or not.

functions.name: ccpRenameReferenceLib
functions.description: Renames references to an external library. The external library is not changed.

functions.name: ccpSetAutoRename
functions.description: Sets the status of the auto rename feature to on or off. Earlier, the status of this feature was controlled only by a single time evaluation of the CDS_COPY_AUTO_RENAME shell environment variable. This environment variable defines the initial status setting for this feature. Now, this function allows you to change the status after the startup initialization.

functions.name: cdfCopyCDF
functions.description: Copies the CDF data of the specified type from specified source to a library or cell by creating a new CDF data ID.

functions.name: cdfCopyParam
functions.description: Copies the specified parameter to the given CDF data object.

functions.name: cdfCreateBaseCellCDF
functions.signature: cdfCreateBaseCellCDF(g_cellID[ ?doneProc t_doneProc ][ ?formInitProc t_formInitProc ][ ?fieldWidth x_fieldWidth ][ ?fieldHeight x_fieldHeight ][ ?buttonFieldWidth x_buttonFieldWidth ][ ?promptWidth x_promptWidth ])=> g_cdfDataID / nil
functions.description: Creates a base-level CDF description for a cell. The CDF description is created with no parameters or simulation models.

functions.name: cdfCreateBaseLibCDF
functions.signature: cdfCreateBaseLibCDF(g_libID[ ?doneProc t_doneProc ][ ?formInitProc t_formInitProc ][ ?fieldWidth x_fieldWidth ][ ?fieldHeight x_fieldHeight ][ ?buttonFieldWidth x_buttonFieldWidth ][ ?promptWidth x_promptWidth ])=> g_cdfDataID / nil
functions.description: Creates the Base Library CDF that is applied to all the devices in the library. The CDF description is created with no parameters or simModels.

functions.name: cdfCreateParam
functions.signature: cdfCreateParam(g_cdfDataId[ ?name t_name ][ ?type t_type ][ ?defValue g_defValue ][ ?units t_units ][ ?parseAsNumber t_parseAsNumber ][ ?choices l_choices ][ ?prompt t_prompt ][ ?use t_use ][ ?display t_display ][ ?editable t_editable][ ?dontSave t_dontSave][ ?callback t_callback][ ?storeDefault t_storeDefault ][ ?parseAsCEL t_parseAsCEL ][ ?description t_description ])=> g_cdfDataId / nil
functions.description: Creates a parameter on the specified CDF database object with the specified attributes. The only attributes that are always required are the parameter's name and type. If this parameter description is not overriding an existing base-level parameter definition, you must also specify the default value.

functions.name: cdfCreateUserCellCDF
functions.signature: cdfCreateUserCellCDF(g_cellId[ ?doneProc t_doneProc ][ ?formInitProc t_formInitProc ][ ?fieldWidth x_fieldWidth ][ ?fieldHeight x_fieldHeight ][ ?buttonFieldWidth x_buttonFieldWidth ][ ?promptWidth x_promptWidth ])=> g_cdfDataId / nil
functions.description: Creates a user-level CDF description for a cell. The CDF description is created with no parameters or simulation models.

functions.name: cdfCreateUserLibCDF
functions.signature: cdfCreateUserLibCDF(g_libId[ ?doneProc t_doneProc ][ ?formInitProc t_formInitProc ][ ?fieldWidth x_fieldWidth ][ ?fieldHeight x_fieldHeight ][ ?buttonFieldWidth x_buttonFieldWidth ][ ?promptWidth x_promptWidth ])=> g_cdfDataId / nil
functions.description: Creates the user-level library CDF that is applied to all the devices in the library. The user-level CDF can override entries in the base-level CDF. Therefore, a combination of the base-level CDF and the user-level CDF becomes the effective CDF.

functions.name: cdfDeleteCDF
functions.description: Deletes a CDF description, including all attached parameters.

functions.name: cdfDeleteParam
functions.description: Deletes the specified CDF parameter.

functions.name: cdfDisableScaleFactorRetentionForZero
functions.description: Disables the unit scale factor retention for CDF parameters enabled using the cdfEnableScaleFactorRetentionForZero function.

functions.name: cdfDump
functions.signature: cdfDump(t_libNamet_fileName[ ?cellName t_cellName ][ ?level s_level ][ ?edit g_edit ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Dumps the CDF description for the specified library and cell into the given file. If a cell is not specified, then only the library CDF description is dumped. The file is created in the current working directory or the directory specified with the file name. If g_edit is t, a text editor window is automatically opened on t_fileName. The default is no editor.

functions.name: cdfDumpAll
functions.description: Dumps the CDF description for the specified library and all its cells into the given file. You can also specify the level of the CDF description by using the ?level s_level argument. The specified file is created in the current working directory or the directory specified with the filename.

functions.name: cdfEditScaleFactors
functions.description: Displays the Units Scaling Factors form which can be used to set scaling factors for displaying CDF parameters.

functions.name: cdfEnableScaleFactorRetentionForZero
functions.description: Lets you retain the unit scale factor for a CDF parameter if its specified default value is 0 followed by the scale factor. This is possible only when the scale factor for a unit type is set to auto.

functions.name: cdfFindParamByName
functions.description: Returns the parameter ID of the specified parameter name for the given CDF description, if it exists. If not, it returns nil.

functions.name: cdfFormatFloatString
functions.description: This function formats the input string into a value representation, if possible. It formats the input string using the input scale factor, re-converts the value to a string, and then returns the formatted string value. If the input string cannot be converted, the input string is returned with no change to it.

functions.name: cdfGetBaseCellCDF
functions.description: Returns the base-level CDF description attached to a cell. If one is not defined, it returns nil.

functions.name: cdfGetBaseLibCDF
functions.description: Returns the base-level CDF description attached to a library. If one is not defined, it returns nil.

functions.name: cdfGetCellCDF
functions.description: Returns the effective CDF description attached to a cell. If neither a base- nor user-level CDF description is defined for the cell or its library, it returns nil. The resulting CDF description represents the overlay of the user-level cell CDF on the base-level cell CDF on the user-level library CDF on the base-level library CDF.

functions.name: cdfGetCustomViaCDF
functions.description: Returns the effective CDF description associated with a custom via or returns nil. When the custom via's cell or library has a base or user-level CDF defined, it returns the g_cdfDataId, otherwise returns nil.

functions.name: cdfGetInstCDF
functions.description: Returns the effective CDF description associated with an instance.

functions.name: cdfGetLibCDF
functions.description: Returns the effective CDF description attached to a library. If neither a base- nor user-level CDF description is defined, it returns nil. The resulting CDF description represents the overlay of the user-level CDF on the base-level CDF.

functions.name: cdfGetUnitScaleFactor
functions.description: Displays the current scale factor for the specified unit.

functions.name: cdfGetUserCellCDF
functions.description: Returns the user-level CDF description attached to a cell. If one is not defined, it returns nil.

functions.name: cdfGetUserLibCDF
functions.description: Returns the user-level CDF description attached to a library. If one is not defined, it returns nil.

functions.name: cdfParseFloatString
functions.description: Uses the standard strtod (string to double) function to parse the input string. When the input string contains trailing non-numerical characters, the fragment of the string is compared against a supported set of scale factor designators.

functions.name: cdfRefreshCDF
functions.description: Updates the CDF structure in the memory for the specified library or cell Id with the contents stored on the hard disk. Returns nil if the CDF structures for the specified library and cell ID are not present in memory.

functions.name: cdfSaveCDF
functions.description: Saves a CDF description to disk. The CDF description is then read in every time you open the cell of the library to which the description is attached. You can save only base-level CDF descriptions.

functions.name: cdfSetUnitScaleFactor
functions.description: Sets the scale factor for the specified unit.

functions.name: cdfSyncInstParamValue
functions.description: This function generates all the CDF parameters for the first instance (d_instId1) and updates the second instance (d_instId2) with the same values. Both the instances must share the same cell.

functions.name: cdfUpdateCustomViaParam
functions.description: Stores the parameters specified in the effective cell CDF of the custom via in the specified custom via instance. When the specified ID is not for a customVia instance or the instance master does not have a CDF definition, it returns nil.

functions.name: cdfUpdateInstParam
functions.description: Stores the CDF parameters specified in the effective cell CDF of the instance master to the given instance. If a doneProc post-processing procedure is specified, the function runs this procedure to validate any updates to the instance. When the ID given is not for an instance or the instance master does not have CDF definition, it returns nil.

functions.name: cdfUpdateInstSingleParam
functions.description: Copies the specified parameter's effective value to the specified instance.

functions.name: cdr
functions.description: Returns the tail of the list, that is, the list without its first element.

functions.name: cdsFixedViaDefs
functions.description: Specifies the technology class to define the cds fixed viaDef.

functions.name: cdsGetInstPath
functions.description: Returns the absolute path of the Cadence installation directory as a string. cdsGetInstPath is for the cds root hierarchy and is meant to be used by all Virtuoso and non-Virtuoso applications.

functions.name: cdsGetNetlistMode
functions.description: Returns the value of the shell environment variable CDS_Netlisting_Mode that is set in the current shell to invoke Virtuoso.

functions.name: cdsGetToolsPath
functions.description: Returns the absolute path of the Cadence installation tools directory as a string after resolving the tools directory appropriately. This function is provided for multiple platform support mainly to simplify access to a common Cadence installation hierarchy for all Unix platforms.

functions.name: cdsName
functions.description: The cdsName function uses information about the instance currently being drawn in order to compute the data returned by the schematic editor during a redraw. Consequently, cdsName is only intended to be called as the value of an ILLabel on a symbol, and is not intended for direct evaluation during a program. If it is invoked directly, information on the current drawn instance will not be available. The cdsName will display label information, usually placed on the layer annotate drawing7, near the cell name or instance name.

functions.name: cdsNetExpr
functions.description: The cdsNetExpr function is used inside the ILLabel that is created using the Create - Net Expression command. This function uses information about the instance currently being drawn in order to compute the data returned by the schematic editor during a redraw. Consequently, cdsNetExpr is only intended to be called as the value of an ILLabel on a symbol, and is not intended for direct evaluation during a program. If it is invoked directly, information on the current drawn instance will not be available.

functions.name: cdsParam
functions.description: The cdsParam function displays label information, usually placed on the layer annotate drawing, about the parameter values or backannotated parameter values. This function uses information about the instance currently being drawn in order to compute the data returned by the schematic editor during a redraw. Consequently, cdsParam is only intended to be called as the value of an ILLabel on a symbol, and is not intended for direct evaluation during a program. If it is invoked directly, information on the current drawn instance will not be available.

functions.name: cdsPlat
functions.description: Returns the platform for the Cadence software that is currently running. The possible values are: sun4v, sol86, hppa, ibmrs, wint, lnx86, or lni64.

functions.name: cdsSetNetlistMode
functions.description: Sets netlisting mode, which is based on the current value of the SHELL environment variable CDS_Netlisting_Mode. The valid values for this shell environment variable are Digital, Analog, or Compatibility. The function cdsSetNetlistMode is used in the Virtuoso SKILL environment to update the settings without restarting Virtuoso.

functions.name: cdsTerm
functions.description: The function cdsTerm displays label information, usually placed on the layer annotate drawing8, near the pin or a net attached to the pin. It is also attached to a cell symbol view when you use the Add Symbol Label form, and the Annotation Setup Form is used to control the display of this label type.

functions.name: ceiling
functions.description: Returns the smallest integer not smaller than the given argument.

functions.name: centerBox
functions.description: Returns the center point of the given bounding box. The bounding box is not validated and is assumed to be correct.

functions.name: changeClass
functions.description: Changes the class of the given instance (g_inst) to the specified class (g_className).

functions.name: changeEnterFun
functions.signature: changeEnterFun(s_enterFun[ ?prompts l_promptList ][ ?points l_pointList ][ ?wantPoints x_pointLimit ][ ?form s_form ][ ?addPointProc t_addProcName ][ ?delPointProc t_delProcName ][ ?initProc t_initProcName ][ ?doneProc t_doneProcName ][ ?formProc t_formProcName ][ ?pathStyle t_pathStyle ][ ?cursor x_cursor ][ ?pathWidth f_pathWidth ][ ?beginExtent f_beginExtent ][ ?endExtent f_endExtent ][ ?dontDraw g_dontDraw ][ ?alwaysMap g_alwaysMap ][ ?acceptString g_acceptString ][ ?acceptNumber g_acceptNumber ][ ?noInfix g_noInfix ][ ?cmdName t_cmdName ][ ?target l_point ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Since this function uses the current window to determine which enterfunction to change, make sure to properly set the current window before using this function. See hiSetCurrentWindow for information about setting the current window.

functions.name: changeNextEnterFun
functions.description: If an enterfunction is currently active, sets a flag that causes the next enterfunction invocation for the current window or a specified window to use the changeEnterFun logic rather than being nested.

functions.name: changeWorkingDir
functions.description: Changes the working directory to the specified working directory.

functions.name: charToInt
functions.description: Returns the ASCII code of the first character of the given symbol. In SKILL, a single character symbol can be used as a character value.

functions.name: checkContextBit
functions.description: Checks and returns the context type of the specified context file.

functions.name: ciAPRCascodeIterator
functions.description: Iterator for advanced place and route cascoded structures.

functions.name: ciAPRDIDeviceGroupIterator
functions.description: Runs an iterator to identify advanced place and route Design Intent structures in the specified design.

functions.name: ciAPRDINetIterator
functions.description: Iterates through all nets that are associated with an APR Net Design Intent in the cellview. The iterator expression is the APR Net DI profile name, for example, APR Net Shielding.

functions.name: ciAPRXYInstSymmetricIterator
functions.description: Evaluates the finderExpr with the current symmetric pair of objects with common source or drain terminal names that are assigned to L and R local variables. This iterator is customized for the Auto-Device Placement and Routing flow and is used by the Circuit Prospector ADA finders to iterate over all symmetric design instance pairs with common source or drain terminal names, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

functions.name: ciActiveSameCellAndSizeIterator
functions.description: Returns a list of devices where each sub-list corresponds to two or more active devices that have the same cell and size in the cellview. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, the device is ignored.

functions.name: ciAddHierarchicalNotes
functions.description: Adds notes to the templates and constraints for a single cellview or all along the hierarchy beginning from the given cellview.

functions.name: ciAddLeadingSlash
functions.description: Adds a forward slash (/) to the beginning of the passed string if it does not already have one.

functions.name: ciAddProcessRules
functions.description: Adds the specified process rules to the front of the rules associated with the given object.

functions.name: ciAddRuleGroup
functions.description: Creates an oaConstraint group, with a given name, for technology or design files.

functions.name: ciAddStructArg
functions.description: Adds a new constraint generator argument to the list of existing arguments registered for the passed structType. By default, the argument is appended to the current list of arguments for the structType. Optionally, the new argument can be inserted after the end of the argument or after a existing argument name.

functions.name: ciAddTrailingSlash
functions.description: Adds a forward slash (/) to the end of the passed string if it does not already have one.

functions.name: ciAlignPinsOnCellSide
functions.description: Generates alignment constraints for pins on the same side.

functions.name: ciAllCellViewsInHierarchy
functions.signature: ciAllCellViewsInHierarchy(d_cellViewDBId[ t_pathToCurrentCellView ][ t_pathFilter ][ t_depth ][ s_predicate ])=> list / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of disembodied property lists containing the path and database ID of each cellview in the hierarchy, or to a specific depth starting from a given cellview and path to that cellview.

functions.name: ciAxisCreate
functions.description: Creates a new axis.

functions.name: ciAxisDelete
functions.description: Deletes an axis from the specified cache.

functions.name: ciAxisExists
functions.description: Returns t (true) if the named axis exists in the cache. Access to axes is only provided through the axis name. No direct reference to an axis object is provided.

functions.name: ciAxisListCon
functions.description: Lists all the constraints that are attached to a given axis.

functions.name: ciAxisListParams
functions.description: Lists the parameters associated with an axis.

functions.name: ciAxisReplaceParams
functions.description: Replaces all axis constraint parameters with a new set of parameters.

functions.name: ciBasicGetParamValue
functions.description: This API is similar to ciGetParamValue, except it does not evaluate iPar or pPar expressions. It gets the parameter value of the user defined parameter. The user-defined parameter was mapped to its PDK names by the ciMapParam function.

functions.name: ciBlockResistorArrayIterator
functions.description: Iterates over all resistor devices in the cellview based on the result of evaluating the passed or matched expression. This function is used by the Block Resistor Array finder of the Circuit Prospector assistant.

functions.name: ciBuildModgenParams
functions.description: Creates modgen parameter and member list. This is a utility function.

functions.name: ciBundleSignalsIterator
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant to iterate over all named bundle and bus nets. It returns the list of corresponding signals. The signals are grouped according to the result of the match expression. If the match expression evaluates to nil the signal list is ignored.

functions.name: ciCPRegistrationFromLAM
functions.description: Used in conjunction with ciGetLAMComponentTypes to create a string containing ci registration function calls to register the device, terminal, and parameter mappings specified in a cph.lam file associated with a particular PDK. The device and terminal registrations are needed for the Circuit Prospector finders, iterators, and generators to function with the selected PDK. The returned string can either be evaluated using evalstring() to call the ci registration functions, or the string can be printed out using printf so that the ci registration calls can be placed in a file loaded by the libInit.il file of the PDK.

functions.name: ciCacheCallbackRegister
functions.description: Registers a callback.

functions.name: ciCacheCallbackUnregister
functions.description: Unregisters a previously registered callback.

functions.name: ciCacheCallbackUpdate
functions.description: Updates a registered callback.

functions.name: ciCacheCellName
functions.description: Returns the cell name of the specified constraint cache. The cache library, cell, and view refers to the schematic, configuration, physical configuration, or layout view that the constraint cache is associated with.

functions.name: ciCacheConstraintCellName
functions.description: Returns the constraint cell name of the specified constraint cache. The constraint library, cell, and view refers to the storage location of the constraints, which might be a constraint view or layout.

functions.name: ciCacheConstraintLibName
functions.description: Returns the constraint library name of the specified constraint cache. The constraint library, cell, and view refers to the storage location of the constraints, which might be a constraint view or layout.

functions.name: ciCacheConstraintViewName
functions.description: Returns the constraint view name of the specified constraint cache. The constraint library, cell, and view refers to the storage location of the constraints, which might be a constraint view or layout.

functions.name: ciCacheDiscardEdits
functions.description: Discards changes made to the constraint cache in the memory and returns a new constraint cache ID. This function does not apply to layout constraint caches.

functions.name: ciCacheFind
functions.signature: ciCacheFind(d_dbCellViewId | t_libName t_cellName t_viewName)=> u_cache / nil
functions.description: Finds an existing constraint cache for a given design specified using library, cell, and view names. Alternatively, pass the dbCellViewId of the required design.

functions.name: ciCacheGet
functions.signature: ciCacheGet(d_dbCellViewId | t_libName t_cellName t_viewName)=> u_cache / nil
functions.description: Finds an existing constraint cache. If it cannot find an existing cache, it creates and populates a cache for the given design, using library, cell, and view names. Alternatively, pass the dbCellViewId of the required design.

functions.name: ciCacheGetAllNetNames
functions.description: Returns a sorted list of all the net names in the cellview associated with the constraints cache. By default, the iterated net names are expanded.

functions.name: ciCacheGetCellView
functions.description: Returns the cellview associated to the specified cache.

functions.name: ciCacheGetEnabledNotifications
functions.description: Returns a list of cache notifications that ciCacheNotifications enabled.

functions.name: ciCacheIsLayout
functions.description: Returns t if the passed cache is a layout cache.

functions.name: ciCacheIsModified
functions.description: Checks whether a constraint cache has been modified.

functions.name: ciCacheIsWritable
functions.description: Checks whether a constraint cache is writable.

functions.name: ciCacheLCV
functions.description: Returns a list containing the library, cell, and view names of the specified constraint cache. The cache library, cell, and view refers to the schematic, configuration, physical configuration, or layout view that the constraint cache is associated with.

functions.name: ciCacheLibName
functions.description: Returns the library name of the specified constraint cache. The cache library, cell, and view refers to the schematic, configuration, physical configuration, or layout view that the constraint cache is associated with.

functions.name: ciCacheListAxesNames
functions.description: Lists all axes names in a cache. Access to axes is only provided through the axis name, no direct reference to an axis object is provided.

functions.name: ciCacheListCon
functions.description: Lists all the constraints from a given cache.

functions.name: ciCacheListConstrainedObjectNames
functions.description: Lists the names of the constrained objects (without the type of object).

functions.name: ciCacheListConstrainedObjects
functions.description: Lists the name and type of all constrained objects.

functions.name: ciCacheListTemplates
functions.description: Lists all templates, of an optional given type, from a cache.

functions.name: ciCacheListTypeNames
functions.description: Lists all the names of the constraint types that are legal for the given cache.

functions.name: ciCacheListTypes
functions.description: Lists all constraint types in a cache.

functions.name: ciCacheMakeEditable
functions.description: Reopens the constraint cache for edit and returns a new constraint cache ID. This function does not apply to layout constraint caches.

functions.name: ciCacheMakeReadOnly
functions.description: Reopens the constraint cache in read-only mode and returns a new constraint cache ID. Any in modifications to the memory are discarded. This function does not apply to layout constraint caches.

functions.name: ciCacheNeedRefresh
functions.description: Checks if the constraint cache has changed on the disk and needs to be refreshed.

functions.name: ciCacheNotifications
functions.description: Enables or disables notifications related to the constraint cache. This function helps CAD teams in debugging.

functions.name: ciCachePurge
functions.description: Purges a constraint cellview from virtual memory.

functions.name: ciCacheSave
functions.description: Saves a constraint cellview.

functions.name: ciCacheTopCellName
functions.description: Returns the top cell name of the specified constraint cache. The top library, cell, and view refers to the schematic or layout cellview. If the cache is associated with a configuration or physical configuration, it is the top cell specified by the configuration.

functions.name: ciCacheTopLibName
functions.description: Returns the top library name of the specified constraint cache. The top library, cell, and view refers to the schematic or layout cellview. If the cache is associated with a configuration or physical configuration, it is the top cell specified by the configuration.

functions.name: ciCacheTopViewName
functions.description: Returns the top view name of the specified constraint cache. The top library, cell, and view refers to the schematic or layout cellview. If the cache is associated with a configuration or physical configuration, it is the top cell specified by the configuration.

functions.name: ciCacheTransfer
functions.description: Transfers constraints from the source cache to the specified target cache. The transfer can be restricted to constraints of a specified type. It cannot be used to transfer constraints between two schematics or two layouts.Note: Before you run ciCacheTransfer, ensure that the schematic and layout windows are open in XL or a higher tier.

functions.name: ciCacheTransferSelection
functions.description: Transfers the selected constraints and templates from the source cache to the target cache in a session run in XL or above tier. If there are no selected constraints in the source cache, all the constraints and templates from the source cache are transferred to an editable target cache. When a constraint is transferred, the template within which it exists is also transferred along with all the other constraints inside the template.Note: Before you run ciCacheTransferSelection, ensure that the schematic and layout windows are open in XL or above tier. The Constraint Manager assistant should also be open in the window from where the constraints need to be transferred.

functions.name: ciCacheViewName
functions.description: Returns the view name of the specified constraint cache. The cache library, cell, and view refers to the schematic, configuration, physical configuration, or layout view that the constraint cache is associated with.

functions.name: ciCachep
functions.description: Checks if an object is a valid constraint cache ID.

functions.name: ciCanCGBeUsed
functions.description: The default callback used by ciSetCMCGSKILLCallbacks when no user-defined function has been specified for determining if a constraint group should be used or not.

functions.name: ciCascodeSeriesCurrentMirrorIterator
functions.description: Returns a list of corresponding devices that match cascode series current mirror structures in the cellview. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, the structures are ignored.

functions.name: ciCategoryListFinderNames
functions.description: Lists all the finder names for a given category in Circuit Prospector.

functions.name: ciCheckConstraints
functions.description: Runs the constraint checker on the passed schematic or layout cellview if the cellview contains constraints.

functions.name: ciCheckDINetHierConsistency
functions.description: Checks that the propagated design intent is consistent with the reference design intent for the selected nets. If no nets are selected, consistency is checked for all nets in the current cellview. Warns about mismatches in profile property values for Design Intent on the same net through the hierarchy or if the Design Intent is missing on a net at a particular level in the hierarchy. The basis for the comparison can be one of the following:

functions.name: ciClearNetSuperTypes
functions.description: Clears all registered net super-types.

functions.name: ciClusterBoundaryForCluster
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set a Cluster Boundary constraint to an existing Cluster constraint. The flexibleFlag parameter of the Cluster Boundary is set to 1 (true).

functions.name: ciCollectDeviceInfo
functions.signature: ciCollectDeviceInfo(g_cachel_devices[ ?devParamNames l_devParamNames ][ ?devTerminalNames l_devTerminalNames ][ ?warnParamUnfound g_warnParamUnfound ][ ?warnUnmapped g_warnUnmapped ][ ?parents g_parents ])=> devs
functions.description: Returns a disembodied property list containing information collected about the passed devices in the generators instsNetsPins list.

functions.name: ciCombineInstNetsPins
functions.description: This function is used within Circuit Prospector constraint generator expressions to turn a list of sub-lists into a single simple list. When the instsNetsPins information is represented as a list of sub-lists there is one sub-list each for instances, nets, pins, and instTerms. In addition, this function effectively flattens the sub-lists to leave a combined list of all the instances, nets, pins, and instTerms without sub-lists. The flattened list is in a form suitable to be used as the member list for ciConCreate.

functions.name: ciCommonGateAndSourceIterator
functions.description: Returns a list of corresponding devices that match the common gate and source structures in the cellview. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, the structures are ignored.

functions.name: ciCommonGateIterator
functions.description: Returns a list of corresponding devices that match the common gate structures in the cellview. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, the structures are ignored.

functions.name: ciCommonSourceIterator
functions.description: Returns a list of corresponding devices that match the common source structures in the cellview. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, the structures are ignored.

functions.name: ciConAppendOneMember
functions.description: Appends one constraint member to the given contstraint. The new member is added in the last position in the member list.

functions.name: ciConBaseName
functions.description: Extracts and returns the basename from the specified constraint name. A constraint name consists of the basename and the counter added as a suffix. For example, in the constraint name, myConstraint_2, the basename is myConstraint and the counter is _2.

functions.name: ciConCallbackIsRegistered
functions.description: Checks whether a constraint callback has been registered.See also ciConRegisterCallback, ciConUnregisterCallback, and ciConUpdateCallback.

functions.name: ciConCreate
functions.signature: ciConCreate(u_cached_constraintType[ ?members l_memberList ][ ?params l_parameterList ][ ?name g_constraintName ][ ?axis g_axisName ][ ?note g_constraintNote ][ ?verbose g_verbose ])=> u_constraint / nil
functions.description: Creates a new constraint.

functions.name: ciConCreateExpanded
functions.signature: ciConCreateExpanded(u_cached_constraintType[ ?members l_memberList][ ?params l_parameterList ][ ?name t_constraintName ][ ?axis t_axisName ][ ?note g_constraintNote ][ ?verbose g_verbose ])=> l_constraints / nil
functions.description: Expands vector names into groups of vector bit names in a constraint specific manner (when a constraint's member list contains vector names). Constraints are then created for each vector bit name grouping.

functions.name: ciConDelete
functions.description: Deletes a constraint. After deleting the constraint, the u_constraint will be invalid.

functions.name: ciConDeleteAll
functions.description: Deletes the specified constraints in a cellview.

functions.name: ciConFind
functions.description: Finds a constraint in a given cache.

functions.name: ciConGetAxisName
functions.description: Returns, for a given constraint, the axis name if one is associated with the given constraint.

functions.name: ciConGetCache
functions.description: Returns the constraint cache that contains the given constraint.

functions.name: ciConGetComment
functions.description: Returns the comment parameter of a constraint.

functions.name: ciConGetCreatedTime
functions.description: Returns the created time of a constraint.

functions.name: ciConGetMembersOfType
functions.description: Returns the constraint member list filtered by the passed member type.

functions.name: ciConGetName
functions.description: Returns the name of a constraint.

functions.name: ciConGetNote
functions.description: Returns the note parameter of a constraint.

functions.name: ciConGetOwner
functions.description: Returns the library name, cell name, and view name of the cell where the passed constraint was created.

functions.name: ciConGetPriority
functions.description: Returns the priority value of a constraint.

functions.name: ciConGetStatus
functions.description: Returns the status of a constraint.

functions.name: ciConGetType
functions.description: Returns the constraint type symbol.

functions.name: ciConIsInContext
functions.description: Returns the current context status of a constraint. A constraint is in context if all its members are in the database. For example, a net member can become out of context if the net is deleted from the database.

functions.name: ciConIsOutOfContext
functions.description: Returns the current context status of a constraint. A constraint is out of context if one or more of its members are not in the database. For example, a net member can become out of context if the net is deleted from the database.

functions.name: ciConIsOverridden
functions.description: Returns whether a constraint has been overridden.

functions.name: ciConIsWritable
functions.description: Returns whether the constraint is writable.

functions.name: ciConListMemberNames
functions.description: Returns a list of strings where each string is a constraint member name. This function will only return member names as opposed to ciConListMembers which returns tuples containing member names and types.

functions.name: ciConListMembers
functions.description: Returns a list of constraint members and their member parameters, if any.

functions.name: ciConListParamNames
functions.description: Returns the legal parameter names for a given constraint.

functions.name: ciConListParams
functions.description: Returns all parameters for a constraint.

functions.name: ciConListTemplates
functions.description: Returns the list of templates of which the given constraint is a member.

functions.name: ciConRegisterCallback
functions.description: Registers a constraint callback.See also ciConCallbackIsRegistered, ciConUnregisterCallback, and ciConUpdateCallback.

functions.name: ciConRemoveMembers
functions.description: Removes a list of members from a constraint.

functions.name: ciConResetAllParams
functions.description: Resets all parameters on a constraint to their default values. Parameters can only be reset if the constraint view is currently writable.

functions.name: ciConResetParams
functions.description: Resets a list of parameters to their default values.

functions.name: ciConSetAxis
functions.description: Associates a given constraint with the named axis. If the constraint does not accept an axis, nil is returned, and if the axis does not exist it will be created.

functions.name: ciConSetNote
functions.description: Replaces the note parameter of a constraint.

functions.name: ciConSetPriority
functions.description: Sets the priority for a constraint.

functions.name: ciConSetStatus
functions.description: Sets a given status flag for a constraint.

functions.name: ciConTypeHasNamedParameter
functions.description: Returns t if the passed constraint type has a parameter with a name matching the passed parameter name.

functions.name: ciConUnregisterCallback
functions.description: Unregisters a constraint callback.See also ciConCallbackIsRegistered, ciConRegisterCallback, and ciConUpdateCallback.

functions.name: ciConUpdateCallback
functions.signature: ciConUpdateCallback(?name t_name?type t_type[ ?enabled g_enabled ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Enables or disables a constraint callback.See also ciConCallbackIsRegistered, ciConRegisterCallback, and ciConUnregisterCallback.

functions.name: ciConUpdateMemberParams
functions.description: Updates the specified constraint member parameters with the given values without impacting other member parameters.

functions.name: ciConUpdateMembers
functions.description: Used to update members and their parameters by replacing the members with the list contained in l_memberList.

functions.name: ciConUpdateParams
functions.description: Updates parameter values with those values listed in l_parameterList.

functions.name: ciConUprevCellBoundary
functions.description: Converts deprecated boundaryArea and areaUtilization constraints to cellBoundary constraints.

functions.name: ciConVerify
functions.signature: ciConVerify({ u_cache [ d_constraintType ] } | { u_constraint })=> t / nil
functions.description: Runs the consistency checker on demand. The behavior of the consistency checker is based on the values provided for each argument.

functions.name: ciConp
functions.description: Checks if an object is a valid constraint ID.

functions.name: ciConstraintLCV
functions.description: Returns a list containing the library, cell, and view names of the specified constraint cache. The constraint library, cell, and view refers to the storage location of the constraints, which may be a constraint view or layout.

functions.name: ciConstraintViewLessp
functions.description: Specifies a predicate function for sorting the constraint caches based on their library, cell, and view names.

functions.name: ciConstraintsForType
functions.description: Filters the list of constraints and returns the constraints of the specified type.

functions.name: ciConvertNestedNetClassToNetClassHierGroup
functions.description: Converts one or all nested Net Class constraints in a cache to corresponding Net Class Hier Group constraints. The name, members, and parameters of the original nested Net Class constraint remain the same after the conversion.

functions.name: ciConvertParamsDPLToParams
functions.description: Converts a disembodied property list of parameter names and values into the list format required for specifying constraint parameters and constraint member parameters. This function is the complement of ciConvertParamsToDPL.

functions.name: ciConvertParamsToDPL
functions.description: Converts a constraint parameter list into a disembodied property list of parameter names and values. This function is the complement of ciConvertParamsDPLToParams. Converting the parameter list into a DPL makes it easier to change values in the list.

functions.name: ciConvertToConArg
functions.description: Converts a GUI-friendly parameter name (which can contain spaces) into a legal constraint parameter name (must not contain spaces).

functions.name: ciCreateFilter
functions.description: Defines a filter to show/hide constraints in the Constraint Manager.

functions.name: ciCreateGuardRing
functions.description: Default function used by the Rapid Analog Prototype constraint generators for creating guard rings. If the modgen is already associated with a guard ring, ciCreateGuardRing updates the parameters of the existing guard ring.

functions.name: ciCreateModgen
functions.description: A constraint generation utility function, which simplifies the process of generating modgens for specified structure types. This function calls expressions to create the modgen device pattern and guard ring that have been pre-registered for the specified structure type. For example, DiffPair and CurrentMirror.

functions.name: ciCreateModgenDummy
functions.description: A utility function for creating a modgen member parameter for specifying a dummy device.

functions.name: ciCreateModgenForStructure
functions.description: A function performs the same basic function as ciCreateModgen, but does not have the createModgenTemplate argument.

functions.name: ciCreateRoutePriorityCon
functions.description: Used by Circuit Prospector constraint generators to generate routing priority constraints.

functions.name: ciCreateRoutingLayerEnumString
functions.description: Utility function for creating layer name enums, which will retrieve the list of layer names from the technology file and make layerNumber the default by adding the associated layer name to the end of the list.

functions.name: ciCurrentPathIterator
functions.description: Finds the current path structure in Circuit Prospector. It is an iterator function that does not support hierarchy.

functions.name: ciDIGetRegisteredIgnoredTerminals
functions.description: Returns the list of terminals that have been registered to be ignored when creating a design intent.

functions.name: ciDIHierConsistencyCheck
functions.description: Runs the design intent consistency checks in the selected cellview.

functions.name: ciDIHierPushDown
functions.description: Pushes the selected net or HighCurrent design intent down the hierarchy. You can choose whether to replace or update any existing design intent at the lower level.

functions.name: ciDIHierPushDownDIWithPaths
functions.description: Pushes the selected nets or HighCurrent design intents down the hierarchy. You can use the hierarchy path to specify multiple nets or design intents. You can choose whether to replace or update any existing design intents at the lower level.

functions.name: ciDIHierPushUp
functions.description: Pushes the selected net or HighCurrent design intent to the top of the hierarchy. You need to descend edit into the design and select a design intent to push from that level to the top of the hierarchy.

functions.name: ciDIHierPushUpDIWithPaths
functions.description: Pushes the selected nets or HighCurrent design intents to the top of the hierarchy. You need to descend edit into the design and select a design intent to push from that level to the top of the hierarchy. You can also use the hierarchy path to specify multiple nets or design intents.

functions.name: ciDIRegisterIgnoredTerminals
functions.description: Registers a list of terminals per master cellview that should be ignored when creating a design intent. Bulk terminals are always ignored regardless of the registration status of the terminals. Ignoring terminals when creating design intent is useful when some terminals exist in the schematic but not in the layout.

functions.name: ciDefaultParamToMatchFilter
functions.description: The function for the default filter in the Match Subset Editor.

functions.name: ciDeleteClusterMembersWithinModgens
functions.description: A utility function for removing devices from cluster constraints if those devices are also members of a modgen.

functions.name: ciDeleteGuardRing
functions.description: If the passed modgen constraint has a Guard Ring constraint associated with it then delete it.

functions.name: ciDeleteModgenTopologies
functions.description: Deletes the database topology objects associated with the specified modgen along with the constraints on those topology objects.See also ciSetModgenTopology for an example of how to create database topology objects for a modgen.

functions.name: ciDeleteRuleGroup
functions.description: Deletes a constraint group.

functions.name: ciDeleteStructArg
functions.description: Deletes the named argument from the registered argument list for the passed structType. See also, ciGetStructArgs, ciSetStructArgs, ciRegexReplaceStructArgs, ciAddStructArg, ciReplaceStructArg, and ciGetStructArg.

functions.name: ciDeleteSymmetriesWithinModgens
functions.description: Removes the devices from symmetry constraints if those devices are also members of a modgen.

functions.name: ciDeleteUnreferencedObjects
functions.description: Deletes the unreferenced objects.When a design contains unreferenced objects and you try to create contraints in it, the constraints might be out-of-context. In such a scenario, use this function before you start to create the constraints.

functions.name: ciDesignLCV
functions.description: Returns a list containing the library, cell, and view names of the specified constraint cache. The design library, cell, and view refers to the schematic or layout cellview. If the cache is associated with a configuration or physical configuration, it is the top cell specified by the configuration.

functions.name: ciDevGroupBoxIterator
functions.description: Iterates all device groups within a cellview that are enclosed by a text box.

functions.name: ciDeviceInfoGetRegisteredParams
functions.description: Returns the parameters registered for the specified device type.

functions.name: ciDeviceInfoGetRegisteredTerminals
functions.description: Returns the terminals registered for the specified device type.

functions.name: ciDeviceInfoRegisterParams
functions.signature: ciDeviceInfoRegisterParams({ t_deviceTypeName | 'default | nil }[ (t_paramName ... t_paramNameN) | 'default | '(nil) ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Registers or unregisters parameters for a device type, such as bjt, mos, and so on.

functions.name: ciDeviceInfoRegisterTerminals
functions.signature: ciDeviceInfoRegisterTerminals({ t_deviceTypeName | 'default | nil }[ (t_terminalName ... t_terminalNameN) | 'default | '(nil) ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Registers or unregisters terminals for a device type, such as bjt, mos, and so on.

functions.name: ciDeviceInfoRegistry
functions.description: Returns the registry where information about all the device types is stored. This registry is used by ciCollectDeviceInfo.

functions.name: ciDeviceInfoRestoreDefaultParamNames
functions.description: Restores device parameters to default parameters.

functions.name: ciDeviceInfoRestoreDefaultTerminalNames
functions.description: Restores device terminals to default terminals.

functions.name: ciDeviceInfoTerminalsAreValid
functions.description: Checks whether the specified device terminals are valid inputs for ciCollectDeviceInfo.

functions.name: ciDiMinMaxVPropertyCallback
functions.description: Runs a callback to check that customized property definitions using minimum and maximum voltage property values are set correctly so that Min Voltage is less than or equal to Max Voltage. When these properties are set incorrectly in the Create Design Intent form or Edit Design Intent form, the properties are highlighted and the form is prevented from closing until the values are corrected.

functions.name: ciDiPostTransferHighCurrent
functions.description: Runs a callback to enslure that when a customized HighCurrent design intent is transferred from Schematics XL to Layout XL, the current is split evenly between the mfactored members in Layout XL. This function is specified using the postTransferCallback for the HighCurrent design intent properties.

functions.name: ciDiPostTransferMinMaxVoltage
functions.description: Runs a callback to propagate the design intent properties Min Voltage, Max Voltage, Signal Type, Power Sensitivity, and Ground Sensitivity on the associated design intent objects after transfer from schematic to layout.

functions.name: ciDiReplaceOrAddPropertyGroupDef
functions.description: Adds or replaces customized design intent property group definitions.

functions.name: ciDiReportGenReport
functions.signature: ciDiReportGenReport([ ?cv d_cellviewID ][ ?depth x_depth ][ ?title t_reportName ][ ?path t_path ][ ?launch { t | nil } ][ ?date t_reportDate ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Generates a report summarizing the design intent in the current design based on the specified criteria and optionally opens the report in the browser.

functions.name: ciEnableAssistant
functions.description: Enables or disables a Circuit Prospector assistant (category) so that it is visible/not visible in the list of Circuit Prospector categories.

functions.name: ciEnableAutoConstraintNotes
functions.description: Provides an API alternative that allows you to enable or disable auto constraint notes.

functions.name: ciEvaluateGeneratorArgs
functions.description: Evaluates the specified constraint generator argument values.

functions.name: ciExpandAndRepeatName
functions.description: Expands iterated device names and repeats the expanded name the required number of times. The repetition is necessary where the iterated device is also M factored.

functions.name: ciExpandIteratedDeviceInfo
functions.description: Expands any iterated device names in a device information list returned by ciCollectDeviceInfo.

functions.name: ciExpandMembers
functions.description: Expands any iterated or repeated member in the passed member list. For example, MN1<0:2> gets expanded to MN1<0>, MN1<1>, and MN1<2>.In the case of net repetitions, such as <*3>inp, by default these get expanded N times as inp, inp, inp. However, if the optional compress argument is set to t, then <*3>inp will be expanded to just inp. The same applies to net bundles that contain repetitions, such as <*3>inp, a, b, c, inp, inp will by default be expanded to inp, inp, inp, a, b, c, inp, inp but with compress set to t will be expanded to inp, a, b, c.

functions.name: ciExpandName
functions.description: This function is used within constraint generators to expand iterated, repeated, and bundled names for instances, nets, and pins into a list of individual bit names. This is necessary if these names are to be used in calls to ciConCreate().As an alternative to calling ciExpandName() and prior to calling ciConCreate(), call ciConCreateExpanded(), which does a default expansion of the iterated, repeated, and bundled names.

functions.name: ciExtractRowNumber
functions.description: Extracts the row number from a string of the form row followed by a rowNumber.

functions.name: ciFindConsWithDuplicateMembers
functions.description: Finds constraints with duplicate members and displays them in a list.

functions.name: ciFindDeviceArraysForDev
functions.description: This function is used for extracting the list of devices which have the same master and are connected in series or parallel chains. This can be used to identify series/parallel resistors/capacitors. The bulk connections of these devices are ignored.

functions.name: ciFindObjectInHier
functions.description: Finds the database ID of the specified hierarchical object. This function is used by Circuit Prospector constraint generators.

functions.name: ciFindOpenCellView
functions.description: Returns the open constraint cache for the library, cell, view, and constraint view. If the constraint cache is not already open, this SKILL function returns nil.See also ciCacheFind that finds the constraint cache based on the constraint viewNameList.See also ciFindOpenCellViews that allows a wider range of criteria to be matched.

functions.name: ciFindOpenCellViews
functions.signature: ciFindOpenCellViews([ ?cacheLib t_cacheLib ][ ?cacheCell t_cacheCell ][ ?cacheView t_cacheView ][ ?designLib t_designLib ][ ?designCell t_designCell ][ ?designView t_designView ][ ?constraintLib t_constraintLib ][ ?constraintCell t_constraintCell ][ ?constraintView t_constraintView ])=> l_cacheIds / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of open constraint caches that match the criteria specified by the optional keyed arguments. A constraint cache can be associated with the following three views:1. The cache library, cell, and view refers to the schematic, configuration, physical configuration, or layout view that the constraint cache is associated with.2. The design library, cell, and view refers to the schematic or layout cellview. If the cache is associated with a configuration or physical configuration, it is the top cell specified by the configuration.3. The constraint library, cell, and view refers to the storage location of the constraints, which can be a constraint view or layout.

functions.name: ciGUIArgsToConArgs
functions.description: A simple wrapper around ciConvertToConArg for converting disembodied property lists of GUI args to a list of list of lists where each sublist is a constraint parameter list.

functions.name: ciGenerateArrayChannelDesc
functions.description: Generates the Pin To Trunk routing information for Passive Device Array structures. This function is called as part of the constraint generation process in the routing expression for Passive Device Array structures which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('PassiveDeviceArray ...).

functions.name: ciGenerateBestFitPattern
functions.description: Generates the modgen member pattern (interdigitation) information for a Passive Device Array structure. This function is called as part of the constraint generation process in the pattern expression for Passive Device Array structures that are registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('PassiveDeviceArray ...).

functions.name: ciGenerateCascodedCurrentMirrorChannelDesc
functions.description: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the Pin To Trunk routing information for a Cascoded Current Mirror structure. This function is called in the routing expression for Cascoded Current Mirrors structures which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('CascodedCurrentMirror ...).

functions.name: ciGenerateCascodedCurrentMirrorPattern
functions.description: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the modgen member pattern (interdigitation) information for a Cascoded Current Mirror structure. This function is called in the pattern expression for Cascoded Current Mirror structures which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('CascodedCurrentMirror ...).

functions.name: ciGenerateConstraintGroup
functions.description: The default constraint group generation callback used by ciSetCMCGSKILLCallbacks when no user-defined function has been specified.

functions.name: ciGenerateCurrentMirrorChannelDesc
functions.description: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the Pin To Trunk routing information for a Current Mirror structure. This function is called in the routing expression for Current Mirror structures, which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('CurrentMirror ...).

functions.name: ciGenerateCurrentMirrorPattern
functions.description: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the modgen member pattern (interdigitation) information for a Current Mirror structure. This function is called in the pattern expression for Current Mirror structures, which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('CurrentMirror ...).

functions.name: ciGenerateDiffPairChannelDesc
functions.description: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the Pin To Trunk routing information for a Diff Pair structure. This function is called in the routing expression for Diff Pair structures, which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('DiffPair ...).

functions.name: ciGenerateDiffPairPattern
functions.description: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the modgen member pattern (interdigitation) information for a Differential Pair structure. This function is called in the pattern expression for Differential Pair structures, which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('DiffPair ...).

functions.name: ciGenerateLargeMfactorPattern
functions.description: This function is called as part of the constraint generation process and generates the modgen member pattern (interdigitation) information for a Large Mfactor structure. This function is called in the pattern expression for Large Mfactor structures, which is registered by ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions('LargeMfactor ...).

functions.name: ciGeneratorCheckInstsNetsPinsInstTerms
functions.description: Checks whether the constraint generator has been called with the expected number of instances, nets, pins, and instTerms. This function is used within the constraint generators. If a wrong number of instances, nets, pins, or instTerms have been provided then a warning message will be displayed in the CIW.

functions.name: ciGeneratorForInstSymmetry
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector constraint generators to generate instance symmetry constraints.

functions.name: ciGeneratorForNetSymmetry
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector constraint generators to generate net symmetry constraints.

functions.name: ciGetAction
functions.description: Returns a disembodied property list (DPL) of attributes associated with the specified action name. This function is an alias for the ciGetGenerator function. The purpose of this alias is to emphasize the fact that constraint generator SKILL expressions can do everything possible in SKILL and not just create constraints.

functions.name: ciGetCPSelectedResults
functions.description: Returns a list of finder results selected in Circuit Prospector. Each item in the list is a finder result which contains the list of devices and the finder name.

functions.name: ciGetCellTermDefaultNetName
functions.description: Returns the default net name registered with a terminal for the cell name and terminal name that is passed.

functions.name: ciGetCellView
functions.signature: ciGetCellView([ ?window d_window ][ ?findOnly g_findOnly ][ @rest rest ])=> u_cache / nil
functions.description: Returns the constraint cellview associated with a schematic or layout window.

functions.name: ciGetCellViewForObjectPath
functions.description: Retrieves the cellview ID from the specified path to an object. This function is used within constraint generators.

functions.name: ciGetConnectedInsts
functions.description: Finds the instances to which all the nets in a constraint are connected and the corresponding connecting nets on which the constraint can be propagated.

functions.name: ciGetConstraintGroupsEnum
functions.description: Returns a string to be used as an enum variable for selecting the default constraint group to be used by the Pin to Trunk router. The result can be used as the value of an argument for a constraint generator. The resulting enum variable is the same as the one used by the Pin to Trunk GUI of the Modgen Pattern Editor. Consistent with the Modgen Pattern Editor, it sets the default to virtuosoDefaultSetup if that choice is available.

functions.name: ciGetCustomFilterNames
functions.description: Returns a list of registered custom filters (including the Default filter) for the Match Subset Editor.

functions.name: ciGetDefaultNetName
functions.description: Returns the default net name registered with a terminal by specifying and an instance ID and a terminal name.

functions.name: ciGetDeviceBulkTermName
functions.description: Returns the name of the bulk terminal for the passed device.

functions.name: ciGetDeviceInfo
functions.description: Returns the disembodied property list (DPL) associated with a particular device type.

functions.name: ciGetDeviceNames
functions.description: Returns all devices registered to the user-defined device name.

functions.name: ciGetDeviceTermName
functions.description: Returns the terminal name of a device based on the device database ID and the user-defined parameter termName.

functions.name: ciGetFinder
functions.description: Returns a disembodied property list (DPL) of attributes associated with the specified finder. This DPL is the same that was used to register the finder using ciRegisterFinder.

functions.name: ciGetFirstDeviceTermName
functions.description: Returns the first terminal name on the specified device that matches one of the terminal names specified in the termNames list.

functions.name: ciGetFluidGuardRingDeviceEnum
functions.description: Returns a space delimited string of the fluid guard ring devices in the technology file. This string can be used to define an enum for constraint generators that require fluid guard ring device selection.Also, see ciSetStructArgs and ciRegisterConstraintGenerator.

functions.name: ciGetFoundryRules
functions.description: Returns the foundry constraint group for the given technology file.

functions.name: ciGetGenerator
functions.description: Returns a disembodied property list (DPL) of attributes associated to the specified constraint generator. This DPL is the same that was used to register the constraint generator using ciRegisterConstraintGenerator.

functions.name: ciGetGuardRing
functions.description: Returns the guard ring constraint associated with the passed modgen constraint, if it has one.

functions.name: ciGetGuardRingMPPName
functions.description: This function returns the registered technology file Guard Ring MPP name for the passed device based on the device type (nfet or pfet).

functions.name: ciGetIterator
functions.description: Returns a disembodied property list (DPL) of attributes associated to the specified iterator. This DPL is the same that was used to register the iterator using ciRegisterIterator.

functions.name: ciGetLAMComponentTypes
functions.description: Returns a list of the device, terminal, and parameter mappings specified in a cph.lam file associated with a particular PDK. This SKILL function can be used in conjunction with the ciCPRegistrationFromLAM SKILL function to create the device, terminal, and parameter registrations needed for the Circuit Prospector finders, iterators, and generators to function with the selected PDK.

functions.name: ciGetMappedDeviceNames
functions.description: Returns all default device names (fet, nfet, pfet, and BJT) that have been registered using ciRegisterDevice.

functions.name: ciGetMatchParam2DList
functions.description: Returns a 2D list (name-value pair) of CDF parameters present on the given instances as well as in the given holder list.

functions.name: ciGetMembersOfType
functions.description: Filters the instsNetsPins list used by constraint generators to only include members of a specified type. See also, ciConGetMembersOfType.

functions.name: ciGetNetNames
functions.description: Retrieves the net names, regular expressions and predicates that make up a net type.

functions.name: ciGetNetSubTypes
functions.description: Retrieves the sub-types contained in a net super-type.

functions.name: ciGetNetSuperTypes
functions.description: Returns the list of registered net super-types.

functions.name: ciGetObjectCellView
functions.description: Used within constraint generators to retrieve the cellview associated with a particular object path. This SKILL function is similar to ciGetCellViewForObjectPath, but uses the cellview information associated with the cache if the object path does not contain a hierarchical path.

functions.name: ciGetOpenCellViews
functions.description: Returns a list of open constraint caches in the virtual memory.

functions.name: ciGetParamMapping
functions.description: Returns all the parameters mapped for a given parameter name.

functions.name: ciGetParamName
functions.description: Returns the parameter name of the user-defined parameter that is mapped to the given parameter placeholder name.

functions.name: ciGetParamValFromParameters
functions.description: Retrieves the specified parameter value from a constraint parameter list. It can be used to retrieve values of constraint parameters or constraint member parameters.

functions.name: ciGetParamValue
functions.description: Returns the parameter value for the user-defined parameter that is mapped to the given parameter placeholder name.

functions.name: ciGetParamValueOrDefault
functions.description: Retrieves the value of the named parameter on the passed database object. The parameter name should have been registered ciMapParam. If the parameter is not found then the default value will be returned.

functions.name: ciGetParamValues
functions.description: Returns the values of the specified parameters for the specified device. By default, the values are returned as a disembodied property list (DPL), but can also be returned as a simple list.

functions.name: ciGetRoutingLayer
functions.description: Retrieves the named routing layer from the technology file associated with the current window. See also, ciGetTechFile, ciGetRoutingLayers, techGetLayerNum, techGetLayerMaskNumber, techFindLayer, and techGetLayerFunctions.

functions.name: ciGetRoutingLayers
functions.description: Retrieves the names of all the routing layers from the technology file associated with the current window. See also ciGetTechFile, ciGetRoutingLayer, techGetLayerNum, techGetLayerMaskNumber, techFindLayer, and techGetLayerFunctions.

functions.name: ciGetRule
functions.description: Retrieves the required rule value from the technology file. If the rule cannot be found, then the default value is returned.

functions.name: ciGetRuleGroupByName
functions.description: Returns the constraint group from the specified design or technology database with the specified name.

functions.name: ciGetRuleGroupName
functions.description: Returns the string name of a constraint group from a given constraint group pointer.

functions.name: ciGetRuleGroups
functions.description: Returns a list of oaConstraintGroup pointers for a given technology or design file.

functions.name: ciGetStructArg
functions.description: Retrieves the named structure argument for the specified structure type. See also, ciSetStructArgs, ciGetStructArgs, ciReplaceStructArg, ciAddStructArg, and ciDeleteStructArg.

functions.name: ciGetStructArgs
functions.description: Retrieves all the structure arguments for the specified structure type. See also, ciSetStructArgs, ciGetStructArg, ciReplaceStructArg, ciAddStructArg, and ciDeleteStructArg.

functions.name: ciGetStructGeneratorExpressions
functions.description: Retrieves the constraint generator expressions registered for the passed structure type. The generator expressions are returned within a ciStructGeneratorExpressions def struct. These expressions are evaluated by the ciCreateModgen SKILL function during modgen creation and modification. See also, ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions, ciListStructGeneratorExpressions, and ciCreateModgen.

functions.name: ciGetStructPDKMult
functions.description: Retrieves the PDK specific multiplier for the passed structure type. The PDK name is determined from the technology file associated with the current window. If multiplier has been registered then the default value of 1.0 will be returned. The PDK multipliers are typically used within constraint generator argument expressions to scale the values in a PDK independent way. See also, ciSetStructPDKMult.

functions.name: ciGetStructure
functions.description: Returns a disembodied property list (DPL) of attributes associated to the specified structure. This DPL is the same that was used to register the structure using ciRegisterStructure.

functions.name: ciGetTechFile
functions.description: Retrieves the technology file for the current window.

functions.name: ciGetTechMPPNames
functions.description: Returns a list of the MPP names for the current technology file. The MPP names are used in the creation of guard rings.

functions.name: ciGetTermNames
functions.description: Returns all the terminal names mapped to the user-defined parameter, termName.

functions.name: ciGetWidgetProperties
functions.description: Returns the widget properties set on the constraint generator arguments, genArgs.
