functions.name: ciGuardRingForCluster
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set a Guard Ring constraint to an existing Cluster constraint.

functions.name: ciGuardRingForModgen
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set a Guard Ring constraint to an existing Modgen constraint.

functions.name: ciHasCellAnyRegTerm
functions.description: Returns information on whether or not the given cell has at least one terminal registered with a default net.

functions.name: ciHaveSameBulkNets
functions.description: Returns t if the passed list of devices have the same bulk connection.

functions.name: ciHaveSameParamValues
functions.description: Returns t if the specified parameters have the same values on all the passed devices. The parameter names should be the PDK independent parameter names specified using the ciMapParam SKILL command.

functions.name: ciHierCompareConstraint
functions.description: Copies and compares applicable pushed or pulled constraints in the layout hierarchy. The copied constraint members, such as nets, terminals, instance terminals, and so on correspond to the original constraint members as they are physically connected.

functions.name: ciHierCompareConstraints
functions.description: Compares applicable pushed or pulled constraints in the layout hierarchy. The copied constraint members (nets, terminals, instance terminals, and so on) correspond to the original constraint members because they are physically connected.

functions.name: ciHierUpdateConstraints
functions.description: Used in sync with the pushed and pulled constraints with their source constraints. After push or pull the constraint parameters have been modified, you can use this SKILL function to update the pushed or pulled constraints.

functions.name: ciHierarchicalSeriesIterator
functions.description: Returns a list of corresponding devices that match the series structures in the cellview. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, the structures are ignored.

functions.name: ciHighestLevelNet
functions.description: This function returns the dbId of the highest level net associated with the passed lower level hierarchical net name. If the net is local to the cellview, which is contained within then the function returns info on that net. See also ciResolveNet.

functions.name: ciIgnoreDevice
functions.description: This is a utility function that can be used in finder or constraint generator expressions. It returns t if the passed device should be ignored.

functions.name: ciInstGetSplitFingers
functions.description: Returns a Boolean value to identify whether the specified instance has been set to use Split Fingers. It can be used by a constraint generator to control how the layout is generated for its member instances.

functions.name: ciInstIterator
functions.description: Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all design instances, collating them into groups based on the result of evaluating the passed (match) expression.

functions.name: ciInstListSplitFingers
functions.description: Returns the names of the instances that use Split Fingers. It can be used by a constraint generator to control how the layout is generated for its member instances.

functions.name: ciInstSetSplitFingers
functions.description: Specifies whether an instance uses Split Fingers, that is, a separate instance per finger in layout. It can be used by a constraint generator to control how the layout is generated for its member instances.

functions.name: ciInstTermIterator
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector to iterate over all design instance terminals in the passed cellview. Instance terminals (instTerms) are grouped together based on the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderInstTermExpr).

functions.name: ciInstsNetsPinsFromSelSet
functions.description: Returns a list of instances, nets, pins, or instTerms (InstsNetsPins) for the current selection.

functions.name: ciIsDevice
functions.description: Checks whether a device belongs to a particular device type.

functions.name: ciIsNet
functions.description: Checks whether a particular netId belongs to a particular netType.

functions.name: ciIsNetSuperType
functions.description: Tests whether or not the given net type is a super-type.

functions.name: ciListAllCategoryNames
functions.description: Lists all the categories in Circuit Prospector that have been registered by using ciRegisterAssistant. By default, it only lists the enabled assistants.

functions.name: ciListAllFinderNames
functions.description: Lists all the finders in Circuit Prospector that have been registered by using ciRegisterFinder.

functions.name: ciListAllGeneratorNames
functions.description: Lists all the constraint generators in Circuit Prospector that have been registered by using ciRegisterConstraintGenerator.

functions.name: ciListAllIteratorNames
functions.description: Lists all the iterators in Circuit Prospector that have been registered by using ciRegisterIterator.

functions.name: ciListAllStructureNames
functions.description: Lists all the structures in Circuit Prospector that have been registered by using ciRegisterStructure.

functions.name: ciListEditors
functions.description: Generates a list of the current constraint editors that are available from the Constraint Manager's Constraint Generator toolbar option.

functions.name: ciListGeneratableConstraintGroups
functions.description: The default generatable constraint group listing callback used by ciSetCMCGSKILLCallbacks when no user-defined function has been specified.

functions.name: ciListProcessRules
functions.description: Lists all process rules associated with the given object.

functions.name: ciListStructGeneratorExpressions
functions.description: Returns a list of all the registered structure generator expressions that are returned within a ciStructGeneratorExpressions def struct. These expressions are evaluated by the ciCreateModgen SKILL function during modgen creation and modification. See also, ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions, ciGetStructGeneratorExpressions, and ciCreateModgen.

functions.name: ciListStructPDKMults
functions.description: This function prints a list of all the registered structure PDK multipliers and returns a table of the registered structure type/PDK combinations. See also, ciSetStructPDKMult and ciGetStructPDKMult.

functions.name: ciListStructTypes
functions.description: Returns a list of the registered structure types used by the Circuit Prospector. See also, ciSetStructArgs, ciGetStructArgs, ciReplaceStructArg, ciSetStructPDKMult ciAddStructArg, ciGetStructArg, ciReplaceStructArg, ciDeleteStructArg, and ciRegexReplaceStructArgs.

functions.name: ciListTemplateTypes
functions.description: Generates a list of the current constraint template types dictionary, outputs its details.

functions.name: ciListTypes
functions.description: Generates a list of the current definitions for each constraint type in the config.xml files, the name of the constraint, and a list of legal constraint parameters and their default values.

functions.name: ciLoadConfigXML
functions.description: Loads the specified constraint config.xml file. In the process, the new entries get merged into the existing config.xml files that have already been loaded and the existing entries are overwritten.When you start Virtuoso, all config.xml files found in the Cadence Search Path are loaded and merged based on the order in which they are found in the setup.loc file. By using this function, you can load a config.xml on demand after Virtuoso has been started, such as when a design library or PDK is loaded.See also ciLoadDotCadenceFiles, ciLoadIcon, and ciLoadIcons.

functions.name: ciLoadConfigXMLFromString
functions.description: Loads the string representation of a config.xml file. If a new entry does not match an existing entry, the new entry gets added into the config.xml files that have already been loaded. However, if the new entry matches an existing entry, the new entry overwrites the old one.When you start Virtuoso, all config.xml files found in the Cadence Search Path are loaded and merged based on the order in which they are found in the setup.loc file. By using this function, you can load a config.xml on demand after Virtuoso has been started, such as when a design library or PDK is loaded.See also ciLoadConfigXML, ciLoadDotCadenceFiles, ciLoadIcon, and ciLoadIcons.

functions.name: ciLoadConstrFrom
functions.description: Loads the constraints from the source cache to the target cache of the same type.

functions.name: ciLoadDotCadenceFiles
functions.description: Loads all constraint-related files within the hierarchy of the specified .cadence directory.

functions.name: ciLoadIcon
functions.description: Loads a specific PNG format icon file from the specified directory so that it can be used by the Constraint Manager. The file should have a .png extension.

functions.name: ciLoadIcons
functions.description: Loads all PNG format icon files from the specified directory so that these can be used by the Constraint Manager. The file should have a .png extension.

functions.name: ciLxComparisonReport
functions.signature: ciLxComparisonReport([ ?layoutCV g_layoutCV ][ ?showReport g_showReport ][ ?useViewNames g_useViewNames ][ ?useTimeStamp g_useTimeStamp ][ ?path g_path ][ ?filename g_filename ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Prints a comparison report between a layout and its corresponding VLS XL schematic and/or top configuration.

functions.name: ciMOSActiveLoadStructIterator
functions.description: Iterator for all MOS active load structures.

functions.name: ciMOSCascodeIterator
functions.description: Iterator for MOS cascoded structures.

functions.name: ciMOSCascodedCurrentMirrorStructIterator
functions.description: Iterator for all MOS cascoded current mirror structures.

functions.name: ciMOSCascodedCurrentMirrorStructIterator2
functions.description: Iterator for all MOS cascoded current mirror structures, with at least one of the leading pairs being diode connected.

functions.name: ciMOSCommonGateStructIterator
functions.description: Iterator for all MOS common gate structures in a design.

functions.name: ciMOSCrossCoupledDifferentialPairStructIterator
functions.description: Iterator for a MOS cross-coupled differential pair structure in a design. A MOS cross-coupled differential pair is a pair of MOS transistors that have the GATE of one transistor connected to the DRAIN of the other. The SOURCE of both transistors are connected to each other. By default, the SOURCE of the transistors cannot be connected to a POWER SUPPLY. This behavior can be changed by setting the environment variable crossCoupleDiffPairRequireSourceNotSupply to nil. To revert to the default behavior, set the environment variable back to t.

functions.name: ciMOSCrossCoupledQuadStructIterator
functions.description: Iterator for all MOS cross coupled quad structures in a design.

functions.name: ciMOSCurrentMirrorStructIterator
functions.description: Iterator for all MOS current mirror structures.

functions.name: ciMOSDifferentialPairStructIterator
functions.description: Iterator for MOS differential pair structures in a design.

functions.name: ciMOSInverterStructIterator
functions.description: Iterator for all MOS inverter structures in a design.

functions.name: ciMOSParallelStructIterator
functions.description: Iterator for all MOS parallel structures.

functions.name: ciMOSTransmissionGateStructIterator
functions.description: Iterator for all MOS transmission gate structures.

functions.name: ciMakeHierContext
functions.description: Used by Circuit Prospector iterators that are required to run on flattened hierarchies. The iterators need to define a local variable, hierContext, to be referenced by finders that use that iterator. This function is used to initialize that local variable.

functions.name: ciMakeObjectInfo
functions.description: A utility function for constructing a disembodied property list to be used by Circuit Prospector iterators to return hierarchical path information about the found objects.

functions.name: ciMapParam
functions.description: Maps a parameter placeholder name to the parameter names used in the PDK.

functions.name: ciMapTerm
functions.description: Maps the user-defined termName to the terminal names used in the PDK.

functions.name: ciMatchedFingerWidth
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set a Matched Parameters constraint to the selected instance members.

functions.name: ciMatchedParametersForCurrent_Mirror
functions.description: Used the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set Matched Parameters constraints to the selected instance members.

functions.name: ciMatchedParamsForInstanceSymmetry
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set Matched Parameters constraints to the selected pair of instance members.

functions.name: ciMatchedParamsForSameSizeInstances
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set Matched Parameters constraints to the selected instance members.

functions.name: ciMemberIndexToModgenPatternSymbol
functions.description: This function returns the modgen pattern symbol for a member where member index is the count of the number of unique member names that have so far been processed in the list of members.

functions.name: ciMergeParams
functions.description: Merges two lists of constraint parameters into a single list. By default, if the parameter being merged already exists in the list of parameters, the parameter value will be overwritten with the new value. The optional overwrite parameter can be set to nil to prevent parameter value overwrites.

functions.name: ciModgenDummyNetName
functions.description: Determines the modgen dummy net name based on bulk connectivity of the specified devices or the power/ground nets in the design. See also, ciCreateModgenDummy.

functions.name: ciModgenForSameCellSizeAndBulk
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to create Modgen constraints on groups of devices that have the same size and bulk connection.

functions.name: ciModgenListFingerSplitCons
functions.description: Returns a list of fingerSplit constraints that exist on the passed modgen members. This SKILL function can be used in a template create or check callback function to include the fingerSplit constraints within a template.Note: The fingerSplit constraints are not visible in the Constraint Manager assistant.

functions.name: ciModgenMergeLayersFromArgs
functions.description: Returns a string with the list of layers from a property list, where each layer is separated by a comma.

functions.name: ciModgenRefreshStorage
functions.description: Reinitializes the internal modgen storage. When the ci SKILL functions are used to update a modgen constraint in layout or the modgen previewer, the internal modgen storage needs to be reinitialized to ensure it is in a consistent state. Modgen constraint updates include adding/removing members, updating parameters, and adding/removing guard rings.

functions.name: ciModgenSplitFingers
functions.description: Splits or unsplits the device fingers for the instances specified in the instsNetsPins list associated with the passed modgen. When called in a layout view, the physical device instances are split or unsplit and the modgen figGroups are updated accordingly. When called in a schematic view, the finger split information is stored in the schematic constraints cache. This information is used while transferring the schematic constraints to layout, and splitting or unsplitting the instances in layout.

functions.name: ciModgenTemplateFingerSplitPreDestroy
functions.description: Ensures that the split device instance fingers are unsplit and that the modgen figGroup is updated before the specified template is deleted. This high-level function should be used where modgens are contained within templates that control finger splitting on those modgens. To call this function before the template is deleted, it should be registered as the preDestroySymbolName of the template when the template is defined by using ciTemplateCreateDefinition.

functions.name: ciNetIterator
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant to iterate over all design nets, collecting them together into groups based on the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderNetExpr). All nets which have the same finderNetExpr result are grouped together. If the finder match net expression evaluates to nil, then the net is ignored.

functions.name: ciNetNames
functions.description: Returns the list of net names registered for t_netType.

functions.name: ciNetOnTerm
functions.description: Utility function used by the Circuit Prospector assistant finders to retrieve the design instance connected to a named instance terminal.

functions.name: ciNetPredicates
functions.description: Returns the net predicates registered for t_netType.

functions.name: ciNetRegexs
functions.description: Returns the list of regular expressions registered for t_netType.

functions.name: ciNextConName
functions.description: Returns the next unique constraint name based on the given constraint name prefix. This function assumes that the constraints have names of the format <prefix><number>.

functions.name: ciNextObjName
functions.description: Returns the next unique object name based on the given base object name prefix and a list of existing object names. This function assumes the objects have names of the format <baseName><number>.

functions.name: ciNextTemplateName
functions.description: Returns the next unique template name based on the given template name prefix. This function assumes the templates have names of the format <prefix><number>.

functions.name: ciNumDevices
functions.description: Returns the number of physical devices for a given device name in the schematic, which effectively retrieves the mfactor for the device.

functions.name: ciNumTermsEQ2
functions.description: Utility function used by the Circuit Prospector assistant finders to check if the passed design net Id is connected to two terminals.

functions.name: ciObjectIsInContext
functions.description: Returns the current context status of an object. If an object is in context, it is present in the database.

functions.name: ciObjectListCon
functions.description: Lists all constraints that refer to a given design object as a member.

functions.name: ciObjectPathAndName
functions.description: This function is used in constraint generators to separate the object path and name from a string. The result is returned as a disembodied property list with properties, such as objectPath and objectName. The objectPath property is a list of strings that represent the full hierarchical path to the object including the objects name.

functions.name: ciOpenCellView
functions.description: Opens the constraint cache for the library, cell, view, and constraint view in read or edit mode as specified, and returns the constraint cache ID or returns nil if the constraint cache could not be opened.ciOpenCellView allows the mode to be specified. However, it does not downgrade the mode to read if the constraint cache is already open in edit mode. In this case, ciReopenCellView can be used to change the mode, if required.See also ciCacheGet that finds or opens the constraint cache based on the current constraint viewNameList instead of specifying a particular constraint view.

functions.name: ciOpenPanicCellView
functions.description: Restores the constraint cellview (associated with a schematic cellview) that was saved in panic state, which is when Virtuoso exited unexpectedly, in the hierDesign.oa- file. The restored constraint cellview opens in append mode. You can use the Constraint Manager to view this constraint cellview. This SKILL function returns a cache pointer of the restored constraint cellview. Use this cache pointer as an argument with the ciCacheSave SKILL function to save the restored constraint cellview. You can then open the recovered constraint cellview in the Constraint Manager.

functions.name: ciOrientationForModgen
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set an Orientation constraint to an existing Modgen constraint.

functions.name: ciPadModgenPattern
functions.description: Adds any missing elements in the modgen pattern list for the specified row and column counts.

functions.name: ciParallelNetResistorArrayIterator
functions.description: Iterates over all resistor devices, collating them into groups of parallelly-arranged resistors that start and end on the same net. This function is used by the Parallel Net Resistor Array finder of the Circuit Prospector assistant.

functions.name: ciParallelResistorArrayIterator
functions.description: Iterates over all resistor devices, collating them into groups of parallelly-arranged resistors that are all of the same length when their m-factor and iteration are expanded. This function is used by the Parallel Resistor Array (Length) finder of the Circuit Prospector assistant.

functions.name: ciPinIterator
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant finders to iterate over all design pins, collecting them together into groups based on the result of evaluating the passed finder expression (finderPinExpr). All pins which have the same finderPinExpr result are grouped together. If the finderPinExpr evaluates to nil, then the pin is ignored.

functions.name: ciPlacerControlledWellGeneration
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector assistant as a generator to set a placerControlledWell property for each given instance that is registered as a pfet.

functions.name: ciPrintMappedDefaultNetNames
functions.description: Returns the default net name registered with a particular terminal. Also returns details of the corresponding lib/cell/view.

functions.name: ciPrintMappedDeviceNames
functions.description: Prints all default device names (for fets, BJTs, and so on) that have been registered using ciRegisterDevice.

functions.name: ciPrintMappedNetNames
functions.description: Prints all net categories registered using ciRegisterNet.

functions.name: ciPrintMappedParams
functions.description: Prints all the parameters mapped by ciMapParam.

functions.name: ciPrintMappedTerminals
functions.description: Prints all the parameters mapped by ciMapTerm.

functions.name: ciPrintReport
functions.description: Generates an HTML report containing constraint differences between two designs.

functions.name: ciPullConstraint
functions.signature: ciPullConstraint(u_consu_targetCache[ ?paths l_paths ][ ?autoTag g_autoTag ][ ?recursive g_recursive ][ ?update g_update ])=> constraintIdList / nil
functions.description: Copies a single constraint up the layout hierarchy.

functions.name: ciPullConstraints
functions.signature: ciPullConstraints(u_sourceCacheu_targetCache[ ?paths l_paths ][ ?autoTag g_autoTag ][ ?recursive g_recursive ][ ?update g_update ])=> constraintIdList / nil
functions.description: Copies all applicable constraints up a layout hierarchy.

functions.name: ciPushConstraint
functions.signature: ciPushConstraint(u_constraint[ ?paths l_paths ][ ?autoTag g_autoTag ][ ?recursive g_recursive ][ ?update g_update ])=> constraintIdList / nil
functions.description: Copies a single of constraint down a layout hierarchy.

functions.name: ciPushConstraints
functions.signature: ciPushConstraints(u_cache[ ?paths l_paths ][ ?autoTag g_autoTag ][ ?recursive g_recursive ][ ?update g_update ])=> constraintIdList / nil
functions.description: Copies a set of constraints down a layout hierarchy.

functions.name: ciRefreshCellView
functions.description: Refreshes the constraint cache in the virtual memory with the most current copy from the disk if it has changed.

functions.name: ciRegTypeBindingParameter
functions.description: Registers a binding parameter for a user-defined constraint type from a config.xml file. The parameter value must match for the constraints of that type to be considered equivalent between schematic and layout. Specifying an empty parameter name string unregisters the binding parameter.

functions.name: ciRegexReplaceStructArgs
functions.description: For the passed constraint generator argument list replace any strings matching the passed regular expression with the passed string replacement. This function is useful for customizing the default constraint generator arguments registered for a given structure. See also, ciGetStructArgs, ciSetStructArgs, ciReplaceStructArg, ciAddStructArg, ciDeleteStructArg, and ciGetStructArg.

functions.name: ciRegisterAction
functions.description: Registers a list of attributes associated with an action and optionally adds the action to the constraints-related context menu, the Constraint Manager assistant's Constraint Menu, or both. This function is an alias for the ciRegisterConstraintGenerator function. The purpose of this alias is to emphasize the fact that constraint generator SKILL expressions can do everything possible in SKILL and not just create constraints.

functions.name: ciRegisterAssistant
functions.description: Registers a new assistant (category) with the Circuit Prospector assistant. Assistants (categories) are groups of related Circuit Prospector finders. A category may represent a set of finders for a particular device type, for example fet, or a category could represent a top down/bottom up constraints flow. Categories can be registered automatically by placing them in a .cadence/dfII/ci/categories directory located on the Cadence File Search Path. The category registration SKILL code should be placed in a file in that directory with an .il extension, for example: .cadence/dfII/ci/categories/myCategory.il.

functions.name: ciRegisterConstraintEditor
functions.signature: ciRegisterConstraintEditor( list(nil'name t_name'description t_description'constraintType t_constraintType'constraintParams l_constraintParams'editorAvailableExpression t_editorAvailableExpression'startEditorExpression t_startEditorExpression'iconName t_iconName'addToToolbar g_addToToolbar'templateTypes l_templateTypes'useForTemplateEdit g_useForTemplateEdit'useForConstraintCreation g_useForConstraintCreation'useForConstraintParamEdit g_useForConstraintParamEdit'editableConstraintParams l_editableConstraintParams)=> t / nil
functions.description: Registers a constraint editor with the Constraint Manager assistant and, optionally, adds a button to the Constraint Manager toolbar. This button can be used to open the registered constraint editor. An entry is also added to the Constraint Editor submenu that appears on the context-sensitive menu of the Constraint Manager.

functions.name: ciRegisterConstraintGenerator
functions.signature: ciRegisterConstraintGenerator( list(nil'name t_name'description t_description'expression t_expression[ 'addToToolbar g_addToToolbar ][ 'args l_args ][ 'callback t_callbackExpr ][ 'iconName t_iconName ][ 'menu g_menu ][ 'precondition t_preconditionExpr ][ 'settings l_settings ][ 'size l_size ][ 'title t_title ][ 'useCGenForEdit g_useCGenForEdit ]))=> t / nil
functions.description: Registers a constraint generator with the Constraint Manager and, optionally, will make it available as an entry in the Constraint Creation toolbar drop-down list of the Constraint Manager and in the Generate Constraints list in the context-menu. The constraint generator can then be set as the default generator for a Circuit Prospector finder or used explicitly in the Constraint Manager to create constraints.

functions.name: ciRegisterCustomDeviceFilter
functions.description: Registers a custom filter or modifies an existing filter.

functions.name: ciRegisterDefaultNetName
functions.description: Registers a default net name for the given terminal for either: the cellview of the same category or all lib/cell/view specified.

functions.name: ciRegisterDevice
functions.description: Function used by the Circuit Prospector assistant to register a list of fet, nfet, pfet, BJT and passive device names to be used by ciIsDevice.

functions.name: ciRegisterDevicesForPDKCategory
functions.description: Calls the ciRegisterDevice function to register all cells of the t_categoryName PDK category in the t_libName library as a device of type, t_deviceTypeName. In addition, the ciRegisterDevicesForPDKCategory function returns the list of devices registered because of the current action. This list does not includes the devices that were registered with the given device type name previously.

functions.name: ciRegisterDynamicParamDef
functions.description: Registers dynamic parameter definition for a constraint type.Only a native constraint type can have a set of dynamic parameters in addition to the predefined (static) parameters defined in Virtuoso. Unlike a normal constraint parameter, a user specifies and registers a dynamic parameter definition at run time in SKILL. Dynamic parameter definitions for custom constraint types can be added by creating different definitions of the constraint using config.xml. These definitions can be dynamically loaded using the ciLoadConfigXML or ciLoadConfigXMLFromString function. However, ensure that you must not change the definition while a design is open using a different definition.

functions.name: ciRegisterFinder
functions.description: Registers a new finder with the Circuit Prospector assistant (although the recommended method is to do this using the Edit Finder form). Finders are used by the Circuit Prospector to iterate over a design and collect together groups of instances, nets, and pins that share common characteristics. The finder expression will determine how these objects are grouped together. Finders can be registered automatically by placing them in a .cadence/dfII/ci/finders directory located on the Cadence File Search Path. The finder registration SKILL code should be placed in a file in that directory with an .il extension, for example .cadence/dfII/ci/finders/netTermCountFinder.il.

functions.name: ciRegisterIterator
functions.description: Registers a new iterator with the Circuit Prospector assistant (although the recommended method is to do this using the Edit Iterator form). Iterators are used by the Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over the design in a specific way, applying a finder expression which determines how objects are grouped.

functions.name: ciRegisterNet
functions.description: Registers the net names, regular expressions and predicates that make up a net type. A net belongs to t_netType if its name is one of l_netNameList, or if it matches one of l_regExpressionList, or if g_predicate returns t.

functions.name: ciRegisterNetNames
functions.description: Registers a list of net names recognized by ciIsNet().

functions.name: ciRegisterNetPredicate
functions.description: Registers a net predicate function used by ciIsNet().

functions.name: ciRegisterNetRegexs
functions.description: Registers a list of regular expressions recognized by ciIsNet().A net belongs to t_netType if its name matches any of these expressions.

functions.name: ciRegisterNetSuperType
functions.description: This function creates a net type that automatically includes the names, regular expressions, and predicates registered in other net types. The new net type is known as a super-type, and the net types included in it as sub-types.

functions.name: ciRegisterStructure
functions.description: Registers a structure with the Circuit Prospector assistant (although the recommended method is to do this using Capturing New Structures).

functions.name: ciReinitStructTemplateDefs
functions.description: Re-initializes the template definitions created by the Circuit Prospector for registered structures. This is necessary if any of the structure arguments are modified. Typically, these modifications will be in the libInit.il file loaded when the PDK library is loaded or in a .cdsinit file.

functions.name: ciRemoveConstrainedPinNetsFromRails
functions.description: Deletes any constraints on pins where the net on the pin is also a member of a rail constraint because this is currently not supported by the Analog Placer.

functions.name: ciRemoveDuplicateMembers
functions.signature: ciRemoveDuplicateMembers({ d_cellViewID | l_constraintList }[ ?conType t_conType ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Removes duplicate constraint members from constraints which do not support duplicate members.

functions.name: ciRemoveHierarchicalNotes
functions.description: Removes the existing notes from the templates and constraints for a single cellview or all along the hierarchy beginning from the given cellview.

functions.name: ciRemoveLeadingSlash
functions.description: Removes the leading forward slash from a string if it has one.

functions.name: ciRemoveProcessRules
functions.description: Removes all process rules associated with the given object.

functions.name: ciRemoveSymmetricPinAlignments
functions.description: This utility function used by the Rapid Analog Prototype Enforce Precedence constraint generator to remove alignment constraints on symmetric pins.

functions.name: ciRemoveTrailingSlash
functions.description: Removes the leading forward slash from a string if it has one.

functions.name: ciReopenCellView
functions.description: Reopens the constraint view in read or edit mode.Note: This function does not apply to layout constraint caches.

functions.name: ciReorderAssistants
functions.description: Reorders the listing of Circuit Prospector assistants (categories). The new ordering should be a list of the existing category names in the order that you wish them to appear in the Circuit Prospector category drop-down list.

functions.name: ciReplaceStructArg
functions.description: For the passed structure type this function replaces the named constraint generator argument with a new argument definition. See also, ciGetStructArgs, ciSetStructArgs, ciRegexReplaceStructArgs, ciAddStructArg, ciDeleteStructArg, and ciGetStructArg.

functions.name: ciResetDIImplementation
functions.description: Resets the implementation status, implementation notes, and signed off status of all design intents in the constraints cache so that the cellview can be reused.

functions.name: ciResistorArrayUpdateRowColVal
functions.description: Increases or decreases the row and column values of the series or parallel resistor array template that contains the currently selected modgen. If the selected topology orders the resistor devices by Row, the value displayed in the Col field is updated using this function. Conversely, if the selected topology orders the resistor devices by Col, the value displayed in the Row field is updated.

functions.name: ciResolveBulkNet
functions.description: This function is used with Circuit Prospector finder expressions to retrieve the bulk net on a device and resolves the net to the highest level in the design.

functions.name: ciResolveNet
functions.description: Resolves the passed net to the highest equivalent design net. Used by Circuit Prospector finders when run on flattened hierarchies. For example, the Active Common Gate finder.

functions.name: ciRunFinder
functions.signature: ciRunFinder(t_finderNamet_iteratorFnNamet_finderExpressiont_constraintGenExpr[ g_iteratorSupportFlatHier ][ t_hierScope ][ n_depth ][ g_cache ][ s_predicate ])=> list
functions.description: Runs a Circuit Prospector finder and returns a list of objects grouped according to the finder expression evaluation result. If the depth argument is specified and the hierScope argument is 'depthCellViews, the finder searches only up to the specified depth. If cache is specified, the finder runs on that cache; otherwise, the search results are obtained from the current window. See also ciRegisterFinder and ciRegisterIterator.

functions.name: ciRunFindersAndGenerators
functions.signature: ciRunFindersAndGenerators(g_cachet_categoryName[ ?runGenerators g_runGenerators ][ ?deleteExisting g_deleteExisting ][ ?addHierNotes g_addHierNotes ][ ?printFinderResults g_printFinderResults ][ ?updateArgsExpr g_updateArgsExpr ][ ?triggerCBinMode g_triggerCBinMode ])=> list
functions.description: Runs all the finders and their corresponding generators for the specified constraint cache and Circuit Prospector category. The finders first find all the results and then the constraint generators are ran on those results to create constraints and templates.

functions.name: ciRunGenerator
functions.description: Given a constraint cache, a generator name and a list of objects(insts, nets, pins & terminals), the function Runs the specified constraint generator in the given constraint cache for the specified list of objects, that is, instances, nets, pins, and terminals. This function is called by ciRunFindersAndGenerators to run the constraint generator.

functions.name: ciRunMatchingConstraintsGenerator
functions.description: This SKILL function is run by the Matching(Strength) constraint generator expression and used to create matching template constraints.

functions.name: ciRunPrecondition
functions.description: Runs all the precondition checks that are needed before a constraint generator can be run.

functions.name: ciSameCellIterator
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector to iterate over all design instances with the same master collecting them together into groups based on the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderDeviceExpr). This iterator ensures that the devices within a group have the same master. All devices with the same master, which have the same finderDeviceExpr result, are grouped together. If the finderDeviceExpr evaluates to nil then the device is ignored.

functions.name: ciSaveConstraintGenerator
functions.description: Saves a constraint generator in the .cadence/dfII/ci/generators directory with the name given to it. The spaces in the constraint generator's name are replaced by underscores.

functions.name: ciSelectedConstraints
functions.description: Returns a list of selected constraint IDs that are contained in the passed constraints cache.

functions.name: ciSelectedTemplates
functions.description: Returns a list of selected template IDs that are contained in the passed constraints cache.

functions.name: ciSeparateInstsNetsPins
functions.description: Converts the instsNetsPins list into a disembodied property list to allow easier access to the instances, nets, pins, and instTerms in the sub-lists. This function is used within constraint generators.

functions.name: ciSeriesResistorArrayIterator
functions.description: Iterates over all resistor devices, collating them into groups of sequentially-arranged resistors that create the longest serial chain between two nets. The serial chain splits at a T-junction point. This function is used by the Series Resistor Array finder of the Circuit Prospector assistant.

functions.name: ciSetCMCGSKILLCallbacks
functions.description: Controls the constraint groups that are visible in the Constraint Manager.

functions.name: ciSetDIPropertyGroupDefs
functions.description: Sets the design intent property group definitions to the specified definitions. All existing property group definitions are deleted.

functions.name: ciSetDefaultConstraintEditor
functions.description: Sets the specified editor as the default constraint editor. The change will take effect at the next start-up of the Virtuoso Schematic Editor or Virtuoso Layout Editor. To keep the change persistent on each start-up of Virtuoso, set this function in an initialization file.

functions.name: ciSetHaloOptions
functions.description: Invokes a user interface that allows you to set the various constraint visualization options.

functions.name: ciSetHaloPolicy
functions.description: Sets the policy for object haloing and grouping.

functions.name: ciSetMaxHaloGroupSize
functions.description: Allows the setting of a limit on the number of database objects to be haloed and grouped together when a constraint is selected in the Constraint Manager. The setting of a group size limit is only possible when minDisplay has been set as the halo policy using ciSetHaloPolicy.

functions.name: ciSetModgenTopology
functions.description: Sets the database topology on the modgen and deletes any pre-existing database topologies.

functions.name: ciSetStructArgVal
functions.description: Replaces the specified structure argument value with the specified value. This SKILL function can be used to override the default settings for the predefined structures.

functions.name: ciSetStructArgs
functions.description: Sets the constraint generator arguments for the passed structure type. See also, ciGetStructArgs, ciRegexReplaceStructArgs, ciAddStructArg, ciDeleteStructArg. ciReplaceStructArg, and ciGetStructArg.

functions.name: ciSetStructGeneratorExpressions
functions.description: Sets the constraint generator expressions for the passed structure type. The generator expressions are specified within a ciStructGeneratorExpressions def struct. These expressions are evaluated by the ciCreateModgen function during modgen creation and modification. See also, ciGetStructGeneratorExpressions, ciListStructGeneratorExpressions, and ciCreateModgen.

functions.name: ciSetStructPDKMult
functions.description: Sets the PDK specific multiplier for the passed structure type and PDK name. The PDK multipliers are typically used within constraint generator argument expressions to scale the values in a PDK independent way. See also, ciGetStructPDKMult.

functions.name: ciSetSymmetricAxes
functions.description: Where symmetry constraints exist with multiple axes, forces a single axis of symmetry to be the most commonly used axis.

functions.name: ciSigTypeMatchesNetType
functions.description: This function creates a net predicate that checks whether or not the sigType attribute of a net matches a given net type.

functions.name: ciSignalIterator
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector to iterate over all signals in the passed cellview, and return a list of corresponding signals.

functions.name: ciSimpleName
functions.description: Expands the passed name and simplifies it (removes duplicates). If the resulting name is a single string then this is returned otherwise the original name string is returned.

functions.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByFingerWidth
functions.description: Returns devs ordered by finger width. The device with the largest finger width will appear first in the list.

functions.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByMfactor
functions.description: Returns devices ordered by mfactor. The device with the largest mfactor will appear first in the list.

functions.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByX
functions.description: Returns devices ordered by increasing X. Margin defines the margin for equivalent X coordinates.

functions.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByXY
functions.description: Returns devices ordered by increasing X and increasing Y where, devices have same X. Margin defines the margin for equivalent X/Y coordinates.

functions.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByY
functions.description: Returns devices ordered by increasing Y. Margin defines the margin for equivalent Y coordinates.

functions.name: ciSortDeviceInfoByYX
functions.description: Returns devices ordered by increasing Y and increasing X where devices have same Y. Margin defines the margin for equivalent X/Y coordinates.

functions.name: ciSortedOpenCellViews
functions.description: Returns a list of open constraint caches from ciGetOpenCellViews sorted using ciConstraintViewLessp.

functions.name: ciTemplateAddCons
functions.description: Adds one or more ci constraints to a ci constraint template.

functions.name: ciTemplateChangeDIProfile
functions.description: Replaces the property profile currently selected for a design intent template.

functions.name: ciTemplateCreate
functions.signature: ciTemplateCreate(u_cachet_templateDefinitionName[ ?name t_name ][ ?members l_members ][ ?params l_params ][ ?userParams t_userParams ])=> templateId / nil
functions.description: Creates a new template.

functions.name: ciTemplateCreateDI
functions.signature: ciTemplateCreateDI(g_cachet_templateType { diDevices | diNets | diPins | diMaxVoltageDrop | diHighCurrent | diCell }t_namel_memberNamesTypes[ ?profile t_profileName ][ ?params l_paramNameAndValue ][ ?propNameValue l_propNameValue ])=> u_templateId / nil
functions.description: Creates a design intent template for the specified template type.

functions.name: ciTemplateCreateDefinition
functions.signature: ciTemplateCreateDefinition(t_typeNames_checkSymbolNames_createSymbolName[ ?params l_params ][ ?acceptsUserParams s_acceptsUserParams ][ ?transferSymbolName s_transferSymbolName ][ ?preDestroySymbolName s_preDestroySymbolName ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Creates a template definition.

functions.name: ciTemplateCreateExpanded
functions.signature: ciTemplateCreateExpanded(u_cachet_templateDefinitionName[ ?name t_name ][ ?members l_members ][ ?params g_params ][ ?userParams g_userParams ][ ?compress g_compress ])=> templateId / nil
functions.description: The same functionality as ciTemplateCreate, but first expands any iterated or repeated members. For example, MN1<0:2> gets expanded to MN1<0>, MN1<1>, and MN1<2>.In the case of net repetitions, such as <*3>inp, by default these get expanded N times as inp, inp, inp. However, if the optional compress argument is set to t, then <*3>inp will be expanded to just inp. The same applies to net bundles that contain repetitions. For example <*3>inp,a,b,c,inp,inp will by default be expanded to inp,inp,inp,a,b,c,inp,inp but with compress set to t will be expanded to inp,a,b,c.

functions.name: ciTemplateDIProfileName
functions.description: Returns the name of the profile associated with the specified design intent template.

functions.name: ciTemplateDIPropDef
functions.description: For the specified design intent template, returns the definition of the named property in the form of a DPL.

functions.name: ciTemplateDIPropGroupDef
functions.description: For the specified design intent template, returns the definition of all the properties in the form of a DPL.

functions.name: ciTemplateDIPropValue
functions.description: For the specified design intent template, returns the value of a named property.

functions.name: ciTemplateDefinitionExists
functions.description: Verifies whether a template definition with a given name exists.

functions.name: ciTemplateDelete
functions.description: Deletes given template.

functions.name: ciTemplateDeleteCons
functions.description: This function deletes or removes one or more CI constraints from a CI constraint template.

functions.name: ciTemplateFind
functions.description: Finds template in cache.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetCache
functions.description: Returns the constraint cache that contains the template.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetComment
functions.description: Returns the comment that shows the template status.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetCreatedTime
functions.description: This function returns the creation time of a template, which is the time and date close to a second when the template has been created.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetDefName
functions.description: Gets the template definition name.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetName
functions.description: Gets the template name.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetNote
functions.description: Returns the note parameter of a template.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetStatus
functions.description: Returns the template status.

functions.name: ciTemplateGetType
functions.description: Returns the symbolic name of the given template type, such as commonCentroid.

functions.name: ciTemplateIsKindOfDI
functions.description: Confirms if the specified constraint template is a design intent template. The available design intent templates are: diDevices, diNets, diPins, diMaxVoltageDrop, diHighCurrent, and diCell.

functions.name: ciTemplateListCon
functions.description: Gets the template constraint list.

functions.name: ciTemplateListDIProps
functions.description: For the specified design intent template, returns a list of the property names, types, and values.

functions.name: ciTemplateListParamNames
functions.description: Returns a list of template parameter names if the template has a list of parameters in its definition.

functions.name: ciTemplateListParams
functions.description: Returns a list of template parameter name, type, and value, provided the template has a list of parameters in its definition.

functions.name: ciTemplateResetAllParams
functions.description: Resets all template parameters to their default values.

functions.name: ciTemplateResetParams
functions.description: Resets one or more template parameters to their default value.

functions.name: ciTemplateSetNote
functions.description: Sets the note parameter of a template.

functions.name: ciTemplateSetStatus
functions.description: Sets the template status.

functions.name: ciTemplateSortParamDefs
functions.description: Sorts parameter definitions of a template type, by name and returns a list of parameter definitions sorted in alphabetical order.

functions.name: ciTemplateUpdateDIProps
functions.description: For the specified design intent template, updates the value of the named property.

functions.name: ciTemplateUpdateParams
functions.description: This function updates the parameter values of the listed parameters for templates that have one or more parameter definitions.

functions.name: ciTemplatep
functions.description: Checks if an object is a valid constraint template ID.

functions.name: ciToFloat
functions.description: Returns a floating point number for the passed value. If the value is a string, then it will be evaluated and the result returned.

functions.name: ciTransferConstraintsInProgress
functions.description: Returns a Boolean to indicate whether constraint transfer is in progress.

functions.name: ciTypeBindingParameter
functions.description: Returns the name of the registered binding parameter for a constraint type or an empty string if none is registered.

functions.name: ciTypeDefBaseType
functions.description: Returns the base type of the passed custom constraint type. You can define multiple versions of a custom constraint type in config.xml by assigning a unique constraint type name to different constraint types that all share the same base type name. This allows multiple versions of the same base constraint type to exist at the same time. To return the version number of a constraint type, see ciTypeDefVersion.

functions.name: ciTypeDefVersion
functions.description: Returns the version number of the passed constraint type. The default version number is 1. Custom constraint types defined through config.xml can specify the version number of the constraint through a version tag.

functions.name: ciTypeHasBindingParameter
functions.description: Checks if a binding parameter has been registered for the specified constraint type.

functions.name: ciTypeIsType
functions.description: Checks if the specified typeName is a constraint type name, which may be a built-in type, such as distance, or a user-defined custom constraint type that has been specified in a config.xml file.

functions.name: ciTypeIsUserDefined
functions.description: Checks if the specified typeName is a user-defined custom constraint type that is specified in a config.xml file.

functions.name: ciTypeListCon
functions.description: Lists all the constraints of a given type for a given cache.

functions.name: ciUnRegisterTerm
functions.description: Unregisters the terminal of a l/c/v if that terminal has already been registered with a default net.

functions.name: ciUnexpandDeviceInfo
functions.description: Contracts any mfactored device names and optionally any expanded iterated device names in a device information list returned by ciCollectDeviceInfo or ciExpandIteratedDeviceInfo. The mfactored device names used in the layout are of the format |<instName>.<mFactorIndx>, such as |MN1.3, and the iterated device names may be schematic device names like MN1<0> or layout device names like |MN1(0). In the layout, the device names may be mfactored and iterated, such as|MN1(3).4.When a collection of mfactored device names are contracted (for example, |MN1.2, |MN1.3, |MN1.4) a single device will appear in the returned deviceInfo list using the base device name like |MN1, and the mfactor property will be set to the total number of devices that were contracted, in this case 3.

functions.name: ciUnexpandIteratedDeviceInfo
functions.description: Contracts any expanded iterated device names in a device information list returned by ciCollectDeviceInfo or ciExpandIteratedDeviceInfo. The iterated device names may be schematic device names, such as MN1<0>, or layout device names, such as |MN1(0).

functions.name: ciUnexpandPhysicalDeviceInfo
functions.description: This is a utility function used in modgen generation for converting a physical devInfo disembodied property list into a logical devInfo disembodied property list. The devInfo disembodied property lists are created by calling ciCollectDeviceInfo for schematic (logical) and layout (physical) devices.

functions.name: ciUniqueMembers
functions.description: This utility function returns the unique members from the specified member list. It is typically used for member lists that can contain repeated member names due to mFactor expansion.

functions.name: ciUnregisterAssistant
functions.description: Unregisters a Circuit Prospector assistant (category) that was previously registered using ciRegisterAssistant.

functions.name: ciUnregisterConstraintEditor
functions.description: Unregisters a previously registered constraint editor. If the constraint editor appears in the Constraint Manager's Constraint Editors menu, then running this function removes it from the menu list.

functions.name: ciUnregisterConstraintGenerator
functions.description: Unregisters a previously registered constraint generator.

functions.name: ciUnregisterIterator
functions.description: Unregisters a Circuit Prospector iterator that was previously registered by using ciRegisterIterator. If successful, the iterator will no longer appear in the Edit Finder list or the Edit Iterator list.

functions.name: ciUnregisterNetSuperType
functions.description: Removes a net super-type, leaving its sub-types intact.

functions.name: ciUpdateHierarchicalNotes
functions.description: Updates the existing notes on the templates and constraints for a single cellview or all along the hierarchy beginning from the given cellview.

functions.name: ciUpdateModgenParamsAndMembers
functions.description: A utility function, which updates the passed modgen constraint parameters and members.

functions.name: ciUpdateObjPropsFromDI
functions.description: Runs a callback to propagate design intent properties to the associated design intent objects. The function can be called when the Create Design Intent form or Edit Design Intent form are submitted.

functions.name: ciUprevEAConstrs
functions.description: Modifies and corrects those constraints in the 610EA (early adopter) release which became obsolete in the full 610 release. Specifically, this command will update any layout structure constraints to be modgen, cluster, or cluster boundary constraints.

functions.name: ciUtilsAddNTimes
functions.description: This utility function is used in modgen constraint generation for creating a string with repeated values.

functions.name: ciUtilsAddQuotes
functions.description: This function is used in constraint generation for converting a list of strings into a string where each string in the list will have double quotes when added to the string.

functions.name: ciUtilsBuildString
functions.description: This is a utility function for building a string from a list of values. The values are converted to strings by applying the passed string format and separated by the passed separator.

functions.name: ciUtilsGetArgVal
functions.description: This is a utility function for accessing constraint generator argument values from a disembodied property list where the argument names may take one of two forms.

functions.name: ciUtilsMakeNumberRange
functions.description: This function returns a list containing a sequence of numbers ranging from the passed from value to the passed to value. Optionally, this function reverses the list into descending order and applies a sprintf format to the numbers.

functions.name: ciUtilsMakeUnique
functions.description: This function takes a list of items, which can contain duplicate items and returns a list without any duplicate items.

functions.name: ciUtilsRemoveNils
functions.description: Removes the nil elements from a list.

functions.name: ciUtilsRepeatNTimes
functions.description: This is a utility function for creating a list containing a single value repeated the specified number of times.

functions.name: ciUtilsReplaceNils
functions.description: This is a utility function for replacing any nil elements in a list with the specified value. See also, ciUtilsRemoveNils and ciUtilsMakeUnique.

functions.name: ciVariantInfoForFingersAndFingerWidth
functions.description: Used by the Circuit Prospector as a generator to set a variantInfo property to each given instance registered as a fet, when the parameter value for the parameter registered as fingerWidth is greater than the given minWidth value, and smaller than the maxWidth value.

functions.name: ciWithinConstraint
functions.description: Returns the constraints that contain the specified objects as members of the given constraint type.

functions.name: ciXYInstSymmetricIterator
functions.description: Evaluates the finderExpr with the current symmetric pair of objects that are assigned to L and R local variables. Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all symmetric design instance pairs, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

functions.name: ciXYNetSymmetricIterator
functions.description: Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all pairs of symmetric nets, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

functions.name: ciXYPinSymmetricIterator
functions.description: Used by Circuit Prospector finders to iterate over all pairs of symmetric pins, collecting them into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil.

functions.name: ciXYSortInsts
functions.description: Sorts a list of dbInstID, first by their X coordinates and then by their Y coordinates. This will order the instances, from top to bottom and left to right, in terms of where they are located on the canvas.

functions.name: ciXYSymmetricIterator
functions.description: Evaluates the finderExpr with the current symmetric pair of objects assigned to L and R local variables. The L and R variables can be referenced in the finderExpr. Iterates all pairs of symmetric design instances/pins (objects) collecting them together into symmetric pairs if the result of evaluating the passed expression (finderExpr) is not nil. The Circuit Prospector assistant finders use this function.

functions.name: ciwAddTranslatorItem
functions.description: Adds an entry for the Import or Export commands.

functions.name: ciwCreateMenu
functions.description: Creates a menu from the given menu definition. The menu created can be used as a pop-up menu. This function exists primarily for application support.

functions.name: ciwCreatePulldown
functions.description: Creates a pulldown menu from the given menu definition. The ls_menuDef argument can either be a list defining the contents of a pulldown menu or the SKILL symbol that represents the list. This function exists primarily for application support.

functions.name: ciwHiExit
functions.description: Exits the session.

functions.name: ciwMenuInit
functions.description: Initializes and installs the CIW pulldown menus based on the menu files found in the hierarchy. This function will be called instead of hiInstallCIWMenus. It can also be called from the CIW to debug the menu file contents.If g_reset is specified as t, the CIW menus are reset. Calling ciwMenuInit without any arguments will initialize the CIW menus only if it has not already been done.

functions.name: ciwMenuInstall
functions.description: Creates and installs into r_window a menu banner based on ls_bannerDef. Useful for applications that create and manage their own windows. This function exists primarily for application support.

functions.name: ciwMenuLoadFile
functions.description: Reads menu files found in the DFII hierarchy using t_appName.

functions.name: ciwRemoveTranslatorItem
functions.description: Removes an entry from the Import or Export commands.

functions.name: className
functions.description: Returns the class symbol denoting a class object.

functions.name: classOf
functions.description: Returns the class object of which the given object is an instance.

functions.name: classp
functions.description: Checks if the given object is an instance of the given class or is an instance of one of its subclasses.

functions.name: cleCleanUpScratchCellViews
functions.description: Deletes all the scratch cellviews with the prefix zcleSCRATCH. These cellviews are saved by the auto-saved or panic files.

functions.name: cleCreatePartition
functions.description: Creates a design partition definition in the specified Concurrent Layout cellview and changes the status of the design partition to Defined.

functions.name: cleCreatePartitionView
functions.description: Creates a design partition view on disk for the specified design partition in the specified Concurrent Layout cellview and changes the status of the design partition to Created.

functions.name: cleGetCurrentPartition
functions.description: Retrieves the name of the Concurrent Layout design partition in which you are currently editing.

functions.name: cleGetPartitions
functions.description: Lists the names of all Concurrent Layout design partitions defined in the specified cellview.

functions.name: cleGetUserTriggers
functions.description: Retrieves the name of the user-defined callback registered using cleRegUserTriggers.

functions.name: cleHasAutoSavedFile
functions.description: Checks whether the specified Concurrent Layout cellview has an auto-saved file.

functions.name: cleHasPanicFile
functions.description: Description

functions.name: cleIsAreaBasedPartition
functions.description: Checks whether the specified design partition is defined by area boundaries.

functions.name: cleIsLayerBasedPartition
functions.description: Checks whether the specified Concurrent Layout design partition is defined by a layer range.

functions.name: cleOpenAutoSavedCellView
functions.description: Opens the auto-saved cellview in the read-only mode. You can save the data using the Save a Copy command in the File menu of the layout window to save the cellview back to the disk. The auto-saved file is the cellview file name appended by a plus sign.

functions.name: cleOpenPanicCellView
functions.description: Opens a saved panic Concurrent Layout cellview from a physical panic file with the.oa-extension. This cellview opens in the read-only mode. You can save the data using the Save a Copy command in the File menu to a new cellview or overwrite the original Concurrent Layout cellview on the disk.

functions.name: clePartitionAttachAreaBoundary
functions.description: Attaches the name or ID of an existing area boundary to the specified design partition in the specified Concurrent Layout cellview.

functions.name: clePartitionGetAreaBoundaries
functions.description: Returns a list of database IDs of area boundaries attached to the specified design partition.

functions.name: clePartitionGetLayers
functions.description: Retrieves the list of layers included in the specified Concurrent Layout design partition.

functions.name: clePartitionGetStatus
functions.description: Retrieves the status and additional information of the specified Concurrent Layout Editing design partition.

functions.name: cleReInitialize
functions.description: Reinitializes a Concurrent Layout cellview if there are objects added to it outside the Concurrent Layout environment.

functions.name: cleRefreshAssistantByCellView
functions.description: Refreshes the content of the Concurrent Layout assistant in the specified Concurrent Layout cellview when you load a SKILL script that updates the design partition definition or changes the status of design partition view.

functions.name: cleRegUserTriggers
functions.signature: cleRegUserTriggers ([ ?cvInitProc t_cvInitProc ][ ?postInstallProc t_postInstallProc ][ ?postImportProc t_postImportProc ][ ?postOpenProc t_postOpenProc ][ ?postSipProc t_postSipProc ][ ?checkCvUpdateProc t_checkCvUpdateProc ][ ?hierEditSetupProc t_hierEditSetupProc ][ ?defLayerProc t_defLayerProc ][ ?postClearAllProc t_postClearAllProc ][ ?rmbMenuProc t_rmbMenuProc ][ ?postCreateProc t_postCreateProc ][ ?postSubmitProc t_postSubmitProc ][ ?postRejectProc t_postRejectProc ][ ?postCommitProc t_postCommitProc ][ ?preOpenScratchProc t_preOpenScratchProc ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Registers user-defined callbacks to customize the cellview for specific Concurrent Layout commands.

functions.name: cleRestoreAndOpenAutoSavedFile
functions.description: Restores and opens the auto-saved file for the specified Concurrent Layout cellview.

functions.name: cleRestoreAndOpenPanicFile
functions.description: Restores and opens the panic file for the specified Concurrent Layout cellview.

functions.name: cleStretchMalformedSpine
functions.description: Specifies whether the Stretch command can recognize a malformed spine and move it together if possible. For example, a malformed spine is a spine without a turn containing several collinear pathSegs with non-coincident end points.By default, this is disabled in a Concurrent Layout design (manager or designer mode) so that stretching a split pathSeg inside a design partition will not attempt to move an outside pathSeg in the same spine or do the opposite, even when the Spine option is enabled in the Selection Options form.

functions.name: cleUnregUserTriggers
functions.description: Unregisters all current or specified user-defined callback functions.

functions.name: clear
functions.description: Clears all tracing and breakpoints.

functions.name: clearAll
functions.description: Erases the contents of the current Waveform window and deletes the waveforms, title, date stamp, and labels stored in internal memory.

functions.name: clearAllEnterFunctions
functions.description: Cancels all nested enterfunctions associated with the current window.

functions.name: clearExitProcs
functions.description: Removes all registered exit procedures. When the optional argument g_tcovItem is set to t, it removes all exit procedures except those needed for the ilTCov reports.

functions.name: clearSubwindow
functions.description: Erases the contents of the current subwindow.

functions.name: cliGetCellViewOrigCellName
functions.description: Returns the cell name of the specified Concurrent Layout cellview.

functions.name: cliGetCellViewOrigLibName
functions.description: Returns the library name of the specified Concurrent Layout cellview.

functions.name: cliGetCellViewOrigViewName
functions.description: Returns the view name of specified Concurrent Layout cellview.

functions.name: cliIsCVType
functions.description: Checks whether the cellview specified by library, cell, and view is a Concurrent Layout cellview. A Concurrent Layout cellview can be a top cellview initialized for Concurrent Layout editing, a Concurrent Layout design partition view, or a Concurrent Layout scratch cellview.

functions.name: cliReopen
functions.description: Changes the mode of the specified cellview to the given mode. This function is equivalent to the dbReopen function but can handle both Concurrent Layout and non-Concurrent Layout cellviews.

functions.name: cliSave
functions.description: Saves the changes made to the specified cellview. This function is equivalent to the dbSave function but can handle both Concurrent Layout and non-Concurrent Layout cellviews.

functions.name: clilsDesignerMode
functions.description: Checks whether the specified cellview is open in Concurrent Layout designer mode.

functions.name: clilsManagerMode
functions.description: Checks whether the specified cellview is open in Concurrent Layout manager mode.

functions.name: clip
functions.description: Restricts the waveform to the range defined by n_from and n_to.

functions.name: clipX
functions.description: Restricts the waveform to the range defined by n_from and n_to.

functions.name: close
functions.description: Drains, closes, and frees a port.

functions.name: closeResults
functions.description: Closes the simulation results stored in the input results directory. The function closes all the internal resources opened by the tool that are related to the results directory. It is recommended that you must call this function before deleting a results directory, moving the directory to any other location, or renaming a results directory.

functions.name: cmdCtrlOption
functions.description: Implements a command option for Virtuoso Layout Suite XLcreating and editing commands when you press the Control key and press the bindkey. The command options are embedded in the Virtuoso Layout Suite XL software and cannot be changed. The default bindkey for this function is the right mouse button. You can change the default to another key.

functions.name: cmdOption
functions.description: Implements a command option for Virtuoso Layout Suite XL creating and editing commands when you press the bindkey. The command options are embedded in the Virtuoso Layout Suite XL software and cannot be changed. The default bindkey for this function is the right mouse button. You can change the default to another key.

functions.name: cmdShiftOption
functions.description: Implements a command option for Virtuoso Layout Suite L creating and editing commands when you press the Shift key and press the bindkey. The command options are embedded in the Virtuoso Layout Suite L software and cannot be changed. The default bindkey for this function is the right mouse button. You can change the default to another key.

functions.name: colorIndex
functions.description: Returns the pixel value for the colormap index of the specified RGB value. This function is an alias for hiMatchColor.

functions.name: compare
functions.description: Compares the two given waveforms based on the specified values for absolute and relative tolerances. This function compares only the sections of the two waveforms where the X or independent axes overlap.

functions.name: compareTime
functions.description: Compares two string arguments, representing a clock-calendar time.

functions.name: complex
functions.description: Creates a complex number of which the real part is equal to the real argument, and the imaginary part is equal to the imaginary argument.

functions.name: complexp
functions.description: Checks if an object is a complex number. The suffix p is added to the name of a function to indicate that it is a predicate function.

functions.name: compress
functions.description: Reduces the size of a SKILL file, which must be SKILL source code, and places the output into another file.

functions.name: compression
functions.signature: compression(o_waveform[ ?x f_x ][ ?y f_y ][ ?compression f_compression ][ ?io s_measure ][ ?tanSlope t_tanSlope ])=> f_compPoint / nil
functions.description: Performs an nth compression point measurement on a power waveform.

functions.name: compressionVRI
functions.signature: compressionVRI(o_vportx_harm[ ?iport o_iport ][ ?rport f_rport ][ ?epoint f_epoint ][ ?gcomp f_gcomp ][ ?measure s_measure ][ ?format format ])=> o_waveform / n_number / nil
functions.description: Performs an nth compression point measurement on a power waveform.

functions.name: compressionVRICurves
functions.signature: compressionVRICurves(o_vportx_harm[ ?iport o_iport ][ ?rport f_rport ][ ?epoint f_epoint ][ ?gcomp f_gcomp ][ ?format format ])=> o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Constructs the waveforms associated with an nth compression measurement.

functions.name: concat
functions.description: Concatenates strings, symbols, or integers into a single symbol.

functions.name: cond
functions.description: Examines conditional clauses from left to right until either a clause is satisfied or there are no more clauses remaining.

functions.name: conjugate
functions.signature: conjugate({ o_waveform | n_x })=> o_waveform / n_y / nil
functions.description: Returns the conjugate of a waveform or number.

functions.name: conn2Sch
functions.signature: conn2Sch(t_srcLibNamet_srcCellNamet_srcViewName[ ?destLibName t_destLibName ][ ?destCellName t_destCellName ][ ?destViewName t_destViewName ][ ?block t_block ][ ?paramFile t_paramFile ][ ?cdslib t_cdslib ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Generates a schematic view from an imported netlist view.

functions.name: conn2SchImpHdlDisplay
functions.description: Accepts the user interface name of Connectivity-to-Schematic tool as an argument and displays the GUI for the tool.

functions.name: conn2SchStartUp
functions.description: Invokes the graphical user interface of the Connectivity-to-Schematic tool. This is a CIW menu callback function.

functions.name: connectRules
functions.signature: connectRules(t_ruleName[ ?lib t_libName ][ ?view t_viewName ][ ?baseRule t_baseRule ][ ?moduleInfo l_moduleInfo ][ ?resolutionInfo l_resolutionInfo ][ ?commonParam l_commonParam ][ ?userDefined s_userDefined ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Sets connect rules for a given AMS OCEAN session required by the elaborator. To specify multiple connect rules, use this command multiple times. To add a connect rule to an OCEAN session, you can either choose a built-in rule from the connectLib library (by specifying t_ruleName, t_libName and t_viewName) or one of your own compiled built-in connect rules (by specifying t_ruleName, t_libName and t_viewName). To add a user defined connect rule to an OCEAN session specify s_userDefined. To modify an existing built-in rule, you need to specify t_baseRule (the name of the built-in rule that needs be modified), specify a new name (by specifying t_ruleName, t_libName and t_viewName) and also specify one or more of the optional arguments.

functions.name: cons
functions.description: Adds an element to the beginning of a list. Thus the car of l_result is g_element and the cdr of l_result is l_list. l_list can be nil, in which case a new list containing the single element is created.

functions.name: constar
functions.description: Adds elements to the beginning of a list.

functions.name: csh

functions.name: cstAddToConstraintGroup
functions.description: Adds a constraint group to be a member constraint group of the containing constraint. You can position the constraint group at the beginning of the members or at the end of the members with g_append. The default value for g_append is nil, which means that add the constraint group to the beginning of the members. The member constraint group cannot be owned by other objects.Note: A member constraint group cannot be added to itself.

functions.description: Creates a constraint group on an object (for example, net, term, and so on) with arguments of the object ID, constraint group definition name, and operator symbol. The constraint group definition name is required while constraint group operators are optional for this SKILL function.

functions.description: Deletes the constraint from any of the constraint groups it is a part of. Its value and constraint parameters are also deleted.

functions.name: cstDeleteConstraintGroup
functions.description: Deletes the constraint group (g_cstConstraintGroupID). The contained constraints in the constraint group are not automatically deleted when the constraintGroup is deleted.
