functions.description: Adds the action to the specified dag node or class. However, if the action is already in the list, it is not replaced. For an existing action, use dagDeleteActionFromObject to delete the action and then call dagAddActionToObject.

functions.name: dagCreateClass
functions.description: Creates a dagClass and returns it. If a class by this name already exists, it is overwritten.

functions.name: dagCreateNode
functions.description: Creates a dagNode and returns it.

functions.name: dagDeleteActionFromObject
functions.description: Deletes the action named t_actionName from the specified class or node. If a node action was inherited from its class, the action must be deleted from the class, not the node.

functions.name: dagDestroyNode
functions.description: Destroys a dagNode. All descendant nodes and arcs of this node are also destroyed, as well as the arcs linking this node to its parents.

functions.name: dagDisplayTool
functions.description: Redisplays a dagTool. You can use this function if you want to re-display all of the objects in the graph rather than calling dagRefreshObject for each one.

functions.name: dagGetCurrentObject
functions.description: Identifies the node for which the action was selected. It takes no arguments and returns the current node, or nil.

functions.name: dagGetCurrentTool
functions.description: Returns the current dagTool, and nil if there is not a current dagTool. The current dagTool is different from the current window. The current tool might not be the current window.

functions.name: dagLinkParentToChild
functions.description: Creates a dagArc that links the parent node to the child node. It returns the arc it creates. If an error occurs, it returns nil.

functions.name: dagNumToTool
functions.description: Returns the dagtool that matches the window number specified by x_toolNumber.

functions.name: dagOpenTool
functions.description: Creates a dagTool object and opens a window in which to display the graph starting from the specified starting node.

functions.name: dagPopTool
functions.description: Pops the tool stack specified by the w_dagTool argument.

functions.name: dagPushTool
functions.description: Pushes a new starting object specified by the w_newStartingNode argument onto the stack of the tool specified by w_dagTool.

functions.name: dagRefreshObject
functions.description: Redraws the node specified by w_dagNode in all the tools it is currently displayed.

functions.name: dagSetActionStatus
functions.description: Sets the status of the specified action in the action list of the class or node. An action that has been turned off is grayed-out in the pop-up menu and not available through its action accelerator, if any.

functions.name: dagSetCurrentTool
functions.description: Sets the current dagTool to the one specified by the w_dagTool argument.

functions.name: dagSetExpandedActionStatus
functions.description: Sets the status of the specified action in the expanded-action list of a node. Setting the status to nil makes the action name appear gray in the pop-up menu and makes the action accelerator unavailable. Once a dagNode has been placed into a tool, the actions from the dagClass are concatenated to make a full list of actions for this node. This is known as the expanded-action list.

functions.name: dagSetFont
functions.description: Modifies the font used in text mode in any dag tool.

functions.name: dagUnlinkParentFromChild
functions.description: Unlinks a parent node from a child node. It takes, as its only argument, the dagArc that connects the parent to the child. The arc is destroyed; however, neither the parent node nor the child node is destroyed. This can be useful if you want to change the parent of a node.

functions.name: dataTrigger
functions.description: The data trigger is called after the DE has collected and verified all of the trigger arguments, checked for the proper application registration, and opened or validated a window for the design.

functions.name: dataTypes
functions.description: Returns the list of data types that are used in an analysis previously specified with selectResult.

functions.name: db10
functions.signature: db10({ o_waveform | n_number })=> o_waveform / n_number / nil
functions.description: Returns 10 times the log10 of the specified waveform object or number. This function can also be written as dB10.

functions.name: db20
functions.description: Returns 20 times the log10 of the specified waveform object or number. This function can also be written as dB20.

functions.name: dbAbutIsInteractive
functions.description: This function is used by user-defined abutment functions. It indicates if the call to the abutment function was triggered by an interactive action.

functions.name: dbAbutIsReAbutGroup
functions.description: When called during abutment event 3 (un-abutment), the SKILL function indicates if re-abutment of Pcell instances will be triggered immediately after un-abutment. If the SKILL function returns true, the PDK SKILL function can store relevant information, if needed, from the current abutment group.

functions.name: dbAddAreaToPinGroupGuide
functions.description: Adds an area boundary to the specified area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbAddFigToFigGroup
functions.description: Adds a figure to the specified figGroup.

functions.name: dbAddFigToNet
functions.description: Assigns the given figure object to a specified net object. If the figure is already associated with a different net, the figure will be detached from that net before being assigned to the given net object.

functions.name: dbAddFigToPin
functions.description: Adds the specified figure to the given pin.

functions.name: dbAddFigToPinGroupGuide
functions.description: This function adds a via or a non-text shape to the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbAddFigsToPin
functions.description: Adds a list of figures to the given pin.

functions.name: dbAddObjectToGroup
functions.description: Adds a database object to a group.

functions.name: dbAddObjectsToMarker
functions.description: Adds a list of objects to a specified marker.

functions.name: dbAddPinToPinGroup
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Adds the padstack instance to the pin group.

functions.name: dbAddPinToPinGroupGuide
functions.description: This function adds a pin to the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbAddPlaceAreaBackgroundDef
functions.description: Adds a reference to the specified placeArea object in the given backgroundDef. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddPlaceAreaCompTypeSetDef
functions.description: Adds a reference in the specified placeArea to the specified compTypeSetDefs. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddPlaceAreaRailDef
functions.description: Adds a reference in the specified placeArea to the specified railDef. A warning message is displayed if the objects specified are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddRowBackgroundDef
functions.description: Adds a reference to the specified row object in the given backgroundDef. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddRowCompTypeSetDef
functions.description: Adds a reference in the specified compTypeSetDef to the specified row object. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddRowRailDef
functions.description: Adds a reference in the specified railDef to the specified row object. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbAddStrapObject
functions.description: Adds a database object to a specified strap pattern. The object must be of the type InstTerm, Via, or Shape. The object must be in the same database as the strap.

functions.name: dbAllCellViews
functions.description: Lists all the view names of a cell.

functions.name: dbAreaBoundaryHasLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: Returns a boolean value indicating that the layerPriorityOrder constraints set on the specified area boundary.

functions.name: dbAreaBoundaryHasValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: Returns a boolean value indicating that the validRoutingLayers constraint is set on the specified area boundary.

functions.name: dbAttachRowRegionToPRBoundary
functions.description: Associates the given rowRegion with the PRBoundary in the same block. If the PRBoundary is assigned to another rowRegion, it is first detached from that region before being assigned to the specified rowRegion.

functions.name: dbBoundaryQuery
functions.signature: dbBoundaryQuery(d_cellviewIdl_bBox[ x_startLevel ][ x_stopLevel ][ n_filterSize ][ l_transform ])=> ld_boundary / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the boundaries in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbCVHasInheritedSig
functions.description: Checks if there is any inherited signal in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCVHasInheritedTerm
functions.description: Checks whether there is any inherited terminal in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCVHasNetSetProp
functions.description: Determines if the netSet property is set on a cellview.

functions.name: dbCanonicalizeAnyAngleTransform
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Canonicalizes composition of the given transformations into a pair of orientation angles and a non-negative acute angle. Transformations are either numbers representing counter-clockwise rotation in degrees or strings representing orientation. The effect of transformation by the composition of the transformations in the return value is the same as effect of transformation by the composition of all input transformations.

functions.name: dbCellViewAreLayerShiftsValid
functions.description: Returns a Boolean depending on whether the layer shift information on the instances in the specified cellview is synchronized with the layers and color information in the bound tech. This function is currently intended only for the advanced nodes release.

functions.name: dbCellViewClearLayerShifts
functions.description: Clears the layer shift information from all instances in the specified cellview. Any cached layer shift specification for the tech bound to the cellview is left intact.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasEquivalentConnectivityTime
functions.description: Checks whether the equivalent connectivity time is set on the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasLayerShifts
functions.description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether there is layer shift information on any instance in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasOpticalData
functions.description: Checks whether the specified cellview has optical data.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasPhotonicPinFig
functions.description: (Virtuoso Photonics Option) Checks whether the specified cellview has a photonic pinFig.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasUnknownColorLockChanges
functions.description: Checks whether any edits were done to the specified type of objects in the older versions of Virtuoso after color lock type information was set for some of them.

functions.name: dbCellViewHasVirtHier
functions.description: Determines whether the specified cellview contains virtual hierarchy data.

functions.name: dbCellViewInitForLayerShifting
functions.description: Initializes the layer shift data for the given cell.

functions.name: dbCellViewResetAllColorLockTypes
functions.description: Changes color lock type for all color-locked objects of the specified object types to the given value.

functions.name: dbCellViewUpdateLayerShifts
functions.description: Creates or rebuilds the layer shift specification cache with the layers that are in the tech bound to the specified cellview. As a result, the per-layer shift information on the instances in the cellview is removed.

functions.name: dbChangeGroupType
functions.description: Changes the type of a group.

functions.name: dbCheckParamCell
functions.description: Checks if the specified cellview is a valid parameterized cell. If there was an error during the reading, binding, or evaluation of the specified cellview, a description of the error is returned.

functions.name: dbCheckRecursion
functions.description: Checks for occurrence of the given top cellview in the hierarchy of the instHeader masters or any other recursion inside the instHeader master hierarchy.

functions.name: dbClearAllActiveWireTypes
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Clears all the active wire type specifications on the design and for the widthSpacingSnapPatternDef. Additionally, clears all the region-specific active wire types.

functions.name: dbClearPcellCache
functions.signature: dbClearPcellCache([ t_libName ][ t_cellName ][ t_viewName ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Deletes all the submasters of the cellview specified by t_libName, t_cellName, and t_viewName from the Express Pcell cache on disk at the location specified by the CDS_EXP_PCELL_DIR environment variable. If no argument is specified then it deletes the complete cache.

functions.name: dbClearUnusedOccShapeColorData
functions.signature: dbClearUnusedOccShapeColorData(d_cellView[ ?dryRun { t | nil } ][ ?ignoreUnboundRefs { t | nil } ])=> x_numClearedObjects / nil
functions.description: Opens hierarchy below the given cellview and removes all occShape coloring data that does not have any effect on the display of coloring data in the opened hierarchy. By default, if some instances or vias in the hierarchy cannot be bound, the function prints a warning message and returns nil, but cleanup can be forced with the ignoreUnboundRefs argument.

functions.name: dbClose
functions.description: Closes a cellview.

functions.name: dbCloseBag
functions.description: Closes the property bag in the given mode. If closing for append or write, the function decrements the write count.

functions.name: dbColorShapeQuery
functions.signature: dbColorShapeQuery(d_cellViewIdl_layerPurposePairl_bBox[ x_startLevel ][ x_stopLevel ][ n_filterSize ][ l_transform ])=> l_shapeColorPairs / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all shapes and their effective color, where the bounding boxes of the shapes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbColorShapeQuery2
functions.signature: dbColorShapeQuery2(d_cellViewIdl_layerPurposePairl_bBox[ x_startLevel ][ x_stopLevel ][ n_filterSize ][ l_transform ])=> l_occShapesWithColorAndState / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of shapes and occurrence shapes within a given region, and the coloring information for each shape. The coloring information includes the color, whether the color is locked, and whether the coloring is due to the color attribute or hierarchical color locking on the shape.

functions.name: dbCompressPointArray
functions.description: Compresses collinear points in a list of points.

functions.name: dbCompressionPlot
functions.description: Plots the nth compression point plot. The x_compression argument is optional and defaults to 1 for 1dB compression, if omitted.

functions.name: dbComputeBBox
functions.description: Recomputes the given cellview bounding box.

functions.name: dbComputeBBoxNoNLP
functions.description: Computes the given cellview bounding box, but excludes all the bounding boxes of the nlp labels in the given cellview itself and its reference cellviews.

functions.name: dbConcatTransform
functions.description: Merges two individual transformations into a single new transformation.

functions.name: dbConvertAnyAngleTransformFromDbToMY
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Converts orientation-based representation of an orthogonal transformation into an MY-based representation. Orientation-based representation is a pair of DB orientation and any-angle rotation with the rotation applied first. The MY-based representation is a pair of any-angle rotation and an optional reflection over a Y-axis with the reflection applied first.

functions.name: dbConvertArcToLine
functions.description: Converts an arc to a line. A line is defined as a number of connecting segments.

functions.name: dbConvertDonutToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a donut to a polygon.

functions.name: dbConvertEllipseToPolygon
functions.description: Converts an ellipse to a polygon.

functions.name: dbConvertLineToPath
functions.description: Converts a line to a path.

functions.name: dbConvertPathSegToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a pathseg to a polygon based on the boundary list.

functions.name: dbConvertPathToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a path to a polygon with the same number of points as the path.

functions.name: dbConvertRectToPolygon
functions.description: Converts a rectangle into a polygon.

functions.name: dbCopyCellView
functions.description: Copies a cellview to a destination cellview.

functions.name: dbCopyFig
functions.description: Copies and transforms a figure, and places it in a cellview.

functions.name: dbCopyProp
functions.description: Copies all the properties of one database object to another database object.

functions.name: dbCopyPropList
functions.description: Copies all the properties from the database object given in the first argument to the database object given in the second argument in a single, atomic, copy operation. Properties with the same name in the destination object are overwritten. If the given database objects are pcell instances, then pcell evaluation happens once after all the properties are copied.

functions.name: dbCopyShape
functions.description: Copies a shape to the specified cellview with the given transformation.

functions.name: dbCopySingleProp
functions.description: Copies a single property to a destination object.

functions.name: dbCreateArc
functions.description: Creates an arc.

functions.name: dbCreateAreaBlockage
functions.description: Creates an area blockage object of the type placement in the given cellview. Area blockages are used to prevent instances from being placed within a specific area.

functions.name: dbCreateAreaBoundary
functions.signature: dbCreateAreaBoundary(d_cellviewIdl_points[ t_name = nil][ lt_edgeNames = nil])=> d_areaBoundaryId / nil
functions.description: Creates an area boundary object in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateAreaHalo
functions.description: Creates an areaHalo blockage object of type placement. An area halo is associated with an instance or a prBoundary to represent an extended area around the master's prBoundary.

functions.name: dbCreateAreaPinGroupGuide
functions.description: Creates an area pin group guide with the specified name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateBackgroundDef
functions.description: Creates a backgroundDef based on the specified attributes. The layer-purpose pair must exist to create a backgroundDef.

functions.name: dbCreateBackgroundDefByAttr
functions.description: Creates a backgroundDef based on the SKILL DPL specification of the object. Contents of the SKILL DPL specification are checked before the backgroundDef is created.

functions.name: dbCreateBusNetDef
functions.description: Creates a bus net definition with specified bit order and base name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateBusTermDef
functions.description: Creates a bus terminal definition with specified bit order and base name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateCluster
functions.description: Creates a cluster in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateClusterBoundary
functions.description: Creates a cluster boundary object in the cellview of the given cluster. The cluster boundary is associated with a cluster (grouping of objects) and defines the area of the cluster objects.

functions.name: dbCreateCompTypeSetDef
functions.description: This function creates a container of component types that use the same placement attributes.

functions.name: dbCreateCompTypeSetDefByAttr
functions.description: Creates a compTypeSetDef in the given cellview based on the specified attributes list.

functions.name: dbCreateConn
functions.description: Identical to dbCreateInstTerm, except the net d_net defines a valid net to be connected to the instance terminal of a master terminal d_term.

functions.name: dbCreateConnByName
functions.description: Similar to dbCreateConn, except the master terminal is defined by t_name instead of being specified by the master terminal's dbObject.

functions.name: dbCreateConnByNewName
functions.description: Similar to dbCreateConnByName, except t_name can refer to a master terminal to be created in the master cellview of instance d_inst.

functions.name: dbCreateCoverObstruction
functions.description: Creates a cover obstruction object associated with the specified prBoundary object.

functions.name: dbCreateCurvedAreaBoundary
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a curved area boundary in the specified cellview, using the specified points.

functions.name: dbCreateCurvedPath
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a curved path that has a straight centerline and round edges at all segments.

functions.name: dbCreateCurvedPolygon
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a curved polygon.

functions.name: dbCreateCustomViaVariant
functions.description: Creates a custom viaVariant in cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateDiffMaskGroup
functions.description: Creates a diff-mask, color shape group (d_group) in the specified cellview with a pair of same-mask color shape groups and with the given name. The name must be unique amongst all diff-mask groups in the cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateDonut
functions.description: Creates a donut (two concentric circles).

functions.name: dbCreateDot
functions.description: Creates a dot.

functions.name: dbCreateEdgePinGroupGuide
functions.description: Creates an edge pin group guide with the specified name in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateEllipse
functions.description: Creates an ellipse.

functions.name: dbCreateEnumProp
functions.description: Creates an enumerated property for an object.

functions.name: dbCreateExtParamInst
functions.description: Creates a parameterized cell instance (of cellview d_master) in the cellview d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient. The parameters in the l_params list may be CDF parameters whose values match the CDF parameter defaults.

functions.name: dbCreateExtParamInstByMasterName
functions.description: Creates an instance of the specified Pcell master in the specified cellview. The parameters in the parameter list may be CDF parameters. In this case, for each parameter the function creates an explicit local user property on the instance, even if its value is the same as the default on the master.

functions.name: dbCreateFigGroup
functions.description: Creates a figGroup object in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateGCellPattern
functions.description: Creates a GCell pattern in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateGenViaVariant
functions.description: Creates a genViaVariant object in the specified cellview according to the specified viaDef and parameter list.

functions.name: dbCreateGroup
functions.description: Creates a group of the specified group definition in the specified cellview. If a group definition is not specified, a traditional, unrestricted group is created, which allows all types of objects and all types of groups as members and can exist in any database.

functions.name: dbCreateGuide
functions.description: Creates a guide based on the specified parameters.

functions.name: dbCreateHierProp
functions.description: Creates a hierarchical property for an object.

functions.name: dbCreateInPlaceCoverObstruction
functions.description: Creates an InPlaceCoverObstruction object on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbCreateInst
functions.description: Creates an instance (of cellview d_master) in the cellview d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient. This function creates a named object and has a ROD ID associated with this object.

functions.name: dbCreateInstByMasterName
functions.description: Creates an instance (of cellview-t_libName/t_cellName/t_viewName) in d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient.

functions.name: dbCreateInstTerm
functions.description: Creates an instance terminal on the instance d_inst for the master terminal d_term.

functions.name: dbCreateInstTermByPosition
functions.description: Creates an instTerm connecting to a terminal at the given position and to the specified master instance.

functions.name: dbCreateLabel
functions.description: Creates a graphic text-string label.

functions.name: dbCreateLayerBlockage
functions.description: Creates a layer blockage object of the specified type in the given cellview. A layer blockage represents an area on a given layer where an instance cannot be placed. In DFII, a layer blockage cannot be of type placement.

functions.name: dbCreateLayerHalo
functions.description: Creates a layer halo blockage object of the specified type.

functions.name: dbCreateLib
functions.description: Creates a library named t_libName.

functions.name: dbCreateLine
functions.description: Creates a line.

functions.name: dbCreateMarker
functions.signature: dbCreateMarker(d_cellviewIdt_msgt_tooll_points[ ld_objects ][ g_isVisible ][ g_isClosed ][ t_severity ][ t_shortMsg ][ t_deleteWhen ])=> d_markerId / nil
functions.description: Creates a marker object in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateMultipleCurvedPolygons
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates multiple curved polygons in the specified cellview on the specified layer or layer-purpose pair using the specified points.

functions.name: dbCreateNamedSubNet
functions.description: Creates a subnet with the specified name. The behavior is different from dbCreateNet because when a root net ID is specified. dbCreateNameSubNet creates an explicitly named scalar net with the specified subnet name.

functions.name: dbCreateNet
functions.description: Creates a new net in a cellview. If the net already exists, returns nil.

functions.name: dbCreatePRBoundary
functions.description: Creates a prBoundary object in the specified cellview for place-and-route purpose. A cellview can only have one prBoundary.

functions.name: dbCreateParamInst
functions.description: Creates a parameterized cell instance (of cellview d_master) in the cellview d_cellView with an origin and orientation specified by l_point and t_orient.

functions.name: dbCreateParamInstByMasterName
functions.description: Creates an instance of the specified Pcell master in the specified cellview. The parameters in the parameter list may be CDF parameters. In this case, when you create a Pcell instance and pass a parameter, with the same value as the default value, dbCreateParamInstByMasterName() does not create an explicit local user property on the instance because the value is the same as the default. If the value is different from the default, the function stores the value as a local property on the instance.

functions.name: dbCreateParamSimpleMosaic
functions.description: Creates a parameterized simple mosaic (from the master d_masterCellView) in d_cellView, with an origin and orientation specified by l_origin and l_orient.

functions.name: dbCreateParamSimpleMosaicByMasterName
functions.description: Creates a parameterized simple mosaic (from the master t_libName/t_cellName/t_viewName) in d_cellView, with an origin and orientation specified by l_origin and l_orient.

functions.name: dbCreatePath
functions.description: Creates a path.

functions.name: dbCreatePathSeg
functions.description: Creates a path segment based on the specified parameters. The argument l_extValue is an optional list that contains six entries.

functions.name: dbCreatePin
functions.signature: dbCreatePin(d_netIdd_figId | nil[ t_pinName | nil ][ d_termId | nil])=> d_pin / nil
functions.description: Creates a pin.

functions.name: dbCreatePinGroup
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Returns the pin group created with the given arguments.

functions.name: dbCreatePlaceArea
functions.description: Creates a custom placeArea in the specified cellview. A custom placeArea is a row structure used for placing device-level instances.

functions.name: dbCreatePlaceBound
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Creates a placeBound using the values specified through the arguments. A placeBound is created within a die footprint cell and is used to represent the die thickness.

functions.name: dbCreatePolygon
functions.description: Creates a polygon.

functions.name: dbCreateProp
functions.description: Creates a scalar property for an object. If a property named t_name already exists on the specified object, it returns nil.

functions.name: dbCreateRailDef
functions.description: This function creates a container of attributes to define a row rail. The definition can be referenced in more than one row or placeArea. If a physical attribute is modifed in the object, it is instantly reflected in all row/placeArea that reference the railDef.

functions.name: dbCreateRailDefByAttr
functions.description: Creates railDef based on the SKILL DPL of the railDef object specification. Contents of the SKILL DPL specification are checked before railDef is created.

functions.name: dbCreateRangeProp
functions.description: Creates a range property for an object.

functions.name: dbCreateRect
functions.description: Creates a rectangle.

functions.name: dbCreateRegionBoundary
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Creates a region boundary.

functions.name: dbCreateRelatedSnapPatterns
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Creates a group of related snap patterns in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateRoute
functions.signature: dbCreateRoute(d_cellviewId[ d_netId ][ g_isGlobal ][ t_routeStatus ])=> d_routeId / nil
functions.description: Creates a route based on the specified parameters.

functions.name: dbCreateRow
functions.description: Creates a row in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateRowRegion
functions.description: Creates a rowRegion in the specified cellview. The contents of the rowRegion are created based on the template defined in the rowRegionSpec. This function supports only non-concave rectilinear polygons.

functions.name: dbCreateRowRegionSpec
functions.signature: dbCreateRowRegionSpec(d_cvIdt_name{ n_height | d_siteDef }l_rowAttrs[ l_refGridNames ][ l_refGridOffsets ][ t_relSnapPatternName ][ t_type ])=> d_specId / nil
functions.description: Creates rowRegionSpec in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateRuler
functions.description: Creates a dbRuler object in the design.

functions.name: dbCreateSameMaskGroup
functions.description: Creates a same-mask, color shape group (d_group) in the specified cellview with the given name. The name must be unique amongst all same-mask groups in the cellview. You can only add shapes to the resulting group.

functions.name: dbCreateSigNetExpr
functions.description: Given an inherited net expression in t_netExpression and a signal id in d_sigId, this function attaches the inherited net expression to the given signal and adds the signal to the set of signals having inherited net expressions.

functions.name: dbCreateSimpleMosaic
functions.description: Creates a simple mosaic in the cellview from the master d_masterCellView.

functions.name: dbCreateSnapBoundary
functions.description: Creates a snap boundary in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateStdViaVariant
functions.signature: dbCreateStdViaVariant(d_cellViewId t_viaVariantName t_viaDefName(t_cutLayerName f_cutLayerWidth f_cutLayerHeight)(n_cutRows n_cutCol (f_cutSpaceX f_cutSpaceY))(f_layer1EncX f_layer1EncY)(f_layer2EncX f_layer2EncY)(f_layer1OffsetX f_layer1OffsetY)(f_layer2OffsetX f_layer2OffsetY)(f_origOffsetX f_origOffsetY)(f_implant1EncX f_implant1EncY)(f_implant2EncX f_implant2EncY)(cut_pattern))=> nil / d_viaVariantId
functions.description: Creates a standard via variant with the specified attributes.

functions.name: dbCreateSteiner
functions.description: Creates a Steiner object in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateStrap
functions.description: Creates a strap pattern with the given name on the specified topology.

functions.name: dbCreateStrongGroup
functions.description: This function is obsolete in this release. Strong connections are defined exclusively by the geometry on the pin. All the pinFigs on the same pin are strongly connected to one another

functions.name: dbCreateTapSteiner
functions.description: Creates a tap steiner object with the specified bounding box in the given cellview.

functions.name: dbCreateTerm
functions.description: Creates a terminal for a net.

functions.name: dbCreateTermNetExpr
functions.description: Given an inherited net expression in t_netExpression and a term ID, in d_termId, this function attaches the inherited net expression to the given terminal and adds the terminal to the set of terminals having inherited net expressions.

functions.name: dbCreateTextDisplay

functions.name: dbGetOverlaps
functions.signature: dbGetOverlaps(d_cellViewl_bBox[ l_layerPurposePair | tx_layer | g_value {t | nil} ][ lx_level ][ g_doRowCol ])=> ld_fig / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the objects (such as, vias, shapes, instances, and mosaics) in a cellview that overlaps the area specified by l_bBox.If the object comes from a lower level in the hierarchy, instead of from the specified cellview, the object is represented by a list (potentially a nested list, if it comes from more than one level down). Each level of the list has the ID of the instance in the corresponding level in the hierarchy.For example, if there is a rectangle in a master cellview two levels down, for this rectangle, in the top cellview, dbGetOverlaps will return a nested list. The output of this function is same as that of dbGetTrueOverlaps.

functions.name: dbGetTrueOverlaps
functions.signature: dbGetTrueOverlaps(d_cellViewl_bBox[ l_layerPurposePair | tx_layer | g_value {t | nil} ][ lx_level ][ g_doRowCol ])=> ld_fig / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the objects (such as, vias, shapes, instances, and mosaics) in a cellview that overlap the area specified by l_bBox.If the object comes from a lower level in the hierarchy, instead of from the specified cellview, the object is represented by a list (potentially a nested list, if it comes from more than one level down). functions.name: dbIsTermSoftConnect
functions.description: Checks the softConnect attribute value of the specified explicit, single-bit terminal.

functions.name: dbIsTopologyPatternId
functions.description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the specified object ID is a dbTopologyPattern.

functions.name: dbIsTrackPatternColorAlternating
functions.description: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether the coloring for the specified track pattern is alternating.

functions.name: dbIsTrackPatternColored
functions.description: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether the first track of the specified track pattern is colored in a color other than gray.

functions.name: dbIsTrackPatternColoringAllowed
functions.description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the specified track pattern can be colored. Only track patterns with specified track layer can be colored.

functions.name: dbIsVPLGen
functions.description: Returns true if the design is a VPLGen.

functions.name: dbIsVRFEnabled
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Confirms whether the Virtuoso RF Solution-related functionality is enabled in the current session.

functions.name: dbIsVRFInfraEnabled
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Confirms whether the Virtuoso RF Solution infrastructure sub-system is enabled in the current session. This includes the basic database SKILL functions required to work with the curved shapes, Allegro translators, and other related features.

functions.name: dbIsValidSigNetExpr
functions.description: Given an inherited net expression in the t_netExpression associated with a signal, this function checks whether its syntax is valid. This function does as much local checking as possible, but it does not detect whether the given default net name is global, nor whether the evaluation of the property results in a valid net name.

functions.name: dbIsValidTermNetExpr
functions.description: Given an inherited net expression in t_netExpression associated with a terminal, this function checks whether its syntax is valid. This function does as much local checking as possible, but it does not detect whether the given default net name is global nor whether the evaluation of the property results in a valid net name.

functions.name: dbIsViaColorStateLayerLocked
functions.description: Indicates whether the coloring for the specified individual layer in a via is locked.

functions.name: dbIsViaColorStateLocked
functions.description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the coloring on the via is locked. The default value is nil.

functions.name: dbLayerAnd
functions.description: Returns a list of objects derived from the overlap of objects on the input lists. This function generates the areas common to both input lists. The resulting objects are created in the specified layer and cellview.

functions.name: dbLayerAndNot
functions.description: Returns a list of new objects derived from areas of the first input list that do not overlap any area of the second input list and creates the resulting objects in the specified layer and cellview.

functions.name: dbLayerBlockageQuery
functions.signature: dbLayerBlockageQuery(d_cellviewIdtx_layerl_bBox[ x_startLevel ][ x_stopLevel ][ n_filterSize ][ l_transform ])=> ld_layerBlockage / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the layer blockages in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbLayerEnclose
functions.description: Returns a list of shapes on the first list that enclose shapes on the second list. A shape is enclosing the other if the entire area of a second shape is covered by first shape.

functions.name: dbLayerHoles
functions.description: Returns a list of new objects from those areas consisting of all the holes in shapes of the input list. A hole is an area created when the perimeter of a polygon touches itself, enclosing an area that is not the polygon.

functions.name: dbLayerInside
functions.description: Creates a new merged object for each overlapping object on dbIdList1 that is completely enclosed by an object on dbIdList2 and returns a list of the new object/objects created. A shape on dbIdList1 is considered inside if its entire area is enclosed by the area of a shape on dbIdList2. Coincident shapes are considered inside in this check. If both shapes are coincident on all sides, then each shape can be defined as being inside the other.

functions.name: dbLayerNoHoles
functions.description: Returns a list of new objects from those areas consisting of all the original shapes of the input list without holes. A hole is an area created when the perimeter of a polygon touches itself, enclosing an area that is not the polygon.

functions.name: dbLayerOr
functions.description: Returns a list of new objects that encompass all areas on input lists and creates the resulting objects in the specified layer and cellview.

functions.name: dbLayerOutside
functions.description: Creates a new object for each object on dbIdList1 that is not enclosed by any object on dbIdList2 and returns a list of the new object created. A shape on dbIdList1 is considered outside if none of its area is enclosed by the area of a shape on dbIdList2. Coincident shapes are considered inside in this check. Butting edges are considered outside.

functions.name: dbLayerSize
functions.description: Performs an oversizing or undersizing operation on the object specified in the input list.

functions.name: dbLayerStraddle
functions.description: Returns a list of new objects from those shapes on the first layer that straddle shapes on the second layer. A shape is straddling, if part of its area is covered by part of the shape on the second layer and part is not. The return list also includes copies of shapes that are touching these straddling shapes.Butting and coincident edges do not affect this function.

functions.name: dbLayerTile
functions.description: Fractures edges of the specified object on the input list into vertical trapezoids.

functions.name: dbLayerXor
functions.description: Returns a list of new objects derived from those portions of either input list that do not overlap the other list and creates the resulting objects in the specified layer and cellview.

functions.name: dbListTypes
functions.description: Lists the enumerated values for a specified database enumerated type.

functions.name: dbMakeBagCurrent
functions.description: Refreshes the given property bag if it is out of date relative to the one on disk.

functions.name: dbMakeFigSetGroup
functions.description: Creates a FigSetGroup in the specified cellview and populates it with the contents of the specified FigSet.

functions.name: dbMakeNet
functions.description: Creates a new net in a cellview. If the net already exists, it returns the dbObject of the net.

functions.name: dbMapPinGroupPins
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework Only) Maps all the pins in every pin group of the given cellview to the pinMapLayer parameter of a die.

functions.name: dbMarkerQuery
functions.signature: dbMarkerQuery(d_cellviewIdl_bBox[ x_startLevel ][ x_stopLevel ][ n_filterSize ][ l_transform ])=> ld_marker / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the markers in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbMergeNet
functions.description: Merges one netId2 into netId1. The pins, terminals, connections, figures, properties, and signals of the merging net (netId2) are merged into the surviving net (netId1), and member nets of netId2's signals become members of netId1's signals. Both of the nets may already be attached to a terminal; both nets must have the same number of bits. If the two nets are in the same net hierarchy, netId1 must not be a descendant of netId2. If the merge is successful, netId1 is returned; otherwise, nil is returned.

functions.name: dbMergeSignal
functions.description: Merges two signals into one signal.

functions.name: dbMergeSingleProp
functions.description: Merges a property with a destination object without overwriting the property if it already exists.

functions.name: dbMergeStrongGroups
functions.description: This function is obsolete in this release. Strong connections are modeled by multiple pinFigs on the same pin.

functions.name: dbMoveChildNet
functions.description: Moves a net to be the child of given parent net, both should be on same terminal.

functions.name: dbMoveFig
functions.description: Moves and transforms a figure, and places it in a cellview.

functions.name: dbMoveGroupMember
functions.description: Moves group member d_groupMem1 immediately after group member d_groupMem2.

functions.name: dbMovePinToNet
functions.description: Moves a pin to the specified net.

functions.name: dbMoveShape
functions.description: Moves a shape to given cellview with given transformation.

functions.name: dbMustConnectPins
functions.description: This function is obsolete in this release. External Pin connections are modeled by collections of MustJoin Terms.

functions.name: dbNetHasTopology
functions.description: Returns a Boolean indicating whether the specified net has a topology.

functions.name: dbNetIsSig
functions.description: Tests whether the specified net ID is also a signal.

functions.name: dbOpenAutoSavedCellView
functions.description: Reads the auto-saved file.

functions.name: dbOpenBag
functions.description: Opens the library, cell, or view property bag in the given mode.

functions.name: dbOpenCellViewByType
functions.signature: dbOpenCellViewByType({ gt_lib | nil }t_cellNamelt_viewName[ t_viewTypeName[ t_mode[ d_contextCellView ] ] ])=> d_cellView / nil
functions.description: Opens a cellview.

functions.name: dbOpenHier
functions.description: Opens and binds masters of instances that constitute a design hierarchy.

functions.name: dbOpenPanicCellView
functions.description: Opens a saved panic cellview from a physical panic file with extension .oa-. The cellview .oa- opens in read mode only. You can then use the dbSave() function to save it to a new cellview, or call the dbReopen() function to reopen it in the append mode and then call the dbSave() function to save the cellview back to disk.

functions.name: dbOpenParamCellView
functions.description: Opens submaster cellview of the Pcell supermaster specified by the library, cell, and view names and the parameter values.

functions.name: dbOpenScratchDesign
functions.description: Opens a scratch design of the specified cellview type scoped to the specified library.

functions.name: dbParseSigNetExpr
functions.description: Parses the expression and returns the individual components of the expression that include the search scope, the property name to be used in searching, the format string, and the default net name.

functions.name: dbParseTermNetExpr
functions.description: Parses the expression and returns the individual components of the expression that include the search scope, the property name to be used in searching, the format string, and the default net name.

functions.name: dbPinGroupGuideHasKeepoutSpacing
functions.description: Returns a boolean value indicating that the keepoutSpacing constraint is set on the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbPinGroupGuideHasLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: Returns a boolean value indicating that the layerPriorityOrder constraint is set on the specified area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbPinGroupGuideHasMinPinSpacing
functions.description: Returns a boolean value indicating whether the minSpacing constraint is set on the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbPinGroupGuideHasMinPinWidth
functions.description: Returns a boolean value indicating whether the minWidth constraint is set on the specified pin group guide.

functions.name: dbPinGroupGuideHasValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: Returns a boolean value indicating whether the validRoutingLayers constraint is set on the specified area pin group guide.

functions.name: dbPinHasMinPinSpacing
functions.description: Returns a boolean value indicating whether the minSpacing constraint is set on the specified pin.

functions.name: dbPinHasMinPinWidth
functions.description: Returns a boolean value indicating whether the minWidth constraint has been applied to the specified pin.

functions.name: dbPlacementBlockageQuery
functions.signature: dbPlacementBlockageQuery(d_cellviewIdl_bBox[ x_startLevel ][ x_stopLevel ][ n_filterSize ][ l_transform ])=> ld_via / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the placement blockages in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbPointArrayAnd
functions.description: Returns a list of point lists derived from the overlap of shapes in the two input point lists. This function generates the areas common to both the input lists. The resulting point list is created in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbPointArrayAndNot
functions.description: Returns a list of point lists derived from the area of the first input point list that does not overlap any area of the second input point list. The resulting point list is created in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbPointArrayOr
functions.description: Returns a list of point lists derived from the union of shapes in the two input point lists. The resulting point list is created in the specified cellview. If the second input point list is not specified, the first input point list is returned.

functions.name: dbPointArraySize
functions.description: Returns a list of point lists derived after performing an over size or under size operation on the shapes specified in the input list. The resulting point list is created in the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbPointArrayXor
functions.description: Returns a list of point lists derived from portions of both the inputs lists that do not overlap the points in the other input list.

functions.name: dbProduceMemName
functions.description: Returns a list of member names for the given name.

functions.name: dbProduceOverlap
functions.description: Returns a list of all the shapes in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the area specified by l_bBox. This function interface is simpler than dbGetOverlaps if you are only interested in finding the overlapping shapes.

functions.name: dbProduceOverlapInst
functions.description: Returns a list of all the instances in a cellview that overlap the area specified by l_bBox. This function interface is simpler than dbGetOverlaps if you are only interested in finding instances.

functions.name: dbPurge
functions.description: Forces a cellview to close and removes from virtual memory.

functions.name: dbPurgeBag
functions.description: Forces a property bag to close and removes it from virtual memory.

functions.name: dbReOpenBag
functions.description: Reopens the given g_bagId for the given mode.

functions.name: dbRebuildRowRegion
functions.description: Removes contents of the specified rowRegion and then regenerates it based on the rowRegionSpec associated with it.

functions.name: dbRedoToHandle
functions.description: Invokes redo up to the given handle. If no handle name is given, it rolls forward to the next labeled checkpoint.

functions.name: dbRefreshBag
functions.description: Refreshes the virtual memory image of the property bag by the one from the disk. If the disk file does not exist and the bag is in edit mode, then the virtual memory is truncated.

functions.name: dbRefreshCellView
functions.description: Refreshes the cellview in virtual memory with the most current copy from disk. If there were any changes to the cellview, this function purges the cellview from virtual memory and reopens the cellview.

functions.name: dbRefreshLibDataCompressionLevel
functions.description: Refreshes the data compression level for the specified library ID from the disk.

functions.name: dbRegPostSaveAsTrigger
functions.description: Allows users to register a trigger function that is called after a postSaveAs or Save Copy operation.

functions.name: dbRegPostSaveTrigger
functions.description: Allows users to register a trigger function that is to be called after dbSave. If dbSave fails, this trigger will not be launched. This trigger will be called only after saving the db cellviews. The post save trigger will be called with the db cellview ID.

functions.name: dbRegPurgeTrigger
functions.description: Registers a user-defined trigger function.

functions.name: dbRegSaveTrigger
functions.description: Registers a SKILL preSave trigger. The trigger function does not need to exist at the time of register, a warning will be issued though. If the function is bound, it is called before the cellview is saved.

functions.name: dbRegVPLGenCreateCellName
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function to create unique cell names for VPLGen core layouts.

functions.name: dbRemasterAnyInst
functions.description: Remasters the specified instance to the specified master cellview.

functions.name: dbRemasterInstHeader
functions.description: Remasters all instances under the specified instance header to the specified master cellview.

functions.name: dbRemoveFigFromFigGroup
functions.description: Removes a figure from a figGroup object.

functions.name: dbRemoveLayerColorData
functions.signature: dbRemoveLayerColorData(d_cellViewIdt_layerNameg_locked[ g_via g_hcl g_instColorShift g_blockage g_trackPattern ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Removes the color data from the specified layer in the given cellview. By default, all color data is removed. You can optionally preserve the via color data, hierarchical color locks, layer shift information, blockage color data, and track pattern color data.

functions.name: dbRemoveObjectsFromMarker
functions.description: Removes a list of objects from a specified marker.

functions.name: dbRemovePinGroupGuideEdge
functions.description: Removes the prBoundary and edge name specification from the specified edge pin group guide.

functions.name: dbRemovePlaceAreaBackgroundDef
functions.description: Removes the association between the specified placeArea and backgroundDef. The background shape on the placeArea is also removed.

functions.name: dbRemovePlaceAreaCompTypeSetDef
functions.description: Removes a reference to the specified compTypeSetDef in the specified placeArea. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbRemovePlaceAreaRailDef
functions.description: Removes a reference to the specified railDef in the specified placeArea. The rail geometry is also deleted. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbRemoveRowBackgroundDef
functions.description: Removes the given backgroundDef from the specified custom row. Removing a backgroundDef also removes the background shape associated with the backgroundDef from the custom row.

functions.name: dbRemoveRowCompTypeSetDef
functions.description: Removes a reference to the specified compTypeSetDef in the specified row. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbRemoveRowRailDef
functions.description: Removes a reference to the specified railDef in the specified row. The rail geometry is also deleted. A warning message is displayed if the objects are not of the correct type.

functions.name: dbRemoveStrapObject
functions.description: Removes the database object from the specified strap pattern.

functions.name: dbRenameNet
functions.description: This function changes the name of the net pointed by netId to the newNetName.

functions.name: dbReopen
functions.description: Changes the mode of the specified cellview to the given mode.

functions.name: dbReplaceEnumProp
functions.description: Replaces an enumerated property for an object.

functions.name: dbReplaceHierProp
functions.description: Replaces a hierarchical property for an object.

functions.name: dbReplaceInstParamList
functions.description: Atomically replaces all the Pcell instance parameters with the given parameter list. The resulting Pcell subMaster is evaluated only once.

functions.name: dbReplaceParam
functions.description: Add or modifies a cellview parameter if the cellview is a Pcell super master. If the cellview is not a super master, dbReplaceParam gives a warning stating that it cannot define a parameter for a non super master, and quits.This function is only used on Pcell super master cellviews.

functions.name: dbReplaceProp
functions.description: Replaces a scalar property for an object. Calls to dbReplaceProp for abutment groups must be made before calls to dbReplaceProp for pcell properties.

functions.name: dbReplacePropList
functions.description: Replaces the specified list of properties (l_params) in the given object. dbReplacePropList will trigger Pcell evaluation once as an atomic operation.

functions.name: dbReplaceRangeProp
functions.description: Replaces a range property for an object.

functions.name: dbReplaceSigNetExpr
functions.description: Replaces any existing inherited net expression already associated with the signal. If none exists, t_netExpression is attached to the given signal and adds the signal to the set of signals having inherited net expressions.

functions.name: dbReplaceTermNetExpr
functions.description: Replaces any existing inherited net expression already associated with the terminal. If none exists, t_netExpression is attached to the given terminal and adds the terminal to the set of terminals having inherited net expressions.

functions.name: dbResetPropList
functions.description: Resets a list of properties on a given object with the specified list of properties.

functions.name: dbRestoreAndOpenAutoSavedFile
functions.description: Restores and opens the auto-saved file for the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbRestoreAndOpenPanicFile
functions.description: Restores and opens the panic file for the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbRowQuery
functions.signature: dbRowQuery(d_cellviewIdl_bBox[ x_startLevel ][ x_stopLevel ][ n_filterSize ][ l_transform ])=> ld_row / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of all the rows in a cellview whose bounding boxes overlap the region specified by l_bBox.

functions.name: dbRowRegionMatchesSpec
functions.description: Checks whether the rowRegion matches its rowRegionSpec.

functions.name: dbRowRegionPointsCutOut
functions.description: Changes the rectilinear specification of the specified rowRegion by cutting out the portion of it defined by the specified box. The box cannot fully cover the current rowRegion and it cannot split it into two or more fully independent rowRegions.

functions.name: dbSave
functions.signature: dbSave(d_cellview[ d_destCellView | t_libName t_cellName t_viewName ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Saves the changes made to a specified cellview opened in write or append mode. By default the cellview is saved to the same database ID; however, you can optionally specify a different destination cellview ID or create a new cellview in a different library. A cellview opened in read mode can only be saved as a new cellview with the different name.

functions.name: dbSaveBag
functions.description: Writes the virtual memory image of the property bag to disk.

functions.name: dbSavePcellCache
functions.description: If there is a mismatch in the timestamps of the supermaster, the existing submasters in the cache are deleted, and only the new submasters generated in virtual memory are saved to the Express Pcell cache on disk.

functions.name: dbSavePcellCacheForCV
functions.description: Opens the cellview specified by t_libName, t_cellName, and t_viewName and saves all the existing submasters generated or updated in virtual memory to the Express Pcell cache (including any other pre-existing submasters in virtual memory) on disk at the location specified by the CDS_EXP_PCELL_DIR environment variable.

functions.name: dbSavePcellCacheForCVOnly
functions.description: Opens the cellview specified by t_libName, t_cellName, and t_viewName and saves all the Pcell submasters specified in the given cell in the Express Pcell Cache.

functions.name: dbSearchCDF
functions.description: Sets and un-sets a flag that will cause CDF to be searched for parameter values.

functions.name: dbSearchPropByName
functions.description: Searches for the specified property.

functions.name: dbSetAnyTermGroundSensitivity
functions.description: Sets the ground sensitivity value for each bit of the specified terminal. If the terminal is a multi-bit terminal, the function only sets the ground sensitivity value on implicit bits. The ground sensitivity values on explicit bits are not affected.

functions.name: dbSetAnyTermSupplySensitivity
functions.description: Sets the supply sensitivity value for each bit of the specified terminal. If the terminal is a multi-bit terminal, the function only sets the supply sensitivity value on implicit bits. The supply sensitivity value on explicit bits are not affected.

functions.name: dbSetAreaBoundaryLayerPriorityOrder
functions.description: Sets the value of the layerPriorityOrder constraint on the given area boundary.

functions.name: dbSetAreaBoundaryValidRoutingLayers
functions.description: Sets the value of the validRoutingLayers constraint on the given area boundary.

functions.name: dbSetAutoSave
functions.description: Enables or disables the automatic save feature.

functions.name: dbSetAutoSaveCallback
functions.description: Enables a user-defined callback function to control the frequency at which large designs are auto-saved. When set, the user-defined callback function is called just before the design is about to be auto-saved.

functions.name: dbSetBeginPatch
functions.description: Adds or removes the beginStyle patch type for the specified path segment depending on the argument g_value.

functions.name: dbSetBlockageColor
functions.description: Assigns color to the specified blockage.

functions.name: dbSetBoundaryEdge
functions.description: Sets the points (edges) and edge names for the specified boundary.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewActiveWireTypes
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the active wire types on the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewActiveWireTypesForWidthSpacingSnapPatternDef
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the active wire types on the specified cellview for a given widthSpacingSnapPatternDef.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewEEQMaster
functions.description: Sets the value of the EEQmaster attribute of the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewEquivalentConnectivityTime
functions.description: Sets the equivalent connectivity time on the specified cellview.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewNetVoltageRange
functions.description: Sets the default minimum and maximum net voltages on a cellview ID.

functions.name: dbSetCellViewSymmetry
functions.description: Sets the symmetry (or orientation) on a cellview (for which the ID is specified). The symmetry of the cellview can be set to a string value, such as X, Y, XY, any, or none, where X mirrors the cellview about the x axis and Y mirrors the cellview about the y axis.

functions.name: dbSetColorModel
functions.description: Sets the value of the color model constraint for the specified cellview. It specifies how you want the contents of the block to be color-shifted. Possible values are any, layerBased, or locked.

functions.name: dbSetCompTypeSetDefCompFilters
functions.description: Sets the component filters in the specified compTypeSetDef.

functions.name: dbSetConnCurrent
functions.description: Sets the value of the connectivity current property to the cellview timestamp counter value.

functions.name: dbSetCurvedAreaBoundaryPoints
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Sets curved points for the specified curved area boundary object.

functions.name: dbSetCurvedPathRealWidth
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Sets the real width of the curved path. The real width could be 1DBU or more.

functions.name: dbSetCurvedPolygonPoints
functions.description: (Virtuoso MultiTech Framework) Sets the given curved point list for the specified polygon. If the polygon is not curved, it is converted to curved and the points are set.

functions.name: dbSetEndPatch
functions.description: Adds or removes the endStyle patch type for the specified path segment depending on the argument g_value.

functions.name: dbSetFigAbutName
functions.description: Assigns a unique abutment name to the figure associated with the given ID (d_figId). If you set the name to an empty string, Virtuoso clears any existing abutment names specified for the figure ID.

functions.name: dbSetFigAbutRefName
functions.description: Assigns an abutment reference name to the specified figure associated with the given ID (d_figId). If you set the name to an empty string, Virtuoso clears any existing abutment reference names specified for the figure ID.

functions.name: dbSetFluidShape
functions.description: Sets the given name for the specified shape to mark it as a fluid shape. This function can be used only in a sub-master layout view, for example, during Pcell generation.

functions.name: dbSetFullPatch
functions.description: Adds or removes the full style patch type for the specified path segment depending on the argument g_value. Path segment needs to have at least one property among beginStyle or endStyle or both to set the full style patch type.

functions.name: dbSetGenViaParamDefault
functions.description: Sets the specified parameter to its default value based on the given genVia ID and parameter name.

functions.name: dbSetGlobalGridDefaultRepeatMode
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the specified repeat mode as the default on a cellview for the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDef global grid.

functions.name: dbSetGlobalGridOffsetReferenceType
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the global grid offset reference type on a cellview for the snapPatternDef and widthSpacingSnapPatternDef global grids. The global grid offset reference type can be boundary or origin.

functions.name: dbSetGlobalGridRepeatMode
functions.description: (ICADVM20.1 Only) Sets the specified repeat mode for the widthSpacingSnapPatternDef global grid in the specified cellview for the given width spacing pattern.

functions.name: dbSetHierCacheUsage
functions.description: Sets the intended hierarchical cache usage for a given design, if specified; otherwise, it sets the usage for the session. The subset of operations permitted by both the session and design cache usages is enabled for the design.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionAbstractFileName
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction AbstractFileName attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionAbstractFilePath
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction AbstractFilePath attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionAbstractViewName
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction AbstractViewName attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionBloat
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction Bloat attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionBlockageAttributeValue
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction BlockageAttributeValue attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionBlockageModel
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction BlockageModel attribute on the specified instance header on the specified layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionDoughnutHalo
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction DoughnutHalo attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionMergeDistance
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction MergeDistance attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionNeedsRemodeling
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction NeedsRemodeling attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionPinCutOut
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction PinCutOut attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionPinRemodeling
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction PinRemodeling attribute on the specified instance header.

functions.name: dbSetInPlaceCoverObstructionSpacingModel
functions.description: Sets value of the InPlaceCoverObstruction SpacingModel attribute on the specified instance header on the given layer.

functions.name: dbSetInstHeaderMasterName
functions.description: Sets the master of individual instance on the instHeader to the new master. All the instances are removed from the old instHeader and move to the new instHeader, which may exist or not. When an instHeader is empty, meaning it does not have any instance on this instHeader, the instHeader is removed and the ID is no longer valid.

functions.name: dbSetInstHeadersCounter
functions.description: Sets the value of the instance header change count property on each instance header to the instance master cellview timestamp counter value.

functions.name: dbSetInstTransparent
functions.description: Sets an instance as transparent to the Virtuoso Layout Suite XL binder.

functions.name: dbSetIntegrationColorModel
functions.description: Sets the value of the integration color model constraint for the specified cellview. Possible values are any or locked.

functions.name: dbSetLibDataCompressionLevel
functions.description: Sets the data compression level for designs that are saved to the specified library ID.

functions.name: dbSetMarkerName

functions.name: dcmatchSummary
functions.signature: dcmatchSummary([ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ][ ?result S_resultName ][ ?output t_fileName | p_port ][ ?paramValues ln_paramValues ][ ?deviceType ls_deviceType ][ ?variations ls_variations ][ ?includeInst lt_includeInst ][ ?excludeInst lt_excludeInst ][ ?truncateData n_truncateData ][ ?truncateType s_truncateType ][ ?sortType ls_sortType ])=> t_fileName / p_port/ nil
functions.description: Prints a report showing the mismatch contribution of each component in a circuit. If you specify a directory with resultsDir, it is equivalent to temporarily using the openResults command. The dcmatchSummary command prints the results for that directory and resets the openResults command to its previous setting. If you specify a particular result with resultName, it is equivalent to temporarily using the selectResult command on the specified results. The dcmatchSummary command prints the results and resets the selectResult command to its previous setting.

functions.description: Sets prompting and automatic check-in and check-out controls for files and views. Takes a list of four integers, each of which can be one of four values: 0 - none, 1 - views, 2 - files, 3 - both views and files. The integers are applied to indicate to the system to prompt for check out, prompt for check in, automatically check out, and automatically check in respectively.
