functions.name: ddCatRemove
functions.description: Removes the category and its contents from disk. All references to the category are removed from the library.

functions.name: ddCatSave
functions.description: Writes the category information to disk. This writes out any changes made to the category to disk.

functions.name: ddCatSubItem
functions.description: Removes the named item from the given category.If the name is the name of a category (that is, removing a subcategory from another category), the checks if it is referenced in any other category. If not, the category is moved to the library category list. This action ensures that the caller must do a ddCatRemove to remove category entries from a library. Changes are not written to disk until a ddCatSave is done.

functions.name: ddCheckin
functions.description: Checks in the new version of the checked-out and modified data files. Builds a system command that invokes the gdmci command. ddCheckin makes it possible to integrate Cadence tools with other design management software.

functions.name: ddCheckout
functions.description: Checks out a version of the files. No version of a cellview can be checked out by any user until any version that is currently checked out is checked in. Builds a system command that invokes the gdmco command. ddCheckout makes it possible to integrate Cadence tools with other design management software.

functions.name: ddClearLibUnmanaged
functions.description: Removes any DMTYPE entry from the cdsinfo.tag file in the library directory. This will allow the default value for DMTYPE to be used for this library.

functions.name: ddCreateLib
functions.description: Searches for the named library in the library list.

functions.name: ddDeleteLocal
functions.description: Removes b_objectId from the local work area only. If the objects are under design management, they are not removed from the repository.

functions.name: ddDeleteObj
functions.description: Deletes b_objectId from the disk.

functions.name: ddDumpLibList
functions.description: Prints information about the library list. It first prints the list of library files (cds.lib and lib.defs files) and then prints information about each library in the library list. This includes the path to the library and the path to TMP directories, if any.

functions.name: ddGetCoManagedSet
functions.description: Returns the list of comanaged files for the specified view.

functions.name: ddGetCombineValue
functions.description: Returns a list of names of libraries in a combined library, if the library specified has the COMBINE attribute assigned.

functions.name: ddGetDisplayValue
functions.description: Returns the value of the DISPLAY attribute assigned to a library.

functions.name: ddGetForcedLib
functions.description: Returns the path to the cds.lib file that was set by using either the -cdslib argument to the executable or by using ddSetForcedLib.

functions.name: ddGetForcedLibEx
functions.description: Gets the cds.lib file that was set with the ddSetForcedLib or ddSetForcedLibEx functions or with the -cdslib command line option.

functions.name: ddGetLibList
functions.description: Generates a list of the libraries in the libList.

functions.name: ddGetObj
functions.signature: ddGetObj({ t_libName / nil }[ t_cellName / nil ][ t_viewName / nil ][ t_fileName / nil ][ b_contextId / nil ][ t_mode ])=> b_ddId / nil
functions.description: Finds libraries, cells, views, and files, and creates cells, views, and files (you use ddCreateLib to create libraries).

functions.name: ddGetObjAccess
functions.description: Retrieves the UNIX access rights of the person specified by t_which to the object designated by b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjAccessEx
functions.description: Retrieves the UNIX access rights of the person specified by t_which to the object designated by b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjAccess except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjChildren
functions.description: Returns the children of b_objId. This includes all the objects in both the temporary and master directories.

functions.name: ddGetObjChildrenEx
functions.description: Returns the children of b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjChildren except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjDMSys
functions.description: Returns the name of the Design Management system of b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjFiles
functions.description: Lists all the files found in the object. This includes files found in both the master and temporary directories.

functions.name: ddGetObjFilesEx
functions.description: Lists all the files found in the object. This function is similar to ddGetObjFiles except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjGroup
functions.description: Retrieves the UNIX group ID of b_objId as an integer.

functions.name: ddGetObjGroupEx
functions.description: Retrieves the UNIX group ID of b_objId as an integer. This function is similar to ddGetObjGroup except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjLastModify
functions.description: Returns the last-modified time from the directory or file associated with b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjLastModifyEx
functions.description: Returns the last-modified time from the directory or file associated with b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjLastModify except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjLib
functions.description: Finds the ID of the library object that contains it b_objId. If the object is a library, it returns the same ID.

functions.name: ddGetObjName
functions.description: Returns the name of b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjOwner
functions.description: Retrieves the UNIX owner name of b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjOwnerEx
functions.description: Retrieves the UNIX owner name of b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjOwner except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjParent
functions.description: Returns the ID of the logical (often physical as well) owner-object od b_objId. For a file, it is the library, cell, or view. For a view, it is the cell. For the cell, it is the library. For the library, it is the library itself.

functions.name: ddGetObjReadPath
functions.description: Returns the read path to b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjReadPathEx
functions.description: Returns the read path to b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjReadPath except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjSize
functions.description: Returns the length of b_objId in bytes.

functions.name: ddGetObjSizeEx
functions.description: Returns the length of b_objId in bytes. This function is similar to ddGetObjSize except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetObjType
functions.description: Returns the ddType of b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjWritePath
functions.description: Returns the write path to b_objId.

functions.name: ddGetObjWritePathEx
functions.description: Returns the write path to b_objId. This function is similar to ddGetObjWritePath except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddGetPathDMSys
functions.description: Takes a string that is the path to a file or directory and either returns the string name of the design management system that manages that path or returns none if no design management system is in use for that path.

functions.name: ddGetStartup
functions.description: Looks for t_fileName in each standard place, and if it is not there, in stdPlace/share/cdssetup.

functions.name: ddGetTmpdirWarn
functions.description: Returns the current setting used to suppress or print a warning message for an ASSIGN statement with attribute TMP that appears in cds.lib files. The TMP attribute defines a temporary storage directory for a read-only or reference library. If you set the DD_TMPDIR_ON environment variable to NO, the temporary directory functionality is turned off and DDPI skips ASSIGN and UNASSIGN statements when parsing cds.lib files and, by default, prints the following warning:WARNING `<PATH_TO_CDSLIB_FILE>/cds.lib', Line 3: skipping: 'ASSIGN' lib1 TMP /tmp

functions.name: ddGetTriggerList
functions.description: Returns a list of functions registered to be executed when t_triggerName is activated.

functions.name: ddGetUpdatedLib
functions.description: Returns the path to the cds.lib file that was last used by ddUpdateLibList. This is the same as ddGetForcedLib if a forced library was in effect.

functions.name: ddHiCreateCellComboField
functions.signature: ddHiCreateCellComboField(?name s_fieldName[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?value t_currentValue ][ ?defValue t_defaultValue ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?nextField g_nextField ][ ?toolTip t_toolTip ][ ?validationType g_validationType ][ ?highlightType g_highlightType ])=> r_comboField
functions.description: Creates a customized Cell combo field, which is an extension of a regular combo field, for selecting cells.

functions.name: ddHiCreateCellToolbarComboBox
functions.signature: ddHiCreateCellToolbarComboBox(?name s_name[ ?prompt t_prompt ][ ?value t_currentValue ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?width x_width ][ ?statusTip t_statusTip ][ ?toolTip t_toolTip ][ ?validationType g_validationType ][ ?highlightType g_highlightType ])=> o_comboBox
functions.description: Creates a customized Cell combo-toolbar item, which is an extension of a regular toolbar combo box item, for selecting cells.

functions.name: ddHiCreateLibraryComboField
functions.signature: ddHiCreateLibraryComboField(?name s_fieldName[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?value t_currentValue ][ ?defValue t_defaultValue ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?nextField g_nextField ][ ?toolTip t_toolTip ][ ?validationType g_validationType ][ ?highlightType g_highlightType ])=> r_comboField
functions.description: Creates a customized Library combo field, which is an extension of a regular combo field, for selecting libraries.

functions.name: ddHiCreateLibraryToolbarComboBox
functions.signature: ddHiCreateLibraryToolbarComboBox(?name s_name[ ?prompt t_prompt ][ ?value t_currentValue ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?width x_width ][ ?statusTip t_statusTip ][ ?toolTip t_toolTip ][ ?validationType g_validationType ][ ?highlightType g_highlightType ])=> o_comboBox
functions.description: Creates a customized Library combo-toolbar item, which is an extension of a regular toolbar combo box item, for selecting libraries.

functions.name: ddHiCreateViewComboField
functions.signature: ddHiCreateViewComboField(?name s_fieldName[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?value t_currentValue ][ ?defValue t_defaultValue ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?nextField g_nextField ][ ?toolTip t_toolTip ][ ?viewTypes l_viewTypes ][ ?validationType g_validationType ][ ?highlightType g_highlightType ])=> r_comboField
functions.description: Creates a customized View combo field, which is an extension of a regular combo field, for selecting views.

functions.name: ddHiCreateViewToolbarComboBox
functions.signature: ddHiCreateViewToolbarComboBox(?name s_name[ ?prompt t_prompt ][ ?value t_currentValue ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?width x_width ][ ?statusTip t_statusTip ][ ?toolTip t_toolTip ][ ?viewTypes l_viewTypes ][ ?validationType g_validationType ][ ?highlightType g_highlightType ])=> o_comboBox
functions.description: Creates a customized View combo-toolbar item, which is an extension of a regular toolbar combo box item, for selecting views.

functions.name: ddHiLinkFields
functions.description: Connects the given combo boxes, where the value changes in one combo box triggers re-populating of the next combo box.

functions.name: ddIsHiddenCell
functions.description: Determines whether the specified cell is hidden. A cell is hidden if it is a member of the Hidden category or a member of a subcategory of the Hidden category.

functions.name: ddIsId
functions.description: Returns t if b_objId is an opaque ID known to the PI, and nil otherwise. Some dd functions will accept nil as the ID parameter, but this function returns nil if the argument is nil.

functions.name: ddIsObjLibMarked
functions.description: Returns t if the library that owns b_objId is marked to be deleted or its path is changed.

functions.name: ddIsObjReadable
functions.description: Returns t if the object specified by b_objId can be read by the current process.

functions.name: ddIsObjReadableEx
functions.description: Returns t if the object specified by b_objId can be read by the current process. This function is similar to ddIsObjReadable except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddIsObjWritable
functions.description: Returns t if the object specified by b_objId can be modified by the current process.

functions.name: ddIsObjWritableEx
functions.description: Returns t if the object specified by b_objId can be modified by the current process. This function is similar to ddIsObjWritable except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddIsPathManageable
functions.description: Returns t if the supplied path is manageable (is in a location that is supported by a design management system).

functions.name: ddIsPathManaged
functions.description: Returns t if the specified path is currently managed by a design management system. A path is managed if the file associated with the path is checked in. You can use ddIsPathManaged to implement a check against creating a file when another user has already created it but the local user work area is not updated to reflect the creation.

functions.name: ddLibHasTmpDir
functions.description: Checks if the library has a temporary directory. A temporary directory for a library is defined by putting a TMP attribute on the library with an ASSIGN statement in a cds.lib file.

functions.name: ddLibIs5X
functions.description: Determines if the library was created with the 5.X library structure.

functions.name: ddLockDescribe
functions.description: Fills a static string with a message.

functions.name: ddLockFree
functions.description: Releases any existing lock on the file specified by b_lockId.

functions.name: ddLockGetStatus
functions.signature: ddLockGetStatus(b_lockId)=> x_sysId t_type x_value t_userName t_userHost t_fileHost t_filePath
functions.description: Retrieves frequently needed information from the lock table: The lock-system ID, type, and value and the holder's user name and hostid.

functions.name: ddLockPath
functions.description: Creates a handle that allows you to lock the file and returns a lock ID for the file. Once you call ddLockFree, all references to that lock ID become invalid.

functions.name: ddLockSet
functions.description: Gets the type of lock in t_mode for the file ID. If you have already locked the file, this function changes the lock type.

functions.name: ddLockSetEx
functions.signature: ddLockSetEx(b_lockIdt_mode[ g_block ][ t_message ][ g_doErrMsgs][ g_timeout ])=> t / nil
functions.description: An extension of ddLockSet with two additional arguments.

functions.name: ddMapGetDataTypeFileName
functions.description: Returns the pattern registered in the registry for t_dataType.

functions.name: ddMapGetDataTypeList
functions.description: Returns a list of names of the data types specified in the registry.

functions.name: ddMapGetFileDataType
functions.description: Returns the name of the data type associated with b_fileObjId.

functions.name: ddMapGetFileTool
functions.description: Looks up the data format registered in the registry for b_fileObjId's file name, and returns the tool name of the preferred editor (if there is one) or the default editor which is registered for that data format.

functions.name: ddMapGetFileViewType
functions.description: Returns the name of the view type associated with b_fileObjId.

functions.name: ddMapGetToolNameDataType
functions.description: Returns the name of the first data type in the registry which is associated with t_toolName.

functions.name: ddMapGetToolNameList
functions.description: Retrieves a list of the names of the tools specified in the registry, in alphabetical order.

functions.name: ddMapGetToolNameViewType
functions.description: Returns the name of the first view type in the registry which is associated with t_toolName.

functions.name: ddMapGetViewTypeFileName
functions.description: Returns the pattern registered in the registry for a view alias or data type named t_viewType.

functions.name: ddMapGetViewTypeList
functions.description: Returns a list of names of view types defined in the registry, in alphabetical order. If a data type in the registry has a dfII_viewType property defined, the value of that property will be in the list. Otherwise, the data type name will be in the list.

functions.name: ddMapIsFileNameKnown
functions.description: Returns t if the file name is registered as the pattern for some data format in the registry.

functions.name: ddMapIsToolLegal
functions.description: Returns t if t_toolName is either the preferred editor or the default editor for b_fileObjId.

functions.name: ddMapIsToolNameKnown
functions.description: Returns t if t_toolName is defined in the registry.

functions.name: ddMarkObjMaster
functions.description: Changes the master.tag file to designate the object as the new master. The master.tag file must be located with the file it designates, so you must be able to write a file to mark it master. The master.tag file is checked out of the Design Management system, if necessary.

functions.name: ddNeedCheckout
functions.description: Enables the tools that need to provide automatic checkout behavior to determine if these tools need to call the ddCheckout and ddCheckin functions.

functions.name: ddObjHasNamedObj
functions.description: Returns t if b_objId has a child object named t_fileName.

functions.name: ddObjHasNamedObjEx
functions.description: Returns t if b_objId has a child object named t_fileName. This function is similar to ddObjHasNamedObj except that you can specify whether to look for the object in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddObjIsInMaster
functions.description: Checks if the object exists in the master directory.

functions.name: ddObjIsInTmp
functions.description: Checks if the object exists in the temporary directory. A temporary directory for a library is defined by putting a TMP attribute on the library with an ASSIGN statement in a cds.lib file. The library itself is considered the master directory.

functions.name: ddProduceObjRelNames
functions.description: Produces the names of all the objects that belong to a library, cell, or view and calls the given function with each name and any provided data structure.

functions.name: ddProduceObjRelNamesEx
functions.description: Produces the names of all the objects that belong to a library, cell, or view and calls the given function with each name and any provided data structure. This function is similar to ddProduceObjRelNames except that you can specify whether to look for the objects in the temporary directory or the master directory, or both, with the x_pathType argument.

functions.name: ddRegHiddenCellsFunc
functions.description: Registers a user-defined SKILL function that will be called to obtain a list of hidden cell names. Note that additionally the Virtuoso environment considers a cell to be hidden if it is a member of the Hidden category or its subcategories.

functions.name: ddRegTrigger
functions.description: Registers a function to be called when the triggering event occurs. Adds callbacks (triggers) to PI functions that change things. Each of these PI functions has a pre-trigger and an post-trigger.

functions.name: ddReleaseObj
functions.description: When you find an object using write (w) or append (a) mode, and the object and its parents do not yet exist, ddGetObj creates the object and its parents in the file system. The effect of this action is to make them visible in the browser and to permit us to designate file as a Master. After you close the file, you should call ddReleaseObj, which then deletes the file if you did not save it yet.

functions.name: ddSetForcedLib
functions.description: If the given path is a valid path, the forcedLib is used for all future library updates/creates/deletes and t is returned. If the path is an empty string, the default cds.lib file is used for all future library updates/creates/deletes and t is returned. If a path is given that is not valid, nil is returned with no error message and the forcedLib will be unchanged.

functions.name: ddSetForcedLibEx
functions.description: Sets the cds.lib file to be used instead of searching for them in the default locations. If no cds.lib is specified but a lib.defs file is specified, the function will use the specified lib.defs as a forced cds.lib file. Cadence recommends you to use the ddSetForcedLib function instead.

functions.name: ddSetLibDmType
functions.description: Sets the DMTYPE entry of the cdsinfo.tag file in the library.

functions.name: ddSetLibUnmanaged
functions.description: Sets the DMTYPE entry of the cdsinfo.tag file in the library directory to none. This will guarantee that regardless of the default value for DMTYPE, this library will not be DM managed. If the library has a temporary directory, it will also not be managed.

functions.name: ddSetTmpdirWarn
functions.description: Enables or disables printing of a warning message for an ASSIGN statement with attribute TMP which appears in cds.lib files. The TMP attribute defines a temporary storage directory for a read-only or reference library. If you set the DD_TMPDIR_ON environment variable to NO, the temporary directory functionality is turned off and DDPI skips ASSIGN and UNASSIGN statements when parsing cds.lib files. In that case, DDPI prints the following warning by default:WARNING `<PATH_TO_CDSLIB_FILE>/cds.lib', Line 3: skipping: 'ASSIGN' lib1 TMP /tmpIf you do not want the warning message to be printed, specify nil for the g_doWarn argument.

functions.name: ddUnregHiddenCellsFunc
functions.description: Unregisters a hidden cells function that was registered using ddRegHiddenCellsFunc.

functions.name: ddUnregTrigger
functions.description: Removes a callback (trigger function) from a named list of trigger functions.

functions.name: ddUpdateLibList
functions.description: Establishes and re-establishes a list of libraries in virtual memory to be used by ddGetObj.

functions.name: ddoAccepts
functions.description: This function is a method of ddHiObjFilter that is called with a specified dd object argument to get listed in the associated combo box.

functions.name: ddoPreferred
functions.description: This function is a method of ddHiObjFilter that returns the preferred dd view object only for the View combo box. This return value is called after a linked cell ID is changed, and the value of the View combo box is not valid. The function is called with a list of dd object IDs and is expected to return a valid dd-view-id or nil.

functions.name: ddsAboutDFII
functions.description: Opens the product information dialog box, which indicates the product, the release number, and copyright information. This dialog box is used for the custom IC design tools.

functions.name: ddsBrowserAction
functions.description: Returns the Boolean value of the requested Library Browser option. This function explains how applications use the Library Browser preferences and the actions specified in the ddsSyncWithForm function. If you are integrating your own Library Browser, you must decide whether to support such actions; if so, you can use this function. This functionality provides applications the ability to support the user's need to see the Library Browser when a particular command is executed.

functions.name: ddsCheckSessionName
functions.description: Checks to see if the current MPS session is also the default session for the user. If the given session name is the same as the effective user ID's name or if there is no session name, builds a unique session name using the process ID. This implies that the current process checks the session and returns the session name to use - either the given name if it is checked or a new unique name to use to perform the checking.

functions.name: ddsCheckinPreferences
functions.description: Sets the prompt behavior you choose for the current DFII design session for checking in design data. This function displays a form to set the auto checkin prompt preferences for properties, files, and cellviews. This process controls access to the design data files that design and team members store in a project data repository.

functions.name: ddsCheckoutPreferences
functions.description: Sets the prompt behaviors you select for the current DFII design session for checking out design data. This function displays a form to set the auto checkout prompt preferences for properties, files, and cellviews. This process controls access to the design data files that design and team members store in a project data repository.

functions.name: ddsCloseLibManager
functions.description: Closes the Library Manager.

functions.name: ddsEditProp
functions.description: Invokes the property editor on the named object. Calls peEditProp after getting the ID for the named object.

functions.name: ddsEndSyncWithForm
functions.description: Terminates an application's form synchronization with the Library Browser and closes the Library Browser.

functions.name: ddsFileBrowseCB
functions.signature: ddsFileBrowseCB(g_forms_targetName[ t_filter ][ s_mode ][ t_caption ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Creates a file browser dialog for specifying file names through browsing.

functions.name: ddsGetCurrentLib
functions.description: Accesses the currently selected library in the Library Browser.

functions.name: ddsGetCustomLibSelect
functions.description: Returns the name string passed to ddsRegCustomLibSelect if a custom Library Browser is registered to the system. If a custom Library Browser is not registered, nil is returned.

functions.name: ddsGetLibManLCV
functions.description: Returns the library, cell, and view name entries currently selected in the library manager

functions.name: ddsGetLibManLogFileName
functions.description: Returns the path to the log file created by Library Manager.

functions.name: ddsGetServiceName
functions.description: Returns a string that can be used as an MPS service name. The string is the name of the invoked program plus the process ID number.

functions.name: ddsHiCloseData
functions.description: Displays the Close and Purge Data form that prompts you to select one or more objects to close and purge form virtual memory.

functions.name: ddsHiCreateLibrary
functions.description: Create new libraries from within DFII.

functions.name: ddsHiMakeReadOnly
functions.description: Displays a form that prompts you to select cellviews currently open in edit mode and change them to read only mode.

functions.name: ddsHiOpenCdsLibEditor
functions.description: Brings up the Library Path Editor.

functions.name: ddsHiPreferences
functions.description: Invokes the Browser and CIW Preferences form.

functions.name: ddsHiRefresh
functions.description: Opens a form listing the open technology files, properties, and cellviews that are not current with their corresponding files on disk.

functions.name: ddsHiSaveData
functions.description: Displays the Save Modified Data form that prompts you to select one or more objects to save from virtual memory.

functions.name: ddsLEWhatsNewAtStartup
functions.description: Brings up the What's New window for Virtuoso Layout Editor.

functions.name: ddsOnLineHelp
functions.description: Brings up online Help documentation for DFII tools.

functions.name: ddsOpenConvertToolBox
functions.description: Displays the Conversion Tool Box user interface.

functions.name: ddsOpenLibManager
functions.description: Starts the library manager. The separate process, library manager, is invoked and connected to using mps.

functions.name: ddsProgramName
functions.description: Returns the name of the program minus any .exe extension.

functions.name: ddsRefresh
functions.signature: ddsRefresh([ ?cellview { t | nil } ][ ?cdf { t | nil } ][ ?property { t | nil } ][ ?techfile { t | nil } ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Refreshes open cellviews, CDFs, property bags, and technology files that are not current with their corresponding files on disk.

functions.name: ddsRegCustomLibSelect
functions.description: ddserv only supports one customization at a given time. If you call this function more than once, the latest set of functions are registered. The ddsRegCustomSelect function performs an isCallable Check on each of its arguments to insure that the functions have been loaded into the system. If not, a message is generated.

functions.name: ddsRegPostRefreshTrigger
functions.description: Registers a user-defined SKILL function that is called after completion of the Refresh command using CIW - File - Refresh or the ddsRefresh SKILL function.

functions.name: ddsRegPreRefreshTrigger
functions.description: Registers a user-defined SKILL function that is called before executing the Refresh command using CIW - File - Refresh or the ddsRefresh SKILL function.

functions.name: ddsServSelect
functions.description: Processes a select request from the browser process if and only if a form is synchronized to it. It is the call logged in the cds.log file. The function sets the appropriate form field with the library, cell, and view values.

functions.name: ddsSetLibManLCV
functions.description: Allows the application to set the library name, cell name, or view name entries in the library manager from a DFII session.

functions.name: ddsSyncWithForm
functions.signature: ddsSyncWithForm(g_forms_actions_libField[ s_cellField [ s_viewField [ l_viewTypes ] ] ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Registers the given form and fields of that form for synchronization with the Library Browser. The Library Browser is seeded with the current values of the library, cell, and view names from the fields in the form if they are not blank. The field value is not updated by ddsSyncWithForm when its enabled or editable attribute is set to nil. From this point until ddsEndSyncWithForm, selections in the Library Browser seed the given form fields.

functions.name: ddsUnregCustomLibSelect
functions.description: Un-registers the custom Library Browser interface during a session.

functions.name: ddsUpdateSyncWithForm
functions.description: If an application has registered a form with the Library Browser by calling ddsSyncWithForm or dmbSyncWithForm, this function updates the Library Browser with the values currently in the respective form fields.

functions.name: ddsViewDDProp
functions.description: Finds information about the specified object and any properties found in its property bag.

functions.name: ddsWhatsNew
functions.description: Brings up the What's New window.

functions.name: deAddAppCapabilities
functions.description: Adds the required application capabilities to the specified view type.

functions.name: deBack
functions.description: This API allows you to go back to a particular window event. It takes two optional integer arguments, w_window and numSteps. If deBack is called without any arguments it will open and display the cellview that was displayed prior to the current cellview in the current window.

functions.name: deBeginConfigurePlugins
functions.description: Lets applications issue a series of deInstallPlugin and deRemovePlugin calls to add or remove plugins in the specified application window. Using deBeginConfigurePlugins before adding or removing plugins helps in reducing calls to the hiApplyWinConfig SKILL function.

functions.name: deCopy
functions.description: Makes a complete copy of the given window, including its stack and the context data stored on it.

functions.name: deCustomizeToolbars
functions.signature: deCustomizeToolbars([ ?app t_appName ][ ?toolbar t_toolbar ][ ?toolbarItem t_toolbarItem ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Invokes the Toolbar Manager graphical user interface for customizing toolbars in the Virtuoso environment.

functions.name: deDisableApp
functions.description: Enables the application registered with t_appName in w_window. It affects only the customizer menu in w_window. It is available to allow certain applications to be disabled depending on run-time state associated with a particular design.

functions.name: deEditInPlace
functions.signature: deEditInPlace(w_window[ l_fileSpec [ t_accessMode [ t_appName ] ] ])=> w_window / nil
functions.description: Requires that w_window exists and has at least one stack element.

functions.name: deEnableApp
functions.description: Enables the application registered with t_appName in w_window. It affects only the customizer menu in w_window. It is available to allow certain applications to be enabled depending on run-time state associated with a particular design.

functions.name: deEndConfigurePlugins
functions.description: Indicates an end to a series of calls for deInstallPlugin and deRemovePlugin marked by the deBeginConfigurePlugins in the same application window.

functions.name: deFileNew
functions.description: Opens the Create New File form.

functions.name: deFileOpen
functions.description: Similar to deOpen(). Radio buttons on the Open form are displayed that allow selection between opening the cellview in a new tab, current tab, or a new window.

functions.name: deFindAssistant
functions.signature: deFindAssistant(t_assistantw_sessionWindow[ ?search_object_name { t | nil } ][ ?search_window_name { t | nil } ][ ?in_active_tab { t | nil } ])=> w_dwindow / nil
functions.description: Returns the dock window ID associated with the specified assistant name in the specified session window. By default, the function returns the assistant whose window name matches t_assistant in the currently active tab of w_sessionWindow. You can optionally widen the search to include object names in all tabs of the specified session window.

functions.name: deFindPlugin
functions.description: Searches for and returns an instance of the specified plugin installed in the given application window

functions.name: deFindToolbar
functions.description: Searches for and returns an instance of the specified toolbar installed in the given session window. This function also supports the Virtuoso design editor toolbars, such as Workspaces, Go, and Bookmarks.

functions.name: deForward
functions.description: Allows you to go forward to a particular window event. It takes two optional integer argument; w_window and numSteps. If the command is called without any arguments it will open and display the cellview that was displayed prior to the use of the last deBack command in the current window.

functions.name: deGetAllApplicationNames
functions.description: Returns a list of all applications that can be associated with the given root view type.

functions.name: deGetAllRootTypes
functions.description: Returns a list of all currently registered root view types.

functions.name: deGetAllViewTypes
functions.description: Returns a list of all fully registered view types and view sub types. Any view sub type for which some parent has not been registered will not appear in this list.

functions.name: deGetAppClassInfo
functions.description: Returns a copy of the registration information (DPL) associated with the given application

functions.name: deGetAppInfo
functions.description: Returns the application registration information associated with t_viewType and its sub-view types.

functions.name: deGetCellView
functions.description: Returns the cellview for the item on the window stack corresponding to x_level. A value of nil is returned if the stack is empty, x_level is not a valid stack level in w_window, or x_level is -1. If x_level is defaulted or nil then the current item on the stack is used.

functions.name: deGetConfigId
functions.description: Gets the Hierarchy Manager configuration ID associated with the given window.

functions.name: deGetContext
functions.description: Returns the context for the item on the window stack corresponding to x_level. A value of nil is returned if the stack is empty or x_level is -1. If x_level is not specified or is nil, the current item on the stack is used.

functions.name: deGetEIP
functions.description: Returns the edit-in-place state for the item on the window stack corresponding to x_level. The edit-in-place state is t if that stack level was created by the deEditInPlace function and nil otherwise. f nil is returned if the stack is empty or x_level is -1. If x_level is not specified or is nil then the current item on the stack is used.

functions.name: deGetEditCellView
functions.description: Returns the cellview for the item on the window stack corresponding to the current edit level. nil is returned if the stack is empty.

functions.name: deGetEditContext
functions.description: Returns the context for the item on the window stack corresponding to the current edit level.

functions.name: deGetEditLevel
functions.description: Returns the current edit level of w_window. If the stack is empty, the routine returns -1. The current edit level is the level of the stack which is currently being displayed. This is normally the maximum edit level, unless deGoToLevel was executed.

functions.name: deGetEditRootType
functions.description: Returns the root class view type of the item at the current edit level in w_window.

functions.name: deGetEditViewType
functions.description: Returns the t_viewType of the item at the current edit level in w_window.

functions.name: deGetLowerTierApp
functions.description: Returns a list of application names, which are x_lowerBy levels lower in tier in the same family of given t_appName. The default value for x_lowerBy is one.

functions.name: deGetMaxEditLevel
functions.description: Returns the highest edit level of w_window. If the stack is empty, returns -1.

functions.name: deGetMaxInContextLevel
functions.description: Gets the maximum level of the given window that is being edited in the context of the Hierarchy Manager configuration ID associated with the window. If the window has no configuration ID, 0 is returned.

functions.name: deGetPlugins
functions.description: Returns a list of all plugin instances installed in the given application window

functions.name: deGetProbeContext
functions.description: Returns the probe context for the window.

functions.name: deGetProbeTrigger
functions.description: Returns the current probe trigger.

functions.name: deGetPushed
functions.description: Returns the pushed state for the item on the window stack corresponding to x_level. The pushed state is t if that x_level is any level other than the current edit level and nil otherwise. nil is returned if the stack is empty or x_level is -1. If x_level is defaulted or is nil then the current item on the stack is used.

functions.name: deGetRootType
functions.description: Returns the root class t_viewType of the item at x_level in w_window. nil is returned if the stack is empty. If x_level is not specified, the current level is assumed.

functions.name: deGetRootViewTypeList
functions.description: Returns a list of root view types, which have an associated tool as specified in the tool registry.

functions.name: deGetVector
functions.description: Gets the Hierarchy Manager path vector associated with the given window.

functions.name: deGetViewType
functions.description: Returns the view type of the item at x_level in w_window. nil is returned if the stack is empty. If x_level is not specified, the current level is assumed.

functions.name: deHiSetDefaultApplication
functions.description: Opens the Set Default Application form for the current cellview.

functions.name: deInheritEnabling
functions.description: Enables t_viewType to depend on the enabling of its parent type. Thus, the user must have the parent application licensed in order to use the application. t_viewType must be a subclass of some other view type.

functions.name: deInheritMenus
functions.description: Causes t_viewType to inherit the menus defined by its parent class.

functions.name: deInstallApp
functions.description: Switches the current application in w_window to t_appName. The enable trigger is called before switching, and if it returns nil, the switch is aborted. Otherwise, the application menus and bindkeys are installed as if the user had executed the corresponding customizer item.

functions.name: deInstallPlugin
functions.description: Installs (or activates) the specified plugin in an application window associated with the given ID. For each session window, DE makes only one instance of a plugin. deInstallPlugin function installs a plugin in an application window. A session window can host multiple application windows. This means that if an instance of the plugin already exists in the specified window, the instance is returned. And, if there exists an instance in another tab of the same session window, the instance is shared.

functions.name: deIsEditInContext
functions.description: Tells whether the current edit cellview in the window is in the context of a Hierarchy Manager configuration.

functions.name: deManageToolbar
functions.description: Puts the toolbar handle on the given session window (under DE management) for the specified application. A managed toolbar is displayed as a menu item in Window-Toolbars and in the context menu of the session window.

functions.name: deMapUserTypeToViewType
functions.description: Maps a user type to the dfII_viewType.

functions.name: deMapViewTypeToUserType
functions.description: Maps the dfII_viewType to the user type.

functions.name: deNew
functions.signature: deNew([ l_fileSpec ][ g_winSpec ][ t_accessMode ][ t_appName ])=> w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Creates a new cellview and opens it in a window.

functions.name: deNewCellView
functions.description: Creates a new cellview and opens it in a window.

functions.name: deOpen
functions.signature: deOpen([ l_fileSpec [ g_winSpec [ t_accessMode [ t_appName g_sessionWindow g_saveSessionHistory] ] ] ])=> w_window / nil
functions.description: Takes a design specification and a window specification and attempts to install the design in the specified window.

functions.name: deOpenCellView
functions.description: Opens an existing cellview in a window.

functions.name: dePush
functions.signature: dePush([ l_fileSpec [ g_winSpec [ t_accessMode [ t_appName ] ] ] ])=> w_window / nil
functions.description: The same as deOpen, except that if the window already exists, the current contents are not removed. Instead the new design is pushed on top of the existing one.

functions.name: deRegApp
functions.signature: deRegApp([ ?viewType t_viewType ][ ?parentType t_parentType ][ ?appName t_appName ][ ?help t_help ][ ?dataTrigger s_dataTrigger ][ ?appTrigger s_appTrigger ][ ?enableTrigger s_enableTrigger ][ ?menuTrigger s_menuTrigger ][ ?postInstallTrigger s_postInstallTrigger ][ ?viewNameSwitchTrigger s_viewNameSwitchTrigger ][ ?widgetType t_widgetType ][ ?noCadenceMenu g_noCadenceMenu ][ ?windowBBoxProc s_function ][ ?appTitle t_appTitle ][ ?exclusive g_exclusive ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Registers the characteristics and entry points of applications so that they can be called in the appropriate situations.

functions.name: deRegPlugin
functions.signature: deRegPlugin(t_appNames_classNames_superClass[ ?appTitle t_appTitle ][ ?bindkeys l_bindkeys ][ ?group t_group ][ ?help t_help ][ ?pluggableMainApps g_pluggableMainApps ][ ?pluggableViewTypes l_pluggableViewTypes ][ ?shortDescription t_shortDescription ][ ?excludeViewTypes l_excludeViewTypes ])=> l_appClassInfo
functions.description: Registers the characteristics of plugins.

functions.name: deRegProbeTrigger
functions.description: Registers a probe trigger, s_probeTrigger, to be called after creating a new window or installing a new design in an existing window.

functions.name: deRegUserTriggers
functions.signature: deRegUserTriggers(t_viewType[ s_appTrigger [ s_menuTrigger [ s_postInstallTrigger ] ] ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Registers user application, user menu, and user post install triggers.

functions.name: deRemoveAppCapabilities
functions.description: Removes the required application capabilities from the specified view type.

functions.name: deRemovePlugin
functions.description: Removes (or deactivates) the named plugin from the specified application window-session or tab window. If the ID is of a session window, the plugin is removed from all tab windows associated with the session window.

functions.name: deReturn
functions.description: Pops the window stack one or more levels.

functions.name: deSetCellView
functions.signature: deSetCellView([ w_window [ d_cellview [ x_level ] ] ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Replaces the cellview for the current item on the window stack. nil is returned if the stack is empty. This routine is intended for use by data triggers executing the 'swap operation. It should never be called by an application outside of a data trigger.

functions.name: deSetConfigId
functions.description: Sets the Hierarchy Manager configuration ID associated with the given window. Also creates a path vector and sets the window path vector. If g_hdbConfigId is nil, the window path vector is destroyed, and the window configuration ID is set to nil.

functions.name: deSetContext
functions.signature: deSetContext([ w_window [ g_context [ x_level ] ] ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Replaces the context for the item at the specified level on the window stack. nil is returned if the stack is empty. This routine is intended for use by data triggers executing the 'swap operation. It should never be called by application code outside of a data trigger.

functions.name: deSetHistoryOpenMode
functions.description: Controls whether designs are opened from history in a new tab or a new window. The setting applies equally to opening a design from the CIW as well as from a session window.

functions.name: deSetProbeContext
functions.description: Sets the probe context for the window. This is normally executed only by the probing implementation in the probe trigger.

functions.name: deSetWorkspace
functions.description: Sets a workspace name to a given window (as long as the workspace name is valid for that window).

functions.name: deSwap
functions.signature: deSwap([ l_fileSpec [ g_winSpec [ t_accessMode [ t_appName] ] ] ])=> w_window / nil
functions.description: This function is same as deOpen, except that if the window already exists, the current contents are not removed. Instead the current stack item is replaced with the new design.

functions.name: deToggleAssistantVisibility
functions.description: Toggles the visibility of the given assistant in the given session window.

functions.name: deToggleAssistants
functions.description: Toggles the visibility of the current assistants off or on to maximize the size of the design window.

functions.name: deToggleToolbars
functions.description: Toggles the currently visible toolbars off. If no visible toolbars are found, toggles the previously hidden toolbars on.

functions.name: deUnInheritEnabling
functions.description: Removes the inheritance of enabling for t_viewType.

functions.name: deUnInheritMenus
functions.description: Removes the inheritance of menus for t_viewType.

functions.name: deUnRegApp
functions.description: Un-registers the view type.Only one application can currently be registered for each view type. If a second registration is attempted, an error results. To re-register a view type with different procedures, the view type must first be unregistered with this routine.

functions.name: deUnRegProbeTrigger
functions.description: Removes the current probe trigger.

functions.name: deUnRegUserTriggers
functions.description: Removes any user triggers associated with t_viewType.

functions.name: deUnmanageToolbar
functions.description: Removes the toolbar from the given session window (under DE management) for the specified application. A toolbar should be removed using the deUnmanageToolbar function before it can be deleted.

functions.name: deViewTypeIsRegistered
functions.description: Returns a non-nil value if t_viewType is fully registered; that is, all ancestors up to and including the root type are currently registered.

functions.name: debugQuit
functions.description: Exits one level of the SKILL debugger.

functions.name: debugStatus
functions.description: Prints the functions and variables being traced, functions that have breakpoints set, functions being counted, and the line breakpoints statistics.

functions.name: declare
functions.description: Creates an array with a specified number of elements. This is a syntax form. All elements of the array are initialized to unbound.

functions.name: declareLambda
functions.description: Tells the evaluator that certain (forward referenced) functions are of lambda type (as opposed to nlambda or macro).

functions.name: declareNLambda
functions.description: Tells the evaluator that certain (forward referenced) functions are of nlambda type (as opposed to lambdas or macros).

functions.name: declareSQNLambda
functions.description: Declares the given nlambda functions to be solely-quoting nlambdas.

functions.name: decode
functions.description: Branches to one of the clauses depending on the value of the given expression. decode() evaluates g_keyForm and matches the resulting value sequentially against the clauses until it finds a match. Once a match is found it stops searching the clauses, evaluates the forms in the matching clause, and returns the resulting value.

functions.name: defCapDepends
functions.description: Specifies which contexts depend on which other contexts.

functions.name: defCapPrefixes
functions.description: Specifies which prefixes are acceptable for a context's global variables.

functions.name: defInitProc
functions.description: Registers a function that the system calls immediately after autoloading a context.

functions.name: defMathConstants
functions.description: Associates a set of predefined math constants as properties of the given symbol.

functions.name: defUserInitProc
functions.description: Registers a user-defined function that the system calls immediately after autoloading a context.

functions.name: defcell
functions.description: Used with TSG template files to call lmdefcell.

functions.name: defclass
functions.description: Creates a class object with class name and optional super class name (or names) and slot specifications. This is a macro form.

functions.name: defdynamic
functions.description: This syntax form sets the dynamic variable s_varName to g_value. In SKILL, this function works as a defvar. In Scheme, g_value is evaluated in the current lexical scope.

functions.name: defgeneric
functions.description: Defines a generic function with an optional default method. This is a macro form. Be sure to leave a space after the function name.

functions.name: defglobalfun
functions.description: Defines a global function with the name and formal argument list you specify.

functions.name: definPostTranslate
functions.description: During DEF In translation, this function is called just after the translation is completed.

functions.name: definPreTranslate
functions.description: During DEF In, this function is called just before the translation starts.

functions.name: define
functions.description: (SKILL++ mode only) Is a syntax form used to provide a definition for a global or local variable. The define syntax form has two variations.

functions.name: define_syntax
functions.description: Creates a syntax rule using the syntax_rule expander form.

functions.name: definitionFile
functions.description: Specifies definitions files to be included in the simulator input file.

functions.name: defmacro
functions.description: Defines a macro which can take a list of formal arguments including @optional, @key, and @rest (instead of the more restrictive format as required by using mprocedure).

functions.name: defmethod
functions.description: Defines a method for a given generic function. This is a macro form. Be sure to leave a space after s_name.

functions.name: defoutPostTranslate
functions.description: During DEF Out, this function is called just after the translation is completed.

functions.name: defoutPreTranslate
functions.description: During DEF Out, this function is called just before the translation starts.

functions.name: defprop
functions.description: Adds properties to symbols but none of its arguments are evaluated. This is a syntax form.

functions.name: defsetf
functions.description: defsetf is a macro that allows you to specify an update function to use when setf() is called with a place using a given access function. It creates a macro with the prefix setf_ which is used by setf to update a value at the place given by s_accessFn().

functions.name: defstruct
functions.description: Creates a defstruct, a named structure that is a collection of one or more variables.

functions.name: defstructp
functions.description: Checks if an object is an instance of a particular defstruct.

functions.name: defun
functions.description: Defines a function with the name and formal argument list you specify. This is a syntax form.

functions.name: defvar
functions.description: Defines a variable and assign it a value.The variable defined follows the scoping rule.

functions.name: delay
functions.signature: delay([ ?wf1 o_waveform1 ][ ?value1 n_value1 ][ ?edge1 s_edge1 ][ ?nth1 x_nth1 ][ ?td1 n_td1 ][ ?wf2 o_waveform2 ][ ?value2 n_value2 ][ ?edge2 s_edge2 ][ ?nth2 x_nth2[ ?td2 n_td2 ][ ?td2r0 n_td2r0 ]}[ ?stop n_stop ][ ?histoDisplay g_histoDisplay ][ ?noOfHistoBins x_noOfHistoBins ][ ?period1 period1 ][ ?period2 period2 ][ ?multiple multiple ][ ?xName xName ]@rest args)=> o_waveform / n_value / nil
functions.description: Calculates the delay between a trigger event and a target event.

functions.name: delayMeasure
functions.description: Calculates the delay between a trigger event and a target event.

functions.name: delete
functions.description: Deletes all the information specified.

functions.name: deleteChecks
functions.description: Deletes device checks.

functions.name: deleteDir
functions.description: Deletes the specified directory. The directory name can be specified with either an absolute or relative path; the SKILL path is used in the latter case. A path that is anchored to the current directory, for example, ./, ../, or ../../.., and so on, is not considered as a relative path.

functions.name: deleteFile
functions.description: Deletes a file. The file name can be specified with either an absolute or relative path; the SKILL path is used in the latter case. If a symbolic link is passed in as the argument, it is the link itself, not the file or directory referenced by the link, that gets removed. A path that is anchored to the current directory, for example, ./, ../, or ../../.., and so on, is not considered as a relative path.

functions.name: deleteJob
functions.signature: deleteJob(t_jobName[ t_jobName2 t_jobName3 ... t_jobNameN ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Removes a job or series of jobs from the text-based job monitor.

functions.name: deleteOpPoint
functions.description: Deletes the specified operating point instance.

functions.name: deletePoint
functions.description: Deletes a point from the enterfunction in the current window.

functions.name: deleteSubckt
functions.description: Deletes the specified subcircuit instance saved using the saveSubckt command.

functions.name: deleteSubwindow
functions.description: Deletes the current subwindow from the current Waveform window.

functions.name: deleteWaveform
functions.description: Deletes the specified waveform curve or all the waveform curves from the current subwindow of a Waveform window.

functions.name: densityEstimateWaveform
functions.description: Returns the density estimator waveform of a histogram.

functions.name: deoEnableTrigger
functions.description: Determines if the application is enabled for use by the current user. The enable trigger will normally do any appropriate security checks necessary to make this determination. Design Editor calls the enable trigger before installing a plugin and then installs the plugin only if this trigger returns a non-nil value. The default deoEnableTrigger permits a plugin to be installed on top of an application as long as it is pluggable to the application.

functions.name: deoExitTrigger
functions.description: When a plugin is being removed from a window, Design Editor calls the exit trigger before disabling all GUI components of the plugin and removes the plugin only if this trigger returns a non-nil value. The return value of the exit trigger is ignored if the window on which the plugin is installed is being closed. The default implementation is a no-op, and always returns t.

functions.name: deoGetAssistantList
functions.description: Returns a list of t_assistant_name and s_placement pairs (called an association list and contains a list of key and value pairs). The default implementation returns all assistants defined by this plugin and super-plugins.

functions.name: deoGetBindkeys
functions.description: Returns a copy of bindkeys defined for the plugin in the format that is acceptable by hiSetBindKeys(). When installing a plugin, DE calls hiSetBindKeys using the value of deoGetBindkeys method. A default implementation of deoGetBindkeys is provided by DE, which returns a list of bindkeys collectively defined by a plugin and its super-plugin(s) through deRegPlugin ?bindkeys argument. The bindkeys returned are ordered from generic to specific.

functions.name: deoMenuTrigger
functions.description: Returns a list of menus to be installed in the banner of a window. The menu trigger is called when the Design Editor installs and removes the plugin. Whenever there's an application switching event, deoMenuTrigger is called again for plugins that are pluggable to the application being switched into. For example, given a plugin whose pluggableViewTypes equals schematic, the plugin is pluggable to all schematic-based applications. So, if the plugin is currently installed in a VSE window then, if you launch VSE XL in the same window the menu trigger will be called again. Also push down, or return back into another schematic cell-view, the deoMenuTrigger is called again. The default deoMenuTrigger is a no-op. It returns args->bannerMenus as is.

functions.name: deoOnApplicationChange
functions.description: An event notification function called when data or application changes in a window, such as when a user opens new data or installs a new application in a window, traverses down or up a design hierarchy, or opens another cellview. This function is called for all active plugins at the same time the DE change-application-trigger is called. The order in which calls are made to all deoOnApplicationChange functions is not defined.

functions.name: deoOnEvent
functions.description: This event handler can be reimplemented in a subclass to receive various events.

functions.name: deoOnTabSwitch
functions.description: An event notification function called during HI calling post tab switch procedures. The order in which calls are made to all deoOnTabSwitch functions is not defined.

functions.name: deoPostInstallTrigger
functions.description: The post-install trigger is called after all other processing is done, including installation of banner menu, toolbar, assistant, bindkeys. This is provided for those applications that need to finish up any initialization that must occur after GUI is installed.

functions.name: deoRequireToolbars
functions.description: Returns a list of toolbar names (string) that are to be customized by the plugin. A plugin can customize toolbars of a main application, or those of another plugin. For a plugin to declare which toolbars need customization, re-define method deoRequireToolbars.

functions.name: deoUpdateToolbar
functions.description: Customizes a toolbar that is requested by deoRequireToolbars. DE calls this method during installing and removing a plugin.

functions.name: deriv
functions.description: Computes the derivative of a waveform with respect to the X axis.

functions.name: desVar
functions.signature: desVar(t_desVar1 f_value1 ... [ t_desVarN f_valueN ])=> undefined / nil
functions.description: Sets the values of design variables used in your design. You can set the values for as many design variables as you want.

functions.name: describe
functions.description: Prints information about the symbol s_symbol. If the symbol has a function definition, information on the argument list and other available details will be printed. If the symbol has a variable definition, information about its value and function will be printed. If the function is called without any arguments, the help message will be printed.

functions.name: design
functions.signature: design(t_cktFile | t_lib t_cell t_view [ t_mode ])=> t_cktFile / nil | (t_lib t_cell t_view) / nil
functions.description: Specifies the directory path to the netlist of a design or the name of a design to be simulated.

functions.name: destructuringBind
functions.description: Enables you to bind value to variables in a list. The list of values is obtained by evaluating the l_expression. The destructuringBind macro then evaluates the g_body form.

functions.name: dft
functions.signature: dft(o_waveformn_fromn_tox_num[ t_windowName ][ n_param1 ][ n_adcSpan ])=> o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Computes the discrete Fourier transform and fast Fourier transform of the input waveform.

functions.name: dftbb
functions.signature: dftbb(o_waveform1o_waveform2f_timeStartf_timeEndx_num[ ?windowName t_windowName ][ ?smooth x_smooth ][ ?cohGain f_cohGain ][ ?spectrumType s_spectrumType ])=> o_waveformComplex / nil
functions.description: Computes the discrete Fourier transform (fast Fourier transform) of a complex signal.

functions.name: difference
functions.description: Returns the result of subtracting one or more operands from the first operand. Prefix form of the - arithmetic operator.

functions.name: digitalHostMode
functions.description: For mixed-signal simulation, specifies whether the digital simulator will run locally or on a remote host.

functions.name: digitalHostName
functions.description: For mixed-signal simulation, specifies the name of the remote host for the digital simulator.

functions.name: disableAllChecks
functions.description: Disables all device checks.

functions.name: disableChecks
functions.description: Disables device checks. Only enabled device checks appear in Spectre input deck.

functions.name: disableDeviceChecking
functions.description: Disables device checking. It is the same as turning off the Enable Device Checking check box in the Device Checking Setup form. No checks are written to Spectre input file. No device checking happens.

functions.name: discipline
functions.description: Adds discrete disciplines to the existing set of disciplines for a given 'ams' OCEAN session. You can use delete('discipline) to delete one or more specified disciplines. You can use ocnDisplay('discipline) to view the currently active disciplines in an OCEAN session.

functions.name: display
functions.description: Writes a representation of an object to the given port.

functions.name: displayChecks
functions.signature: displayChecks(?resultsDir t_resultsDir[ t_check1 t_check2 t_check3... ])=> nil
functions.description: Displays device checks. If no name is provided, this function displays all checks that have been added so far. If no device checks have been added and a results directory is set by using the openResults() command, it prints device checks from the asserts.info.asserts file in that results directory. If the results directory is provided, it displays device checks found in the asserts.info.asserts file in that results directory.

functions.name: displayMode
functions.description: Sets the display mode of the current subwindow.

functions.name: displayNetlist
functions.description: Displays the concatenated AMS complete design info file used in a given AMS OCEAN session. The concatenated file displays the netlisting of the cellviews used in the configuration along with the analog control file and the TCL file generated by AMS-ADE. This command is applicable for Spectre.

functions.name: displaySubckt
functions.description: Prints the subcircuit information to the output file.

functions.name: dlAddArc
functions.description: Adds an arc to the display list.

functions.name: dlAddBox
functions.description: Adds a box to the display list.

functions.name: dlAddCircle
functions.description: Adds a circle to the display list.

functions.name: dlAddDonut
functions.description: Adds a donut to the display list.

functions.name: dlAddEventObject

functions.name: drplEvmBpsk
functions.description: Processes the I and Q waveform outputs from the transient simulation run to calculate the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) and plot the I versus Q scatterplot. EVM is a useful measurement to describe the overall signal amplitude and phase modulated signal quality. It is based on a statistical error distribution normalized from an ideal digital modulation. Binary Phase Shift Keying (BPSK) is a typical modulation scheme where EVM is useful. The EVM is calculated by detecting the I and Q signal levels corresponding to the two possible I and Q symbol combinations, and calculating the difference between the signal level and the ideal signal level. Compared to other types of phase shift keying, such as QPSK, QAM16 and QAM64, BPSK has lowest bit error rate for the same signal to noise ratio.

functions.name: evmOFDM
functions.signature: evmOFDM(o_waveform1o_waveform2e_sigStandardn_tstarte_modulationTypen_fftSizen_PrefixLengthn_SymbolPeriod[ ?packet n_packetLength ][ ?modifier e_modifier ][ ?skiplength n_skiplength ][ ?idx n_idx ][ ?getval g_getval ])=> constellation o_waveform evm_value / nil
functions.description: Processes the I and Q waveform outputs from the hb-envlp simulation run to calculate the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) and plot the I versus Q scatterplot (constellation). EVM is a useful measurement to describe the overall signal amplitude and phase modulated signal quality. It is based on a statistical error distribution normalized from an ideal digital modulation. Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is a modern high throughput modulation scheme widely used in wireless signals, such as 802.11a,g,n, where EVM measurement is useful . The EVM is calculated by detecting the I and Q signal levels corresponding to constellation points of each modulation type (can be BPSK, QPSK, 16QAM, and 64QAM) and calculating the difference between the signal level and the ideal signal level.

functions.name: evmQAM
functions.description: Processes the I and Q waveform outputs from the transient simulation run to calculate the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) for multi-mode modulations. The function plots the I versus Q scatterplot. EVM is a useful measurement to describe the overall signal amplitude and phase modulated signal quality. It is based on a statistical error distribution normalized from an ideal digital modulation. Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) is a typical modulation scheme where EVM is useful. The EVM is calculated by detecting the I and Q signal levels corresponding to the four possible I and Q symbol combinations and calculating the difference between the actual signal level and the ideal signal level.

functions.name: evmQpsk
functions.description: Processes the I and Q waveform outputs from the transient simulation run to calculate the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) and plot the I versus Q scatterplot. EVM is a useful measurement to describe the overall signal amplitude and phase modulated signal quality. It is based on a statistical error distribution normalized from an ideal digital modulation. Quadrature Phase Shift Keying (QPSK) is a typical modulation scheme where EVM is useful. The EVM is calculated by detecting the I and Q signal levels corresponding to the four possible I and Q symbol combinations and calculating the difference between the actual signal level and the ideal signal level.

You can use the fnlGetGlobalSigName function at any time during the netlisting process.

It may be especially useful during the evaluation of the NLPnetlistHeader and NLPnetlistFooter properties, where you can use it to output information about the top level design for the header and footer of the netlist. There is no equivalent netlister-defined property.

functions.signature: fscanf(p_inputPortt_formatString[ s_var1 ... ])=> x_items / nilscanf(t_formatString[ s_var1 ... ])=> x_items / nilsscanf(t_sourceStringt_formatString[ s_var1 ... ])=> x_items / nil

functions.name: geSetSelProtectionHighlightOptionForm
functions.description: Opens the Selection Protection Highlight Options form where you can configure the settings for highlighting protected objects.

functions.name: geSetSelProtectionHighlightOptions
functions.description: Sets the highlight options for objects that are marked protected.

functions.name: geSetTCProbeDisplayStyle

functions.description: Implements the sub mode of point selection.

functions.name: geToggleAreaSelectOption

functions.name: geToggleDisplayResolution

functions.name: geTogglePartialSelect
functions.description: Toggles partial selection off and on.

functions.name: geToggleWindowSelProtectionHighlight

functions.name: geToggleWindowSelProtectionSelectability
functions.description: Toggles the selectability state of protected objects in the specified window.

functions.name: geTransformUserBBox

functions.name: geTransformUserPoint

functions.name: geTransparencyOptions
functions.description: Opens the Transparency Options form.

functions.name: geUnRegCrossProbeTrigger

functions.name: geWriteCellView
functions.description: Creates a copy of a cellview.

functions.name: geZoomToBackgroundAndEditCV
functions.description: When a background cellview is set on the window, zooms to fit the background cellview and the current edit cellview. If a background cellview is not set on the window, zooms to fit the current edit cellview.

functions.name: geZoomToBackgroundCV
functions.description: When a background cellview is set on the window, zooms to fit the background cellview.

functions.name: geZoomToGrid
functions.description: Zooms in on a subject up to the last point at which the major grid is still visible.

functions.name: gec

functions.name: geiLoadProbe

functions.description: Displays the Save Probes form.

functions.name: gensym

functions.name: geqp
