functions.name: get
functions.description: Returns the value of a property in a property list (including disembodied property list), association table, structure, database object, and a standard object (instance of a user-defined subclass of standardObject). get has no infix operator syntax.

functions.name: getAllLoadedFiles
functions.description: Returns a list of all files loaded since debug mode was turned on.

functions.name: getApplicableMethods
functions.description: Returns a list of applicable methods (funObjects) for the specified generic function for a given set of arguments. The returned list contains methods in the calling order.

functions.name: getAsciiWave
functions.signature: getAsciiWave(t_filenamex_xColumnx_yColumn[ ?xskip x_x_skip ][ ?yskip x_yskip ][ ?formatFloat g_formatFloat ][ ?xName t_xName ][ ?xUnits t_xUnits ][ ?yName t_yName ][ ?yUnits t_yUnits ])=> o_wave / nil
functions.description: Reads in an ASCII file of data and generates a waveform object from the specified data. The X-axis data must be real numbers. The Y-axis data can be real or complex values. Complex values are represented as (real imag) or complex(real imag). This function skips blank lines and comment lines. Comments are defined as lines beginning with a semicolon.

functions.name: getCallingFunction
functions.description: Returns the name of the calling function or procedure at the specified level in the call stack.

functions.name: getCompatContextVersion
functions.description: Returns the compatible context version (for IC 6.1.6/CAT 33.00, the compatible context version is 601).

functions.name: getCurSaveContextVersion
functions.description: Returns the current saveContext version (the version which the new context will have.) The possible return values are, 601 for compatible contexts and 602 for native contexts (for IC 6.1.6/CAT 33.00)

functions.name: getCurrentTime
functions.description: Returns a string representation of the current time.

functions.name: getCurrentWindow
functions.description: The getCurrentWindow function is an alias for the hiGetCurrentWindow function.

functions.name: getData
functions.signature: getData(t_name[ ?result s_resultName [ ?resultsDir t_resultsDir ] ] )=> x_number / o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Returns the number or waveform for the signal name specified.

functions.name: getDependents
functions.description: Returns a list of dependents registered for the given SKILL object, which could be a class or a generic function

functions.name: getDirFiles
functions.description: Returns a list of the names of all files and directories, including . and .., in a directory.

functions.name: getFnWriteProtect
functions.description: Checks if the given function is write-protected. The value is t if s_name is write-protected. Else, it is nil.

functions.name: getFunType
functions.description: Returns a symbol denoting the function type for a given function object. Possible function types include lambda, nlambda, macro, syntax, or primop.

functions.name: getFunctions
functions.description: Returns functions defined in a file loaded after debug mode is turned on.

functions.name: getGFbyClass
functions.description: Returns a list of generic functions specializing on a given class.

functions.name: getGFproxy
functions.description: Returns a proxy instance from the specified generic function object

functions.name: getInstallPath
functions.description: Returns the absolute path of the Cadence DFII installation directory where the DFII products are installed on your system as a list of a single string.

functions.name: getLogin
functions.description: Returns the login name of the current user as a string.

functions.name: getMaxScreenCoords
functions.description: The getMaxScreenCoords function is an alias for the hiGetMaxScreenCoords function.

functions.name: getMethodName
functions.description: Returns the method name for the given function object

functions.name: getMethodRole
functions.description: Returns the method role for the given function object. U_funObject should be a valid generic function object.

functions.name: getMethodSpec
functions.description: Returns the list of specializers for the given funobject.

functions.name: getMethodSpecializers
functions.description: Returns the specializers of all methods currently associated with the given generic function, in a list of class names. The first element in the list is t if there is a default method.

functions.name: getMuffleWarnings
functions.description: Returns a list of warnings that were called and suppressed by the preceding muffleWarnings command.

functions.name: getNativeContextVersion
functions.description: Returns the native context version (for IC 6.1.6/CAT 33.00, the native context version is 602).

functions.name: getOutstring
functions.description: Retrieves the content of the outstring port (while it is open).

functions.name: getPrompts
functions.description: Returns the current values of the first level and second level prompt text strings, respectively.

functions.name: getResult
functions.description: Gets the data object for a specified analysis without overriding the status of any previously executed selectResult() or openResults() commands.

functions.name: getSG
functions.description: Evaluates and then retrieves the value of the specified attribute or property. It is a lambda implementation of getSGq().

functions.name: getShellEnvVar
functions.description: Returns the value of a UNIX environment variable, if it has been set. This function expands the environment variable name specified in the argument.

functions.name: getSimRunInfo
functions.description: Returns the value of the specified type of simulation information for a given ADE output expression by accessing the related psf directory.

functions.name: getSkillPath
functions.description: Returns the current SKILL path. The SKILL path is used in resolving relative paths for some SKILL functions.

functions.name: getSkillVersion
functions.description: Returns the major version if the argument is left blank; otherwise, returns the current subversion (or tarkit version) of SKILL that is running in the build

functions.name: getSymbolNamespace
functions.description: Returns the namespace where the symbol is created.

functions.name: getTempDir
functions.description: Returns the system temp directory as a string.

functions.name: getVarWriteProtect
functions.description: (SKILL mode only) Checks if a variable is write-protected. Does not work in SKILL++ mode. In SKILL++ mode, use getFnWriteProtect instead.

functions.name: getVersion
functions.description: Returns the version number of the Cadence software you are currently using. If you specify the optional argument g_opt, as t (or a non-nil value), the subversion number of the Cadence software currently used is returned. By default, the full version number, including the hotfix version, of the Cadence software currently used is returned.

functions.name: getWarn
functions.description: Returns the buffered warning if it has not already been printed.

functions.name: getWorkingDir
functions.description: Returns the current working directory as a string.

functions.name: get_filename
functions.description: Returns the file name of a port.

functions.name: get_pname
functions.description: Returns the print name of a symbol as a string.

functions.name: get_string
functions.description: Converts the argument to a string if it is a symbol. Otherwise it returns the string itself.

functions.name: getc
functions.description: Reads and returns a single character from an input port. Unlike the C library, the getc and getchar SKILL functions are totally unrelated.

functions.name: getchar
functions.description: Returns an indexed character of a string or the print name if the string is a symbol. Unlike the C library, the getc and getchar SKILL functions are totally unrelated.

functions.name: getd
functions.description: Returns the function binding for a function name.

functions.name: getq
functions.description: Returns the value of a property in a property list. Same as get except that the second argument is not evaluated. This is a syntax form.

functions.name: getqq
functions.description: Returns the value of a property in a symbol's property list. Same as get except that neither argument is evaluated. This is a syntax form.

functions.name: gets
functions.description: Reads a line from the input port and stores the line as a string in the variable. This is a macro.

functions.name: globalProc
functions.description: Defines a global function using a formal argument list. The functions that you define using globalProc are defined within a lexical scope, but are globally accessible.

functions.name: globalSigAlias
functions.description: Removes all the previous signal aliases and creates the specified aliases. The signal names in each of the signal lists are marked as aliases of each other. Each of the signal lists is a set of signal names that are to be aliased. The signal names should match the names that were specified using the globalSignal command. To unalias all signal, pecify nil instead of signal lists.

functions.name: globalSignal
functions.signature: globalSignal([ ?name t_signalName ][ ?lang t_langName ][ ?wireType t_wireType ][ ?discipline t_discipline ][ ?ground t_ground ]@Rest args)=> t / nil
functions.description: Adds or modifies a global signal for a given AMS OCEAN session needed by the elaborator. If the global signal already exists in the session, the values are updated. If it does not exist, a global signal with the specified name is added. In case of a vector signal, the range information can be appended with the name of the signal.

functions.name: gmax
functions.description: Returns the maximum power gain in terms of the supplied parameters.

functions.name: gmin
functions.description: Returns the optimum noise reflection coefficient in terms of o_Gopt, o_Bopt, and f_zref.

functions.name: gmsg
functions.description: Returns the maximum stable power gain in terms of the supplied parameters.

functions.name: gmux
functions.description: Returns the maximum unilateral power gain in terms of the supplied parameters.

functions.name: go
functions.description: Transfers control to the statement following the label argument. This is a syntax form.

functions.name: gp
functions.description: Computes the power gain in terms of the S-parameters.

functions.name: gpc
functions.description: Computes the power gain circles.

functions.name: gpc_freq
functions.description: Returns the operating power gain circles where the gain is fixed and frequency is swept.

functions.name: gpc_gain
functions.description: Returns the operating power gain circles where the frequency is fixed and gain is swept.

functions.signature: gpeAddDummyInEmptyCells(u_sandbox[ ?dummyConfig l_dummyConfig ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Fills the empty cells in the specified sandbox object with dummies.

functions.description: Adds a ring of dummies around the specified sandbox grid.

functions.name: gpeClearChannelWidthEntry
functions.description: Clears the channelWidth value of the specified channel in the specified sandbox.

functions.description: Unplaces the grid entries that match the given identifiers in the given sandbox object.

functions.description: Removes all the matched groups from the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeClearPresetGenerators
functions.description: Deletes all the registered preset generator functions from the system.

functions.name: gpeClearStrapEntries
functions.description: Removes all straps from the specified Modgen sandbox.

functions.name: gpeClearTopo
functions.description: Removes all topologies from the specified Modgen sandbox.

functions.name: gpeClearTrunkChains
functions.description: Removes all trunk chains from the Modgen sandbox.

functions.name: gpeCopyColAbutment
functions.description: Copies abutment information from one column to another.

functions.name: gpeCopyRowAbutment
functions.description: Copies abutment information from one row to another.

functions.description: Creates a list of abut entries that are in line with the information in the arguments.

functions.description: Creates a map entry DPL that stores the schematic name of an instance, along with its symbol mapping.

functions.name: gpeCreateMatchGroupEntry
functions.signature: gpeCreateMatchGroupEntry(d_matchGroupID[ ?twigMatchType t_twigMatchType ][ ?trunkMatchType t_trunkMatchType ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Creates a DPL that represents a matched group. The DPL can then be added to a Modgen sandbox object using the gpeAddMatchGroups function.

functions.name: gpeCreateSandbox
functions.signature: gpeCreateSandbox([ ?cv d_cellview ][ ?ids l_figs ][ ?sync { t | nil } ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> u_sandbox / nil
functions.description: Creates a Modgen sandbox object that includes the specified instances. This function can be used to create Modgen sandbox objects in both schematic and layout cellviews. If none of the arguments are provided, the current edit cellview and selected instances are considered.

functions.name: gpeCreateStrapEntries
functions.signature: gpeCreateStrapEntries([ ?netNames l_netNames ][ ?instTermEntries l_instTermEntries ][ ?direction t_direction ][ ?constraints l_constraints ][ ?template l_template ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> l_straps / nil
functions.description: Creates straps for the specified nets that connect the specified instance terminals.

functions.name: gpeCreateTrunkChain
functions.signature: gpeCreateTrunkChain(?trunks l_trunks?anchorIndex n_anchorIndex[ ?trunkDirection { horizontal | vertical } ][ ?offsetDirection { positive | negative } ][ ?anchorPoint t_anchorPoint ][ ?anchorReference t_anchorReference ][ ?centerInChannel { t | nil } ][ ?template l_template ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> g_trunkChainObject / nil
functions.description: Creates trunk chain entries based on the specified identifiers from the sandbox. It is recommended to use only one of the optional arguments. If none of the optional arguments is provided, all trunk chains available in the Modgen are listed. If multiple optional arguments are provided, the return value is the intersection of all the sets.

functions.name: gpeCreateTrunkEntries
functions.signature: gpeCreateTrunkEntries([ ?netNames lt_netNames ][ ?offset f_offset ][ ?longOffsetSource1 t_longOffsetSource1 ][ ?longOffset1 f_longOffset1 ][ ?longOffsetSource2 t_longOffsetSource2 ][ ?longOffset2 f_longOffset2 ][ ?twigs lg_twigs ][ ?twigConstraints lg_twigConstraints ][ ?constraints lg_constraints ][ ?template l_template ][ ?matchGroup l_matchGroupID ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> l_trunkObjects / nil
functions.description: Creates a list of trunk entries, one for each netName. The properties defined by the arguments are applied to all trunks. To define different properties for each trunk, call the function in a for loop and set the arguments, as required, for each unique trunk.

functions.name: gpeCreateTwigEntries
functions.signature: gpeCreateTwigEntries([ ?instTermEntries l_instTermEntries ][ ?constraints l_constraints ][ ?template l_template ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> g_twigObject / nil
functions.description: Creates a Modgen sandbox twig object, which specifies the instance terminals to make connections to and the constraints that define how the connections must be made. The twig objects can be added to trunk with the ?twigEntries parameter on gpeCreateTrunkEntries.

functions.name: gpeDeleteDummyEntries
functions.description: Deletes dummy entries from the given Modgen sandbox object and compresses the grid based on the specified options.

functions.name: gpeDeleteSandbox
functions.description: Deletes the specified Modgen sandbox object but does not delete its associated figGroup.

functions.name: gpeEditSandbox
functions.signature: gpeEditSandbox([ d_modgenID | d_figGroupID ][ g_sync ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> u_sandbox / nil
functions.description: Returns a Modgen sandbox object that represents the current Modgen or figGroup. The sandbox object can be edited using SKILL APIs.

functions.name: gpeExtractReuseTemplate
functions.description: Extracts the given Modgen into a reusable text file.

functions.name: gpeExtractReuseTemplatesFromLCV
functions.description: Extracts array reuse template files for recognized groups and arrays for all combinations of the specified libraries, cells, and views in the current design.

functions.name: gpeExtractTemplateFromMG
functions.description: Generates a reusable template for each Modgen constraint present in the specified constraint cache.

functions.name: gpeFindArrayPatternDiffs
functions.description: Compares array patterns of the specified Modgen constraints or sandbox objects and reports differences, if any.

functions.name: gpeFinishSandbox
functions.signature: gpeFinishSandbox(u_sandbox[ ?transfer { t | nil } ][ ?removeScratch { t | nil } ][ ?backAnnotate { t | nil } ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the specified Modgen sandbox object. If run from the schematic view, the Modgen's associated scratch cellview is also deleted. If run from the layout view, the command optionally transfers the Modgen constraint to the schematic view and backannotates any dummies. gpeFinishSandbox must be used in tandem with the functions that create sandboxes, such as gpeCreateSandbox and gpeEditSandbox. It is recommend that all Modgen sandbox objects are finished by calling this function.

functions.name: gpeGetAbut
functions.description: Returns the Modgen abutment DPL for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetAbutTypeList
functions.description: Returns a list of abutment types for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetAbutTypeName
functions.description: Returns the name corresponding to the given abutment type number from the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetChannelWidthEntry
functions.description: Returns the channelWidth sandbox object that matches the specified index and direction values.

functions.name: gpeGetConstraints
functions.description: Returns a list of constraint IDs that are associated with the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetDefaultAbutType
functions.description: Returns the default abutment type name for the given Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetFigGroup
functions.description: Returns the ID of the Modgen figGroup that is associated with the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetGrid
functions.description: Returns the Modgen sandbox grid DPL that describes the grid placement of the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetGridColCount
functions.description: Returns the number of columns available in the grid of the given Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetGridEntries
functions.signature: gpeGetGridEntries(u_sandbox[ ?row x_row ][ ?col x_col ][ ?name t_name ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> l_gridEntries / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of grid entries from the Modgen sandbox that match the specified identifiers. If you specify multiple identifiers, then the function returns a list of instances that satisfy all requirements.

functions.name: gpeGetGridEntry
functions.signature: gpeGetGridEntry(u_sandbox[ ?ref d_refID ][ ?index l_index ][ ?name t_layoutName ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> l_gridEntry / nil
functions.description: Returns a grid entry that matches the specified argument for the specified sandbox object. When calling this function, only one search argument of type reference, index, or layout name must be specified. If multiple arguments are specified, an error message is displayed.

functions.name: gpeGetGridRowCount
functions.description: Returns the number of rows available in the grid of the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetGridSelection
functions.description: Returns a list of indexes that represent the grid selection in the GPE (Grid Pattern Editor) assistant. The DPL is a list of list of indexes, for example ((0 1) (1 3) ... ), that are associated with the specified userType (UT).

functions.name: gpeGetGridValue
functions.description: Returns the value of the cells in the Grid Pattern Editor table view.

functions.name: gpeGetMap
functions.description: Returns the Modgen sandbox map DPL for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeGetMapEntry
functions.description: Returns the map entry DPL from the specified Modgen sandbox object that matches the specified schematic or symbol name. The function first looks for a matching schematic name; if not found, then looks for a matching symbol name and returns the first match.

functions.name: gpeGetSelection
functions.description: Returns a list of currently selected cells or a range of cells in a grid-pattern-editor table format.

functions.name: gpeGetStrapEntries
functions.signature: gpeGetStrapEntries(u_sandboxObject[ ?netNames l_netNames ][ ?deviceNames l_deviceNames ][ ?instTermNames l_instTermNames ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> l_straps / nil
functions.description: Filters straps in the Modgen sandbox based on the specified identifiers. It is recommended to use only one of the optional arguments. If no arguments are provided, all straps in the Modgen are displayed. If multiple arguments are provided, the intersection of the sets is displayed.

functions.name: gpeGetTrunkChains
functions.signature: gpeGetTrunkChains(u_sandbox[ ?anchorIndex n_anchorIndex ][ ?trunkDirection t_trunkDirection ][ ?offsetDirection t_offsetDirection ][ ?anchorPoint t_anchorPoint ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> l_trunksChains / nil
functions.description: Returns a list of trunk chains based on the specified identifiers. If none of the optional arguments are provided, all trunkChains available in the Modgen are listed. If multiple optional arguments are provided, the return value is the intersection of all the sets.

functions.name: gpeGetTwigEntries
functions.signature: gpeGetTwigEntries(u_sandbox[ ?trunks l_trunks ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> l_Twigs / nil
functions.description: Returns all twigs on the specified trunks from the specified sandbox.

functions.name: gpeInsertEmptyColumns
functions.description: Inserts empty columns in the specified Modgen sandbox object in the specified direction, starting at the specified column.

functions.name: gpeInsertEmptyRows
functions.description: Inserts empty rows in the specified Modgen sandbox object in the specified direction, starting at the specified row.

functions.name: gpeIsPresetGenDisplayable
functions.description: Checks whether the given preset generator is displayed in the Preset drop-down of the Grid Pattern Editor for the selected Modgen.

functions.name: gpeIsRegisteredPresetGen
functions.description: Checks whether the specified function is a registered preset generator function.

functions.name: gpeIsSandboxSync
functions.description: Checks whether the specified Modgen sandbox object is in sync with its associated Modgen constraint, and returns a Boolean that indicates the status.

functions.name: gpeIsValidAbutType
functions.signature: gpeIsValidAbutType (u_sandbox{ t_abutTypeName | x_abutType }[ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Validates the specified abutment type name or number for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeLoadReuseTemplate
functions.description: Creates a new Modgen constraint by applying the given Modgen reuse template to the specified list of instances.

functions.name: gpeMove
functions.description: Moves a list of cells within the Grid Pattern Editor table from one point to another.

functions.name: gpePlaceGridEntries
functions.description: Places the specified grid entries at the specified location in the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpePresetReorientResistor
functions.description: Flips the orientations of the members of a preselected Modgen to reduce the overall connectivity wire length. The placement of the members is not altered.

functions.name: gpeRegisterPresetGen
functions.description: Registers the specified function as a preset generator.

functions.name: gpeRemoveEmptyRowsAndColumns
functions.description: Removes empty rows and columns from the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeRemoveInstance
functions.description: Removes the given instances from the specified Modgen figGroup.

functions.name: gpeRunPresetGen
functions.description: Invokes the specified preset generator function on the active figGroup. The figGroup is updated according to the preset generator logic. Ensure that the Grid Pattern Editor (GPE) assistant is open when running this command. Also ensure that the selection argument specifies a valid Modgen figGroup and that the preset is registered correctly.

functions.name: gpeSboxp
functions.description: Checks whether the specified object is a valid Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeSelect
functions.description: Select cells in the Grid Pattern Editor or Grid Pattern Mapping assistants.

functions.name: gpeSetAbut
functions.description: Sets the abutment for the entire grid, without using individual abutment entries. The entire abutment object of the sandbox-in-place is replaced.

functions.name: gpeSetAbutEntries
functions.description: Modifies the Modgen sandbox object by applying the abutment specified by the abutment entries. If there is any conflict between the new entry and any existing entry, the existing entry is removed and the new entry is used.

functions.name: gpeSetChannelWidthEntry
functions.description: Sets the channelWidth for the specified channel.

functions.name: gpeSetGrid
functions.description: Sets the entire grid without using individual grid entries. You can also use this function to update grid placement by providing a list of lists describing the row placement of instances.

functions.name: gpeSetGridEntry
functions.description: Adds the specified grid entry to the grid portion of the specified Modgen sandbox object. If the grid location specified in the grid entry is already occupied, the existing entry is unplaced, and the specified grid entry is set.

functions.name: gpeSetGridText
functions.description: Specifies a textual grid pattern for the Pattern field on the Text tab of the Grid Pattern Editor assistant.

functions.name: gpeSetGridValue
functions.description: Sets the value of the Grid Pattern Editor table view cells. If there is a single cell selected before the call, the next cell will be selected automatically.

functions.name: gpeSetMap
functions.description: Updates the symbol mapping without using individual map entries. When a sandbox map DPL is specified, the current mapping of instances is replaced with the mapping specified by the provided map DPL. Symbol mapping can also be updated by providing a list of lists of strings. The first string in each sub-list holds the schematic name of an instance and the second string holds its updated mapping.

functions.name: gpeSetMapEntry
functions.description: Modifies the map portion of the Modgen sandbox object by updating the symbol mapping value with the specified map entry. The key in the map is the schematic name. If the sandbox has a schematic instance with the same name as the one specified in the map entry, then the symbol mapping of that instance in the sandbox is modified.

functions.name: gpeSetMergeLayer
functions.signature: gpeSetMergeLayer(u_sandboxg_mergeLayer { default | well | none | t_layerName | l_layerNames }[ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Sets the MergeLayer parameter for the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeSetOrientText
functions.description: Specifies the grid pattern orientation for the Orient field on the Text tab of the Grid Pattern Editor assistant.

functions.name: gpeSetRouter
functions.description: Specifies the router to be used to route the Modgen.

functions.name: gpeSetSize
functions.description: Resizes the specified Grid Pattern Editor table. If the table dimensions are smaller or larger than the new dimensions, then rows or columns are added or removed, as needed.

functions.name: gpeStacksAreCompressed
functions.description: Determines whether the stacks in the specified Modgen sandbox object are in the compressed state.

functions.name: gpeStacksCompress:
functions.description: Compresses all stacks in the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeStacksUncompress
functions.description: Uncompresses all stacks in the specified Modgen sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeStartSandbox
functions.signature: gpeStartSandbox([ ?ref l_reference ][ ?cv d_cellview ][ ?sync { t | nil } ][ ?updateSchConstraint { t | nil } ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> g_sandbox / nil
functions.description: Checks for a Modgen sandbox object that includes the specified instances. If one exists, the handle of the Modgen sandbox object is returned for editing with the GPE placement and routing APIs. If an existing object does not have the specified instances, a new Modgen sandbox object is created.

functions.name: gpeSyncSandbox
functions.signature: gpeSyncSandbox(u_sandbox[ g_transferConstraint ][ ?verbose { t | nil } ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Sets the specified Modgen sandbox object to sync mode, meaning that changes made to the state of the Modgen sandbox object cause an update to any associated Modgen constraint and layout placement.

functions.name: gpeUnAbutGridEntries
functions.description: Unabuts the specified list of instances or indexes in the specified sandbox object.

functions.name: gpeUnSyncSandbox
functions.description: Sets the specified Modgen sandbox object to the unsynchronized mode. In this mode, any change to the state of the Modgen sandbox object is not reflected in any associated Modgen constraint and the layout placement.

functions.name: gpeUnregisterPresetGen
functions.description: Unregisters the given preset generator function from the Grid Pattern Editor.

functions.name: gpeUpdateInstanceFromSchematic
functions.description: Updates the given Modgen instance parameters based on the binding schematic cellview.

functions.name: graphicsOff
functions.description: Disables the redrawing of the current Waveform window.

functions.name: graphicsOn
functions.description: Enables the redrawing of the current Waveform window.

functions.name: greaterp
functions.description: This predicate function checks if the first argument is greater than the second argument. Prefix form of the > operator.

functions.name: groupDelay
functions.description: Computes the group delay of a waveform.

functions.name: gt
functions.description: Returns the transducer gain in terms of the supplied parameters and the optional source reflection coefficient (Gs) and the input reflection coefficient (Gl).

functions.name: gtc
functions.description: Returns the ID of the window in which the specified cellview is the top cellview. This function is a shortcut for the function geGetTopCellViewWindow.

functions.name: gwc
functions.description: Returns the ID of the cellview displayed in a window. This function is a shortcut of the function geGetWindowCellView.

functions.name: hardCopy
functions.description: Sends a Waveform window plot to a printer or a file. To plot to a printer specify a printer name using the ?hcPrinterName argument of the hardCopyOptions command. To plot to a file, specify a file name using the ?hcOutputFile argument of the hardCopyOptions command.

functions.name: hardCopyOptions
functions.signature: hardCopyOptions([ ?hcCopyNum x_hcCopyNum ][ ?hcOffsetHeight x_hcOffsetHeight ][ ?hcOffsetWidth x_hcOffsetWidth ][ ?hcOrientation s_hcOrientation ][ ?hcOutputFile g_hcOutputFile ][ ?hcPrinterName s_hcPrinterName ][ ?hcTmpDir t_hcTmpDir ][ ?hcPaperSize s_hcPaperSize ][ ?hcMakeExactCopy g_hcMakeExactCopy ][ ?hcQuality x_hcQuality ][ ?hcOptimizeForWindows g_hcOptimizeForWindows ][ ?hcImageWidth x_hcImageWidth ][ ?hcImageHeight x_hcImageHeight ][ ?hcImageSizeUnits s_hcImageSizeUnits ][ ?hcImageResolution x_ImageResolution ][ ?hcResolutionUnits s_hcResolutionUnits ][ ?hcImageAspectRatio x_hcImageAspectRatio ][ ?hcUseExistingBackground g_hcUseExistingBackground ][ ?hcDisplayTitle g_hcDisplayTitle ][ ?hcDisplayLegend g_hcDisplayLegend ][ ?hcDisplayAxes g_hcDisplayAxes ][ ?hcDisplayGrids g_hcDisplayGrids ][ ?hcSaveEachSubwindowSeparately g_hcSaveEachSubwindowSeparately ])=> g_value / nil
functions.description: Sets the graph window hardcopy plotting options.

functions.name: harmonic
functions.description: Returns the waveform for a given harmonic index.

functions.name: harmonicFreq
functions.description: Returns the frequency(s) of the harmonic waveform for the specified harmonic. This function is available only in the SKILL mode.

functions.name: harmonicFreqList
functions.description: Returns a list of lists, with each sublist containing a harmonic index and the minimum and maximum frequency values that the particular harmonic ranges between.

functions.name: harmonicList
functions.description: Returns the list of harmonic indices available in the resultName or current result data.

functions.name: hdbAddConfigToBag
functions.description: Adds a configuration handle to a configuration bag.

functions.name: hdbBind
functions.signature: hdbBind(h_pathVectort_masterLibNamet_masterCellNamet_masterViewNamet_instNameg_fixedLibg_fixedCellg_fixedView[ g_wantSignature ][ g_wantWhy ])=> ( t_boundLibId t_boundCellId t_boundView h_bindSignature h_bindWhy )
functions.description: Binds an instance to a master.

functions.name: hdbBindBit
functions.signature: hdbBindBit(h_pathVectort_masterLibNamet_masterCellNamet_masterViewNamet_baseInstNamex_bitx_leftRangeIndexx_rightRangeIndexg_fixedLibg_fixedCellg_fixedView[ g_wantSignature ][ g_wantWhy ])=> ( t_boundLib t_boundCell t_boundView h_bindSignatureId h_bindWhyId )
functions.description: Binds a single bit of an iterated instance.

functions.name: hdbBitHasRules
functions.description: Determines whether a bit-specific configuration rule applies to the specified iterated instance bit.

functions.name: hdbClose
functions.description: Closes a configuration. In all cases where you are using the hdb interface to traverse (bind, elaborate) a design use hdbCloseConfigsInBag to close open configurations instead of this function.

functions.name: hdbCloseConfigsInBag
functions.description: Closes all of the configurations held in a configuration bag.

functions.name: hdbConfigHasOccRules
functions.description: Checks whether a configuration contains any occurrence rules.

functions.name: hdbCreateConfigBag
functions.description: Creates a configuration bag to hold configurations.

functions.name: hdbCreatePathVector
functions.description: Creates a path vector to use while traversing (elaborating) a design hierarchy.

functions.name: hdbCreatePathVectorStack
functions.description: Creates a stack to hold path vectors when traversing into sub-configurations.

functions.name: hdbDestroyPathVector
functions.description: Destroys a path vector.

functions.name: hdbExplainBinding
functions.description: Explains why a hdbBind binding was made the way it was.

functions.name: hdbExplainSignature
functions.description: Explains the contents of a binding signature.

functions.name: hdbExplainStop
functions.description: Explains why a stop was declared.

functions.name: hdbGetCellName
functions.description: Gets the cell name of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbGetLibName
functions.description: Gets the library name of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbGetPathStackStr
functions.description: Creates a string listing all the path vectors. Creates something similar to a fully rooted path for a design binding that contains sub-configurations.

functions.name: hdbGetPathStr
functions.description: Creates a string representation of a path vector.

functions.name: hdbGetPathVectorStackTop
functions.description: Gets the top of a path vector stack.

functions.name: hdbGetTopCellName
functions.description: Gets the name of the top cell of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbGetTopLibName
functions.description: Gets the name of the top library of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbGetTopViewName
functions.description: Gets the name of the top view pointed to by h_hdbConfig.

functions.name: hdbGetViewName
functions.description: Gets the view name of a configuration specified by h_configId.

functions.name: hdbHasIterInstBitRules
functions.description: Determines whether a configuration contains rules that apply to iterated instance bits.

functions.name: hdbIsAtStopPoint
functions.description: Checks if the point just pushed into with hdbPushCell is a stop point.

functions.name: hdbIsConfig
functions.description: Checks if a given library/cell/view is a configuration.

functions.name: hdbIsIterInst
functions.description: Determines whether an instance name is of an iterated instance. If it is of an iterated instance, the base instance name and range indexes are returned.

functions.name: hdbIsOpenConfig
functions.description: Checks if the configuration ID you specify is valid. The configuration ID is valid if the configuration is still open.

functions.name: hdbIterInstHasBitRules
functions.description: Determines whether an iterated instance has bit-specific configuration rules. If it does, you might want to check whether the binding for individual bits of the iterated instance are different from the iterated instance binding.

functions.name: hdbOpen
functions.description: Opens a configuration for read or edit.

functions.name: hdbPopCell
functions.description: Pops an entry off a path vector.

functions.name: hdbPopPathVect
functions.description: Pops a path vector off the top of a path vector stack.

functions.name: hdbPushBitCell
functions.description: Pushes the cell of an iterated instance bit on to a path vector.

functions.name: hdbPushCell
functions.description: Push a cell onto a path vector.

functions.name: hdbPushPathVect
functions.description: Adds a path vector on to the top of a path vector stack.

functions.name: hdbReOpenNewConfig
functions.description: Increments the reference count of an in-memory only configuration (that is, a new configuration that has not yet been written to disk) and returns t. If the configuration does not exist in memory or if it already exists on disk, this function returns nil and the reference count is not incremented.

functions.name: hdbSave
functions.description: Saves a configuration opened with hdbOpen.

functions.name: hdbSaveACopy
functions.description: Makes a copy of a configuration and saves it to a library/cell/view. Unlike hdbSaveAs, this function does not modify the location of the configuration associated with the specified configId.

functions.name: hdbSaveAs
functions.description: Saves a configuration to a library/cell/view.

functions.name: hdbSetDefaultLibListString
functions.description: Sets the global library list in the configuration specified by the h_configId

functions.name: hdbSetDefaultStopListString
functions.description: Sets the global stop view list in the configuration specified by h_configId

functions.name: hdbSetDefaultViewListString
functions.description: Sets the global view list in the configuration specified by h_configId

functions.name: hdbSetObjBindRule
functions.description: Sets or deletes a binding rule on a cell, instance, or occurrence (path). You can set the following binding rules: library list, view list, binding, or stop point.

functions.name: hdbSetTopCellViewName
functions.description: Sets the top of the design hierarchy to library.cell:view in the configuration specified by h_configId

functions.name: hdlGenerateTextDatabase
functions.description: Generates the text database for analog and digital languages without requiring the Text Editor.

functions.name: hdlPkgCreateEnvSetupFile
functions.description: Saves the environment variables used by the HDL Package Setup from the current Virtuoso setup database into a specified file. Each name-value pair for a variable is printed in the following format:

functions.name: hdlPkgExportXrunArgs
functions.signature: hdlPkgExportXrunArgs(t_fileName[ ?format { t | nil } ][ ?isExpandPath { t | nil } ][ ?userSpecOnly { t | nil } ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Exports the xrun arguments corresponding to environment variables used by the HDL Package Setup from the current Virtuoso setup database into the specified file.

functions.name: heHiEditConfig
functions.description: Opens the hierarchy editor if the current editing window has a design opened within the context of a configuration.

functions.name: heHiSetInstBinding
functions.description: Sets the instance bindings of an instance in a cellview of open configurations. The form associated with this function is updated with current binding information. The new bindings are communicated to the hierarchy editor.

functions.name: heHiShowViewsFound
functions.description: Shows the current view being used for each instance in a form.

functions.name: heHiUpdate
functions.description: Updates the information in the hierarchy editor after you edit the configuration.

functions.name: hedRegUICustomFunc
functions.description: Registers a UI customization function that gets called when a new Hierarchy Editor window is created.

functions.name: help
functions.description: Retrieves and prints the cdsFinder documentation strings for the given function name (a symbol). If the given name is a string, it is interpreted as a regular expression, and the entire cdsFinder database is searched for functions whose name or documentation string contains or matches the given string. Help is an nlambda function.

functions.name: hiAbout
functions.description: Displays an application's product information window, which includes the release version and copyright information. If w_windowId is a session window, the product information is about the window that is displayed in the top tab.

functions.name: hiAbsolutePan
functions.signature: hiAbsolutePan([ w_window ][ n_%x ][ n_%y ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Scrolls a window in any direction by specifying the amount to pan as a percentage of the window size.

functions.name: hiAddCyclicChoice
functions.description: Adds the new entry to the end of the list of choices in the cyclic field in the form.

functions.name: hiAddExtraRepeatCommand
functions.description: Adds the specified SKILL command to the extra repeat command list so that the command becomes repeatable next time the hiRepeat function is called. Additionally, you can add the specified commands to the extra repeat command list that are not repeated automatically after there first run.

functions.name: hiAddField
functions.signature: hiAddField(g_formRegionOrLayoutg_field[ x_attachment | s_layout [ l_field_controls ] ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Adds a field to a form. The form must already exist, and the field must have been created with one of the field creation routines.

functions.name: hiAddFields
functions.description: Adds fields to a form. The form must already exist, and the fields must have been created with one of the field creation routines.

functions.name: hiAddFixedMenu
functions.signature: hiAddFixedMenu([ ?window w_window ]?fixedMenu g_fixedMenu[ ?menuSide s_menuSide ][ ?append g_append ][ ?newLine g_newLine ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Fixed menus are no longer supported in windows. Use the new toolbar functions to create toolbars instead for windows. Existing fixed menus that have been added to windows are no longer displayed, although no warnings are being generated. Replace these menus with toolbars.

functions.name: hiAddIconOverrides
functions.description: Adds names to the list of icons that are loaded using CSF search results directly, bypassing the hierarchy files. If the CSF search fails, the files in the hierarchy are loaded.

functions.name: hiAddItemToLayout
functions.description: Adds the required controls to the layout.

functions.name: hiAddMenuItem
functions.description: Adds the menu item or action to the end of all instances of the specified hiMenu.

functions.name: hiAddNonRepeatPrefix
functions.description: Adds a string to the list of repeat filter strings. All strings is compared on every command run.

functions.name: hiAddTextWordDelimiter
functions.description: Adds characters to the word delimiter list for the window.

functions.name: hiAddToolbarItem
functions.description: Adds one toolbar item to a toolbar. The item is added to the end of the toolbar.

functions.name: hiAddToolbarItems
functions.description: Adds a list of toolbar items to a toolbar. The items are added at the end of the toolbar.

functions.name: hiAdvanceProgressBarOneStep
functions.description: Increments the progress bar by one step for the specified window.

functions.name: hiAppendInputCmd
functions.description: Appends a command to the input area of an encapsulation window.

functions.name: hiApplyWinConfig
functions.description: Applies a workspace to a session window. If the session window has toolbars and dock assistants that were not present when the workspace was created, they get hidden.

functions.name: hiBindKeyModifiers
functions.description: Returns the list of modifiers that can be used with bindkeys in the current session. You can specify the type of keys for which you want the list of legal modifiers: printable, mouse, or function.

functions.name: hiBoxCenter
functions.description: Returns the center point of a bounding box.

functions.name: hiCancelProgressBox
functions.description: Programmatically cancels a progress dialog box. Calls the callback procedure for the dialog box, if any.

functions.name: hiChangeBannerLabel
functions.description: Overwrites an existing label or adds a new label in the banner bar of a window.

functions.name: hiChangeFormCallback
functions.description: Changes the doneAction and/or the cancelAction of the specified form to the SKILL callback procedure defined by newCallback. newCallback can be a symbol, a string, a function object,or a list of two symbols/strings/function objects. The first callback is taken as the doneAction. The second callback is taken as the cancelAction. After this routine is called, if the OK or Apply button of the form is pressed, the doneAction is executed, and if the Cancel button is pressed, the cancelAction is executed.

functions.name: hiChangeFormTitle
functions.description: Changes the window manager title of the specified form to t_newTitle.

functions.name: hiCheckAbort
functions.description: Returns the value of the global abort flag.

functions.name: hiClearClipboard
functions.description: Clears the text stored in the system clipboard.

functions.name: hiClearCurrentTextSelection
functions.description: Clears current selection, if any, in the specified text window. This is equivalent to clicking anywhere in the text window when text is selected.

functions.name: hiCloseWindow
functions.description: Closes and destroys a window, dock window, or session window.

functions.name: hiCollapseTreeItem
functions.description: Collapses the tree item you specify. This function also executes the collapse callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiConfigureBindKeys
functions.signature: hiConfigureBindKeys(?showOnlyApps l_apps?showAllChildren g_showAllChildren?selectApp t_appname?selectKeyBinding t_keyBinding?showEmptyApps g_showEmptyApps?showInheritedBindings g_showInheritedBindings)=> t / nil
functions.description: Resets and displays the Bindkey Configuration form according to the supplied arguments. If the form is currently open, and contains unsaved changes, it will prompt before resetting the data.

functions.name: hiCreate2DMenu
functions.description: Creates a two-dimensional popup menu. Once this menu is created, you can display it with hiDisplayMenu or associate it with a window using hiSetWindowMenu.

functions.name: hiCreateAction
functions.signature: hiCreateAction(?name s_name[ ?callback t_callback ][ ?icon g_icon ][ ?iconText t_iconText ][ ?toolTip t_tooltip ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?checkable g_checkable ][ ?checked g_checked ][ ?defAction g_defaultAction ][ ?actionList l_actionList ][ ?statusTip t_statusTip ][ ?useNameForIconText g_useNameForIconText ])=> o_action
functions.description: Creates an action for a toolbar or menu. An action is a toolbar or menu item that, when clicked, triggers a callback. Actions are typically used for common commands that are added to multiple places in the user interface, such as toolbars and menus. An action present in both a toolbar and a menu remains synchronized. For example, if it is selected from the toolbar, the corresponding menu item is also checked.

functions.name: hiCreateAppForm
functions.signature: hiCreateAppForm(?name s_name?fields l_fieldEntries[ ?attachmentList l_fieldAttachments ][ ?tabOrderIsAddOrder g_tabOrderIsAddOrder ][ ?formTitle t_formTitle ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?unmapAfterCB g_unmapAfterCB ][ ?mapCB g_mapCallback ][ ?formType s_formType ][ ?dialogStyle s_dialogStyle ][ ?buttonLayout g_buttonLayout ][ ?buttonDisabled s_buttonDisabled ][ ?help g_help ][ ?initialSize g_initialSize ][ ?minSize g_minSize ][ ?maxSize g_maxSize ][ ?dontBlock g_dontBlock ][ ?fieldFocus s_fieldFocus ][ ?plist g_plist ][ ?baseName s_baseName ])=> r_form
functions.description: Returns the SKILL representation of a form with the specified field entries, setting it to the specified name. All standard forms, from simple forms to property lists, are generated using hiCreateAppForm, with varying field entries. Use this function instead of hiCreateForm.

functions.name: hiCreateBBoxField
functions.signature: hiCreateBBoxField(?name s_fieldName[ prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?value l_currentValue ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?defValue l_defaultValue ][ ?font t_font ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ][ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?nextField g_nextField ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a bounding box field for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateBooleanButton
functions.signature: hiCreateBooleanButton(?name s_fieldName?buttonText t_buttonText[ ?buttonLocation s_buttonLocation ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?value g_booleanValue ][ ?defValue g_defaultValue ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?font t_font ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?partialSelect g_partialSelect ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a single Boolean button for a form. The button text appears as a prompt next to the button; the button is on the left of the button text if the ?buttonLocation argument is 'left and on the right of the button text if the ?buttonLocation argument is 'right. A Boolean field consists of a single toggle button which may have an associated callback procedure executed when the Boolean state changes.

functions.name: hiCreateButton
functions.signature: hiCreateButton(?name s_fieldName?callback g_callback[ ?buttonText t_buttonText ][ ?buttonIcon g_buttonIcon ][ ?showTextWithIcon g_showTextWithIcon ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?font t_font ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?toolTip l_tooltip ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a standalone push button for a form or two-dimensional menu. The button must have an associated callback procedure to be executed when the button is selected. A button-only field differs from a button box field in that there is no prompt associated with this button.

functions.name: hiCreateButtonBoxField
functions.signature: hiCreateButtonBoxField(?name s_fieldName?choices l_buttonText?callback l_callbackList?prompt t_fieldPrompt[ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?font t_font ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a button box field for a form. A button box field contains individual buttons to be displayed in one row. Each button in the button box have an associated callback procedure that is run when that button is selected. A prompt is displayed on this row as well.

functions.name: hiCreateColorArray
functions.description: Example: colorArray[0] is represented by a or A; colorArray[12] is represented by m or M; colorArray[26] is represented by a period (.).

functions.name: hiCreateComboField
functions.signature: hiCreateComboField(?name s_fieldName?items g_choices[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?value t_currentValue ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?defValue t_defaultValue ][ ?font t_font ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ][ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ][ ?format t_fieldFormat ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?nextField g_nextField ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a drop-down combination field, which is a type-in field with an attached drop-down list. Users can either select an item from the list or type in a value.

functions.name: hiCreateCyclicField
functions.signature: hiCreateCyclicField(?name s_fieldName?choices l_enumerations?prompt t_fieldPrompt[ ?value g_currentValue ][ ?defValue g_defaultValue ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?font t_font ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?keepHistory g_keepHistory ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a cyclic field for a form. A cyclic field contains a list of string or icon enumerations, which are displayed in a drop-down list. Only one item can be selected at a time.

functions.name: hiCreateDisclosureButton
functions.signature: hiCreateDisclosureButton(?name s_name[ ?callback g_callback ][ ?value g_value ][ ?defValue g_defValue ][ ?help S_help ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?onFields l_onFields ][ ?offFields l_offFields ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: A disclosure button is a button without a label used for displaying the additional information or functionality associated with another widget.

functions.name: hiCreateDisclosureTriangle
functions.signature: hiCreateDisclosureTriangle(?name s_name[ ?labelText t_labelText ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?value g_value ][ ?defValue g_defValue ][ ?help S_help ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?onFields l_onFields ][ ?offFields l_offFields ][ ?persistent g_state ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: A disclosure triangle is a low profile widget for displaying the additional information or functionality embedded in a form.

functions.name: hiCreateDockWindow
functions.signature: hiCreateDockWindow(?appType t_appType?widgetType t_widgetType[ ?handle s_handle ][ ?dockSizeHint l_dockSizeHint ][ ?minimumSizeHint l_minimumSizeHint ][ ?floatSizeHint l_floatSizeHint ][ ?form g_form ][ ?help t_help ][ ?scrollBar g_scrollBar ][ ?title t_title ][ ?visibilityProc s_visibilityProc ])=> w_dwindowID / nil
functions.description: Creates a dockable window, which can be docked in a session window with the hiDockWindow function. Dockable windows can be of the following types: form, hypertext, html, or text. Dockable windows cannot be of type graphics.

functions.name: hiCreateFileSelectorField
functions.signature: hiCreateFileSelectorField(?name s_fieldName?mode s_mode[ ?prompt t_prompt ][ ?value t_currentValue ][ ?defValue t_defaultValue ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ][ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?nextField g_nextField ][ ?confirmOverwrite g_confirmOverwrite ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a type-in field similar to a string field, except that it also has a Browse button at the right of the type-in box. The Browse button, when pressed, brings up a file dialog box that lets users select a file or directory. You can use the ?mode argument to specify what the user is allowed to select. The file dialog is modal, that is, it blocks access to the application while it is open. When the user makes a selection and closes the file dialog, the selection is entered into the type-in box.

functions.name: hiCreateFloatField
functions.signature: hiCreateFloatField(?name s_fieldName[ ?value f_currentValue ][ ?acceptNil g_acceptNil ][ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?defValue f_defaultValue ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?font t_font ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ][ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ][ ?range l_fieldRange ][ ?format t_fieldFormat ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?nextField g_nextField ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a float field for a form. A float field is a field which accepts floating-point input only. A format string can be specified which is automatically imposed on any user input. An optional range can be specified and enforced for this field as well.

functions.name: hiCreateFloatSpinBox
functions.signature: hiCreateFloatSpinBox(?name s_fieldName[ ?prompt t_prompt ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?value g_value ][ ?defValue g_defaultValue ][ ?font t_fontName ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?range l_rangeOfItems ][ ?shadowed g_shadowed ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?precision x_precision ][ ?step f_step ][ ?obeyWidth g_obeyWidth ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?wrapAround g_wraparound ][ ?arrowOrientation g_arrowOrientation ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a float spin box field, which contains a range of items that users can cycle through. The spin box field can only contain floating point numbers. For integers, use hiCreateSpinBox.

functions.name: hiCreateForm
functions.description: Use hiCreateAppForm instead of this function.

functions.name: hiCreateFormButton
functions.signature: hiCreateFormButton(?name s_fieldName?buttonText t_buttonText?callback g_callback[ ?buttonIcon g_buttonIcon ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?font t_font ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?showTextWithIcon g_showTextWithIcon ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a standalone push button for a form or two-dimensional menu. This function is the same as hiCreateButton.

functions.name: hiCreateFormLabel
functions.signature: hiCreateFormLabel(?name s_name[ ?labelText t_labelText ][ ?labelIcon g_labelIcon ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?font t_font ][ ?justification s_justification ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: This function is an alias for hiCreateLabel. Use hiCreateLabel instead of this function.

functions.name: hiCreateFormLayout
functions.signature: hiCreateFormLayout(s_name[ ?items l_items ][ ?frame g_frame ][ ?margins l_margins ][ ?spacing g_spacing ][ ?label_align g_labelAlign ][ ?horiz_align g_horizAlign ][ ?vert_align g_vertAlign ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?scrollable g_scrollable])=> r_hiLayout
functions.description: Creates a form layout by specifying the labels, margins, spacing, and alignment.

functions.name: hiCreateFrameField
functions.signature: hiCreateFrameField(?name s_fieldName[ ?labelText t_labelText ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a frame field for a two-dimensional form. A frame field is a border that surrounds a group of related fields so they are easier to see.

functions.name: hiCreateGridLayout
functions.signature: hiCreateGridLayout(s_name[ ?items l_items ][ ?frame g_frame ][ ?margins l_margins ][ ?spacing g_spacing ][ ?horiz_align g_horizAlign ][ ?vert_align g_vertAlign ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?scrollable g_scrollable])=> r_hiLayout
functions.description: Creates a grid layout by specifying the margins, spacing, and alignment.

functions.name: hiCreateHorizontalBoxLayout
functions.signature: hiCreateHorizontalBoxLayout(s_name[ ?items l_items ][ ?frame g_frame ][ ?margins l_margins ][ ?spacing g_spacing ][ ?horiz_align g_horizAlign ][ ?vert_align g_vertAlign ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?scrollable g_scrollable ])=> r_hiLayout
functions.description: Creates a horizontal box layout by specifying the margins, spacing, and alignment.

functions.name: hiCreateHorizontalFixedMenu
functions.description: Creates a horizontal fixed menu that is a free-floating menu unattached to any application window. The fixed menu is created as a grid of row x column dimensions, and contains menu item objects created by hiCreateMenuItem. An additional Done item is added as the last item. Selecting Done removes the fixed menu from the screen.

functions.name: hiCreateHypertextField
functions.signature: hiCreateHypertextField(?name s_name[ ?title t_title ][ ?titleAlignment g_titleAlignment ][ ?value t_value ][ ?pos t_position ][ ?defValue t_defaultValue ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?shadowed g_shadowed ][ ?hasVerticalScrollbar g_hasVerticalScrollbar ][ ?hasHorizontalScrollbar g_hasHorizontalScrollbar ][ ?invisible g_invisible ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a hypertext field, which displays rich text with hypertext navigation. You can also specify hyperlinks to execute SKILL commands.

functions.name: hiCreateIntField
functions.signature: hiCreateIntField(?name s_fieldName[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?value x_currentValue ][ ?acceptNil g_acceptNil ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?defValue x_defaultValue ][ ?font t_font ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ][ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ][ ?format t_fieldFormat ][ ?range l_fieldRange ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?nextField g_nextField ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates an integer field entry for a form. An int field is a field that accepts integer input only. A format string can be specified which is imposed automatically on any user input. An optional range can be specified and enforced for this field as well.

functions.name: hiCreateLabel
functions.signature: hiCreateLabel(?name s_fieldName[?labelText t_labelText][?labelIcon g_labelIcon][?justification s_justification][?font t_font][?enabled g_enabled][?invisible g_invisible][?help g_fieldHelp])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a standalone label entry for a form or two-dimensional menu. This label-only field contains a descriptive label and can provide additional features to a form or two-dimensional menu.

functions.name: hiCreateLayerCyclicField
functions.description: Creates a cyclic field entry containing icon representations of specified layers for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateLayoutForm
functions.signature: hiCreateLayoutForm(s_namet_titler_layout[ ?callback g_callback ][ ?mapCB g_mapCallback ][ ?help g_help ][ ?unmapAfterCB g_unmapAfterCB ][ ?buttonLayout g_buttonLayout ][ ?buttonDisabled l_buttonDisabled ][ ?formType s_formType ][ ?dialogStyle s_dialogStyle ][ ?baseName s_baseName ][ ?plist g_plist ][ ?initialSize l_initialSize ][ ?minSize l_minimumSize ][ ?maxSize l_maximumSize ][ ?sizePolicy s_sizePolicy ])=> r_form / nil
functions.description: Returns the SKILL representation of a layout form with the specified field entries and sets it to the specified name.

functions.name: hiCreateListBoxField
functions.signature: hiCreateListBoxField(?name s_fieldName?choices l_listItems[ ?prompt t_prompt ][ ?value l_selectedItem ][ ?defValue l_defSelectedItem ][ ?valueByPosition g_valueByPosition ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?changeCB g_changeCB ][ ?numRows x_numRows ][ ?multipleSelect g_multipleSelect ][ ?doubleClickCB g_doubleClickCB ][ ?CBOnReselect g_CBOnReselect ][ ?keepHistory g_keepHistory ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?selectionEnabled g_selectionEnabled ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a list box field for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateListField
functions.signature: hiCreateListField(?name s_fieldName[ ?value l_currentValue ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?defValue l_defaultValue ][ ?font t_font ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ][ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?nextField g_nextField ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a list field entry for a form. A list field accepts a valid SKILL expression as input. linereadstring determines if the expression is valid. The list expression ID is not evaluated; it is only checked to see if it is valid.

functions.signature: hiCreateMLTextField(?name s_fieldName[ ?prompt t_prompt ][ ?value t_value ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?defValue t_defaultValue ][ ?font t_font ][ ?hasVerticalScrollbar g_hasVerticalScrollbar ][ ?hasHorizontalScrollbar g_hasHorizontalScrollbar ][ ?enableWordWrap g_enableWordWrap ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ][ ?changeCB g_changeCB ][ ?nextField g_nextField ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a multiline text field entry for a form. Any input typed into this field gets converted to a single string accessible through SKILL.

functions.name: hiCreateMenu
functions.description: Returns the SKILL representation of a popup menu. Once this menu is created, you can display it with hiDisplayMenu or associate it with a window using hiSetWindowMenu.

functions.name: hiCreateMenuItem
functions.signature: hiCreateMenuItem(?name s_itemHandle?itemText t_menuItemText[ ?itemIcon g_menuIcon ][ ?callback t_itemCallback ][ ?disable g_disabled ][ ?statusTip t_statusTip ][ ?font t_font ])=> r_hiMenuItem
functions.description: Creates a menu item that can be used in any type of menu, except two-dimensional menus and simple menus.

functions.name: hiCreateOptionsForm
functions.description: Generates a form with the specified field entries, setting it to formHandle.

functions.name: hiCreateOutputStringField
functions.signature: hiCreateOutputStringField(?name s_fieldName[ ?value t_currentValue ][ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?defValue t_defaultValue ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a field that displays text. You cannot type into this field.

functions.name: hiCreatePointField
functions.signature: hiCreatePointField(?name s_fieldName[ ?value l_currentValue ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?defValue l_defaultValue ][ ?font t_font ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ][ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?nextField g_nextField ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a point field entry for a form.

functions.name: hiCreatePointListField
functions.signature: hiCreatePointListField(?name s_fieldName[ ?value l_currentValue ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?defValue l_defaultValue ][ ?font t_font ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ][ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?nextField g_nextField ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a point list field entry for a form.

functions.name: hiCreatePulldownMenu
functions.description: Creates a pulldown menu that contains text, icon, or slider menu items. s_menuHandle is the SKILL symbol set to the created menu.

functions.name: hiCreateRadioField
functions.signature: hiCreateRadioField(?name s_fieldName?choices l_radioList[ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?value t_currentSelection ][ ?defValue t_defaultSelection ][ ?itemsPerRow x_itemsPerRow ][ ?font t_font ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?callback l_radioListCallbacks ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a radio field for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateReportField
functions.signature: hiCreateReportField(?name s_fieldName[ ?title t_title ][ ?titleAlignment g_titleAlignment ][ ?headers g_headers ][ ?choices l_choices ][ ?value g_value ][ ?defValue g_defaultValue ][ ?returnPackedValue g_returnPackedValue ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?enableDeselectCB S_enableDeselectCB ][ ?doubleClickCB g_doubleClickCB ][ ?sortCallback g_sortCallback ][ ?sort l_sort ][ ?selectMode s_selectMode ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?nextField g_nextField ][ ?altRowHilight g_rowHighlight ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a report field, which you can use to display information in a complex format. For example, you can display a table with sortable columns. The items in a report field can be selected but they cannot be edited.

functions.name: hiCreateScaleField
functions.signature: hiCreateScaleField(?name s_fieldName[ ?prompt t_prompt ][ ?value x_currentValue ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?isContinuous g_isContinuous ][ ?range l_range ][ ?defValue x_defaultValue ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?font t_font ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?precision x_precision ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a scale field for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateScrollRegion
functions.signature: hiCreateScrollRegion(?name s_name[ ?fields l_fieldEntries ][ ?attachmentList l_fieldAttachments ][ ?tabOrderIsAddOrder g_tabOrderIsAddOrder ][ ?labelText t_labelText ][ ?borderWidth x_borderWidth ][ ?scrollBars g_scrollBars ][ ?rightMargin x_rightMargin ][ ?bottomMargin x_bottomMargin ][ ?help g_help ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?enabled g_enabled ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a scroll region field, which can be scrolled and can contain any type of field. A scroll region field is like a sub-form within a form.

functions.name: hiCreateSeparatorField
functions.description: Creates a separator field for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateSeparatorMenuItem
functions.description: Creates a menu separator-a horizontal line that separates menu items. This menu item is used in the l_menuItems argument of the hiCreateMenu and hiCreatePulldownMenu functions. You can use the separator menu item in more than one menu or in multiple locations in the same menu.

functions.name: hiCreateSimpleHypertextField
functions.description: Creates a simple one-line hypertext field, which displays a hyperlink to a Web page. See hiCreateHypertextField() for information on how to create a more complex hypertext field.

functions.name: hiCreateSimpleMenu
functions.description: Returns the SKILL description of a simple menu, which is a single level menu containing only text menu items, none of which invoke a submenu. Once this menu is created, you can display it with hiDisplayMenu or associate it with a window using hiSetWindowMenu.

functions.name: hiCreateSliderMenuItem
functions.signature: hiCreateSliderMenuItem(?name s_itemHandle?itemText t_menuItemText?subMenu r_pulldownMenu[ ?itemIcon l_menuIcon ][ ?disable g_disabled ][ ?statusTip t_statusTip ][ ?font t_font ])=> r_hiSliderItem
functions.description: Creates a slider menu item that is used in functions that create a menu, all menus except simple or 2D menus. Slider menu items bring up submenus when selected. They can contain text (t_menuItemText) or icon (l_menuIcon) information.

functions.name: hiCreateSpinBox
functions.signature: hiCreateSpinBox(?name s_fieldName[ ?prompt t_prompt ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?value g_value ][ ?defValue g_defaultValue ][ ?font t_fontName ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?range l_rangeOfItems ][ ?arrowOrientation g_arrowOrientation ][ ?shadowed g_shadowed ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?obeyWidth g_obeyWidth ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?wrapAround g_wraparound ][ ?justification s_justification ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a spin box field, which contains a range of items that users can cycle through. The spin box field can only contain integers. For floating point numbers, use hiCreateFloatSpinBox.

functions.name: hiCreateStackedLayout
functions.signature: hiCreateStackedLayout(s_name[ ?items l_items ][ ?frame g_frame ][ ?margins l_margins ][ ?currentIndex g_currentIndex ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?scrollable g_scrollable ])=> r_hiLayout
functions.description: Creates a stacked layout. A stacked layout only shows one of the fields at a time, which can be set using the currentIndex argument of the layout.

functions.name: hiCreateStringField
functions.signature: hiCreateStringField(?name s_fieldName[ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?value t_currentValue ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?defValue t_defaultValue ][ ?font t_font ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?modifyCallback g_modifyCallback ][ ?focusInCallback g_focusInCallback ][ ?format t_fieldFormat ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?nextField g_nextField ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a string field entry for a form. Any input typed into this field is surrounded by double quotation marks before being passed to SKILL to interpret.

functions.name: hiCreateTabField
functions.signature: hiCreateTabField(?name s_name?fields l_fieldEntries[ ?attachmentList l_fieldAttachments ][ ?tabs g_tabs ][ ?pageBase g_pageBase ][ ?value g_currentValue ][ ?defValue g_defaultValue ][ ?tabPlacement g_tabPlacement ][ ?tabOrderIsAddOrder g_tabOrderIsAddOrder ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?pageScroller g_pageScroller ][ ?notebookStyle g_notebookStyle ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?tabToolTips l_tooltip ][ ?tabLabels l_tabLabel ][ ?scrollPage l_scrollPage ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a tab field, which can have multiple pages. You can change the pages interactively by selecting the tab attached to each page, or programmatically by using the form->field->value property.

functions.name: hiCreateToggleField
functions.signature: hiCreateToggleField(?name s_fieldName?choices l_toggleList[ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?numSelect x_numSelectable ][ ?prompt t_fieldPrompt ][ ?value l_currentValues ][ ?defValue l_defaultValues ][ ?itemsPerRow x_itemsPerRow ][ ?font t_font ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?callback l_toggleListCallbacks ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a toggle field entry for a form.

functions.name: hiCreateToolbar
functions.signature: hiCreateToolbar(?name s_name[ ?title t_title ][ ?toolButtonStyle s_buttonStyle ][ ?toolTip t_toolTip ][ ?items l_toolbarItems ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?contextMenuItems l_contextMenuItems ])=> o_hiToolbar
functions.description: Creates a toolbar that you can add to windows and session windows. A toolbar is a container object that can contain combo boxes, type-in items, actions, and separators.

functions.name: hiCreateToolbarComboBox
functions.signature: hiCreateToolbarComboBox(?name s_name?items l_items[ ?prompt t_prompt ][ ?value t_value ][ ?toolTip t_tooltip ][ ?callback t_callback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?iconFile t_iconFile ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?width x_width ][ ?statusTip t_statusTip ][ ?CBOnEnter g_cbOnEnter ])=> o_comboBox
functions.description: Creates a drop-down list box item (popularly called a combo box) to be added to the toolbar created using hiCreateToolbar. The drop-down list box has a type-in field as well as a drop-down list. You can either type in a value or select an item from the list.

functions.name: hiCreateToolbarSeparator
functions.description: Creates a separator that is used to separate the items in a toolbar created using hiCreateToolbar.

functions.name: hiCreateToolbarTypein
functions.signature: hiCreateToolbarTypein(?name s_name[ ?prompt t_prompt ][ ?value t_value ][ ?tooltip t_tooltip ][ ?callback t_callback ][ ?editable g_editable ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?width x_width ][ ?statusTip t_statusTip ][ ?CBOnEnter g_cbOnEnter ])=> o_typein
functions.description: Creates a type-in field to be added to the toolbar created using hiCreateToolbar.

functions.name: hiCreateTree
functions.description: Creates a new tree or sub-tree, to which you then add items you create with the hiCreateTreeItem function. You add the tree to a tree table field created with the hiCreateTreeTable function.

functions.name: hiCreateTreeItem
functions.signature: hiCreateTreeItem(s_itemName[ g_description ][ g_itemIcon ][ g_selectionIcon ][ g_expandedIcon ][ g_expandedSelectionIcon ])=> r_treeItem / nil
functions.description: Creates a new item for a tree. Use hiTreeAppendItem or hiTreePrependItem to attach the item to a tree.

functions.name: hiCreateTreeTable
functions.signature: hiCreateTreeTable(?name s_name[ ?title t_title ][ ?choice g_choice ][ ?value g_value ][ ?defValue g_defaultValue ][ ?help g_fieldHelp ][ ?headers g_headers ][ ?sort l_sort ][ ?callback g_callback ][ ?enableDeselectCB g_enableDeselectCB ][ ?expandCallback g_expandCallback ][ ?collapseCallback g_collapseCallback ][ ?sortCallback g_sortCallback ][ ?nextField g_nextField ][ ?titleAlignment g_titleAlignment ][ ?selectMode s_selectMode ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?altRowHilight g_rowHighlight ][ ?expandCollapseOnDoubleClick g_expandCollapseOnDoubleClick ])=> r_fieldHandle
functions.description: Creates a tree table field. If you have already created a tree, you can specify it when you create the field; otherwise you can add a tree later to the field. To create a tree, use hiCreateTree and other tree table field functions.

functions.name: hiCreateTypeinMenuItem
functions.signature: hiCreateTypeinMenuItem(?name s_name[ ?itemIcon g_icon ][ ?itemText t_text ][ ?callback S_funcname ][ ?disable g_disable ][ ?statusTip t_statusTip ][ ?toolTip t_toolTip ][ ?completerType s_type ][ ?completerList l_list ])=> r_menuItem / nil
functions.description: Creates a type-in menu item that can receive user inputs. When a user types text in the type-in menu item created using this function and presses Enter, the specified callback function S_funcname is run.

functions.name: hiCreateVerticalBoxLayout
functions.signature: hiCreateVerticalBoxLayout(s_name[ ?items l_items ][ ?frame g_frame ][ ?margins l_margins ][ ?spacing g_spacing ][ ?horiz_align g_horizAlign ][ ?vert_align g_vertAlign ][ ?enabled g_enabled ][ ?invisible g_invisible ][ ?scrollable g_scrollable ])=> r_hiLayout
functions.description: Creates a vertical box layout by specifying the margins, spacing, and alignment.

functions.name: hiCreateVerticalFixedMenu
functions.description: Creates a vertical fixed menu that can be displayed in the root window. Fixed menus can no longer be displayed in application windows; use the new toolbar functions to create toolbars for windows instead.

functions.name: hiCreateWindow
functions.signature: hiCreateWindow(g_boxSpect_widgetTypet_appType[ t_help ][ g_scrollbars ][ g_form ][ l_iconPosition ])=> w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Creates, but does not display, a window of one of the following types: session, graphics, text, hypertext, html, encap, or form. This window becomes the current window.

functions.name: hiCreateWorldView
functions.description: Creates a World View assistant for your graphics window, which you can then display with hiDockWindow. World View assistant is a small window that shows you a picture of your entire design and marks the part of the design that is currently displayed in the graphics window. You can also use it to navigate the design or zoom in or out of it.

functions.name: hiDBoxCancel
functions.description: Function logged when either the Cancel or the No button is pressed on a dialog box. This function can also be called directly from SKILL to simulate pressing No or Cancel.

functions.name: hiDBoxOK
