functions.description: Sets the status tip for the specified menu item. The status tip is displayed on the status bar at the bottom of the window when the mouse hovers over the menu item.

functions.name: hiSetMenuItemText
functions.description: Changes the text associated with all instances of a specified menu item.

functions.name: hiSetMouseMoveSampleRate
functions.description: Sets the number of mouse motion events to be processed.

functions.name: hiSetMouseStopDetectTime
functions.description: Sets the stop detection time to detect if a mouse has stopped moving.

functions.name: hiSetMultiClickTime
functions.description: Sets the number of milliseconds that must elapse before a mouse click is recognized as a separate single click rather than the second click of a double click.

functions.name: hiSetProgress
functions.description: Sets the progress bar in a progress dialog box to the step you specify. Note, however, that the text above the progress bar remains the same; use hiSetProgressText to update the text or hiSetProgressAndText to update both the step and the text.

functions.name: hiSetProgressAndText
functions.description: In a progress dialog box, sets the current step of the progress bar as well as the text that is displayed above the progress bar.

functions.name: hiSetProgressBannerText
functions.description: Sets the text that is displayed on the window banner of a progress dialog box.

functions.name: hiSetProgressBar
functions.description: Sets the progress (the current step) of the progress bar in the window you specify.

functions.name: hiSetProgressButtonText
functions.description: Changes the text of the button on a progress dialog box. Progress dialog boxes, created with hiDisplayProgressBox, have one button, whose default text is Cancel.

functions.name: hiSetProgressLabel
functions.description: Sets the label of the progress bar in the specified window. An empty string removes the label.

functions.name: hiSetProgressText
functions.description: Sets the text that is displayed above the progress bar in a progress dialog box.

functions.name: hiSetProgressTotalSteps
functions.description: Sets the total number of steps on the progress bar in a progress dialog box. This function also sets the current step.

functions.name: hiSetScrollBarValue
functions.description: Sets the horizontal and vertical scroll bars in a form or scroll region field to the position you specify, therefore allowing you to display a specific part of the form or scroll region field programmatically. Use hiGetScrollBarInfo to get information about the form or scroll region field before you use this function.

functions.name: hiSetSessionFocus
functions.description: Sets the keyboard focus to a session window's active tab window or docked window when the session window becomes active. The active tab window or docked window that you specify must be part of a session window and must contain a sub-widget that is enabled, visible, and that can get focus through the Tab key. The focus is set to a sub-widget.

functions.name: hiSetShadowMode
functions.description: Controls the display of unselected objects in a graphics window. When you enable shadow mode with this function, all unselected objects are dimmed and all selected objects are displayed at full brightness in their original layer color instead of the selection color. The shadow mode setting applies to all graphics in all windows of the application, not just to the current window.

functions.name: hiSetSplashBackground
functions.description: Sets the background for an application's splash screen. If the graphic you specify has too many colors, the background is not set.

functions.name: hiSetSplashDefaultBackground
functions.description: Sets the splash screen background to the default background.

functions.name: hiSetSplashFamily
functions.description: Sets the product family name on an application's splash screen.

functions.name: hiSetSplashIcon
functions.description: Sets a new icon for an application splash screen. The icon is displayed between the product name and the license information and always be set to a 48x48 size.

functions.name: hiSetSplashLicense
functions.description: Sets the license information in an application's splash screen. You can currently set only Cadence license information.

functions.name: hiSetSplashProduct
functions.description: Sets the product name on an application's splash screen.

functions.name: hiSetStackedLayoutCurrentIndex
functions.description: Sets the index of the current top item of a valid stacked hiLayout.

functions.name: hiSetTabWindowIcon
functions.description: Sets the icon in the specified window's tab. Tabs are displayed when multiple windows are open in a session window.

functions.name: hiSetTabWindowTip
functions.description: Sets the tooltip for the specified window's tab. Tabs are displayed when multiple windows are open in a session window.

functions.name: hiSetTabWindowTitle
functions.description: Sets the title of the specified window's tab. Tabs are displayed when multiple windows are open in a session window.

functions.name: hiSetTextClass
functions.description: Sets the active selection (highlight) text class in a window.

functions.name: hiSetTextHighlightColor
functions.description: Sets the foreground and background highlight colors of a class to the specified RGB value.

functions.name: hiSetTextSelectAll
functions.description: Highlights all occurrences of a specified string and resets the cursor to the top of the file.

functions.name: hiSetTextSelection
functions.description: Highlights the next occurrence of a specified string relative to the current cursor position. If no matching string is found between the current cursor position and the end of the file, it wraps around to the beginning of the file and continues the search.

functions.name: hiSetToolbarObjName
functions.description: Sets a name for the toolbar that is used for storing window configuration information about the toolbar. Every toolbar must have a unique name that does not change. Do not use this function with toolbars provided by Cadence.

functions.name: hiSetTopListItem
functions.description: Sets the first visible item in a list box field to the specified position (x_itemPosition). A position value of 1 indicates the first item, a position value of 2 indicates the second item, and so on. A value of 0 (zero) specifies the last item in the list.

functions.name: hiSetTreeItemDescription
functions.description: Changes the item description. The description is initially set with the g_description argument of hiCreateTreeItem. To get the current description, use hiGetTreeItemDescription.

functions.name: hiSetTreeItemIcons
functions.description: Sets the following icons for a tree item: default icon, expanded icon (displayed when the item is expanded), selection icon (displayed when the item is selected), and expanded selection icon (displayed when the item is both expanded and selected).

functions.name: hiSetTypeinMenuItemCompleterList
functions.description: Replaces the list of strings that store the history of user inputs for the specified type-in menu item. This list is used to assist user inputs in the type-in menu item.

functions.name: hiSetUndoLimit
functions.description: Sets the maximum number of hiUndo commands that can be performed in sequence. Specify either 0 or 128; 0 disables the undo command and 128 sets the undo limit to 128. If you specify any number other than 0, the undo limit is 128.

functions.name: hiSetUserPreferences
functions.description: Displays the User Preferences form with the latest values.

functions.name: hiSetViewfile
functions.description: Reads a file and displays its contents in a viewfile window that has already been created.

functions.name: hiSetWinObjName
functions.description: Sets the window name which is used for storing workspace information about a dock assistant. Every dock assistant must have a unique name that does not change. Do not use this function with dock assistants provided by Cadence.

functions.name: hiSetWinStyle
functions.description: Sets the window creation style to 'default, 'interactive or 'bBox.

functions.name: hiSetWindowAtts
functions.signature: hiSetWindowAtts([ ?window w_windowId ][ ?appType t_applicationType ][ ?help t_help ][ ?scroll g_scrollbars ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Changes the application type, help string, or scroll bar attributes of a window. You must register the new application type before setting it with this function.

functions.name: hiSetWindowDefaultPrompt
functions.description: Sets the prompt for the window associated with the given window ID instead of the default SKILL prompt. The function returns either the value of the previously set prompt or nil. If you specify an empty string for t_prompt, the function resets the prompt to the default value, which is the SKILL prompt.

functions.name: hiSetWindowFocus
functions.description: Sets the focus to the window associated with the given window ID.

functions.name: hiSetWindowIcon
functions.description: Sets the icon of a window, which is displayed when the window is minimized. A session window, when minimized, displays the icon of the window that is currently active within it; if the window does not have an icon set, then the session window's icon is displayed.

functions.name: hiSetWindowMenu
functions.description: Associates the given menu with the specified window.

functions.name: hiSetWindowName
functions.description: Sets the window name, which is displayed in the window manager frame of a window. A session window displays the window name of the window that is currently active within it.

functions.name: hiShowBindKeys
functions.description: Displays the bindkeys for an application type or window in a Viewfile window.

functions.name: hiShowBindKeysByAppType
functions.description: Displays the bindkeys for an application in a Viewfile window.

functions.name: hiShowBindKeysByWindow
functions.description: Displays the bindkeys for a window in a Viewfile window.

functions.name: hiShowFieldBorders
functions.description: Displays or hides borders around form fields. Used as a debugging aid to avoid overlapping fields when laying out forms.

functions.name: hiShowListBox
functions.signature: hiShowListBox(?name s_listBoxHandle?choices lt_listItems?callback s_callback[?title t_listBoxTitle][?multipleSelect g_multiSelect][?value lt_selectedItem][?appData g_appData][?applyButton g_applyButton])=> t / nil
functions.description: Creates and displays a list box. The list box displays a list of strings. The list box can be created so that one item is selectable or multiple items are selectable. While the list box is displayed on the screen, the user may change the items in the list box, or change the item(s) selected. The list box remains on the screen until the user selects OK or Cancel. The list box is destroyed when it is removed from the screen.

functions.name: hiShowProgressBar
functions.signature: hiShowProgressBar(w_windowID[ x_totalSteps ][ x_delay ][ t_label ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Displays a progress bar in the status bar of a window, typically in the bottom-right corner. The progress bar displays the progress of a command.

functions.name: hiShowToolbar
functions.description: Displays a hidden toolbar.

functions.name: hiSleep
functions.description: The hiSleep() function is an alias for the ipcSleep function.

functions.name: hiStartGenTextIndex
functions.description: Searches the specified text string from the beginning of the file and returns the first character position of the matching text.

functions.name: hiStartLog
functions.description: Writes a transaction log to a file.

functions.name: hiStoreFormLocation
functions.description: Stores a form location coordinates so that the form can be restored later to the same position.

functions.name: hiStringToIcon
functions.description: Returns an icon description that can be used in hi functions that accept icons, such as hiCreatePulldownMenu, hiCreateMenuItem, hiCreateSliderMenuItem, hiCreateButton, hiCreateCyclicField, hiCreateLabel, and hiAddCyclicChoice.

functions.name: hiStroke
functions.description: Mouse callback that initiates a stroke command.

functions.name: hiSwapTreeItemSelectionIcons
functions.description: Swaps the item icon and expanded icon with the selection icon and expanded selection icon respectively for the specified tree item. For information about setting these icons, see hiSetTreeItemIcons.

functions.name: hiSwitchWindowType
functions.description: Switches the widget type of a window between graphics, text, or hypertext. The window must be in a session window.

functions.name: hiSync
functions.description: For programs with several GUI-related creation and deletion operations running in a loop, Qt objects deferred to be deleted later may accumulate and affect performance. This function solves this issue by forcing Qt to immediately delete these objects.

functions.name: hiSynchronize
functions.description: Flushes the event queue by calling QApplication::flush().

functions.name: hiTextDisplayString
functions.description: Displays a text string in a window.

functions.name: hiTextWidth
functions.description: Determines the width, in pixels, of a string of characters that has a specified font. Returns nil if the font type is not valid.

functions.name: hiToggleAnchorMagnifier
functions.description: Toggles the anchored state of the magnifier to anchored/un-anchored depending upon the current anchored state of the magnifier.

functions.name: hiToggleEnterForm
functions.description: Displays or removes the options form of the enterfunction in the current window.

functions.name: hiToggleMagnifier
functions.description: Changes the visibility of the magnifier to on/off depending on the current visibility setting of the magnifier.

functions.name: hiToggleMagnifierResolution
functions.description: Turns on magnifier resolution in the canvas if the canvas is not currently using magnifier resolution. Otherwise turns off magnifier resolution.

functions.name: hiTreeAppendItem
functions.description: Adds an item at the end of a tree. To add an item to the beginning of the tree, use hiTreePrependItem.

functions.name: hiTreeAppendItems
functions.description: Adds items at the end of a tree. To add items to the beginning of the tree, use hiTreePrependItems.

functions.name: hiTreePrependItem
functions.description: Adds an item to the beginning of a tree. To add an item at the end of the tree, use hiTreeAppendItem.

functions.name: hiTreePrependItems
functions.description: Adds items to the beginning of a tree. To add items at the end of the tree, use hiTreeAppendItems.

functions.name: hiTreeRemoveAllItems
functions.description: Removes all the items from a tree. To remove a single item, use hiTreeRemoveItem. To remove more than one item, use hiTreeRemoveItems.

functions.name: hiTreeRemoveItem
functions.description: Removes an item from a tree. To remove more than one item, use hiTreeRemoveItems. To remove all the items, use hiTreeRemoveAllItems.

functions.name: hiTreeRemoveItems
functions.description: Removes the specified items from a tree. To remove a single item, use hiTreeRemoveItem; to remove all items, use hiTreeRemoveAllItems.

functions.name: hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems
functions.description: Deselects all selected items in a tree table field. To deselect a single item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItem; to deselect more than one item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItems.

functions.name: hiTreeTableDeselectItem
functions.description: Deselects an item in a tree table field. To deselect more than one item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItems. To deselect all selected items in a field, use hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems.

functions.name: hiTreeTableDeselectItems
functions.description: Deselects items in a tree table field. To deselect a single item, use hiTreeTableDeselectItem; to deselect all items in a field, use hiTreeTableDeselectAllItems.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetExpandedItemCount
functions.description: Returns the number of items that are currently expanded in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetExpandedItems
functions.description: Gets a list of all the items that are currently expanded in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetItemCount
functions.description: Returns the number of items in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetItems
functions.description: Gets a list of all the items in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetSelectedItemCount
functions.description: Returns the number of items that are currently selected in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableGetSelectedItems
functions.description: Gets a list of all the items that are currently selected in a tree table field.

functions.name: hiTreeTableSelectAllItems
functions.description: Selects all items in a tree table field. This function also executes the callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiTreeTableSelectItem
functions.description: Selects an item in a tree table field. This function also executes the callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiTreeTableSelectItems
functions.description: Selects items in a tree table field. This function also executes the callback of the tree table field if you specify t as the value of the g_notify argument.

functions.name: hiUndo
functions.description: Undoes the last user command that modified the database and that has not been undone by a previous hiUndo.

functions.name: hiUndockWindow
functions.description: Undocks a dockable window from a session window. The window is floated. You can dock the window again with hiDockWindow.

functions.name: hiUnmapWindow
functions.description: Removes a window, dockable window, or session window from the screen without closing or destroying it.

functions.name: hiUnregCloseProc
functions.description: Unregisters the closing procedure for a window.

functions.name: hiUnregCurWindowTrigger
functions.description: Unregisters a SKILL function that was registered to be called whenever the current window changes.

functions.name: hiUnregZoomPanProc
functions.description: Unregisters a SKILL procedure that was registered with the hiRegZoomPanProc function and that is called whenever the user uses a zoom, pan, fit, or redraw command in a graphics window.

functions.name: hiUnselectText
functions.description: Unhighlights the next occurrence of selected text in the viewfile relative to the cursor position.

functions.name: hiUnselectTextAll
functions.description: Unselects all occurrences of the selected text that match with the specified pattern t_text and class x_class in the viewfile. If the search pattern t_text is not specified, unselects all occurrences of the selected text of all classes. If the class x_class is not specified, unselects all occurrences of the selected text that match with the specified pattern t_text. Afterwards, the cursor position is reset to the top of the file. If an empty string is passed for t_text, and x_class is specified, unselects all strings selected in that class

functions.name: hiUnselectTextByLoc
functions.description: Unhighlights selected text specified as a list of starting and ending location pairs in the given window.

functions.name: hiUnselectTextClass
functions.description: Unhighlights all occurrences of selected text belonging to the specified class.

functions.name: hiUpdate
functions.description: Updates window prompts and application-specific state variables. Especially important if an enterfunction has been canceled in a window that is not the current window.

functions.name: hiUpdateFormBlock
functions.description: Used to reset a form if you have blocked multiple updates with the hiSetFormBlock function. The functions pf hiUpdateFormBlock(r_form) is equivalent to hiSetFormBlock(r_form nil).

functions.name: hiUpdateMagOptions
functions.description: Update and display the Magnifier Options form with the magnifier values that are being used in the current window.

functions.name: hiUpdateTextSelectionColors
functions.description: Redraws all selections visible in the window and updates any colors previously reset with hiSetTextHighlightColor.

functions.name: hiUseMagnifierResolution
functions.description: Alters the movement of the cursor within the canvas.

functions.name: hiUsingMagnifierResolution
functions.description: Returns whether mouse movement in the canvas is set to behave as if the mouse is located within the magnifier.

functions.name: hiVectorPan
functions.signature: hiVectorPan([ w_window ][ l_refPt ][ l_destPt ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Scrolls the view of the design in any direction by specifying two points in user units.

functions.name: hiViewTextFile
functions.signature: hiViewTextFile(t_file?winSpec g_winspec?title g_title?appName g_appName?help g_help?iconPosition l_iconPosition?deviceMode g_deviceMode?pluginFactory g_pluginFactory?fixedFont g_fixedFont)=> w_windowId / nil
functions.description: Creates a viewfile window, inserts the menu bar, sets the window and icon names, specifies how to load the file in the window, and displays the file in the window.

functions.name: hiViewfile
functions.description: Brings up the Choose a File to View form in which you can specify a file to view and then calls the view function on the file.

functions.name: hiWinConfigModified
functions.description: Checks whether a workspace has been modified since it was last applied to the session window.

functions.name: hiWindowSaveImage
functions.signature: hiWindowSaveImage([ ?target g_target ][ ?path t_path ][ ?format t_format ][ ?toplevel g_toplevel ][ ?quality n_quality ][ ?delay n_delay ][ ?timeoutBeep g_timeoutBeep ][ ?grabFromScreen g_grabFromScreen ][ ?centralWidget g_centralWidget ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Takes a screen capture of a window, a region, or the entire screen. You can specify the object to capture either through the arguments or, in interactive mode, by selecting it with the mouse.

functions.name: hiWorldViewFit
functions.description: Fits the current canvas display area in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiWorldViewRedraw
functions.description: Redraws the current canvas display area in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiWorldViewZoomIn
functions.description: Zooms into the current canvas display area open in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiWorldViewZoomOut
functions.description: Zooms out of the current canvas display area open in the World View assistant of the specified graphics window.

functions.name: hiZoomAbsoluteScale
functions.signature: hiZoomAbsoluteScale([ w_window ][ n_scale ][ g_ignoreEFunBBox ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Zooms in or out with an absolute scale.

functions.name: hiZoomExpandAtMouse
functions.description: Zooms out by two in the specified window (or current window) expanding the zoom area in the direction of the mouse relative to the center of the window

functions.name: hiZoomExpandAtPoint
functions.description: Zooms out the image by keeping the mirror image point of l_point at the same location

functions.name: hiZoomIn
functions.description: Zooms in to a design.

functions.name: hiZoomInAtMouse
functions.description: Zooms into a window by a scale factor of 2, keeping the point beneath the mouse at its current location in the window.

functions.name: hiZoomInMagnifier
functions.description: Zooms into the picture in canvas, as opposed to the picture in the magnifier, with the current magnifier zooming factor.

functions.name: hiZoomOut
functions.description: Zoom out of a design.

functions.name: hiZoomOutAtMouse
functions.description: Zooms out of a window by a scale factor of 2, keeping the point beneath the mouse at its current location in the window.

functions.name: hiZoomOutMagnifier
functions.description: Backs out one call to the hiZoomInMagnifier command from the stack, similar to an undo action.

functions.name: hiZoomRelativeScale
functions.description: Zooms in or out with a scale relative to the current window.

functions.name: hiZoomWindowAtMouse
functions.description: Zooms in or out of a window, keeping the point beneath the mouse at its current location in the window.

functions.name: hiZoomWindowAtPoint
functions.description: Zooms in or out of a window, keeping the point you specify at its current location in the window.

functions.name: histo
functions.description: Returns a waveform that represents the statistical distribution of input data in the form of a histogram. The height of the bars (or bins) in the histogram represents the frequency of the occurrence of values within a specific period. Using the histo function, the range for capturing these frequencies can be specified through the n_min and n_max values.

functions.name: histogram2D
functions.signature: histogram2D(o_waveformx_nbins[ t_type ][ g_setAnnotation ][ g_setDensityEstimator ])=> o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Returns a waveform that represents the statistical distribution of input data in the form of a histogram. The height of the bars (or bins) in the histogram represents the frequency of the occurrence of values within a specific period.

functions.name: history
functions.description: Displays the command history. By default, it the last twenty commands are listed from the current session and the most recently terminated session. More commands can be printed by giving a number as an argument.

functions.name: hlcheck
functions.description: Sets or gets the value of the hlcheck option used in the vec_include statement in a netlist. You may use the ocnDisplay('hlcheck) command to view the current value of hlcheck in an OCEAN session associated with vector files.

functions.name: hnlAbortNetlist
functions.description: Aborts netlisting. When the formatter detects an error during netlisting, it calls this function to inform the netlister to abort netlisting. This function aborts netlisting at the next convenient point, usually after the current cell is processed.

functions.name: hnlAddExtraParameters
functions.description: Adds user-specified design variables to the OSS design variables list. For example, ADE-XL requires to add more design variables to OSS design variables list that are obtained after CDF callback evaluation.

functions.name: hnlCatIncrementalNetlistFiles
functions.description: Concatenates the list of netlist files into a single file whose file handle is given as the first parameter to this function. The second parameter is the list of files to be concatenated.

functions.name: hnlCellExtracted
functions.description: Checks if the cellview has not been modified since it was last extracted.

functions.name: hnlCellInAllCells
functions.description: Checks if the cellview argument exists as a cellview in the list of all cells. If not, this function returns nil.

functions.name: hnlCloseCellFiles
functions.description: Closes all opened files to netlist the cell from hnlCurrentCell. This function calls the hnlWriteBlockControlFile function to create the control file under the directory for hnlCurrentCell.

functions.name: hnlCloseMasterList
functions.description: Closes a list of cellviews one by one. This is the reverse function of hnlGetMasterCells.

functions.name: hnlCompletePrint
functions.description: Clears the buffers needed for the hnlPrintString function and closes the netlist file.

functions.name: hnlDeRegPostNetlistTrigger
functions.description: Deregisters a trigger, which is a user-defined SKILL procedure that has been registered using hnlRegPostNetlistTrigger.

functions.name: hnlDeRegPreNetlistTrigger
functions.description: Deregisters a trigger, which is a user-defined SKILL procedure that has been registered using hnlRegPreNetlistTrigger.

functions.name: hnlDoInstBased
functions.description: Driver for instance-based netlists. It determines the order in which most of the output functions are called. For each cellview in the schematic hierarchy that is determined by the hnlListOfAllCells variable, it sets the hnlCurrentCell global variable to the cellview to be netlisted.

functions.name: hnlDoNetBased
functions.description: The driver for net-based netlists. cellList is the list of cellviews, or macros used to generate the netlist. By default, this procedure is called by the hnlPrintNetlist function with hnlListOfAllCells as the list of cells to be netlisted.

functions.name: hnlEMHGetDigitaGlobalNets
functions.description: Returns a list of global nets found in digital design during mixed signal netlisting. This is used by the auCdl netlister to print *.GLOBAL statements for these nets in the top level netlist. This function must be called from Cadence internal formatters or ADE third-party integration formatters only when mixed signal netlisting is in progress.

functions.name: hnlEMHGetDigitalNetlistFileName
functions.description: Returns the netlist file path for digital netlist during mixed signal netlisting. This path is exported for use by formatters like auCdl to include digital netlist file name in the top-level netlist. This function must be called from Cadence internal formatters or ADE third-party integration formatters only when mixed signal netlisting is in progress.

functions.name: hnlEMHSetVerbosityLevel
functions.description: Raises the level of informative output from the mixed signal netlister. To avoid cluttering of output, the level should be set to one.

functions.name: hnlFindAllCells
functions.description: Returns a list of all the unique devices and levels of the hierarchy that need to be netlisted. This is a list of lists where the first element of each sublist is a cell.

functions.name: hnlFindAllInstInCell
functions.description: Finds all instances that can be netlisted in a cellview.

functions.name: hnlGenIncludeFile
functions.description: Creates the include file. You must define this function for a formatter that needs an include file. Use the hnlIncludeFileName variable to specify the name of the include file. Use the hnlIncludeFile variable to access the file pointer. IHNL calls the hnlGenIncludeFile function after it generates the netlist files.

functions.name: hnlGetCellHdbProps
functions.description: Returns the list of HDB properties and their values for the given cellview, when called by the formatter during netlisting. The function uses the DBId of cellview to extract the libName and cellName. It further uses the libName and cellName combination to query the HDB properties from prop.cfg property file.

functions.name: hnlGetGlobalModelMappedName
functions.description: Returns a new mapped name for a given cell, if the argument specified as cellName is not a valid name for the target tool. Otherwise, an empty string is returned.

functions.name: hnlGetGlobalNetMappedName
functions.description: Returns a new mapped name for a given global net, if the argument specified as netName is not a valid name for the target tool. Otherwise, an empty string is returned.

functions.name: hnlGetInstanceCount
functions.description: Returns the number of instances netlisted in a single session. The function does not count the instances for which the nlAction property is set to ignore. This functions helps estimate the time taken to netlist and simulate based on the number of instances in a design. For example, this function can be used to implement a progress bar. A formatter can use this function only when OSS calls formatter functions to print a netlist.

functions.name: hnlGetMappedInstNames
functions.description: Returns the list of all names mapped using the hnlMapInstName function. This function can only be called during netlisting.

functions.name: hnlGetMappedModelNames
functions.description: Returns the list of all names mapped using the hnlMapModelName function. This function can only be called during netlisting.

functions.name: hnlGetMappedNames
functions.description: Returns the list of all names mapped using the hnlMapName function. This function can only be called during netlisting.

functions.name: hnlGetMappedNetNames
functions.description: Returns the list of all names mapped using the hnlMapNetName function. This function can only be called during netlisting.

functions.name: hnlGetMasterCells
functions.description: Returns a list of cellviews of the view-switched masters for a list of instances, which are stored in the same order as the given list.

functions.name: hnlGetPrintLinePrefix
functions.description: Returns the line prefix set using hnlSetPrintLinePrefix function, which is used to print individual subcircuits during auCdl netlisting to indicate the continuation of the text on the next line, when the line exceeds the maximum character limit.

functions.name: hnlGetPropVal
functions.description: Returns the value of the property whose string name is given as the first argument. First, the property is searched for on the instance given as the third argument, and if not found there, on the cellview given as the second argument. If the property is found, the value is returned. Otherwise, nil is returned.

functions.name: hnlGetRoundProp
functions.description: Locates the property of the given name, using hnlGetPropVal, hnlCurrentMaster, and hnlCurrentInst, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest integer. If the named property is not found, nil is returned.

functions.name: hnlGetScaleCapacitance
functions.description: Locates the property of the given name, using hnlGetPropVal, hnlCurrentMaster, and hnlCurrentInst, divides the value by the value of the simCapUnit variable, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest integer. If the named property is not found, nil is returned. If simCapUnit is set to nil, the value of the property is returned, again rounded to the nearest integer.

functions.name: hnlGetScaleMarginalDelay
functions.description: Locates the property of the given name, using hnlGetPropVal, hnlCurrentMaster, and hnlCurrentInst, divides the value by the value of the simTimeUnit variable, multiplies it by the value of the simCapUnit variable, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest tenth. If the named property is not found, nil is returned. If simTimeUnit is set to nil, the value of the property is returned, again rounded to the nearest tenth.

functions.name: hnlGetScaleTimeUnit
functions.description: Locates the property of the given name, using hnlGetPropVal, hnlCurrentMaster, and hnlCurrentInst, divides the value by the value of the simTimeUnit variable, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest integer. If the named property is not found, nil is returned. If simTimeUnit is set to nil, then the value of the property is returned, again rounded to the nearest integer.

functions.name: hnlGetSimulator
functions.description: Provides a distinction between AMS and other flows. When it is called from the AMS flow, the function displays AMS as output, otherwise it behaves the same as simSimulator.

functions.name: hnlGetSourceFile
functions.description: Retreives the path of source file of the given instance or cellview as specified in the HDB (prop.cfg property file), when this function is called by the formatter during netlisting.

functions.name: hnlGetSourceFileModels
functions.description: Retreives a list of names of the netlisted cells, when this function is called by the formatter during netlisting. For the cells that have the -subckt value set using the sourcefile_opts property, the cell names in the list are replaced by the subcircuit names, for example, -subckt <name>.

functions.name: hnlGetSymbolPropVal
functions.description: Returns the value of the property whose symbol name is given as the first argument. First the property is searched on the instance given as the third argument, and if not found there, on the cellview given as the second argument. If the property is found, the value is returned; otherwise, nil is returned.

functions.name: hnlGetTermByName
functions.description: Returns the terminal ID and index corresponding to the member termname found in the specified cellview, where the ID is the first element of the list and the index is the second. If the given terminal name implies a width greater than 1, a -1 is returned as the index. If a single bit name is given, then the index returned is the index to the terminal.

functions.name: hnlGetTermNameOfSig
functions.description: Finds the names of all the terminals that the specified signal connects to. The names are the single-bit names of the bits of the terminals that connect to the signal.

functions.name: hnlHspiceInstPropVal
functions.description: This procedure prints a list of property values to the netlist.

functions.name: hnlHspicePrintInstPropEqVal
functions.description: This procedure prints a list of property values to the netlist. It is similar to the procedure hnlHspicePrintInstPropVal except that the property name and the symbol, = is included before the value.

functions.name: hnlHspicePrintInstPropVal
functions.description: This procedure returns the value of the property specified by propName if it exists on the current instance. If the value of this property has the syntax specifying an inherited value it returns the name of the property whose value is being inherited without the surrounding syntax.

functions.name: hnlHspicePrintMOSfetModel
functions.description: This function prints out the line for a MOSFET model.

functions.name: hnlHspicePrintNMOSfetElement
functions.description: This function prints out the line for a n-MOSFET model.

functions.name: hnlIfNoProcedure
functions.description: Defines procedures in HNL. By using this function, the netlister only defines a procedure if it is not already defined, thus allowing user-override of netlister functionality by loading user-supplied functions before loading the Cadence netlister.

functions.name: hnlIgnoreTerm
functions.description: Checks if the terminal argument belongs to a patchcord or to an instance whose master is not a stopping cell and does not contain any instances. This function excludes terminals attached to instances such as vdd and gnd.

functions.name: hnlInitMap
functions.description: Initializes the variables needed for name translation.

functions.name: hnlInitPrint
functions.description: Opens the netlist output file specified as the filename and sets up the information required by the hnlPrintString function.

functions.name: hnlIsAPatchCord
functions.description: Checks if the master of the given instance is a patchcord.

functions.name: hnlIsAStoppingCell
functions.description: Checks if the cellview argument is a stopping cellview. A cell is a stopping point for expansion if its viewName is in the hnlViewList switch view list as well as the hnlStopList stopping list, or if the cell has a string property nlAction with stop as its value. This function is used throughout the netlister to determine when to stop expansion and whether to output a macro reference or a reference to a primitive device.

functions.name: hnlIsCellNetlistable
functions.description: Determines if instantiation of the specified cellview can be netlisted to HNL. This procedure returns nil for a cellview that contains no connectivity and for a cellview that has the property nlAction set to the value ignore.

functions.name: hnlIsCurrentInstStopping
functions.description: Checks if the current instance, hnlCurrentInst, is a stopping instance. An instance is a stopping point for expansion if the instance master is in the instance specific stopList. An instance is also a stopping point if the instance has a string property, nlAction with stop as its value. This function is used throughout the netlister to determine when to stop expansion and whether to output a macro reference or a reference to a primitive device.

functions.name: hnlMakeNetlistFileName
functions.description: Returns the relative name of the netlist file for cellViewId. This relative name is the path in the current netlisting directory. The cellViewId must be a non-stopping cellview, which you can netlist.

functions.name: hnlMapCellModuleName
functions.description: Returns the netlist module name of the cellview, the cellViewId. It adds the <cell name><module name> mapped pair into the model section of the name map associated with the hnlCurrentCell variable. The cellViewId must be a non-stopping instance. For a design opened in the configuration view, you must specify the additional arguments.

functions.name: hnlMapCellName
functions.signature: hnlMapCellName(d_cellViewId[ t_viewList ][ t_pathName ][ t_LibName ][ t_cellName ][ t_viewName ][ t_isCellTopCell ])=> name
functions.description: Returns the netlist module name of the cellview, which is the cellViewId. It adds the <cell name><module name> mapped pair into the model section of the name map associated with the hnlCurrentCell variable. The cellViewId must be a non-stopping instance.

functions.name: hnlMapInstName
functions.description: Returns a new mapped name. The cdsName string is a mandatory parameter and the prefix string is an optional one. If the argument specified in cdsName is legal, the same name is returned. Otherwise, OSS searches for the prefix. In case, the prefix is legal, then the value of global counter, which starts with 0, is appended to the prefix. If the prefix is not legal or null, a new name using the global instance prefix and the global counter is generated. However, if both the prefix and the global instance prefix are illegal or null, then an error message is displayed.

functions.name: hnlMapModelName
functions.description: Returns a new mapped name if the argument specified as the cdsName string is not a valid name for the target simulator. Otherwise, the string is returned. The hnlMapModelFirstChar, hnlMapModelInName, hnlMaxNameLength, and simModelNamePrefix variables are used to determine the mapping of the name.

functions.name: hnlMapName
functions.description: Returns a new mapped name if the argument specified as the cdsName string is not a valid name for the target simulator. Otherwise, the cdsName string is returned.

functions.name: hnlMapNetName
functions.description: Returns a new mapped name if the argument specified as the cdsName string is not a valid name for the target simulator. Otherwise, the cdsName string is returned.

functions.name: hnlMapTermName
functions.description: Returns a new mapped name if the argument specified as the cdsName string is not a valid name for the target simulator. Otherwise, the cdsName string is returned.

functions.name: hnlMultipleCells
functions.description: Checks if the cellname argument exists for more than one cell name or cellview in the list of all cells. This function is used to detect cases of cells having the same name, but which are found in more than one location of the design hierarchy. This happens when cells with the same name are found in more than one library.

functions.name: hnlNameOfSignal
functions.description: Returns a string for the name of the signal that defines the given net-index pair. This name is considered to be the preferred name and is consistent even when called with two different nets whose ~> name field differs, but which are electrically equivalent at this level of the design hierarchy. If the netIndex is not in the range of bits for the given net, nil is returned.

functions.name: hnlNetNameOnTerm
functions.description: Returns the signal name of the net attached to the given bit of the terminal of the given name on the current instance being expanded. This function guarantees the same name is returned even if the net is aliased, and this function is later called with a terminal attached to one of the aliases of this net.

functions.name: hnlNetNameOnTermName
functions.description: Returns the signal name of the net attached to the terminal of the given name on the current instance being expanded. This function guarantees the same name is returned even if the net is aliased, and this function is later called with a terminal attached to one of the aliases of this net.

functions.name: hnlNmpSetNameSpaces
functions.description: Specifies the nmp namespaces to perform namespace mapping during OSS netlisting. The function accepts Cadence nmp supported namespaces as arguments. You can run the %> nmp getSpaceNames command to display a list of valid namespaces.

functions.name: hnlOpenTopCell
functions.description: Opens the top-level cellview. If the lib/cell/view is an HDB config, then open the config before opening the top-level cellview.

functions.name: hnlPcellIsParamOverridden
functions.description: Finds if the Pcell parameter of a master is overridden at the instance.

functions.name: hnlPostNetlistTriggerList
functions.description: Returns the list of functions registered through hnlRegPostNetlistTrigger.

functions.name: hnlPreNetlistTriggerList
functions.description: Returns the list of functions registered through hnlRegPreNetlistTrigger.

functions.name: hnlPrintDevices
functions.description: Sets up the global variables needed by the output functions to output the connectivity for a device and then calls the hnlPrintInst formatter function to print the connectivity for each iteration of each instance in the current cellview being netlisted. The current cellview is determined by the value of the hnlCurrentCell global variable. The global variables set up by this function, which can be used by the formatter function, are as follows:

functions.name: hnlPrintMessage
functions.description: Prints the text argument to the stdout port if executed in the Cadence non-graphical environment. If the function is called from within the Cadence graphics environment, the output is written to the CIW window.

functions.name: hnlPrintNetlist
functions.description: Prints the netlist header, then calls a function to output the connectivity for the netlist, and after that, prints the netlist footer. At this point, all cells are expected to be bound. Error detection for binding is done by the traversal functions.

functions.name: hnlPrintSignal
functions.description: Finds and directs the netlisting of all signals in hnlCurrentCell. It processes each signal and sets up the needed variables for use later. It is responsible for calling the hnlPrintSignalHeader, hnlPrintInst, and hnlPrintSignalFooter functions.

functions.name: hnlPrintString
functions.description: Prints the SKILL string text argument to the netlist file.

functions.name: hnlRegPostNetlistTrigger
functions.description: Registers a trigger, which is a user-defined SKILL procedure that is called after netlist generation.

functions.name: hnlRegPreNetlistTrigger
functions.description: Registers a trigger, which is a user-defined SKILL procedure that is called before the netlist generation.

functions.name: hnlRunNetlister
functions.description: Runs the hierarchical netlister and is the entry point for HNL.

functions.name: hnlRunPinChecker
functions.signature: hnlRunPinChecker(t_libt_cellt_view[ ?checkAms { t | nil } ][ ?useHDLPackageSettings { t | nil } ][ ?compilerOptionFile t_compilerOptionFile ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Runs the Pin Checker tool from the SKILL interface without launching Virtuoso or the Hierarchy Editor. This is especially helpful when you want to automate the launch of Pin Checker functionality before netlisting or running any simulations.

functions.name: hnlScaleCapacitance
functions.description: Accepts the given value as an argument, divides it by the value of the simCapUnit variable, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest integer. If simCapUnit isset to nil, then the value of the property is returned, again rounded to the nearest integer. The property name given as the second argument is used for error messages if the value does not evaluate to a number.

functions.name: hnlScaleMarginalDelay
functions.description: Accepts the value given as argument, divides the value by the value of the simTimeUnit variable, multiplies it by the value of the simCapUnit variable, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest tenth. If the named property is not found, nil is returned. If simTimeUnit is set to nil or simCapUnitis set to nil, the value of the property is returned, again rounded to the nearest tenth. The property name given as the second argument is used for error messages if the value does not evaluate to a number.

functions.name: hnlScaleTimeUnit
functions.description: Accepts the value given as argument, divides it by the value of the simTimeUnit variable, and then returns the result rounded to the nearest integer. If simTimeUnit is set to nil, the value of the property is returned, again rounded to the nearest integer. The property name given as the second argument is used for error messages if the value does not evaluate to a number. If the property is of the string type, the property value is evaluated before it is scaled.

functions.name: hnlSetCellFiles
functions.description: Opens all the files associated with hnlCurrentCell and reinitializes name-mapping functions.

functions.name: hnlSetDef
functions.description: Sets variables in HNL. By using this function, the netlister only sets sVariable if it is not already set, or the symbol sVariable evaluates to null, thus allowing user-override of netlister variables by loading user-supplied defaults before loading the Cadence netlister.

functions.name: hnlSetMappingType
functions.description: Sets namespace mapping type for nets, terminals, globals, and models to tabularOnly, nmpOnly, or nmpWithTabular.

functions.name: hnlSetPrintLinePrefix
functions.description: Registers the line prefix to be used when printing individual subcircuits during auCdl netlisting to indicate the continuation of the text on the next line, when the line length exceeds the limit set by the HNL global variable hnlSoftLineLength.

functions.name: hnlSetPseudoTermDir
functions.description: Sets the direction of pseudo ports, which are created to propagate inherited connections from a cellview to upper levels in the hierarchy. OSS-based formatter calls this function to set the direction of pseudo ports. If the formatter does not call it, you can specify a statement to call the function in the .simrc file.

functions.name: hnlSetVars
functions.description: Sets all global-required variables for netlisting. Depending on the target simulator, the required netlist formatting functions are loaded.

functions.name: hnlSortTerms
functions.description: Determines net order in the sorted lists of net names. It takes as argument two terminals and does a comparison by the name field. It is used as argument to the sort SKILL function.

functions.name: hnlSortTermsToNets
functions.description: Returns a list of lists by accepting a list of terminals as argument. The first element in each list is the original terminal, the second element is the name of the net attached to that terminal. The list is sorted alphanumerically by the name of the terminal attached to the net.

functions.name: hnlStartNetlist
functions.description: Opens the output files.

functions.name: hnlStopNetlist
functions.description: Cleans up after netlisting, closes open files, closes all open cellviews, and resets all global variables to nil.

functions.name: hnlStringToList
functions.description: Accepts a string of white-space-separated strings, and returns a list of strings, that is, the string - silos schematic - returns the list (silos schematic).

functions.name: hnlVerilogPrintCmos
functions.description: Used by netlister to print cmos, rcmos gates.

functions.name: hnlVerilogPrintNmosPmos
functions.description: Used by netlister to print pmos, rpmos, nmos, or rnmos gates.

functions.name: hnlWriteBlockControlFile
functions.signature: hnlWriteBlockControlFile(d_cellView[ t_viewList ][ t_pathName ][ t_LibName ][ t_cellName ][ t_viewName ][ t_isCellTopCell ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Creates the control file for the cellview. The control file records information for subsequent IHNL runs. The hnlCloseCellFiles function calls the hnlWriteBlockControlFile function.

functions.name: hnlWriteMap
functions.description: Saves the name map tables in a file specified in an earlier call to the hnlInitMap function. This function takes no arguments.

functions.name: hnllsCVInUserStopCVList
functions.description: Determines whether a cellview, which is present in hnlUerStopCVList, is considered a primitive or a stop view while netlisting.

functions.name: hostMode
functions.description: Sets the simulation host mode.

functions.name: hostName
functions.description: Specifies the name of the remote host.

functions.name: hsmDeselect
functions.signature: hsmDeselect([ ?type d_type ][ ?path g_path ][ ?name g_name ][ ?spec l_spec ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Deselects named objects in the design hierarchy.

functions.name: hsmGetSelectedSet
functions.signature: hsmGetSelectedSet([ ?top g_top ][ ?type d_type ][ ?pathStyle g_pathStyle ][ ?includeExtra g_includeExtra ][ ?cellview d_cellview ][ ?path g_path ])=> list / nil
functions.description: Gets the hierarchical selected set.

functions.name: hsmSelect
functions.signature: hsmSelect([ ?type d_type ][ ?path g_path ][ ?name g_name ][ ?spec l_spec ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Selects named objects in the design hierarchy.

functions.name: i
functions.description: Returns the current through the specified component.

functions.name: iagCreateMenuItem
functions.description: Creates a custom menu item with the user-specified name and adds it to the integrated Abstract Generator. The menu is created if it is not already available, and the menu item is added under it. Function name is the callback procedure for the menu item.

functions.name: iagGenAbstract
functions.description: Runs Integrated Abstract Generator on the specified cellviews with the given settings.

functions.name: ic
functions.signature: ic(t_netName1 f_value1 ... [ t_netNameN f_valueN ])=> undefined / nil
functions.description: Sets initial conditions on nets in a transient analysis.

functions.name: iccIsConnected
functions.description: Indicates if a connection from the Virtuoso Studio Design Environment to the router has been established.

functions.name: iccSendCommand
functions.description: Sends a command to the router command line interpreter.

functions.name: iccSendSkillCommand
functions.description: Sends a SKILL command to the router.

functions.name: iclicCheckOutAndLock
functions.description: Checks out the specified layout license, layout option license, or an appropriate higher-tier license and locks it after successful checkout.

functions.name: if
functions.signature: if(g_conditiong_thenExpression[ g_elseExpression ])=> g_resultif(g_conditionthen g_thenExpr1 ...[ else g_elseExpr1 ... ])=> g_result
functions.description: Evaluates g_condition, typically a relational expression, and runs g_thenExpression if the condition is true (that is, its value is non-nil); otherwise, runs g_elseExpression.

functions.name: ifreq
functions.description: Returns the current of the terminal at a specified frequency or at all frequencies in the frequency domain.

functions.name: ih
functions.description: Returns the current of the terminal at a specified harmonic or at all harmonics in the frequency domain.

functions.name: iim
functions.description: Aliased to imag(i()). Gets the imaginary part of a complex number representing the AC current through a component.

functions.name: iinteg
functions.description: Computes the indefinite integral of a waveform with respect to the X-axis variable.

functions.name: ilAddTopLevelErrorHandler
functions.description: Registers a new top-level error-handler. This error-handler is called after stacktrace, when an error occurs. If an error-handler already exists, the function displays a warning message.

functions.name: ilArgMatchesSpecializer
functions.description: Determines whether a argument passed to the generic function at run time matches a particular specializer class, so that it then knows which method should be called.

functions.name: ilDebugCountLevels
functions.description: Returns the number of top-level debug and error frames present in the SKILL stack if SKILL is in breakpoint or error top level. Otherwise, the function returns 1.

functions.name: ilEquivalentSpecializers
functions.description: Defines a method to check if two specializers are equal. This is required during method redefinition.

functions.name: ilGenerateSpecializer
functions.description: Returns a SKILL expression that makes an instance of the given specializer class and optionally set the slots. In the generated SKILL expression, l_argList can be used to initialize the slots.

functions.name: ilGetGFbyClass
functions.description: Returns a list of generic functions specializing on a given class.

functions.name: ilGetIdeSessionWindow
functions.description: Returns the SKILL IDE session window ID. If g_force is set to a value other than nil, the function creates an IDE window and displays it on the screen.

functions.name: ilGetTCovFiles
functions.description: Returns the list of files processed when you run an application in test coverage mode using the command line option -ilTCov <fileList>.

functions.name: ilMergeTCovData
functions.description: Merges tCov files from several directories and stores them in a single directory.

functions.name: ilRemoveMethod
functions.description: Removes a given method from a generic function.

functions.name: ilRemoveTopLevelErrorHandler
functions.description: Unregisters the top-level error handler previously registered by the ilAddTopLevelErrorHandler function.

functions.name: ilSlotBoundp
functions.description: Checks if a named slot is bound (has been assigned a value) to an instance.

functions.name: ilSpecMoreSpecificp
functions.description: Checks if spec1 is more specific than spec2. You need to define all required ilSpecMoreSpecificp methods for all existing custom specializers (so that the system can find a method to compare any pair of custom specializers).

functions.name: ilToolBox
functions.description: Brings up the SKILL Development toolbox, which lets you debug SKILL programs using a form-based graphical user interface.

functions.name: ilgAddRecentFiles
functions.description: Adds the files listed in l_fileList to the SKILL IDE File menu.

functions.name: ilgAppendText
functions.description: Inserts text into the SKILL IDE editor window at the current cursor location.

functions.name: ilgCopy
functions.description: Copies the selected text into public text buffer. This function does not work on read-only files.

functions.name: ilgCut
functions.description: Cuts and pastes the selected text into public text buffer. This function does not work on read-only files.

functions.name: ilgFindIdent
functions.description: Returns the nearest identifiers from a given opening parenthesis location '(' in the SKILL IDE editor tab.

functions.name: ilgFindParenthesis
functions.signature: ilgFindParenthesis(x_columnx_row[ ?level S_level ][ ?direction S_direction ][ ?tab w_tab ])=> l_coord / nil
functions.description: Returns the closest parenthesis in a file currently open in the SKILL IDE editor.

functions.name: ilgFoldLine
functions.description: Folds a document block in SKILL IDE at (x_column x_row) where (x_column x_row) is the location of an opening parenthesis. If this function is called without arguments, the current cursor location is used for computing (x_column x_row).

functions.name: ilgGetCursorLocation
functions.description: Returns the location of the cursor in the SKILL IDE editor window.

functions.name: ilgGetEditLock
functions.description: Returns the read-only property for a SKILL IDE editor window.

functions.name: ilgGetHighlight
functions.description: Returns the list of highlight IDs for the text highlighted in the SKILL IDE editor window.

functions.name: ilgGetSelectedLocation
functions.description: Returns the location coordinates of the current selection in the SKILL IDE editor window.

functions.name: ilgGetText
functions.description: Returns the text between l_location_begin and l_location_end. If these locations are not provided, the entire text in the SKILL IDE editor window is returned.

functions.name: ilgInvokeIDE
functions.description: Displays the SKILL IDE main window.

functions.name: ilgLastDir
functions.description: Returns the directory path of the file currently open in SKILL IDE.

functions.name: ilgPaste
functions.description: Pastes the text from the clipboard/buffer to the cursor location in the SKILL IDE editor window. This function does not work on read-only files.

functions.name: ilgPositionInComment
functions.description: Checks if the specified coordinates (x_column x_row) fall within a comments block in the SKILL IDE document.

functions.name: ilgRegisterSelectionCB
functions.description: Registers a SKILL callback for SKILL IDE, which is called when some text is selected in the SKILL IDE editor window.

functions.name: ilgResetErrorMarker
functions.description: Clears the error marker that was set by ilgSetErrorMarker() on line x_line in the SKILL IDE editor window.

functions.name: ilgResetHighlight
functions.description: Resets a specified highlight in a SKILL IDE document between location l_location_begin and l_location_end.

functions.name: ilgResetWarningMarker
functions.description: Clears the warning marker that was set by ilgSetWarningMarker() on line x_line in the SKILL IDE editor window.

functions.name: ilgRunSKILLIDE
functions.description: Launches SKILL IDE and opens the files listed in lt_fileList.

functions.name: ilgScrollToLocation
functions.description: Scrolls to the specified location in the specified SKILL IDE editor window or tab.

functions.name: ilgSearchText
functions.signature: ilgSearchText(t_text[ ?loc l_location ][ ?direction s_direction ][ w_tab ])=> l_location / nil
functions.description: Searches the specified text in a SKILL IDE document.

functions.name: ilgSelectText
functions.description: Selects the text between location l_location_begin and l_location_end in the SKILL IDE editor window.

functions.name: ilgSetColor
functions.description: Sets a custom color for the given SKILL IDE GUI control.

functions.name: ilgSetCursorLocation
functions.description: Sets the cursor location in a SKILL IDE document.

functions.name: ilgSetEditLock
functions.description: Changes the read-only property for a SKILL IDE editor window.

functions.name: ilgSetErrorMarker
functions.description: Sets the error marker with the pop-up description t_description on line x_line of the SKILL IDE editor window.

functions.name: ilgSetHighlight
functions.description: Highlights the area within l_location_begin and l_location_end in the color specified by t_color.

functions.name: ilgSetWarningMarker
functions.description: Sets the warning marker with pop-up description t_description on line x_line of the SKILL IDE editor window.

functions.name: ilgUnfoldLine
functions.description: This function unfolds a document block in SKILL IDE at position (x_column x_row), if it was folded. Here (x_column x_row) is the location of an opening parenthesis. If this function is called without arguments, the current cursor location is used for computing (x_column x_row).

functions.name: ilgUnregisterSelectionCB
functions.description: Unregisters a selection callback that was previously registered using ilgRegisterSelectionCB.

functions.name: im
functions.description: Aliased to mag(i()). Gets the magnitude of the AC current through a component.

functions.name: imag
functions.signature: imag({ o_waveform | n_input })=> o_waveformImag / n_numberImag / nil
functions.description: Returns the imaginary part of a waveform representing a complex number or returns the imaginary part of a complex number.

functions.name: impHdlDisplay
functions.description: Displays the Verilog In form. Alternatively, in the CIW, choose File - Import - Verilog to open the Verilog In form.

functions.name: importSkillVar
functions.description: (SKILL++ mode) Tells the compiler that the given variable names should be treated as SKILL global variables in SKILL++ code.

functions.name: importSymbol
functions.description: Imports symbols into the given namespace. By default, this function imports into the IL (or default) namespace.

functions.name: inNext
functions.description: Returns t if the function is called in the expression that is executed in the debugged code on the next() SKILL function.

functions.name: inScheme
functions.description: Evaluates a form as top-level SKILL++ code, disregarding the surrounding evaluation context.

functions.name: inSkill
functions.description: Evaluates a form as top-level SKILL code, disregarding the surrounding evaluation context.

functions.name: inStepOut
functions.description: Returns t if the function is called in the stepout() SKILL function.

functions.name: include
functions.description: Loads the file with name t_file in SKILL regardless of any errors in the file.

functions.name: includeFile
functions.description: Includes the specified file in the final netlist of the simulator for the current session.

functions.name: index
functions.description: Returns a string consisting of the remainder of string1 beginning with the first occurrence of string2.

functions.name: infile
functions.description: Opens an input port ready to read a file.

functions.name: info
functions.description: Prints the formatted output to poport according to the specification.

functions.name: initializeInstance
functions.signature: initializeInstance(g_instance[ u_?initArg1 value1 ][ u_?initArg2 value2 ]...)=> t
functions.description: Initializes the newly created instance of a class. The initializeInstance is a generic function which is called by the makeInstance function. Methods can be defined for a particular class to allow complex initialization to be performed on the object.

functions.name: inl
functions.signature: inl(o_dacSignalo_sample | o_pointList | n_interval[ ?mode t_mode ][ ?threshold n_threshold ][ ?crossType t_crossType ][ ?delay f_delay ][ ?units x_units ][ ?nbsamples n_nbsamples ])=> n_inl / nil
functions.description: Computes the integral non-linearity of a transient simple or parametric waveform.

functions.name: inportp
functions.description: Checks if an object is an input port.

functions.name: installDebugger
functions.description: Installs the SKILL debugger as the error handler so that the debugger is entered automatically upon error.

functions.name: instring
functions.description: Opens a string for reading, just as infile would open a file.

functions.name: int
functions.description: Returns the largest integer not larger than the given argument.

functions.name: intToChar
functions.description: Returns the single-character symbol whose ASCII code is the given integer value.

functions.name: integ
functions.signature: integ(o_waveform[ n_intial_limit , n_final_limit ])=> o_waveform / n_value / nil
functions.description: Computes the definite integral of the waveform with respect to a range specified on the X-axis of the waveform. The result is the value of the area under the curve over the range specified on the X-axis.

functions.name: integerp
functions.description: Checks if an object is an integer. This function is the same as fixp.

functions.name: intersect
functions.description: Returns a waveform containing the points of intersection for two waveforms passed as arguments.

functions.name: ip
functions.description: Aliased to phase(i()). Gets the phase of the AC current through a component.

functions.name: ip3Plot
functions.description: Plots the IP3 curves.

functions.name: ipcActivateBatch
functions.description: Switches a child process to batch mode.

functions.name: ipcActivateMessages
functions.description: Switches a child process into interactive mode. In interactive mode, output from the child is written to a log file and is passed on to the parent process.

functions.name: ipcBatchProcess
functions.description: Invokes a process to execute batch commands. The child process in this case is a batch process that does not communicate with the parent process.

functions.name: ipcBeginProcess
functions.signature: ipcBeginProcess(t_command[ t_hostName ][ tsu_dataHandler ][ tsu_errHandler ][ tsu_postFunc ][ t_logFile ])=> o_childId
functions.description: Invokes a process to execute a command or sequence of commands specified.

functions.name: ipcCloseProcess
functions.description: Closes the input channel of the child process.

functions.name: ipcContProcess
functions.description: Causes a suspended child process to resume executing. This is equivalent to sending a UNIX CONT signal.

functions.name: ipcGetExitStatus
functions.description: Returns the exit value of the child process.

functions.name: ipcGetPid
functions.description: Returns the runtime process identification number of the process executing this function.

functions.name: ipcGetPriority
functions.description: Gets the current default priority. If a child process handle is given, ipcGetPriority returns the priority under which the relevant child process was invoked.

functions.name: ipcIsActiveProcess
functions.description: Determines if a child process is active; that is, not stopped.

functions.name: ipcIsAliveProcess
functions.description: Checks if a child process is still alive.

functions.name: ipcKillAllProcesses
functions.description: Kills every process initiated by the parent through one of the ipcBeginProcess class of functions.

functions.name: ipcKillProcess
functions.description: Kills the process identified by o_childId. This call results in a UNIX SIGKILL signal being sent to the child process.

functions.name: ipcReadProcess
functions.description: Reads data from the child process stdout channel, allowing the developer to specify a time, in seconds, beyond which the read operation must not block. It only reads 4096 bytes for each call.

functions.name: ipcSetPriority
functions.description: Sets the priority value for child processes. All processes spawned after this call run at the priority offset to x_priorityChange.

functions.name: ipcSignalProcess
functions.description: Sends the specified POSIX signal to the specified UNIX/Linux child process.

functions.name: ipcSkillProcess

functions.name: ipcSleep
functions.description: Causes the parent process to be delayed for the given number of seconds.

functions.name: ipcSleepMilli
functions.description: Causes the parent process to be delayed for the given number of milliseconds. Use the otherwise identical ipcSleep function to specify the delay in seconds.

functions.name: ipcSoftInterrupt
functions.description: Equivalent to executing the UNIX kill -2 command. If the child process is active, it is sent a soft interrupt. The child is responsible for catching the signal.

functions.name: ipcStopProcess
functions.description: Causes the child process to suspend its execution. This is equivalent to sending a STOP signal through the UNIX kill command.

functions.name: ipcWait
functions.description: Causes the parent process to suspend until the child terminates.

functions.name: ipcWaitForProcess
functions.description: Causes the parent process to suspend until the child process is alive and ready for communication.

functions.name: ipcWriteProcess
functions.description: Writes data to the stdin port of the child process.
