functions.name: map
functions.description: Applies the given function to successive sublists of the argument lists and returns the first argument list. All of the lists should have the same length. This function is not the same as the standard Scheme map function. To get the behavior of the standard Scheme map function, use mapcar instead. This function is usually used for its side effects, not its return value (see mapc).

functions.name: mapc
functions.description: Applies a function to successive elements of the argument lists and returns the first argument list. All of the lists should have the same length. mapc returns l_arg1.

functions.name: mapcan
functions.description: Applies a function to successive elements of the argument lists and returns the result of appending these intermediate results. All of the lists should have the same length.

functions.name: mapcar
functions.description: Applies a function to successive elements of the argument lists and returns the list of the corresponding results.

functions.name: mapcon
functions.description: Applies the function u_func to successive sublists of the lists and returns a concatenated list.

functions.name: mapinto
functions.description: Applies g_function to the elements of l_sequences and destructively modifies the l_resultSequence. The first argument is a sequence that receives the results of the mapping. If l_resultSequence and the other argument sequences are not all of the same length, the mapping stops when the shortest of l_resultSequence or l_sequences is exhausted.

functions.name: maplist
functions.description: Applies a function to successive sublists of the argument lists and returns a list of the corresponding results. All of the lists should have the same length.

functions.name: max
functions.description: Returns the maximum of the values passed in. Requires a minimum of two arguments.

functions.name: mbGetAction
functions.description: Retrieves an action from the menu builder data structure.

functions.name: mbRegisterAction
functions.signature: mbRegisterAction(t_viewTypet_uniqueIdt_namet_callbackt_enableCB[ ?iconFile g_iconFile ][ ?icon g_icon ][ ?checkable g_checkable ][ ?checkedCB t_checkedCB ])=> o_action / nil
functions.description: Creates an action and registers it with the menu builder for future retrieval and use within menus. This action will appear only when mbSetContextData is used to set its visibility location.

functions.name: mbRegisterCustomMenu
functions.description: Registers a custom menu with the menu builder for future retrieval and use within menus. A custom menu item is a single or slider menu that is built using the hi function calls, independently of the menu builder. The t_customCB argument is used to specify the function that is responsible for building and returning the menu item. The menu will display only when the mbSetContextData function is called.

functions.name: mbRegisterHierMenu
functions.description: Registers a hierarchical menu with the menu builder for future retrieval and use within menus.

functions.name: mbRegisterMenuItem
functions.description: Registers a menu item with the menu builder that has been defined using the older menu creation syntax. mbSetContextData needs to be called before the menu item is visible.

functions.name: mbSetContextData
functions.description: Sets various attributes to determine the menus with which the registered action is to be associated.

functions.name: mbUnregisterAction
functions.signature: mbUnregisterAction(t_name[ ?objType t_objType ][ ?viewType t_viewType ][ ?silent g_silent ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Removes the provided menu item from the RMB menu. The optional arguments can be used to limit the removal of a menu item to specific object types or view types for which it is registered.

functions.name: measureAcross
functions.description: Computes the given calculator expression across the parameters provided in the parameter list. Use this function only when you are creating expressions for outputs that can be evaluated across any dimension. These expressions have their eval type as any. If you specify this expression for other eval types, the parameter list is ignored.

functions.name: measureTime
functions.description: Measures the time needed to evaluate an expression and returns a list with performance data (n_utime, n_stime, n_clockTime, and x_pageFaults) for the executed expressions. This is a syntax form.

functions.name: member, memq, memv
functions.description: Returns the largest sublist of l_list whose first element is g_obj or checks whether the key g_obj exists in the association table. For comparison, member uses the equal function, memq uses the eq function, and memv uses eqv.

functions.name: memoryAllocated
functions.description: Returns the amount of memory allocated by a process. The returned value is an approximation in megabytes and might not include the memory that has been allocated, but the amount that is unused.

functions.name: menuTrigger
functions.description: The menu trigger is called when an application is about to be installed as the current application in a window. At the time the menu trigger is called, all other triggers have already been called, and the window is about to be displayed (or if the window was a previously existing window, about to be refreshed).

functions.name: mgAbutAllCB
functions.description: Abuts all currently selected instances.

functions.name: mgAbutCB
functions.description: Attempts to abut the selected instances in the Modgen currently being edited.

functions.name: mgAddBodyContact
functions.description: Adds a body contact on the specified side to the selected instances inside a Modgen. Side can be one of left, right, top, or bottom.

functions.name: mgAddCopyDummies
functions.description: Creates copies of the specified Modgen dummy and places them on the t_sideString side of the instance.

functions.name: mgAddDummyBottomCB
functions.description: Adds dummy devices to the bottom of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyLeftCB
functions.description: Adds dummy devices to the left side of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyRCBottomCB
functions.description: Adds a complete row of dummy devices to the bottom of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyRCLeftCB
functions.description: Adds a complete row of dummy devices to the left of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyRCRightCB
functions.description: Adds a complete row of dummy devices to the right of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyRCTopCB
functions.description: Adds a complete row of dummy devices to the top of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyRightCB
functions.description: Adds dummy devices to the right side of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddDummyTopCB
functions.description: Adds dummy devices to the top of the selected instances.

functions.name: mgAddEmptyRCCB
functions.description: Adds an empty row or column to the specified side of a selected instance. To add empty row or column only one instance should be selected.

functions.name: mgAddGuardRingCB
functions.description: Displays the Guard Ring Options form for creating and modifying the guard ring for the current Modgen.

functions.name: mgAddShapeToTopo
functions.description: Adds a user-generated shape, such as a rectangle, to a topology group, usually a topological strap.

functions.name: mgAddTopologyToModgen
functions.description: Adds the specified topology object to the specified Modgen.

functions.name: mgCreateMatchGroupInModgen
functions.description: Creates a matchGroup in the specified Modgen storage.

functions.name: mgCreateModgenAsLayout
functions.description: Creates a Modgen from the list of specified instances and keeps the relative instance locations inside the Modgen, as similar as possible to the original instances in the layout. If instance list is not specified, the selected instances from the cellview are used.

functions.name: mgCreateModgenConstraintAsLayout
functions.description: Creates a Modgen constraint that uses the current layout to drive the initial Modgen constraint and row/column assignments.

functions.name: mgCreateOrEdit
functions.description: Opens the Modgen editor to create a new Modgen or to edit parameters of an existing Modgen. After making edits, the Modgen constraint is updated. If the source is a layout cellview, then the Modgen layout, the associated geometry, and the associated database objects are updated.

functions.name: mgDeleteAllBodyContacts
functions.description: Deletes all body contacts of the Modgen when the current window is the Modgen edit window.

functions.name: mgDeleteAllDummies
functions.description: Deletes all dummies from the specified Modgen.

functions.name: mgDeleteAllDummyRowColumnCB
functions.description: Deletes all dummy rows and columns of the Modgen when the current window is the Modgen Editing window.

functions.name: mgDeleteAllEmptyRowColumnCB
functions.description: Deletes all empty rows and columns of the Modgen when the current window is the Modgen Editing window.

functions.name: mgDeleteCB
functions.description: Deletes the selected dummy devices or body contacts.

functions.name: mgDeleteEmptyRowColumnCB
functions.description: Interactively deletes an empty row or column in Modgen Editor.

functions.name: mgDestroyMatchGroupOnObject
functions.description: Destroys the matchGroups that include the specified database object.

functions.name: mgEditGuardRingCB
functions.description: Displays the Guard Ring Options form for creating and modifying the guard ring for the current Modgen.

functions.name: mgEvalInBackgroundModgen
functions.description: Creates a Modgen scratch cellview for the specified schematic Modgen constraint, evaluates the specified user callback in the Modgen context, and then closes and deletes the scratch cellview.

functions.name: mgExecNoConObs
functions.description: Disables the Modgen constraint observer and evaluates the expressions in the specified sequence. Next, the function updates the constraint with any changes encountered while evaluating the expressions. After the process is complete, the Modgen constraint observer is re-enabled. This function helps change geometries or parameters of a Modgen or its instances without requiring the Modgen to enforce any consistency constraints on the resulting geometries. For example, increasing the numRows Modgen parameter using this function will cause the Modgen to have more rows, but will not rearrange the Modgen instances to fit in the new number of rows. This function is a defmacro.

functions.name: mgExitCB
functions.description: Closes the Modgen editing environment.

functions.name: mgFGREnterHandEdit
functions.description: Enters the hand edit mode for the fluid guard rings in the specified Modgen. In this mode, the fluid guard rings are not regenerated each time the Modgen is updated. Therefore, all customizations remain. The guard rings that are not edited in the hand edit mode are regenerated, and all manual edits are lost. Use mgFGRExitHandEdit to exit the hand edit mode.

functions.name: mgFGRExitHandEdit
functions.description: Exits the hand edit mode for the fluid guard rings in the specified Modgen. Unlike the hand edit mode, the fluid guard rings will now be regenerated each time the Modgen is updated. To enter the hand edit mode, use mgFGREnterHandEdit.

functions.name: mgFGRIsHandEdit
functions.description: Checks the status of the hand edit mode of the fluid guard rings in the specified Modgen.

functions.name: mgFlattenModgens
functions.description: Flattens the specified Modgens in the specified cellview. When a Modgen is flattened, its constraint is removed, it is ungrouped, and all geometry created by it remains ungrouped in the layout cellview.

functions.name: mgFlipHorizontalCB
functions.description: Horizontally flips the selected instance. To flip an instance, at least one instance should be selected. After you flip the instance, the orientation of the selected instance changes to reflect the flip.

functions.name: mgFlipVerticalCB
functions.description: Vertically flips the selected instance. To flip an instance, at least one instance should be selected. After you flip the instance, the orientation of the selected instance changes to reflect the flip.

functions.name: mgGetBoxLPPArea
functions.description: Calculates the total area on the specified layer within the specified bounding box. If you specify a Modgen ID as the l_bBox parameter, then the total Modgen area is calculated and displayed.

functions.name: mgGetChannelTrunks
functions.description: Returns a list of topology trunks that belong to the specified channel.

functions.name: mgGetColumnRoutingChannelWidth
functions.description: Returns the routing channel width of the specified Modgen column.

functions.name: mgGetConstraintFromFG
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the Modgen constraint for the specified Modgen figGroup ID.

functions.name: mgGetDummyRefDirectionParams
functions.signature: mgGetDummyRefDirectionParams([ t_libName ][ t_cellName ][ t_paramName ])=> l_registeredDummyDirectionalParams / nil
functions.description: Returns the first set of registered Modgen dummy directional parameters that match the specified library, cell, and parameter names.

functions.name: mgGetGuardRingConnectObject
functions.description: Returns the guard ring object for the topology connection for the specified Modgen.

functions.name: mgGetIsLocalTrunk
functions.description: Checks whether the specified trunk is local. Trunks inside a Modgen are called local trunks. These trunks can be connected only within the same Modgen, and not from outside the Modgen.

functions.name: mgGetLayerSpacing
functions.description: Returns the effective spacing between two instances, given the spacing between a reference layer inside the instances. For example, if the reference layer is Oxide_thk drawing, then x_spacing would indicate the spacing between the bounding box of the Oxide_thk layer inside the instances. The t_direction argument specifies the position of the instances relative to each other, either horizontal (next to each other) or vertical (above and below each other).

functions.name: mgGetMatchGroupMembers
functions.description: Displays a list of matchGroup members that belong to the same matchGroup as the specified database object d_dbObjectId.

functions.name: mgGetModgenConstraintFromTopology
functions.description: Returns the Modgen constraint ID that is associated with the specified topology object.

functions.name: mgGetModgenFGFromConstraint
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the Modgen figGroup for a specified Modgen constraint ID in a specified cellview.

functions.name: mgGetModgenFigGroupFromTopology
functions.description: Retrieves the Modgen figGroup object that is associated with the specified topology object.

functions.name: mgGetRegUserProc
functions.description: Accepts a user function symbol and returns the names of the user functions that are registered corresponding to the specified user function symbol.

functions.name: mgGetRegisteredDummyNetProc
functions.description: Returns a list of dummyNet procedures that are currently registered.

functions.name: mgGetRegisteredDummyOverrideParameters
functions.signature: mgGetRegisteredDummyOverrideParameters([ t_libName ][ t_cellName ][ t_paramType ])=> l_registeredDummyOverrides / nil
functions.description: Returns the first set of registered Modgen dummy override parameters that match the specified library and cell names. If the library name is not specified, the function returns all registered overrides. If the cell name is not specified, the function returns all cell overrides that are registered for the given library.

functions.name: mgGetRowRoutingChannelWidth
functions.description: Returns the routing channel width of the specified Modgen row.

functions.name: mgGetStrapDirection
functions.description: Returns the direction of the specified strap. This function is valid if the strap has a single strap object. Otherwise, the router determines the strap direction.

functions.name: mgGetStrapHasDirection
functions.description: Determines whether the strap direction is set for the specified strap.

functions.name: mgGetStrapHasOffset
functions.description: Determines whether the specified strap has an associated offset value.

functions.name: mgGetStrapLongOffset1
functions.description: Returns the long offset attribute of the specified strap for the bottom or left edge. This value determines how far beyond the strap object that the strap can extend.

functions.name: mgGetStrapLongOffset2
functions.description: Returns the long offset attribute of the specified strap for the top or right edge. This value determines how far beyond the strap object that the strap can extend.

functions.name: mgGetStrapOffset
functions.description: Returns the strap offset attribute, which represents the distance from the bottom or left of the bBox of the strapObject.

functions.name: mgGetTopoShapes
functions.description: Retrieves all user-generated shapes from the specified topology group object, usually a topological strap.

functions.name: mgGetTopoTrunkShapes
functions.description: Retrieves the shapes associated with a topological trunk.

functions.name: mgGetTopologyFromModgen
functions.description: Returns a list of topology objects that are available in the specified Modgen.

functions.name: mgGetTrunkChannel
functions.description: Returns the channel number in which the specified topological trunk pattern is located.

functions.name: mgGetTrunkRefLPPEnclosure
functions.description: Returns the enclosure of a topological trunk reference layer and the purpose within an instance. For example, if the LPP of a trunk reference is Oxide drawing, then the function returns the distance from one side of the Oxide bounding box to the instance bounding box. This value is subtracted from the channel width of the topological trunk to derive the trunk-to-device spacing to the reference layer in the instances above (or to the right of) a trunk.

functions.name: mgGetTrunkRefLayerPurpose
functions.description: Returns the reference layer and purpose of a topological trunk. This function returns a list containing the layer and purpose names.

functions.name: mgGetTrunkTopo
functions.description: Returns a list of topology trunks belonging to the specified pathSeg.

functions.name: mgHilightEmptyRowColumnCB
functions.description: Turns on or off highlighting of empty rows and columns.

functions.name: mgIsInBackAnnotation
functions.description: Checks if there are any Modgens currently running dummy backannotation. Use this function for user callbacks to allow changes to the Modgen constraint caused by backannotation, while preventing other changes to the Modgen constraint.

functions.name: mgIsTopologyInsideModgen
functions.description: Checks whether the specified topology object belongs to a Modgen. For example, this function can be used to identify Modgen topologies or to find all topologies that are available in the Modgen specified by the optional d_figGroupId argument.

functions.name: mgModgenHasTopology
functions.description: Checks whether the specified Modgen contains a topology.

functions.name: mgObjectHasMatchGroup
functions.description: Checks whether the specified database object is part of a matchGroup.

functions.name: mgRegUserProc
functions.description: Accepts user functions based on their keywords and registers them in the Modgen code to enable callbacks.

functions.name: mgRegenerateModgen
functions.description: Forces a Modgen-type group to rebuild its geometry.

functions.name: mgRegisterDummyNetProc
functions.description: Registers a function that specifies a net for a specified dummy instance ID and terminal ID.

functions.name: mgRegisterDummyOverrideParameters
functions.description: Registers the parameter overrides to be applied to Modgen dummies. The order in which the override parameters are registered is the order in which the look up is processed.

functions.name: mgRegisterDummyParamsRefDirection
functions.description: Registers Modgen dummy parameters and forcefully matches them to their nearest directional neighbor, left/right or top/bottom.

functions.name: mgRemoveMemberFromMatchGroup
functions.description: Removes the specified database object from its associated matchGroup.

functions.name: mgRemoveTopologyFromModgen
functions.description: Removes the specified topology object from the specified Modgen.

functions.name: mgRotateLeftCB
functions.description: Rotates the selected instance to the left. To rotate an instance at least one instance should be selected.

functions.name: mgRotateMXCB
functions.description: Rotates the selected Modgen around its center using the MX transform.

functions.name: mgRotateMYCB
functions.description: Rotates the selected Modgen around its center using the MY transform.

functions.name: mgRotateR270CB
functions.description: Rotates the selected Modgen around its center using the R270 transform.

functions.name: mgRotateR90CB
functions.description: Rotates the selected Modgen around its center using the R90 transform.

functions.name: mgRotateRightCB
functions.description: Rotates the selected instance to the right. To rotate an instance at least one instance should be selected.

functions.name: mgRouteCB
functions.description: Displays the Routing Style form for the current module.

functions.name: mgRoutePToTCB
functions.description: Routes the currently open Modgen using the Modgen pin-to-trunk router.

functions.name: mgSelectRowColCB
functions.description: Selects all of the instances in the current row or column from the currently selected instance.

functions.name: mgSetColumnRoutingChannelWidth
functions.description: Sets the routing channel width for the specified Modgen column.

functions.name: mgSetIsLocalTrunk
functions.description: Sets the specified trunk as local. Trunks inside a Modgen are called local trunks. These trunks can be connected only within the same Modgen, and not from outside the Modgen.

functions.name: mgSetRowRoutingChannelWidth
functions.description: Sets the routing channel width for the specified Modgen row.

functions.name: mgSetStrapDirection
functions.description: Sets the strap direction. This value is valid only for straps with a single strap object. For straps with more than one strap objects, the router determines strap direction.

functions.name: mgSetStrapHasDirection
functions.description: Specifies whether the given strap can have a direction.

functions.name: mgSetStrapHasOffset
functions.description: Specifies whether the given strap has a valid offset value.

functions.name: mgSetStrapLongOffset1
functions.description: Sets the long offset attribute for the bottom and left edge of the specified strap. This value determines the distance that the strap will extend from the strap object.

functions.name: mgSetStrapLongOffset2
functions.description: Sets the long offset attribute for the top and right edge of the specified strap. This value determines the distance that the strap will extend from the strap object.

functions.name: mgSetStrapOffset
functions.description: Sets the strap offset attribute, which represents the distance from the bottom or left of the bBox of the strap object.

functions.name: mgSetTrunkRefLayerPurpose
functions.description: Sets the layer and purpose of a topological trunk that is anchored to an instance. The bounding box of the specified layer and purpose inside the instance is used to determine the trunk's location. In other words, the trunk's orthogonal offset is from one side of the reference layer and purpose bounding box. The purpose argument is optional. If not specified, then the purpose argument defaults to any. A trunk's reference layer and purpose can be removed by setting both the layer and purpose arguments to any.

functions.name: mgSwapCB
functions.description: Swaps two selected instances, two rows of instances, or two columns of instances in Modgen.

functions.name: mgUnAbutCB
functions.description: Unabuts the selected instances in the current Modgen in the specified cellview.

functions.name: mgUnRegUserProc
functions.description: Accepts user functions based on the keywords and unregisters them in the Modgen code.

functions.name: mgUnRegisterDummyNetProc
functions.description: Unregisters a function that specifies a net for a given dummy instance ID and terminal ID.

functions.name: mgUnregisterDummyOverrideParameters
functions.description: Unregisters all registered Modgen dummy parameter overrides for the given library, if no library is specified, or all currently registered Modgen dummy parameter overrides.

functions.name: mgUnregisterDummyParamRefDirection
functions.description: Unregister either all registered Modgen dummy directional parameters for the given library name or cellNameOrRegex or all currently registered Modgen dummy directional parameters.

functions.name: mgUpdateCB
functions.description: Lets the Modgen ConObserver update the Modgen layout module.

functions.name: mgUpdateEmptyRowColumnHilightCB
functions.description: Update highlights of empty rows to follow any other changes in the Modgen.

functions.name: mgUpdateHoriAlignCB
functions.description: Aligns the selected instances on the specified side. Side can be one of left, right, or center.

functions.name: mgUpdateVertAlignCB
functions.description: Aligns the selected instances on the specified side. Side can be one of top, bottom, or center.

functions.name: min
functions.description: Returns the minimum of the values passed in. Requires a minimum of two arguments.

functions.name: minus
functions.description: Returns the negative of a number. Prefix form of the - unary operator.

functions.name: minusp
functions.description: Checks if a value is a negative number. Same as negativep.

functions.name: mod
functions.description: Returns the integer remainder of dividing two integers. The remainder is either zero or has the sign of the dividend.

functions.name: modelFile
functions.description: Specifies model files to be included in the simulator input file.

functions.name: modf
functions.description: Returns the floating-point remainder of the division of f_flonum1 by f_flonum2.

functions.name: modulo
functions.description: Returns the remainder of dividing two integers. The remainder always has the sign of the divisor.

functions.name: monitor
functions.description: Monitors the jobs submitted to the distributed system.

functions.name: mouseAddPt
functions.description: Adds the point at the location where you clicked the mouse button to the enter function in the current window.

functions.name: mouseAddSelectPt
functions.description: Performs an add mode point selection at the point you click in the current window.

functions.name: mouseFinishPt
functions.description: Adds the point at the location where you clicked the mouse button to the enter function in the current window and completes the enter function, if possible.

functions.name: mousePopUp
functions.description: Displays the popup menu associated with the given windowId, which must be a valid data structure returned by a call to hiOpenWindow or hiCreateWindow.

functions.name: mouseSingleSelectPt
functions.description: Performs a single mode point selection at the point you click in the current window.

functions.name: mouseSubSelectPt
functions.description: Performs a sub-mode point selection at the point you click in the specified window.

functions.name: mouseUndoPt
functions.description: Deletes the point at the location where you clicked the mouse button to the enter function and cancels the enter function in the current window.

functions.name: mprocedure
functions.description: Defines a macro with the given name that takes a single formal argument. This is a syntax form.

functions.name: mptActivate
functions.description: Specifies whether to switch the Virtuoso Multi-Patterning Technology coloring engine ON or OFF.

functions.name: mptCheckFlow
functions.description: Checks the flow settings by loading the check procedure of the specified flow or by comparing the current value of the related environment variables against the environment variables set by the set procedure of the flow.

functions.name: mptCheckHierarchicalLocks
functions.description: Performs a check for hierarchical color lock (HCL) conflict in the cellview.

functions.name: mptCleanClusters
functions.description: Cleans out-of-date cluster information in the cellview which can help to reduce the design size and/or improve performance.

functions.name: mptCleanColoredDataOnSingleMaskLayer
functions.description: Cleans layer-based color violations on the entire design hierarchy or library.

functions.name: mptColorRemastering
functions.signature: mptColorRemastering(d_cellViewID?mode t_mode[ ?mappingFile t_mappingFile ][ ?fromView t_fromView ][ ?toView t_toView ][ ?invalidMappingWord t_invalidMappingWord ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Remasters color-shifted abstract views to corresponding layout views or color-shifted layout views to abstract views.

functions.name: mptDefineFlow
functions.description: Registers a flow by linking the flow name to a set and a check procedure. If the check procedure is not defined, the check defined in the cdsenv file is run. This function checks the environment variables defined in the set function against their current values.

functions.name: mptDeleteClusters
functions.signature: mptDeleteClusters(d_cellViewID[ ?layers l_layers ][ ?checkOnly g_checkOnly ][ ?thruHierarchy g_thruHierarchy ][ ?openForEdit g_openForEdit ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Removes coloring clusters in the specified cellview.

functions.name: mptDoColorChecks
functions.description: Performs coloring checks in the specified cellview.

functions.name: mptDoToolbarAction
functions.description: Runs the specified Multiple Patterning toolbar function.

functions.name: mptFixCVUncoloredAndUnlocked
functions.signature: mptFixCVUncoloredAndUnlocked(d_cellViewID[ l_layers[ l_region[ g_fixUncolored[ g_fixUnlocked ]]]])=> t / nil
functions.description: Searches for uncolored and unlocked, top-level shapes or vias, in the specified cellview and colors and locks them, respectively.

functions.name: mptGetColorShiftingLayers
functions.description: Returns a list of valid shifting layers set by the environment variable, colorShiftingLayers.

functions.name: mptGetColoredPurposes
functions.description: Returns a list of the colored layer purpose pairs for the cellview.

functions.name: mptGetDefaultColoringMethod
functions.description: Returns the session default coloring method that was set using mptSetDefaultColoringMethod.

functions.name: mptGetFlowNames
functions.description: Lists all available flow names that have been defined. It includes pre-defined and custom flow names.

functions.name: mptGetFlowSettings
functions.description: Reports, the procedure used to set a flow, in the CIW and output.

functions.name: mptGetLayerColoringMethod
functions.description: Returns either the coloring method for the given layer, or the coloring method for the session, the design, and layers with a specified coloring method.

functions.name: mptGetLayerDefaultColor
functions.description: Returns either the default color for the given layer, or a list of layer-default color pairs.

functions.name: mptGetLayerDefaultColorSetting
functions.signature: mptGetLayerDefaultColorSetting(d_techFileID[ t_layerName ][ b_getAll ])=> t_color / l_layerColor / l_ColorSettings / nil
functions.description: Returns the default color setting for the specified layer.

functions.name: mptGetLockDefaultColors
functions.description: Indicates whether the layer default color specified by mptSetLayerDefaultColor will be locked when assigned to a shape.

functions.name: mptGetOutdatedDesigns
functions.description: Returns a list of the cellviews in the design hierarchy for which the color information is outdated. The list can optionally specify the outdated layers for each cellview in the returned list.

functions.name: mptGetTrackPatternPattern
functions.description: Returns a list of the color patterns for the specified track pattern.

functions.name: mptGetUpToDateDesigns
functions.description: Returns a list of the cellviews in the hierarchy for which the color information is up to date.

functions.name: mptHiStitch
functions.description: Enables stitch mode to fix odd loop color violations by breaking shapes into two overlapping (stitched) shapes. The first click in the layout selects the shape to be stitched, and the second click sets the stitch location.

functions.name: mptHiUnStitch
functions.description: Enables unstitch mode to revert stitches that were created while in stitch mode (enabled by mptHiStitch). Click a stitched shape in the layout to remove the stitch.

functions.name: mptIsMaskColorShown
functions.description: Checks whether the specified mask color is visible for the layer.

functions.name: mptLPPMergeToColor
functions.description: Converts the layout into Virtuoso multi-pattern conformance format for designs that use two or more separate layer-purpose pairs to represent multi-patterning mask information, so that Virtuoso coloring engine can perform further operations on it. You can choose to write the conversion result into a different library or/and a different view. In this case, new cells with the same cell name and the library or/and view name that you specify are used. The original cell is not changed. If you choose to write the result to the same cell, the original layer-purpose pair data is removed. This function is performed on the entire hierarchy starting from the specified cell.

functions.name: mptLockAll
functions.description: Locks all the top-level shapes of the specified cellview with their current color. You can optionally lock only the shapes on specific colorable layers. Gray color shapes are not locked.

functions.name: mptMarkersToColoredBlockages
functions.description: Transforms the shapes on the specified purposes of the colored layers in the given cellview to colored blockages on the same layer. This function works hierarchically on a layout.

functions.name: mptMarkersToMaskColors
functions.signature: mptMarkersToMaskColors(l_purposesg_drawingPurposed_cellViewID[ g_locked ][ g_removeMarker ][ g_recolorAll ][ g_save ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Transforms the shapes in the given cellview to the drawing purpose and assigns color to each shape based on its original marker purpose. This function works hierarchically on a layout. By default, the assigned color is locked and the marker purpose shapes are removed.

functions.name: mptPropagateLocks
functions.description: Propagates all the locks visible from the top level to connected shapes through the hierarchy.

functions.name: mptPropagateSameMaskGroups
functions.description: Propagates same mask groups in the given cellview through the hierarchy. This should be run following top-level editing of designs with same mask groups. This ensures that shapes in the hierarchy that are connected to same mask group shapes are included in that mask group.

functions.name: mptPurgePcell
functions.description: Removes the color of Pcell or express Pcell colored by the coloring engine. Pcells are purged and the cache of the purged express Pcell is deleted. This is performed hierarchically. Before the color is removed, the coloring engine is deactivated to prevent recoloring of Pcells.

functions.name: mptReColor
functions.description: Rebuilds the color information for the cellview from the bottom hierarchically, according to the specified depth and layers.

functions.name: mptReColorFromShapes
functions.description: Recolors the shapes in the list and the shapes that are connected to them. If the coloring method is colorSpacing, the color of the shapes that are within the same-mask spacing of the shapes in the list will be updated, according to the clustering algorithm described in Automatic Color Shifting in Virtuoso Multiple Patterning Technology User Guide.

functions.name: mptReColorSelection
functions.description: Recolors the shapes specified in the selection set in the specified cellview.

functions.name: mptReColorWsp
functions.signature: mptReColorWsp(d_cellViewID[ ?layers l_layers ][ ?region l_bBox ][ ?grayShapeOnly g_grayShapeOnly ][ ?trackPatterns l_trackPatterns ][ ?shapes l_shapes ][ ?checkWidth g_checkWidth ][ ?vias l_vias ])=> l_coloredShapes / nil
functions.description: Recolors shapes based on the color of WSPs only.

functions.name: mptReconstructStitch
functions.description: Reconstructs stitches by creating stitch pairs from overlapping shapes on the specified purpose.

functions.name: mptReportColoredShapesOnSingleMaskLayer
functions.description: Reports MPT flow settings. Reports the number of shapes, vias, and HCLs that have colored data on the specified layer, with a single mask. This function traverses the design and its sub cells and creates the report. If the g_createMarkers argument is set to t, markers are created for each error.

functions.name: mptReportCurrentSettings
functions.description: Reports MPT flow settings.

functions.name: mptSetDefaultColoringMethod
functions.description: Sets the session default coloring method.

functions.name: mptSetFlow
functions.description: Applies the flow settings by loading the procedure linked to the flow name.

functions.name: mptSetLayerColoringMethod
functions.description: Sets the default coloring method for the technology database, the design, or specified layers in the design.

functions.name: mptSetLayerDefaultColor
functions.description: Sets the default color for a layer. This color will be assigned to newly created shapes and vias on the layer, and to gray shapes and vias on the layer when recoloring the design. The color will also be used to initialize the active color for this layer in the Palette.

functions.name: mptSetLockDefaultColors
functions.description: Specifies whether the layer default color specified by mptSetLayerDefaultColor will be locked when assigned to a shape.

functions.name: mptSetTrackPatternPattern
functions.description: Specifies the color pattern for the track pattern.

functions.name: mptSetupComplianceChecker
functions.description: Flags any objects that are not aligned with the current MPT setup.

functions.name: mptShowMaskColor
functions.description: Shows or hides the color for the specified mask on the given layers.

functions.name: mptUnlockAll
functions.description: Unlocks all the colored shapes that are locked at the top level of the specified cellview. You can optionally unlock only the shapes on specific colorable layers. Top-level shapes with color attribute locks (dbLocks) are unlocked with their current color. Hierarchical color locks at the current editing hierarchy level are removed.

functions.name: mptUnpropagateLocks
functions.description: Removes the system locks created by the propagate locks command.

functions.name: mptUpdateColor
functions.description: Updates the color information from the bottom hierarchically, according to the specified depth and layers. This is useful when the color engine has been switched off/on, or a third party tool has been used to modify color information, leaving color information in an out-of-date state.

functions.name: msgHelp
functions.description: This function is used to access extended help for an error or a warning message. Currently, Distributed Processing (DP) is the only product that supports this feature.

functions.name: mspDisplaySetPartSetupForm
functions.description: This function displays the Partitions Options form, which can be used to edit and set the values for the Analog Stop View Set and Digital Stop View Set.

functions.name: mspEditIEProps
functions.description: This is the main entry procedure for the Interface Element property editor. It takes an object type. The object type can be one of instTerm, instance, terminal, cellView, lib, or default.

functions.name: mspsMapNetName
functions.description: Maps a hierarchical schematic net name to a fragment of the equivalent net in the extracted view.

functions.name: mu
functions.description: Returns the alternative stability factor that indicates the minimum distance between the origin of the unit Smith chart and the load unstable region.

functions.name: mu_prime
functions.description: Returns the alternative stability factor that indicates the minimum distance between the center of the unit Smith chart and the source unstable region.

functions.name: muffleWarnings
functions.description: Returns the result of the last expression evaluated. If the last expression evaluated calls the warn function (either SKILL warn() or C-level ilWarn*), the related message is not printed out.

functions.name: nameToColor
functions.description: Specifies the color name as string or symbol.

functions.name: nc
functions.description: Computes the noise circles.

functions.name: nc_freq
functions.description: Returns noise circles with fixed gain.

functions.name: nc_gain
functions.description: Returns noise circles with fixed frequency.

functions.name: nclRunConstraintValidation
functions.description: Validates the constraints supported by constraint-aware editing mode in the specified cellview.

functions.name: nclToggleCAEMode
functions.description: Toggles constraint-aware editing mode, which causes figures in the layout to move in a constraint-correct fashion. For example, moving a device that is part of a symmetry constraint moves its constrained partner devices appropriately.

functions.name: nconc
functions.description: Equivalent to a destructive append where the first argument is modified.

functions.name: ncons
functions.description: Builds a list containing an element. This function is equivalent to cons( g_element nil ).

functions.name: nearlyEqual
functions.description: Checks whether one value (n_val1) is approximately equal to another value (n_val2).

functions.name: needNCells
functions.description: Ensures that there is enough memory available for the specified number of SKILL objects (cells).

functions.name: negativep
functions.description: Checks whether the specified value is a negative number. Same as minusp.

functions.name: neq
functions.description: Checks if two arguments are not identical using the eq function and returns t if they are not. That is, g_arg1 and g_arg2 are tested to see if they are at the same address in memory.

functions.name: nequal
functions.description: Checks if two arguments are not logically equivalent using the equal function and returns t if they are not.

functions.name: netlist
functions.description: Performs all the steps needed to generate a netlist. If the simDoNetlist variable is not set to t, the function returns t and does not run.

functions.name: newWindow
functions.description: Creates a new Waveform window and returns the window ID.

functions.name: newline
functions.description: Prints a newline (backslash n) character and then flushes the output port.

functions.name: next
functions.description: Allows execution to proceed until the next expression. This function only works if executed from within a break handler and if the code you want to step through was loaded under debugMode. See installDebugger.

functions.name: nextMethodp
functions.description: Checks if there is a next applicable method for the current method's generic function. The current method is the method that is calling nextMethodp.

functions.name: nf
functions.description: Returns the noise figure.

functions.name: nfmin
functions.description: Returns the minimum noise figure.

functions.name: nindex
functions.description: Finds the symbol or string, S_string2, in t_string1 and returns the character index, starting from one, of the first point at which the S_string2 matches part of t_string1.

functions.name: nlDisplayOption
functions.description: Prints the option names available on this object along with their values.

functions.name: nlError
functions.description: Issues a user error. The error is printed immediately and it is collected on the object. In this way, if netlisting is interrupted, the user is aware of any errors that occurred during netlisting. All errors are printed to the netlist log file.

functions.name: nlGetCdf
functions.description: Obtains the CDF information of the IE cell. CDF information contains the default IE parameter, default IE macro model file name and parameter mapping from CDF to simulator specific names.

functions.name: nlGetCellName
functions.description: Gets the cell name of the specified instance.

functions.name: nlGetCurrentSwitchMaster
functions.description: This function returns the database ID for the current switch master for the instance in hierarchical incremental netlisting. This function should only be used while printing the instance statement. Avoid using this function if possible.

functions.name: nlGetDesign
functions.description: Returns the design object.

functions.name: nlGetFormatter
functions.description: Returns the formatter.

functions.name: nlGetGlobalNets
functions.description: Returns a list of global nets. This method should only be used in the nlPrintHeader method of the formatter.

functions.name: nlGetId
functions.description: Returns the database ID for the instance. If the instance represents a cdba instance, this is a database ID.

functions.name: nlGetLibName
functions.description: Gets the library name of the specified instance.

functions.name: nlGetModelName
functions.description: This method must be used to obtain the model name of an instance. Use of this method assures consistency in netlisting across interfaces. For instances that represent subcircuits, this method returns a name chosen by the netlister, using the modulePrefix netlist option.

functions.name: nlGetNetlistDir
functions.description: Returns the netlist directory.

functions.name: nlGetNetlistedStopCellViewList
functions.description: Returns a list of cellview objects treated as stop cells for the specified netlister object.

functions.name: nlGetNetlister
functions.description: Returns an object representing the netlister.

functions.name: nlGetNumberOfBits
functions.description: Returns the number of bits on the instance and terminal specified.

functions.name: nlGetOption
functions.description: Returns the value of the option.

functions.name: nlGetOptionNameList
functions.description: Returns a list of option names available on this object.

functions.name: nlGetPCellParamSource
functions.description: Identifies the source of value of the Pcell parameters of the given cellview.

functions.name: nlGetParamList
functions.description: Returns the list of parameters of the specified instance or cellview.

functions.name: nlGetParamStringValue
functions.description: Returns a string representing the parameter value for the instance and parameter name.

functions.name: nlGetScratchInstPcellParamValue
functions.description: Returns the parameter value of the scratch instance to be used for Pcell evaluations.

functions.name: nlGetScratchInstance
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the scratch instance to be used for Pcell evaluations.

functions.name: nlGetSignalList
functions.description: Returns a list of mapped signal names for the instance according to the terminal order specified for the cellview.

functions.name: nlGetSimName
functions.description: If the input type is cellview object, then returns the simulator name of the subcircuit. If the input type is instance object, then returns the mapped name of the instance. The name returned depends on the useInstNamePrefix netlist option. When it is not set, the name prefix is not taken into account. However, for instances representing interface elements, the name prefix is always taken into account. No mapping is performed for interface elements.

functions.name: nlGetSimTerminalNets
functions.description: Returns the list of mapped names of signals connecting to the terminals of the cellview based on the terminal order specified for the cellview. Several signals may come from inherited connections. Signal buses are handled in scalar form.

functions.name: nlGetSwitchMaster
functions.description: Returns the database ID of the switch master.

functions.name: nlGetSwitchViewList
functions.description: Returns the switch view list for the cellView.

functions.name: nlGetTerminalList
functions.description: Returns a list of terminal names in the order specified on the pin order property on the schematic, or on the termOrder property on the CDF, or on the cellview of the instance, in that order.

functions.name: nlGetTerminalNets
functions.description: Returns the schematic names of the signals connected to the terminals. Many of the signals may come from inherited connections.

functions.name: nlGetTerminalSignalName
functions.description: Returns the name of the signal connected to the terminal.

functions.name: nlGetToolName
functions.description: Returns a symbol representing the simulator. It returns the value of the tool name. This name is used for the selection of the simulator information on the library component.

functions.name: nlGetTopCellName
functions.description: Returns the cell name of the design.

functions.name: nlGetTopLibName
functions.description: Returns the library name of the design.

functions.name: nlGetTopViewName
functions.description: Returns the view name of the design.

functions.name: nlGetViewName
functions.description: Returns the view name of the specified cellview object.

functions.name: nlIncludeDbDSPFTextFile
functions.description: Prints the dspf_include statement for the DSPF type text cellview in the design.

functions.name: nlIncludeDbSPICEMODELTextFile
functions.description: Prints the include statement for SPICEMODEL cellviews in the design. This function is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all SPICEMODEL modules. If your simulator does not support SPICEMODEL views, call the nlError function in this method.

functions.name: nlIncludePspiceFile
functions.description: Prints the include statement for pspice cellviews in the design. This function is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all pspice modules. If your simulator does not support pspice views, call nlError function in this method.

functions.name: nlIncludeSrcFile
functions.description: Prints the include statement for instances bound to source files using Hierarchy Editor. This is called while printing the footer for the netlist for all the source files to which any instance in the design is bound. If your simulator does not support source file bindings, call nlError in this method.

functions.name: nlIncludeVerilogFile
functions.description: Prints the include statement for Verilog type text cell view in the design. This is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all Verilog text cell views. If your simulator does not support Verilog-a views, call nlError in this method.

functions.name: nlIncludeVerilogaFile
functions.description: Prints the include statement for Verilog-a cell views in the design. This is called before printing the footer for the netlist for all Verilog-a modules. If your simulator does not support Verilog-a views, call nlError in this method.

functions.name: nlInfo
functions.description: Sends an informational message to the calling application.

functions.name: nlInitialize
functions.description: For the nlFormatter class, this method initializes the netlister. This method can be redefined for the simulator-specific netlister and is called by nlCreateFormatter. This method initializes all simulator-specific aspects of netlisting such as name mapping. For the nlAnalogFormatter class, this method sets a number of netlist options. These options and their values are shown in the table below.

functions.name: nlIsModelNameInherited
functions.description: Returns t if the model name for the stopping instance is passed through the hierarchy through parameters.

functions.name: nlIsPcellInstance
functions.description: Checks if the specified instance name represents a schematic Pcell instance.

functions.name: nlIsPcellParam
functions.description: Checks if the specified device parameter represents a Pcell parameter.

functions.name: nlIsSmartExtractedView
functions.description: Identifies if the currently netlisted cellview is of the type smart_view. You can use this function in custom netlist procedures to modify the syntax printed to the netlist as required. For example, you can modify the syntax to determine if the printing of parenthesis needs to be enabled or disabled when printing the port connections of the instance.

functions.name: nlMapGlobalNet
functions.description: Maps a global net (signal) to the simulator name. This should only be used in the nlPrintHeader method of the formatter. Use at any other time is an error.

functions.name: nlObjError
functions.description: Similar to nlError, but prints a description of the object along with the error message. The description includes the library name, the cell name, the view name, and the instance name in case the object is an instance.

functions.name: nlPrintComment
functions.description: Prints a comment.

functions.name: nlPrintComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for the instance being netlisted.

functions.name: nlPrintFooter
functions.description: This method is called at the end of netlisting. It does not print anything at the end of the netlist for the nlAnalogFormatter class.

functions.name: nlPrintHeader
functions.description: This method writes the beginning comment, adds .GLOBAL, and prints header comments.

functions.name: nlPrintHeaderComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for the netlist file, including the library, cell, and view names of the top-level cellview of the design netlisted. This method only has effect when the printFileComments netlist option is set.

functions.name: nlPrintIndentString
functions.description: Prints the indent string for the instance statement. When inside the top-level circuit, the empty string is printed. When inside subcircuit definitions, the value of the subcktIndentString netlist option is printed.

functions.name: nlPrintInst
functions.description: Prints the netlist statement for an instance. This is the default netlist procedure for a component.

functions.name: nlPrintInstComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for an instance.

functions.name: nlPrintInstEnd
functions.description: Prints the end of the instance statement, which is a return (\n). This method is called by the netlister after the netlist procedure or by nlPrintInst.

functions.name: nlPrintInstName
functions.description: Prints the simulator name of the instance, taking the instance name prefix specified on the component into account when the simulator so requires. This is determined with the useInstNamePrefix netlist option.

functions.name: nlPrintInstParameters
functions.description: Prints the instance parameters in name=value pairs.

functions.name: nlPrintInstSignals
functions.description: Prints the simulator names of the signals according to the terminal order specified on the component, using the nlGetSignalList method of the instance.

functions.name: nlPrintModelName
functions.description: Prints the model name. The nlGetModelName for the instance is used for the model name.

functions.name: nlPrintString
functions.description: Prints the string arguments to the file. This function does the required line folding, prefixing, and, postfixing.

functions.name: nlPrintStringNoFold
functions.description: Prints the string arguments to the file, like the function nlPrintString. This function does the required prefixing and postfixing, but does not fold the line until a newline character or maxLineLength is encountered. While in a 'no fold' print mode, calls cannot be made to nlPrintString.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktBegin
functions.description: Prints the .subckt keyword for the nlAnalogFormatter class. This method is called by nlSubcktHeader.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktEnd
functions.description: For the nlAnalogFormatter class, prints the .ends keyword, followed by a space and the simulator name of the subcircuit, to mark the end of the subcircuit definition. It is called by nlPrintSubcktFooter.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktFooter
functions.description: Writes the footer for the subcircuit. For the nlAnalogFormatter class, it prints .ends.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktFooterComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for the subcircuit footer by printing the string 'End of subcircuit definition.' preceded by the comment begin string.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktHeader
functions.description: Writes the header for a subcircuit following these steps: prints comments by calling nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments; prints the subckt begin keyword by calling nlPrintSubcktBegin; prints the subckt name by calling nlPrintSubcktName; prints the subckt terminal list by calling nlPrintSubcktTerminalList.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments
functions.description: Prints the comments for the subcircuit header and the mapping information when the printSubcktComments option is set.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktName
functions.description: Prints a space and the simulator name of the subcircuit. This method is used by nlSubcktHeader.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktParameters
functions.description: Prints the passed parameters for the subcircuit definition.

functions.name: nlPrintSubcktTerminalList
functions.description: Prints the simulator names of the signals connected to the terminals for a subcircuit definition and handles the signals resulting from inherited connections at a lower level .

functions.name: nlPrintTopCellFooter
functions.description: Writes the top cell view footer. This function prints an empty line and calls nlPrintTopCellFooterComments.

functions.name: nlPrintTopCellFooterComments
functions.description: Returns t at the analogFormatter level.

functions.name: nlPrintTopCellHeader
functions.description: Prints the header of the top-level circuit by calling nlPrintTopCellHeaderComments.

functions.name: nlPrintTopCellHeaderComments
functions.description: Calls nlPrintSubcktHeaderComments for the nlAnalogFormatter class.

functions.name: nlSetOption
functions.description: Sets an option value.

functions.name: nlSetPcellName
functions.description: Define this function if the default generic OSS naming convention for Pcells needs to be customized.

functions.name: nlTranslateFlatIEPathName
functions.description: Parses a hierachical IE instance path and returns the path of the IE instance that is to be printed in the digital netlist.

functions.name: nlWarning
functions.description: Issue a warning to the user.

functions.name: nlambda
functions.description: (SKILL mode only) Allows nlambda functions to be defined without having names. In all other respects, nlambda is identical to nprocedure. This is a syntax form that is not supported in SKILL++ mode.

functions.name: nmp<NameSpace>To<NameSpace>
functions.description: Maps t_identifier from the first name space to the second name space. In the function name, substitute the first <NameSpace> with the name space to which the identifier belongs and substitute the second <NameSpace> with the name space to which you want to convert the identifier. For example, nmpCDBAToVerilog() or nmpVHDLAMSToVHDL().

functions.name: nmp<Namespace>ToIdent
functions.description: Maps t_identifier from a name space to an nmp Ident. In the function name, substitute <NameSpace> with the name space to which the identifier belongs. For example, nmpCDBAToIdent().

When a window is displayed, the second argument of this function is the string show, when a window is removed, the second argument is hide, and when a window is iconified, the second argument is min. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

This function is logged for menus derived from the nrReplayPopupMenu class, which is a part of the native Qt replay library. The function is logged whenever the contentsChanged signal is emitted from the menu. This function is intended only for replay use and should not be called explicitly.

functions.description: Deletes a note from the given test, history, corner, or variable.

functions.name: ocnxlDisableSweepVar

functions.name: ocnxlDisableTest
functions.description: Lets you disable a test. A disabled test will not be run when ocnxlRun() command is fired. See help on ocnxlRun().

functions.name: ocnxlEADEnableVoltageConstraints

functions.name: ocnxlEADSelectAllSignals

functions.name: ocnxlEADSetDutMaster

functions.name: ocnxlEADSetWaveFormClipping

functions.name: ocnxlEnableCorner

functions.name: ocnxlEnableCornerForTest

functions.name: ocnxlEnableSweepParam

functions.name: ocnxlEnableSweepVar

functions.name: ocnxlEnableTest

functions.name: ocnxlEndTest

functions.name: ocnxlEndXLMode

functions.name: ocnxlExportOutputView

functions.name: ocnxlGetOverwriteHistory

functions.name: ocnxlGetPointId

functions.name: ocnxlGetReferenceHistory

functions.name: ocnxlGetRunDistributeOptions

functions.name: ocnxlGetSession

functions.name: ocnxlGetSpecs

functions.description: Sets the project directory to the specified location. All simulation data goes into this location by default, if the simulation results or results directories are not set. By default, the project directory is set as $HOME/simulation.

functions.description: Specifies a list of library/cell/view lists that define the names of cellviews within a test for which the checks and asserts defined in the Checks/Asserts assistant will be netlisted. The checks and asserts under each of these cellviews will be netlisted provided that the netlist attribute of the test is set to t and its netlistScope attribute is set to partial or all. The cellviews will not be netlisted if the netlist attribute is nil or the netlistScope attribute is none.

The starting iteration number for the calibration run is set to the current iteration number of the main Monte Carlo simulation run. This command must be used only in a pre-run script.

functions.name: ocnxlSetDesignVariablePerTest

functions.name: ocnxlSetMCdut
functions.description: Sets a design instance to be used in a pre-run script for Monte Carlo calibration. If set, the specified subcircuit instance has process and mismatch variations applied to it and the unspecified instances only have process variations. All subcircuits instantiated under the specified instance also have process and mismatch enabled. By default, mismatch variations are applied to all the subcircuit instances in the design and process variations are applied globally. This allows the testbench to change and not affect the variations seen by the original design.
