functions.name: sevSelectResults
functions.description: Displays the Select Results form that lets you select and load a previously saved set of results.

functions.name: sevSession
functions.description: Displays the session ID of the simulation environment such as the ADE L window, the schematic window associated with ADE L, or a form launched from ADE L.

functions.name: sevSetConnectModules
functions.description: Displays the Connect Rules form that allows you to select built-in or user-defined connect rules.

functions.name: sevSetEngineOptions
functions.description: Displays the Engine Options form for the selected type for editing.

functions.name: sevSetMTSMode
functions.description: Enables or disables MTS mode.

functions.name: sevSetMainWindowPulldownMenus
functions.description: Sets the menus for the Virtuoso Analog Simulation Environment window.

functions.name: sevSetMenuItemLists
functions.description: Creates the menu item lists.

functions.name: sevSetPropertyForSelectedOuts
functions.description: Sets the property to the specified value on the selected outputs.

functions.name: sevSetSchematicPulldownMenus
functions.description: Sets the simulation menus on the schematic window.

functions.name: sevSetSimDataDir
functions.description: Loads the results for the specified simulation environment session and results directory.

functions.name: sevSetSolver
functions.description: Displays the Choose Solver form, which lets you select a solver.

functions.name: sevSetTopSaveDir
functions.description: This function sets the ADE L Save State directory for the simulation environment session.

functions.name: sevSetTypeInWindowPulldownMenus
functions.description: Sets the menu on the simulator type in window.

functions.name: sevSetupSimulationFiles
functions.description: Displays the Simulation Files Setup form that lets you specify the simulation files and paths for Spectre direct simulation.

functions.name: sevSetupStimuli
functions.description: Displays the Setup Analog Stimuli form that lets you specify the circuit stimuli.

functions.name: sevSimulator
functions.description: Displays the name of the simulator used in the session as a string.

functions.name: sevStartSession
functions.signature: sevStartSession([ ?design g_design ][ ?lib g_lib ][ ?cell g_cell ][ ?view g_view ][ ?schematic g_schematic ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Starts the Virtuoso Analog Simulation Environment session tied to the specified design. It will try the design first, then lib/cell/view, and finally it will try the schematic. If none of these is specified, it will start a skeleton session that will not be able to do anything until a design has been tied to the session. The lib/cell/view arguments must be specified, otherwise they are ignored.

functions.name: sevStopEngine
functions.description: Stops the currently running simulation that is tied to the session.

functions.name: sevTopSaveDir
functions.description: Displays the current ADE L Save State directory path.

functions.name: sevViewCompilerLog
functions.description: Displays the AMS simulation compiler log file. The log file can be either ncvlog.log or ncvhdl.log depending on the contents of the AMS design.

functions.name: sevViewElabLog
functions.description: Displays the AMS simulation elaborator log file.

functions.name: sevViewNcVerilogLog
functions.description: Displays the AMS simulation NcVerilog log file.

functions.name: sevViewNetlisterLog
functions.description: Displays the AMS netlister log file.

functions.name: sevViewSimLog
functions.description: Displays the AMS simulator log file.

functions.name: sevViewSimulatorOutput
functions.description: Displays the simulation output log.

functions.name: sevWhatsNew
functions.description: Opens the Whats New window for the simulation environment.

functions.name: sevWriteTable
functions.description: Writes the component table in the specified XML state file.

functions.name: sevWriteValue
functions.description: Writes a XML component value in the specified XML state file.

functions.name: sh, shell
functions.signature: sh([ t_command ])=> t / nilshell([ t_command ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Starts the UNIX Bourne shell sh as a child process to execute a command string.

functions.name: shadow
functions.description: Adds symbols s_symbol to the shadow list of the default namespace. The symbols which are added to the shadow list are not overridden by import.

functions.name: shadowImport
functions.description: Adds symbols to the namespace shadow list. By default, all warnings related to namespaces are suppressed in the shadowImport function.

functions.name: sharedInitialize
functions.description: This is a generic function, which is called when an instance is created, re-initialized, updated to conform to a redefined class, or updated to conform to a different class. It is called from the initializeInstance, updateInstanceForRedefinedClass, and updateInstanceForDifferentClass functions to initialize slots of the instance g_object using the corresponding initforms.

functions.name: simAddProbeCapByName
functions.description: Displays the net capacitance of the supplied net name. This function is to be used in conjunction with the function simReadNetCapFile, which reads in the sim.cap file, initializing all the net names in the design with the associated capacitance values. This function refreshes the active display window by displaying the capacitance value of the given net name.

functions.name: simAddProbeCapByScreen
functions.description: Displays all the nets capacitance on the current screen.

functions.name: simAddProbeCapForBusBit
functions.description: Displays net capacitance on each bit of a bus.

functions.name: simCheckExist
functions.description: Checks whether all of the variables in the variableNames list argument are defined and are not set to nil. Otherwise, prints an error message.

functions.name: simCheckHeader
functions.description: Checks the header stamp of the net capacitance file pointer,sim.cap. The header stamp must be the first word on the first line of the sim.cap file, and it must be equal to Net_Capacitance_File. Use the infile function to open the sim.cap file before calling this function.

functions.name: simCheckVariables
functions.description: Checks whether the variables simSimulator, simCellName, simLibName, simViewName, simRunDir, simViewList, simStopList, simSedFile, simCommand, simNlpGlobalLibName, and simNlpGlobalCellName have been set and their value is t. It does so by calling the simCheckExist function.

functions.name: simCheckViewConfig
functions.description: Checks if the design you want to netlist is an HDB configuration.

functions.name: simCleanRun
functions.description: Deletes files created by both SE and the analysis tool being used from the simulation run directory. The function deletes only files that can be recreated by renetlisting or resimulating. Files which are required to rerun the simulation, such as the si.env and control files, are not deleted. The function displays a dialog box so you can confirm that you intend to delete the information. If the deletion is confirmed, the files that SE creates are deleted along with the files specified by the simCleanFileList variable. The simCleanFileList variable is set differently by each application integrated into SE.

functions.name: simDateStamp
functions.description: Prints the value contained in t_string argument followed by the date to standard output.

functions.name: simDeRegPostNetlistTrigger
functions.description: Deregisters a user-defined SKILL trigger that has been registered using simRegPostNetlistTrigger. For backward compatibility, hnlDeRegPostNetlistTrigger can be used as an alias for simDeRegPostNetlistTrigger.

functions.name: simDeRegPreNetlistTrigger
functions.description: Deregisters a user-defined SKILL trigger that has been registered using simRegPreNetlistTrigger. For backward compatibility, hnlDeRegPreNetlistTrigger can be used as an alias for simDeRegPreNetlistTrigger.

functions.name: simDeleteRunDirFile
functions.description: Deletes the specified file in the simulation run directory.

functions.name: simDesignVarCdsNameExtName
functions.description: Accepts the user-assigned variable name, cdsDesignVarName, as an argument and returns the netlister-assigned name for it as it appears in the netlist. The function reads the mapping information from the simRunDir directory using the design information set through the simCellName, simLibName, simViewName SKILL variables. Therefore, all these variables must be set before calling this function.

functions.name: simDesignVarExtNameCdsName
functions.description: Accepts the netlister-assigned variable name, extDesignVarName, as an argument and returns the user-assigned name for it as it appears on the schematic. The function reads the mapping information from the simRunDir directory using the design information set through the simCellName, simLibName, simViewName SKILL variables. Therefore, all these variables must be set before calling this function.

functions.name: simDrain
functions.description: Performs the equivalent of drain( stdout ) when run in the non-graphic environment without accepting any arguments. No action is taken or required when this function is run in the Cadence graphics environment.

functions.name: simEditFileWithName
functions.description: Calls the edit function internally to display the specified file.

functions.name: simExecute
functions.description: Runs the UNIX command or program provided as its single argument.

functions.name: simFindFile
functions.description: Finds the full file system pathname to t_filename in the install hierarchy, if it exists. The pathname this function searches for is specified by the prependInstallPath function.

functions.name: simFlattenWithArgs
functions.description: Runs the prFlatten tool. The design hierarchy is specified by the simLibName, simCellName, and simViewName variables. The global formatting properties are defined in simNlpGlobalLibName, simNlpGlobalCellName and simNlpGlobalViewName. The function is defined in /bin/si and also in the Cadence graphics program.

functions.name: simGetLoginName
functions.description: Returns the string-valued login name of the current user.

functions.name: simGetTermList
functions.description: Collects all the terminals for a block and returns them as a list.

functions.name: simIfNoProcedure
functions.description: Same as the SKILL keyword procedure, except the procedure definition given as an argument is only defined if it is not currently defined. This function is used instead of the SKILL procedure to permit the overriding of procedures defined in SE by procedures in .simrc.

functions.name: simIlSleep
functions.description: Suspends the current process by the number of seconds specified as an argument. The current process in a replay file launches si in batch mode and waits for si to return before it runs the next command in the file.

functions.name: simInWithArgs
functions.description: Translates the designer-assigned names for nets and instances in the input files into the corresponding netlister-assigned names and creates the files for input into the simulator.

functions.name: simInitControl
functions.description: Checks whether a file called control exists in the simulation run directory.

functions.name: simInitEnv
functions.description: Initializes the simulation environment within the Cadence graphics environment.

functions.name: simInitEnvWithArgs
functions.signature: simInitEnvWithArgs(t_runDirNamet_libName | nilt_cellName | nilt_viewName | nilt_simulatorName | nilg_forceInit)=> t / nil
functions.description: Initializes the simulation environment within the Cadence graphics environment. In addition to defining the SKILL environment needed for SE and the target application, the run directory is created and initialized as needed.

functions.name: simInitRaw
functions.description: Creates the raw directory in the simulation run directory that stores the waveform file.

functions.name: simInitRunDir
functions.description: Executes the list of functions specified by the variable simInitRunActions. If this variable is not set then simInitControl and simInitRaw are the default list of functions to be executed in this order, which initializes a simulation run directory.

functions.name: simInitSimulator
functions.description: Calls the function with the same name as the simulator name specified by the simSimulator variable, for example, silos. This function must be defined in a file with the same name with either the .il or the .ile suffix added and stored in the local/si/caplib directory.

functions.name: simInstCdsNameExtName
functions.description: Accepts the user-assigned instance name as an argument and returns the netlister-assigned instance name for cdsInstName as it appears in the netlist. The exact name returned depends on the design.

functions.name: simInstExtNameCdsName
functions.description: Accepts the netlister-assigned instance name as an argument extInstName and returns the user-assigned instance name as it appears in the schematic.

functions.name: simJobMonitor
functions.description: Displays a form listing the analysis jobs invoked in the background using the simRunNetAndSim and simRunNetAndSimWithArgs functions. The analysis job is listed on the form, along with its current status, time of invocation, and execution priority. Using this form, you can view the run log of a job, terminate the execution of an active job, suspend the execution of an active job, change the execution priority of a job, or delete a job from the form.

functions.name: simLoadNetlisterFiles
functions.description: Loads the file specified as an argument from the local/fnl directory. If the tool does not find the file in the local/fnl directory, it searches in the etc/skill/fnl directory in the install hierarchy. If it does not exist, no error is generated.

functions.name: simLoadSimulatorFiles
functions.description: Loads the simulator-specific file from the local/si/caplib directory. If it does not find the file in local/si/caplib, it searches etc/skill/si/caplib directory in the install hierarchy. If the file does not exist, no error is generated.

functions.name: simNetCdsNameExtName
functions.description: Accepts the user-assigned net name as an argument for cdsNetName and returns the netlister-assigned net name as it appears in the netlist.

functions.name: simNetExtNameCdsName
functions.description: Accepts the netlister-assigned net name as an argument and returns the user-assigned net name for extNetName as it appears in the schematic.

functions.name: simNetlistWithArgs
functions.description: Generates a flattened description of the design hierarchy specified by simLibName, simCellName, and simViewName in the syntax described by the global formatting properties in simNlpGlobalLibName, simNlpGlobalCellName and simNlpGlobalViewName.

functions.name: simNoNetlist
functions.description: Sets the simNoNetlist variable to t to specify that no netlist is generated, and then callsthe sim function to perform a complete simulation, except for netlist generation.

functions.name: simOutWithArgs
functions.description: Translates the netlister-assigned names for nets and instances in the input files specified in fileList to the corresponding user-assigned names, and produces the output files specified in fileList.

functions.name: simPostNameConvert
functions.description: Clears all allocated storage and marks the map structure as invalid. Since this function can be called using SKILL, the parameter has to be maintained as a list.

functions.name: simPostNetlistTriggerList
functions.description: Returns the list of functions registered through simRegPostNetlistTrigger when this function is specified in the .simrc file or the CIW. For backward compatibility, hnlPostNetlistTriggerList can be used as an alias for simPostNetlistTriggerList.

functions.name: simPreNameConvert
functions.description: Sets up the variables needed for name conversion routines. If no arguments are passed, it does the setup by doing a lookup of the simulator environment settings.

functions.name: simPreNetlistTriggerList
functions.description: Returns the list of functions registered through simRegPreNetlistTrigger when this function is specified in the .simrc file or the CIW. For backward compatibility, hnlPreNetlistTriggerList can be used as an alias for simPreNetlistTriggerList.

functions.name: simPrintEnvironment
functions.description: Writes the primary simulation control variables and their values to the si.env file in the simulation run directory.

functions.name: simPrintError
functions.description: Prints the text argument to the stderr port if executed in the Cadence nongraphic environment. If the function is called from within the Cadence graphics environment, the output is written to the CIW window.

functions.name: simPrintErrorLine
functions.description: Prints the errors for a cell and writes them out to a file.

functions.name: simPrintMessage
functions.description: Prints the text argument to the stdout port if executed in the Cadence non-graphic environment. If the function is called from within the Cadence graphics environment, the output is written to the CIW window.

functions.name: simPrintTermList
functions.description: Lists the terminals for a cell and writes them out to a file.

functions.name: simReadNetCapFile
functions.description: Reads in the net capacitance file and initializes the simAllNets global variable. This contains the list of all nets in the design and their associated capacitance values, which are present in the capacitance file.

functions.name: simRegPostNetlistTrigger
functions.description: Registers a function to be called after the netlist has been generated. This is applicable for both hierarchical and flat netlisting. For backward compatibility, hnlRegPostNetlistTrigger can be used as an alias for simRegPostNetlistTrigger.

functions.name: simRegPreNetlistTrigger
functions.description: Registers a function to be called before the netlisting begins. This is applicable for both hierarchical and flat netlisting. For backward compatibility, hnlRegPreNetlistTrigger can be used as an alias for simRegPreNetlistTrigger.

functions.name: simRep
functions.description: Creates a view with specified properties for the specified cell. Use this function only for backward compatibility with Edge 2.1; otherwise, use the lmSimView function.

functions.name: simRunDirInfile
functions.description: Opens the file specified using the fileName argument in the simulation run directory for reading. It creates a full file system path name to the file in the simulation run directory and then passes the file as an argument to the SKILL infile function. The function returns a SKILL port.

functions.name: simRunDirLoad
functions.description: Loads the file specified using the t_fileName argument in the simulation run directory. It creates a full file system path to the file in the simulation run directory and then passes the file as an argument to the SKILL load function.

functions.name: simRunDirOutfile
functions.description: Opens the file specified using the fileName argument in the simulation run directory for writing. It creates a full file system path name to the file in the simulation run directory and then passes the file as an argument to the SKILL outfile function. The function returns a SKILL port.

functions.name: simRunNetAndSim
functions.description: Starts an analysis job in either foreground or background mode.

functions.name: simRunNetAndSimWithArgs
functions.signature: simRunNetAndSimWithArgs(t_libName | nilt_cellName | nilt_viewName | nilt_simulatorName | nilg_doNetlistg_doSimulationg_runBackgroundx_jobPriority)=> t / nil
functions.description: Starts an analysis job in either foreground or background mode.

functions.name: simRunNetAndSimWithCmd
functions.signature: simRunNetAndSimWithCmd(t_libName | nilt_cellName | nilt_viewName | nilt_simulatorName | nilt_cmdToBeExecutedg_runBackgroundx_jobPriority)=> t / nil
functions.description: Runs a command that you specify in either foreground or background mode. The simulation environment must be initialized before simRunNetAndSimWithCmd is called. The simRunDir global variable specifies the current run directory. It is set when the simulation environment is initialized.

functions.name: simSetDef
functions.description: Sets the g_variableName variable to g_value only if the variable is not yet set or if the symbol variableName evaluates to nil. If the variable was set prior to calling this function, and the simGenWarnings variable is not nil, a warning message is printed to stdout that the value of the variableName variable is overridden.

functions.name: simSetDefWithNoWarn
functions.description: Sets the g_variableName variable to g_value, same as the simSetDef function, except that no warning is generated if variableName is already set.

functions.name: simStringsToList
functions.description: Accepts a string of names separated by blanks and tab characters as an argument and returns a list of strings.

functions.name: simSubProbeCapByName
functions.description: Displays net capacitance by name.

functions.name: simSubProbeCapByScreen
functions.description: Displays all the net capacitance on the current screen.

functions.name: simVertToHoriz
functions.description: Reads in the inputFileName file, converts names in vertical table headers to horizontal, and copies the rest of the file.

functions.name: simViewFileWithArgs
functions.description: Calls the view function with the file name as the first argument and the window size as the second argument. The view function creates a viewFile window where the file text is displayed with the banner as the value supplied through the optional windowTitle argument.

functions.name: simWaveOpen
functions.description: Invokes a form displaying the current simulation run directory name, and prompts you for the name of the waveform file to display. The default waveform file is raw/waves in the simulation run directory. When the file name is specified, a new window is opened, displaying the waveform information.

functions.name: simin
functions.description: Translates the user-assigned names for nets and instances in the control file to the corresponding netlister-assigned names and creates the si.inp file for input to the simulator. A message is printed stating that simin is being run, and then the simInWithArgs function is called with the correct arguments to do the translation.

functions.name: simout
functions.description: Translates the netlister-assigned names for nets and instances in the simout.tmp file to the corresponding user-assigned names and produces the si.out file. The simout.tmp file is normally the simulator text output. A message is printed stating that simout is being run, and then the simOutWithArgs function is called with the correct arguments to do the translation.

functions.name: simplifyFilename
functions.description: Expands the name of a file to its full path.

functions.name: simplifyFilenameUnique
functions.description: Returns the full path for the given t_path without links and a trailing slash / at the end of the result string. The function returns an error if the given t_path is incorrect.

functions.name: simulator
functions.description: Starts an OCEAN session and sets the simulator name for that session. The previous session (if any) is closed and all session information is cleared.

functions.name: sin
functions.description: Returns the sine of a floating-point number or integer.

functions.name: sinh
functions.description: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a signal.

functions.name: skDisableMessage
functions.description: Disables a SKILL Lint message from being reported inside a given function definition.

functions.name: skDisableMessageBlock
functions.description: Disables one or a list of SKILL Lint messages from being reported by rules within the body of the function. You might want to turn off certain rules temporarily, and not globally, inside a particular block of code. SKILL Lint will recognize a call to this function if inserted inside the block of code being analyzed.

functions.name: skEnableMessageBlock
functions.description: Re-enables reporting of one or more SKILL Lint messages that have been globally turned off within the body of this function only.

functions.name: skIgnoreMessage
functions.description: Turns off the reporting of specified SKILL Lint messages. For a message to appear, both the message and its group have to be unignored.

functions.name: skTabulate
functions.signature: skTabulate(?fileNames g_tabulatedFileNames[ ?reportFile t_reportFile ][ ?showFile g_showFile ][ ?dontResolveSymLink g_dontResolveSymLink ][ ?customerInfo l_customerInfo ][ ?printFiltered g_printFiltered ][ ?ext l_ext ][ ?infoFile g_infoFile ][ ?defnFile g_defnFile ][ ?recurse g_recurse ][ ?exclude g_exclude ][ ?recurseExclude g_recurseExclude ][ ?sendReport g_sendReport ]=> t
functions.description: Runs the SKILL Tabulator in batch mode.

functions.name: skTabulateSKILL
functions.description: Brings up the SKILL Tabulator UI form.

functions.name: skUnignoreMessage
functions.description: Turns on the reporting of specified SKILL Lint messages. For a message to appear, both the message and its group have to be unignored.

functions.name: skewness
functions.description: Calculates the skewness of the specified waveform.

functions.name: skillDebugger
functions.description: Activates the SKILL Debugger. Usually invoked by a break or error handler.

functions.name: skillDevStatus
functions.description: Returns the current status of the Cadence SKILL Development Environment license.

functions.name: sklint
functions.signature: sklint([ ?file tl_inputFileName ][ ?context t_contextName ][ ?outputFile t_outputFileName ][ ?ignoreGroups l_ignoreGroups ][ ?globals l_globals ][ ?depends l_depends ][ ?rulesFile t_rulesFile ][ ?ignores l_ignoresMessageList ][ ?checkNlambda g_checkNlambda ][ ?noPrintLog g_noPrintLog ][ ?useGlobalIgnores g_useGlobalIgnores ][ ?useGlobalRulesFileList g_useGlobalRulesFileList ][ ?useDisableMessages g_useDisableMessages ][ ?checkCdsFuncs g_checkCdsFuncs ][ ?checkPvtFuncs g_checkPvtFuncs ][ ?checkPubFuncs g_checkPubFuncs ][ ?prefixes l_prefixList ][ ?checkCdsPrefixes g_checkCdsPrefixes ][ ?checkFuncPrefixes g_checkFuncPrefixes ][ ?tabulate g_tabulate ][ ?skPath t_skPath ][ ?codeVersion t_release ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Checks a SKILL file or context and reports potential errors and ways to clean up your code.

functions.name: slaAddCornerModelFile
functions.description: Adds a model file to a corner within a corner setup in the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode. The function creates the specified corner if it does not exist in the corner setup.

functions.name: slaAddCornerVariable
functions.description: Adds a corner variable to a corner of a corner setup in the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode. The function creates the specified corner if it does not exist in the corner setup.

functions.name: slaAddDocument
functions.description: Adds a document to a setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaAddSweepVariable
functions.description: Adds a sweep variable to a sweep setup in the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaAddToParametricSet
functions.description: Adds a variable to the specified parametric set in the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaAreParametricSetsEnabled
functions.description: Checks if all parametric sets are enabled for the specified sweep setup in the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function.

functions.name: slaCreateCornerSetup
functions.description: Creates a corner setup in the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaCreateSimulationSetup
functions.description: Creates a simulation setup in the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function.

functions.name: slaCreateSweepSetup
functions.description: Creates a sweep setup in a setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaCreateVerificationSpace
functions.description: Creates a verification space in the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaExportSetup
functions.description: Exports the sweep setup, corner setup, simulation setup, and verification spaces to the SDB file in the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function.

functions.name: slaGetAllDocuments
functions.description: Retrieves a list of documents from the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaGetCornerModels
functions.description: Retrieves a list of corner models of corner setup from the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaGetCornerSetupCorners
functions.description: Retrieves a list of corners for a specified corner setup from the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaGetCornerSetups
functions.description: Retrieves a list of corner setups from the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaGetCornerVars
functions.description: Retrieves a list of corner variables of the specified corner setup from the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaGetDocumentAbsolutePath
functions.description: Retrieves the absolute path of a document in the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaGetParametricSets
functions.description: Retrieves a list of parametric sets from the specified sweep setup in the setup library cellview that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function.

functions.name: slaGetSimulationSetupRunOptionValue
functions.description: Retrieves the value of the run option for the specified simulation setup of the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function.

functions.name: slaGetSimulationSetupRunOptions
functions.description: Retrieves the list of run options for the specified simulation setup of the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function.

functions.name: slaGetSimulationSetups
functions.description: Retrieves the list of simulation setups from the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function.

functions.name: slaGetSweepSetupVars
functions.description: Retrieves a list of sweep setup variables from the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaGetSweepSetups
functions.description: Retrieves a list of sweep setups from the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaGetVerificationSpaces
functions.description: Retrieves a list of verification spaces from the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaGroupAsParametricSet
functions.description: Groups the variables as parametric set in sweep setup in the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in editable mode.

functions.name: slaImportCorners
functions.description: Imports corners into the setup library corner setup opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode. The file must be in CSV or SDB format.

functions.name: slaImportSetup
functions.description: Imports the sweep setup, corner setup, simulation setup, and verification spaces from the SDB file in the setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaImportSweeps
functions.description: Imports sweeps into the corner setup in a setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode. The supported file extensions are csv and sdb.

functions.name: slaOpenOrCreateView
functions.description: When this function is run in edit mode, it opens the specified view in edit mode if the view exists. Otherwise, it creates a new view. In read-only mode, the function opens the provided view in read-only mode. In both cases, invoking this function checks out the ADE Verifier license. You can initialize the view from the Virtuoso CIW or by using the *il script.

functions.name: slaRemoveCorner
functions.description: Removes a corner from the corner setup in a setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaRemoveCornerModel
functions.description: Removes a corner model file from the corner setup in a setup library view that is opened using the slaOpenOrCreateView function in edit mode.

functions.name: slaRemoveCornerSetup

functions.name: sort

functions.name: tcDumpTechFile
functions.description: Dumps the technology data in the specified binary technology database to the specified ASCII file.

functions.name: tcLoadTechFile
functions.description: Compiles the ASCII source file, opens the technology database in a (append) mode, and updates it with the compiled data. The default action is to merge the newly compiled data with the technology database already loaded into virtual memory. If you set t_mode to w, the system deletes the data in virtual memory and loads the newly compiled data. If you specify the sections to compile, this function compiles only the specified sections and preserves the data in the other sections.

functions.name: tcNewLibDisplayRefTechForm
functions.description: Opens the Reference Existing Technology Libraries form that displays the reference technology file library choices for the newly created technology library with the specified name.

functions.name: tcQcInstallDevices
functions.description: Opens the Install Device form. This is equivalent to clicking the Install Device button in the Technology Tool Box form.

functions.name: tcRegPostAttachTrigger
functions.description: Registers a trigger function the system calls after attaching a design library to a technology library. You can use this function to keep track of the technology library of a design library is attached to.

functions.name: tcRegPostDumpTrigger
functions.description: Registers a trigger function the system calls after it dumps a technology database. The s_function argument is a SKILL procedure with three arguments: the database identifier of the technology database, the port (or print destination) for the dump file, and the name of the dump file.Trigger functions are called in order of priority, with 0 having the highest priority. If you do not specify a priority argument, the default is the lowest priority (that is, it is executed after any other trigger function that specifies a priority).

functions.name: tcRegPostLoadTrigger
functions.description: Registers a trigger function the system calls after loading a technology file. The s_function argument is a SKILL procedure with two arguments: the database identifier of the technology database and the name of the ASCII technology file you are loading.Trigger functions are called in order of priority, with 0 having the highest priority. If you do not specify a priority argument, the default is the lowest priority (that is, it executes after any other trigger function that specifies a priority).

functions.name: tcRegPostSetRefTrigger
functions.description: Registers a trigger function that the system calls after setting the reference for the specified technology database. You can use this function to keep track of the technology database reference when a technology database is updated.

functions.name: tcRegPreDumpTrigger
functions.description: Registers a trigger function the system calls before dumping a technology database. The s_function argument is a SKILL procedure with three arguments: the database identifier of the technology database, the port (or print destination) for the dump file, and the name of the dump file.Trigger functions are called in order of priority, with 0 having the highest priority. If you do not specify a priority argument, the default is the lowest priority (that is, it executes after any other trigger function that specifies a priority).

functions.name: tcRegPreLoadTrigger
functions.description: Registers a trigger function the system calls before loading a technology database. The s_function argument is a SKILL procedure with two arguments: the database identifier of the technology database and the name of the ASCII technology file you are loading.Trigger functions are called in order of priority, with 0 having the highest priority. If you do not specify a priority argument, the default is the lowest priority (that is, it executes after any other trigger function that specifies a priority).

functions.name: tcUnregPostAttachTrigger
functions.description: Unregisters post attach trigger so the system does not call the function after attaching a design library to a technology library.

functions.name: tcUnregPostDumpTrigger
functions.description: Unregisters the specified postdump trigger function so the system does not call it after dumping a technology database.

functions.name: tcUnregPostLoadTrigger
functions.description: Unregisters the specified trigger function so the system does not call it after loading a technology file.

functions.name: tcUnregPostSetRefTrigger

functions.name: tcUnregPreDumpTrigger

functions.name: tcUnregPreLoadTrigger
functions.description: Unregisters the specified preload trigger function so the system does not call it before loading a technology file.

functions.name: techCloseTechFile
functions.description: Changes the status of the technology database to closed and decrements the close count. The technology database is not purged from virtual memory until the system needs to use the memory. Internally, the system maintains a count of the number of times you open and close a specific technology database. The count increments when you open and decrements when you close. When the close count is 0 and the system needs more virtual memory, it purges the technology database from virtual memory.

functions.name: techGetDeviceClass

functions.name: techGetDeviceClassProp

functions.name: techGetLPsByPriority

functions.name: techGetLabelLayers

functions.name: techGetLayerAbbrev

functions.name: techGetPrGenViaRules
functions.description: Returns a list of all via specifications containing standard via definitions in the specified technology database.

functions.description: Returns a list of the layers in the specified technology database that are valid masterslice layers. A masterslice layer is any layer that meets both of the following conditions:1. The layer is explicitly assigned one of the following functions: nwell, pwell, ndiff, pdiff, or poly. ASCII technology file location: in the functions subsection of the layerRules section.2. If the technology database contains a LEFDefaultRouteSpec constraint group, the layer is not listed in the validLayers section of that constraint group.

functions.name: techGetPrNonDefaultParams
