functions.description: Chops the fluid shape of a given instance. The information of the chop rectangle or polygon is provided by chopShapeData which is a class object of vfoShapeData. The shape data points are in the design coordinates. This function transforms the chopShapeData before chopping the fluid shape.Note: The Chop command for fluid Pcells does not pass these arguments. This function updates the relevant Pcell parameters. If the chop operation results in multiple shapes, it may need to create multiple Pcell instances.

functions.name: vfoConvertToPolygon
functions.description: Converts the fluid shape of the given instance to a polygon. This is used for instances containing path type fluid shape. The Convert to Polygon command for fluid Pcells does not pass these arguments. This function updates the relevant Pcell parameters.

functions.name: vfoCreateAutoFGR
functions.description: Wraps obstacles in wrap mode on clicking an obstacle if AUTO mode is selected in the Device field of the Create Guard Ring form. This function is used to specify the bindkey for creation of FGR in auto mode.

functions.name: vfoCreateObstruction
functions.description: Creates obstruction or tunnel on a given instance that has an associated fluid shape. A tunnel helps you to cut a specific layer-purpose of a guard ring device for connectivity purpose. There are four types of tunneling mechanisms-Path, Rectangle, Polygon, and Overlapping Shape. For procedural details about creating tunnels using GUI, refer to the Creating a Tunnel Through a Fluid Guard Ring section in the Editing Fluid Guard Rings chapter of the Virtuoso Fluid Guard Ring User Guide.Note: To remove any existing obstructions, use the vfoDeleteObstruction SKILL function.

functions.name: vfoCreateObstructions
functions.description: Creates obstruction or tunnel on a given instance that has an associated fluid shape. A tunnel helps you to cut a specific layer-purpose of a guard ring device for connectivity purpose. There are four types of tunneling mechanisms-Path, Rectangle, Polygon, and Overlapping Shape. For procedural details about creating tunnels using GUI, refer to the Creating a Tunnel Through a Fluid Guard Ring section in the Editing Fluid Guard Rings chapter of the Virtuoso Fluid Guard Ring User Guide.Note: To remove any existing obstructions, use the vfoDeleteObstruction SKILL function.

functions.name: vfoCreateShapeData
functions.description: Allocates, initializes, and returns an instance of the subclass of the vfoShapeData of the given shape type.

functions.name: vfoDeleteObstruction
functions.description: Deletes the obstruction or tunnel on a given instance that has an associated fluid shape. This SKILL function is equivalent to healing.For procedural details about healing an obstruction using GUI, refer to the Healing a Fluid Guard Ring section in the Editing Fluid Guard Rings chapter of the Virtuoso Fluid Guard Ring User Guide.Note: To create an obstruction, use the vfoCreateObstruction SKILL function.

functions.name: vfoDoSnapToSnapPattern
functions.description: Snaps the fluid object to the snap pattern.

functions.name: vfoDrawFluidShape
functions.description: Creates a dbObject corresponding to shapeData object in the given cellview on the given layer purpose pair.

functions.name: vfoGRCleanVersionCache
functions.description: Updates the index.pcl and cache.pcl files by removing any unused entries of sub-masters from these files. This is an alternative to cleaning the cache if you have disabled the automatic FGR cache cleaning mechanism described in the Automatic Cache Cleaning section, or even if the Automatic Cache Cleaning mechanism is enabled by you and would like to clean the FGR caches on-demand.

functions.name: vfoGRCompareParams
functions.description: Checks the equality of FGR instances. You override this function and can define its new equality for FGR instances. By default, it checks the value of the following parameters: verticalPitch, horizontalPitch, verticalSegWidth, and horizontalSegWidth. This function is called by the Merge command. For the Merge command to succeed, this function should return t for the two FGR instances being compared.

functions.name: vfoGRCreateDeviceClass
functions.description: Creates the device class definition for fluid guard ring (cdsGuardRing) in the given technology file. If the device class already exists in the technology file, it is updated when override is set to true.

functions.name: vfoGRDisableVersionCache
functions.description: Disables version cache for all instances that belong to the specified super-master list and found in the specified library, cell, or view. All instances are updated and the value of their createVersionCache parameter is set to 0.

functions.name: vfoGREnableVersionCache
functions.description: Enables version cache on all instances currently not cache-enabled that belong to the specified list of FGR super-masters and found in the in the specified library, cell, or view. The createVersionCache parameter of such instances will get updated from 0 to the VFO version of the current Virtuoso session.

functions.name: vfoGRGeometry
functions.description: Calls three generic functions in the following order: vfoSfInitialize(pcell), vfoSfDraw(pcell), and then vfoSfFinalize(pcell) for drawing the fluid Pcell geometry.NOTE: This is the top-level entry point to the vfo space-filling Pcell.

functions.name: vfoGRGetCommonQPtr
functions.description: Returns the common queue pointer of the Create Guard Ring form customized by you.

functions.name: vfoGRGetCreateFormFieldProp
functions.description: Gets the value of a property assigned to an existing field or GUI component displayed on the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRGetCreateFormIdentifier
functions.description: Returns the unique identifier string used for creating the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRGetCreateFormPointer
functions.description: Returns the form pointer corresponding to the unique identifier that creates the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRGetExtraArgument
functions.description: Retrieves the value of user-defined fields, that is, list of `key value' pair set using the vfoGRSetExtraArgument SKILL function.

functions.name: vfoGRGetExtraArgumentName
functions.description: Returns the extra parameter names in a list. The end user should override this function for its class that has been extended from vfoAdvGuardRing.

functions.name: vfoGRGetQueuePointer
functions.description: Returns the pointer corresponding to the name of the queue of the customized Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRMaximizeShapes
functions.description: Tries all possible combinations of fillStyle and decompositionMode to find the combination that maximizes the number of shapes, and thereby the number of contact cuts.

functions.name: vfoGRNewCreateForm
functions.description: Creates the new Create Guard Ring form, that is, a new form pointer along with the unique fields and form symbol.

functions.name: vfoGRRegCreateFormUpdateCallback
functions.description: Registers the user-defined form customization procedure. This procedure gets called for the particular form pointer after the vfoGRUpdateCreateForm trigger is called.

functions.name: vfoGRSetCreateFormAllFieldsInvisible
functions.description: Sets the visible property for the predefined system fields, except the Technology and Device fields, on the Create Guard Ring form. This function cannot be used to set the properties of fields that you add while customizing the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRSetCreateFormFieldProp
functions.description: Sets the properties of the fields or components displayed on the Create Guard Ring form.

functions.name: vfoGRSetExtraArgument
functions.description: Makes the values of the user-defined GUI components available for processing to the FGR infrastructure that resides in Virtuoso, and sets the corresponding CDF parameters. This SKILL function helps in binding the front-end data for back-end processing.

functions.name: vfoGRSmoothen
functions.description: Removes the small notches in the given direction from the fluid shape of the given fluid Pcell instance. The temporary shapes are created on tmpLpp.

functions.name: vfoGRUpdateCreateFormSize
functions.description: Resizes the Create Guard Ring forms, including the form used for modgens. This function updates the size of all tabs and subtabs proportionately. However, there is no change in the size of the fields on the form.

functions.name: vfoGRUpdateTunnelLPPs
functions.description: Returns the layer-purpose pairs on which tunnelling is allowed. The VFO infrastructure selects common layer-purpose present in the FGR and LPPs returned by the function vfoGRUpdateTunnelLPPs. If the function vfoGRUpdateTunnelLLPs returns nil, all FGR layer-purposes are displayed on the Create Tunnel in Fluid Object form.

functions.name: vfoGRUpdateTunnelOptions
functions.description: Returns the list of supported options for FGR tunnel shape types. VFO infrastructure uses options returned by this function and checks with the existing options. The first value returned by this function is selected by default when the Create Tunnel in Fluid Object form opens. If the vfoGRUpdateTunnelOptions function is not defined, returns nil, or any invalid option is returned, all tunnel options are displayed on the Create Tunnel in Fluid Object form.

functions.name: vfoGRUpdateVersionCache
functions.description: Updates the vfoCreateVersion parameter of an instance to the current Virtuoso version. If the vfoCreateVersion parameter is set to 0, the vfoGRUpdateVersionCache function does not update the vfoCreateVersion parameter to the latest Virtuoso version. You have to call the vfoGREnableVersionCache function to update this parameter to the latest Virtuoso version. If the vfoCreateVersion parameter is set to an older Virtuoso version and the image of the sub-master is not found in the cache files, cache.pcl and index.pcl, the vfoGRUpdateVersionCache function does not update the vfoCreateVersion parameter to the latest Virtuoso version. You have to call the vfoGRDisableVersionCache function and then the vfoGREnableVersionCache function to update this parameter to the latest Virtuoso version.

functions.name: vfoGetDeviceClassParam
functions.description: Returns the class parameter of the specified cdsGuardRing device. This SKILL function also supports the incremental technology database (ITDB). Therefore, the information is retrieved for FGR devices in both the library and the referenced library.

functions.name: vfoGetDeviceFormalParam
functions.description: Returns the implementation formal parameter of the specified cdsGuardRing device. This SKILL function also supports ITDB. Therefore, the information is retrieved for FGR devices in both the library and the referenced library.

functions.name: vfoGetFileListWithLoadSequence
functions.description: Returns a list of vfo*.ils filenames with their loading sequence.

functions.name: vfoGetImplementationClassName
functions.description: Returns the value of the vfoGRImpl class parameter, that is the implementation class name, of an FGR device from the specified library. This SKILL function also supports the incremental technology database (ITDB). Therefore, the information is retrieved for FGR devices in both the library and the referenced library.

functions.name: vfoGetInstWithMissingCache
functions.description: Returns three lists of dbIDs. The first is the list of dbIDs of all instances whose submaster is not found in index.pcl file. The second is the list of dbIDs of all instances whose submaster is found in index.pcl file but not found in cache.pcl file because the file is corrupt or missing. The third is the list of dbIDs of instances whose submaster is not found because the supermaster has been updated after instance creation.

functions.name: vfoGetParam
functions.description: Returns the value of a CDF parameter for the given object.

functions.name: vfoGetProtocolClassName
functions.description: Returns the symbol naming the protocol class to use with the fluid Pcell functions.

functions.name: vfoGetVersion
functions.description: Returns the version of the VFO SKILL code used in Virtuoso. This SKILL function is available from IC6.1.6 ISR2 and ICADV12.1 ISR4 onwards.

functions.name: vfoGrCreateCDF
functions.description: Creates fluid guard ring CDF parameters on the given library, cell view of the fluid guard ring device. It deletes any existing CDF parameters on the device.

functions.name: vfoInstallFluidDeviceFiles
functions.signature: vfoInstallFluidDeviceFiles([ ?installPath t_installPath ][ ?overwrite { t | nil } ][ ?showMsg { t | nil } ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Loads a set of Cadence-supplied SKILL files in a specific sequence in the Virtuoso environment. These files are required to work with fluid guard rings. These files are automatically loaded when you start Virtuoso.

functions.name: vfoIsCommandInDragMode
functions.description: Returns t if the vfo-related command is in drag mode, else returns nil.

functions.name: vfoIsGuardRing
functions.description: Returns t if the object to be queried is a valid guard ring instance, else returns nil.

functions.name: vfoMergeInstances
functions.description: Merges the fluid Pcell instances inst1 and inst2. The Merge command for fluid Pcells does not pass these arguments. This function updates the relevant Pcell parameters.

functions.name: vfoPostChopCBHandler
functions.description: Registers or deregisters a user-defined callback function that is called after the chop command completes on an FGR instance. You can do post-processing on the edited FGR instance in the registered callback function.

functions.name: vfoPostReshapeCBHandler
functions.description: Registers or deregisters a user-defined callback function that is called after the reshape command completes on an FGR instance. You can do post-processing on the edited FGR instance in the registered callback function.

functions.name: vfoPostSplitCBHandler
functions.description: Registers or deregisters a user-defined callback function that is called after the split command completes on an FGR instance. You can do post-processing on the edited FGR instance in the registered callback function.

functions.name: vfoPostStretchCBHandler
functions.description: Registers or deregisters a user-defined callback function that is called after the stretch command completes on an FGR instance. You can do post-processing on the edited FGR instance in the registered callback function.

functions.name: vfoReInstallAllFluidGuardRingDevices
functions.description: Reinstalls all the FGR devices in the specified technology file.

functions.name: vfoReInstallGuardRingDevice
functions.description: Reinstalls the specified FGR devices in the specified technology file.

functions.name: vfoRotateInstance
functions.description: Applies the rotation angle on the FGR instance. This function applies to Pcells.

functions.name: vfoSetParam
functions.description: Sets the value of a CDF parameter to the given value and triggers the callback, if any. The callback is triggered recursively so that if the callback changes another parameter, that callback is also triggered, recursively.

functions.name: vfoSetParams
functions.description: Sets the value of multiple parameters in a single call. The l_paramlist argument contains a list of parameter name and value pairs.

functions.name: vfoSetProtocolClassName
functions.description: Sets the protocol class for fluid Pcell for the given Pcell supermaster. This function gets called in the Pcell code for creating the supermaster of a fluid guard ring device in a text file.

functions.name: vfoSfDraw
functions.description: Draws the Pcell geometries using the information populated by the vfoSfInitialize function.

functions.name: vfoSfFinalize
functions.description: Performs any required cleanup.

functions.name: vfoSfInitialize
functions.description: This is the initialization function that is called during space-filling Pcell evaluation. This function initializes the slots and populates other required information for Pcell drawing (vfoSfDraw).

functions.name: vfoSfOuterEdgeCornerContRemoval
functions.description: Removes the ear-vertex and end-corner contacts from the corners of an FGR to ensure it is created with a smaller footprint. This is achieved by allowing specification of enclosure values lesser than the maximum value, but greater than the minimum value of the minOppExtension rule.

functions.name: vfoSmoothen
functions.description: Smoothens the given polygon shape. If the shape is not a polygon, then the shape is returned unchanged.

functions.name: vfoSupportsAbut?
functions.description: Checks if the Abut operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsChop?
functions.description: Checks if the Chop operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsConvertToPolygon?
functions.description: Checks if the Convert to Polygon operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsCreateObstruction?
functions.description: Checks if the Create Obstruction (Tunnel) operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsCreateObstructions?
functions.description: Checks if the Create Obstruction (Tunnel) operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsDeleteObstruction?
functions.description: Checks if the Delete Obstruction (Heal) operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsMerge?
functions.description: Checks if the Merge operation is supported on the given instance.

functions.name: vfoSupportsRotation
functions.description: Checks of the Pcell instance supports rotation.

functions.name: vfoSupportsUpdateModelShape?
functions.description: Checks if the fluid shape of the given instance can be modified. This function is called by commands that directly update the fluid shape, such as Stretch, Reshape, Split, and Align.

functions.name: vfoSupportsVersionCache
functions.description: Checks whether the Version Cache Management feature is supported on the specified instance.

functions.name: vfoTransformFluidShape
functions.description: Applies the transform to the given shapeData. This function modifies the given shapeData object and returns it.

functions.name: vfoTunnelHigherMetalLayers
functions.description: Enables tunneling of high metal layers in a stacked metal fluid guard ring device. This function is called during the Pcell evaluation of fluid guard ring devices.

functions.name: vfoUpdateModelShape
functions.description: Updates the given fluid shape of the Pcell instance. The new shape type and points are specified in the newShapeType and newPointList arguments, respectively. The newPointList points are in the design coordinates. This function transforms the newPointList before updating the fluid shape. The Edit command for fluid shapes does not pass these arguments. This function updates the relevant Pcell parameters.

functions.name: vfpAlignPins
functions.description: Aligns a list of target pins with respect to the position of a list of reference pins.

functions.name: vfpAutoPin

functions.description: Searches for net shapes in the specified window or cellview and automatically creates boundary and buried pins on these net shapes.

functions.name: vfpCPHGenPhysicalHier
functions.description: Generates a hierarchical floorplan. It takes the Floorplan property file and the names of the logical and physical top cellview names as inputs. The top logical lib cellview name should match the names provided in the Floorplan property file.

functions.name: vfpCPHGenPhysicalHierNoPropFile
functions.description: Generates a physical configuration without a Floorplanning property file.

functions.name: vfpCPHLoadFloorplanFile
functions.description: Populates the CPH form in Soft Block mode by using the Floorplan property file.

functions.name: vfpCreateBoundaryPinsForSelectedShapes
functions.description: Creates boundary pins on selected shapes.

functions.name: vfpHiPushPreRoutesDown
functions.description: Invokes the GUI for pushing pre-routes down.

functions.name: vfpLoadPhysicalView
functions.signature: vfpLoadPhysicalView(t_sourceLibNamet_sourceCellNamet_sourceViewNamet_targetLibNamet_targetCellNamet_targetViewName[ ?updateInstances g_updateInstances ][ ?updateInstanceOptions l_updateInstanceOptions ][ ?updateDesignOptions l_updateDesignOptions ][ ?updateSelectedNets l_updateSelectedNets ][ ?loadPins s_updatePins ][ ?mapperFile t_fileName ][ ?addGeometries g_addGeometries ][ ?addGeometryOptions l_addGeometryOptions ][ ?updateBoundaries g_updateBoundaries ][ ?updateBoundaryOptions l_updateBoundaryOptions ][ ?replaceRows g_replaceRows ][ ?replaceRowOptions l_replaceRowOptions ][ ?replaceBlockages g_replaceBlockages ][ ?replaceHalos g_replaceHalos ][ ?replaceObstructionOptions l_replaceObstructionOptions ][ ?transferConstraints g_transferConstraints ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Updates the instances, pins, geometries, and P&R information from a source cellview to a target cellview. The source cellview acts as a template to perform the following in the target cellview:

functions.name: vfpPinConnectivitySetting
functions.description: This function takes no arguments. It invokes a GUI to enable the pin connectivity information setting.

functions.name: vfpPinSnapToEdge
functions.signature: vfpPinSnapToEdge(?cv d_cv[ ?pinIOType { input | output | inputOutput } ][ ?pinTermNames l_pinTermNames ][ ?edge { Left | Right | Top | Bottom | Nearest } ][ ?layerName t_layerName ][ ?skipTracks x_numTracks ][ ?honorCurrentLocation { t | nil } ][ ?verboseMode { t | nil } ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Snaps pins to the specified edge. You can select pins by specifying either their I/O types or terminal names. You can also change the pin layers and skip tracks between pins.

functions.name: vfpPtAddPinResizeEstimator
functions.description: Register a custom SKILL function for resizing pins. This registered function is passed as a parameter to vfpPtRunPinResizeEstimator to resize pins.

functions.name: vfpPtGetPinResizeEstimators
functions.description: Retrieves a list of registered pin resize estimator SKILL functions. You can specify whether the list must include only the function nicknames or both the function names and their nicknames.

functions.name: vfpPtLoadPinResizeFile
functions.description: Loads the specified SKILL file containing pin-resize functions.

functions.name: vfpPtRemovePinResizeEstimator
functions.description: Deregisters the given pin resize estimator SKILL function.

functions.name: vfpPtRunPinResizeEstimator
functions.signature: vfpPtRunPinResizeEstimator(d_topCellViewIDt_nickname?mode { all | selected | specify }?pinList l_pinList)=> t / nil
functions.description: Runs the given registered pin resize estimator SKILL function on pins as specified in the mode argument.

functions.name: vfpPushPreRoutesDown
functions.signature: vfpPushPreRoutesDown(t_topCVLibNamet_topCVCellNamet_topCVViewNamet_softBlockInstNamet_targetLibNamet_targetCellNamet_targetViewNameg_pushCloseWireBlkgg_rebindInst[ g_pushOverlappingBlockages ][ g_pushPowerNetGeometry ][ g_pushRegularNetGeometry ][ g_pushRow ][ g_pushWSP ][ g_pushWholeShape ][ g_pushSelection ][ g_pushFloatingShapes ][ t_pushMode ( Auto Push | Create Net & Push with Feed Thru Pins | Push as Blockage ) ][ l_pushLPPs ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Pushes the top-level power structures of a cellview over a specified soft block instance into a target cellview.

functions.name: vfpReportIOPadLocation
functions.description: Prints the IO pad information in formatted manner for all the pads which are placed in the IO rows within the design.

functions.name: vfpSbDefineObstruction
functions.signature: vfpSbDefineObstruction(l_PhysLCVt_obstructionType[ ?topOffset n_topOffset ][ ?bottomOffset n_BottomOffset ][ ?leftOffset n_LeftOffset ][ ?rightOffset n_RightOffset ][ ?layerName t_layerName ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Creates placement, routing, or other obstructions based on the obstructionType argument. All conditions that are enforced for these obstructions through GUI-based flow are applicable here. For example, only one placement blockage would be applied per soft block. If a second placement blockage is applied through this API, a warning is issued. The latest applied placement blockage will not replace the existing placement blockage.

functions.name: vfpSbDeleteObstruction
functions.signature: vfpSbDeleteObstruction(l_PhysLCVt_obstructionType[ ?topOffset n_topOffset ][ ?bottomOffset n_BottomOffset ][ ?leftOffset n_LeftOffset ][ ?rightOffset n_RightOffset ][ ?layerName t_layerName ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the specified obstruction.

functions.name: vfpSbEditIOPin
functions.signature: vfpSbEditIOPin(l_PhysLCVt_termName[ ?lpp txl_lpp ][ ?width n_width ][ ?height n_height ][ ?number x_number ][ ?criticality x_criticality ][ ?sigType t_sigType ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Edits attributes of the pin that is associated with the specified termName.

functions.name: vfpSbEditSoftBlockType
functions.description: Edits the blockType of the specified soft block.

functions.name: vfpSbSetPolygonalBoundary
functions.description: Specifies the boundary attributes of soft blocks that are polygonal in shape.

functions.name: vfpSbSetRectangularBoundary
functions.description: Specifies the boundary vertices of the rectangular soft block.

functions.name: vfreq
functions.description: Returns the voltage of a net at a specified frequency or at all frequencies in the frequency domain.

functions.name: vfreqterm
functions.signature: vfreqterm(s_anat_terminal[ freq x_freq ])=> o_waveform | g_value | nil
functions.description: Returns the voltage of a terminal at a specified frequency or at all frequencies in the frequency domain.

functions.name: vh
functions.description: Returns the voltage on a net at a specified harmonic or at all harmonics in the frequency domain.

functions.name: vhdlHiImport
functions.description: Builds and displays the VHDL Import form.

functions.name: vhdlHiInvokeToolBox
functions.description: Invokes the VHDL Toolbox window.

functions.name: vhdlImport
functions.description: Opens VHDL In to let you import a list of VHDL source files into the specified library with the given parameters. The parameters are the names of the VHDL In parameters, passed in as a disembodied property list. Optionally, it can run VHDL In as a background process (vhdlin) and/or display the results interactively.

functions.name: vhdlPinListToVHDL
functions.description: Allows the generation of VHDL views from an intermediate pin list format.

functions.name: vhdlRegisterSimulator
functions.signature: vhdlRegisterSimulator([ parserCallBack ][ analyzerCallBack ][ analyzerFileExt ][ elaboratorCallBack ][ simulatorCallBack ][ dataDirCallBack ][ dataFileCallBack ][ workLibCallBack ])=> t / nil
functions.description: To register your callbacks, add the procedures for the callbacks in some file, say myfile.il that is in the /home/xyz directory and add the following lines to the .cdsinit file in your home directory:

functions.name: vhdlToPinList
functions.description: Translates a VHDL cellview into an intermediate pin list format.

functions.name: vhmsCompilationFailure
functions.description: Informs about the compilation failures of the file specified with the fileName parameter. A compilation error message is displayed and you can open the file for editing by clicking 'Yes'.

functions.name: vhmsDefaultEdit
functions.description: Opens an existing file or creates a template and opens it in an editor. If the mode is set to r, which indicates read-only then it tries to open an existing file.

functions.name: vhmsGetCellParameters
functions.description: Returns the CDF parameters of the vhdl generics. The sub-list returned contains the name of the generic, the default value, and the type.

functions.name: vhmsPinListToVHDLAMS
functions.description: Creates a vhdlams entity, package, body, configuration, or architecture depending on the view name. Specify the view name as entity, package, body, or configuration for creating an entity, package, body, or configuration respectively. If nothing is specified, an architecture view is created. The view is created in ./libName/cellName/viewName.

functions.name: vhmsSaveFile
functions.description: Compiles the vhms file. If the symbol does not exist, it displays a prompt to create the symbol. If the compilation fails, it calls the vhmsCompilationFailure function.

functions.name: vhmsSymbolToPinListGen
functions.description: Generates a pin list from the symbol.

functions.name: vhmsToPinList
functions.description: Translates a VHDLAMS cellview into an intermediate pin list format. The pin list represents all the ports to the VHDLAMS description and their directions, such as input, output, and inout.

functions.name: vhmsUpdateCellCDFParams
functions.description: Updates the CDF parameters by reading all the parameters from the pin list. The CDF is updated if a given parameter does not exist in the CDF.

functions.name: vhterm
functions.signature: vhterm(s_anat_terminal[ harmonic x_hlist ])=> o_waveform | g_value | nil
functions.description: Returns the voltage on a terminal at the specified harmonic or at all the harmonics in the frequency domain.

functions.name: vi, vii, vil
functions.signature: vi([ S_fileName ])=> t / nilvii[ S_fileName ])=> t / nilviii[ S_fileName ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Edits a file using the vi editor. This is an nlambda function. Edits the named file using the vi editor, and optionally includes (vii) or loads (vil) the file into SKILL after exiting the editor. These functions are just variants of ed, edi, and edl with explicit request for using the vi editor.

functions.name: viaFindTransitions
functions.description: Returns the list of transitions of the given constraint group setup object found between the specified top and bottom layers.

functions.name: viaGenerateViasAtPoint
functions.signature: viaGenerateViasAtPoint(w_windowId | d_cellViewIdl_pointt_viaOptionsObject[ ?topAndBottomLayers lt_topAndBottomLayers ][ ?startLevel x_startLevel ][ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ])=> l_via / nil
functions.description: Generates vias with the specified options at a given location in the specified window or cellview.The figures present at the given location are queried, and if they form valid overlaps, vias are created to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaGenerateViasFromShapes
functions.signature: viaGenerateViasFromShapes(w_windowId | d_cellViewIdl_shapest_viaOptionsObject[ ?topAndBottomLayers lt_topAndBottomLayers ][ ?startLevel x_startLevel ][ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ])=> l_via / nil
functions.description: Generates vias from the specified shapes with the given via options in the specified window or cellview. If the specified shapes form valid overlaps, vias are created to connect the shapes.

functions.name: viaGenerateViasInArea
functions.signature: viaGenerateViasInArea(w_windowId | d_cellViewIdl_ptArrayt_viaOptionsObject[ ?topAndBottomLayers lt_topAndBottomLayers ][ ?startLevel x_startLevel ][ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ])=> l_via / nil
functions.description: Generates vias with the specified options within a given area in the specified window or cellview. The figures present at the given location are queried, and if they form valid overlaps, vias are created to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaGetViaOptions
functions.description: Returns a via options object from the specified constraint group. This via options object can be used by any SKILL procedure enabling generation or re-computation of vias.

functions.name: viaLoadViaVariants
functions.description: Loads the via variants from the specified cellview for the Create Via command.

functions.name: viaRecomputeVias
functions.signature: viaRecomputeVias(w_windowId | d_cellViewIdl_viat_viaOptionsObject[ ?startLevel x_startLevel ][ ?stopLevel x_stopLevel ])=> l_via / nil
functions.description: Recomputes the via list with the given via options in the specified window or cellview. The figures connected by the vias are searched and the vias are recomputed with the via options specified to connect the figures.

functions.name: viaRecomputeViasAtPoint

functions.name: viaRegisterCreateViaInitCallback
functions.description: Registers the function to be called each time the Create Via form is opened. The registered function name should be a valid SKILL procedure and the init procedure that is registered should be defined without arguments.

functions.name: viaRegisterPostViaEngineCallback
functions.description: Registers the function name to be called after the viaEngine processing. The registered function name should be a valid SKILL procedure. The postViaEngine procedure that is registered should be declared with one argument, the viaEngineContext. This argument is a user type representing the context of the viaEngine call. The viaRegisterPostViaEngineCallback function that is registered should be declared with the viaEngineContext argument. This argument is a user type representing the context of the viaEngine call. The function returns t or nil. If nil is returned by the viaRegisterPostViaEngineCallback function registered, vias are not created.

functions.name: viaRegisterPostViaServerCallback
functions.description: Registers the function name to be called after the via server processing. The function should be a valid SKILL procedure. The postViaServer procedure that is registered should be declared with three arguments, the constraintGroup, the overlapInfo, and the list of viaViaDef user type computed by the via server. The postViaServer procedure returns a list of viaViaDef user types. You can update all viaViaDefs specified in the viaViaDef argument. You also have the option to modify the sequence of the viaViaDef list.

functions.name: viaRegisterPreViaEngineCallback
functions.description: Registers the function name to be called before via engine processing. The registered function name should be a valid SKILL procedure. The preViaEngine procedure that is registered should be declared with one argument, viaEngineContext. This argument is a user type representing the context of the viaEngine call. The viaRegisterPreViaEngineCallback function that is registered should be declared with the viaEngineContext argument. This argument is a user type representing the context of the viaEngine call. The function returns t or nil. If nil is returned by the viaRegisterPreViaEngineCallback function registered, vias are not created.

functions.name: vrfCheckTILPVersion
functions.description: Checks the version of the TILP from the given ID, which can be of an instance, cellview, library, or sub-master cellview. There are warnings and errors generated when checks are performed. Warning messages are issued for the TILP versions that are compatible with the current version of the tool. You need to upgrade the TILP only if the associated features are going to be used. For example, if you want to use a new feature, the die TILP needs to be updated. Error messages indicate that the TILP versions must be updated before use in the current version of the tool. Otherwise, the tool does not work as expected. For example, die TILP V1 is not compatible with the tool version post ICADVM18.1ISR10.

functions.description: Exports the die for IC layouts. The function supports both IO cell and Shape with overlapping label as Die Interface Type. It generates a package type library that contains abstract, Technology Independent Layout Pcells (TILPs), schematic, and symbol views. The abstract view is the base cellview for the Pcell generated layout, that is, TILP. The schematic is the wrapper schematic for the IC symbol. The symbol view is used to instantiate the generated die symbol in a package schematic.

functions.description: Exports the specified package layout if its sipObjectType value is set to package. Use the instanceNames argument to specify the instance names to search master views for identifying candidate IO cells to be exported. The IO cells to be exported should have the cellType defined as coverBump or pad. The shapes in the master views must match the front or back layer-purpose pairs specified in the SKILL function arguments. Only the sub-master views of the package instances and IO cells are processed, not the super-master views. To export a package layout, there should be top-level terminals in the layout. Also, all the package type instances in a package layout must be fully connected to top-level terminals.

functions.signature: vrtCheckDesign([ d_cvid ][ ?layers l_layers ][ ?region l_region ][ ?all { t | nil } | ?checkDeadEndPins ?checkDeviceTrims ?checkDiffPins?checkGatePins ?checkGridSanity ?checkPinWSPConformance ?checkSDPins?checkSymmetry ?checkTracks ?checkTrimValidity ?checkVias ][ ?showLog | ?logVios | ?createMarkers ])=> t / nil

functions.description: Creates an ID layer according to advanced node OppExtensionRules.

functions.description: Deletes the routing on the nets. The routing is done by the signal router or power router either on the whole cellview or on certain layers or a region of the design. It can also delete pre-routes of nets that are not generated by signal router or power router.

functions.name: vrtPowerRoute
functions.signature: vrtPowerRoute(d_cvid[ ?nets l_nets ][ ?layer l_layers ][ ?region l_region ][ ?options l_options ][ ?sharedTrack g_sharedTrack ][ ?net2WireTypes g_net2WireTypes ][ ?pullbacks g_pullbacks ][ ?postFixTrim g_postFixTrim ][ ?postFixMinLength g_postFixMinLength ][ ?postFixEolKeepout g_postFixEolKeepout ][ ?logFile g_logFile ][ ?appenToLog g_appendToLog ])=> t / nil

functions.signature: vrtRouteAssisted(d_cvid[ nets l_nets ][ layers l_layers ][ regionBox l_regionBox ][ ?generateSpine g_generateSpine ][ ?spineLayer g_spineLayer ][ ?connectPins g_connectPins ][ ?generateMesh g_generateMesh ][ ?meshBottomLayer t_meshBottomLayer ][ ?meshTopLayer t_meshTopLayer ][ ?meshSetting l_meshSetting ][ ?meshExtendPreRoute g_meshExtendPreRoute ][ ?finishRouting g_finishRouting ][ ?preferredLayerBottom t_preferredLayerBottom ][ ?preferredLayerTop t_preferredLayerTop ][ ?postFixTrim g_postFixTrim ][ ?postFixMinLength g_postFixMinLength ][ ?postFixEolKeepout g_postFixEOLKeepout ][ ?minSkipTrack d_minSkipTrack ][ ?createFigGroup g_createFigGroup ])=> t / nil

functions.description: Runs the ART spine generator and the spine router together.

functions.name: vsaCreateMarker
functions.description: Creates a point marker with the specified attributes. When this marker is created successfully, it appears in the Misc tab of Annotation Browser.

functions.name: vsaDescendView
functions.description: Descends in the hierarchy and opens the child view of the design in Virtuoso for running Voltus-Fi-L.

functions.name: vsaLoadEM
functions.description: Specifies that the EM analysis results should be loaded. Before specifying this function, ensure that the EM results file and the EM technology file are specified.

functions.name: vsaLoadIR
functions.description: Specifies that the IR drop analysis results should be loaded. Before specifying this function, ensure that the IR drop results filename is specified.

functions.name: vsaLoadNets
functions.description: Specifies the nets to be loaded in the Voltus-Fi GUI.

functions.name: vsaLoadSecondaryLayers
functions.description: Enables the loading of data for all layers in the Voltus-Fi GUI.

functions.name: vsaOpenLayout
functions.description: Opens the design in Virtuoso in the read-only mode.

functions.name: vsaOpenSchematic
functions.description: Opens the design on the Virtuoso layout for running Voltus-Fi-L.

functions.name: vsaSelectFailedNets
functions.description: Specifies that EM analysis results for only those nets that failed the EM check should be plotted. It enables the Show Only Failed option in the GUI.

functions.name: vsaSetDfiiLayerMapFileName
functions.description: Specifies the DFII layer map filename that provides the mapping between the extractor-generated xDSPF file layer names and the DFII layer names.

functions.name: vsaSetEMIRConfig
functions.description: Loads the EMIR configuration file to be used for EMIR analysis in Voltus-Fi-XL. This file is specified before calling the vsaLoadEM() function.

functions.name: vsaSetEMLayerMapFileName
functions.description: Specifies the name of the layer map file to be used for the EM technology file. This file provides the mapping between layer names in the simulation database and those in the technology file. This function is only used for EM plots.

functions.name: vsaSetEMOnlyICTFile
functions.description: Specifies the name of the ICT file to be used for specifying the EM rules for plotting EM analysis results.

functions.name: vsaSetEMPlot
functions.description: Specifies the default plot for EM analysis results in Voltus-Fi.

functions.name: vsaSetEMResultsFile
functions.description: Specifies the simulation results file to be used for viewing the EMIR analysis results in Voltus-Fi-XL. This file contains the simulation database generated using the Spectre simulator.

functions.name: vsaSetEMTechFileName
functions.description: Specifies the name of the EM technology file that contains the EM rule information to be used for plotting EM results in Voltus-Fi.

functions.name: vsaSetEMTypes
functions.description: Specifies the types of EM analyses for which you want to plot EM results in Voltus-Fi. At least one analysis type must be selected.

functions.name: vsaSetFinerDisplayOff
functions.description: Disables the finer gradient for the specified layers while displaying the IR/EM plots on the Virtuoso layout. This function is specified after specifying the DFII layermap file and before loading the IR drop or EM analysis results.

functions.name: vsaSetIRPlot
functions.description: Specifies the default plot for IR drop analysis results in Voltus-Fi.

functions.name: vsaSetIRResultsFile
functions.description: Specifies the results file to be used for viewing the EMIR analysis results in Voltus-Fi-XL.

functions.name: vsaSetIRThreshold
functions.description: Sets the threshold value for viewing IR drop violations.

functions.name: vsaSetInputType
functions.description: Specifies the data base input options, parameter storage format (PSF) or vavo_db, for running IR drop and EM analyses in the Voltus-Fi-L GUI. The resultsType, startTime and stopTime arguments are only valid for the psf-based flow.

functions.name: vsaSetLRPShortedLayers
functions.description: Specifies the names of layers to be shorted for the least-resistive path (LRP) analysis.

functions.name: vsaSetLayersToMergeDuringResultsLoading
functions.description: Specifies the name of the metal layer and the corresponding cut-layer to be excluded from highlighting while plotting the EMIR analysis results. This function can be called multiple times to specify different pairs of metal and cut layers. Voltus-Fi honors all these calls. This function must be called before loading results in Voltus-Fi.

functions.name: vsaSetParallelLoading
functions.description: Enables parallel loading of OpenAccess shapes in the Voltus-Fi application interface.

functions.name: vsaSetQRCData
functions.description: Sets the Quantus inputs to enable solid shape highlighting for EMIR plots displayed on the Virtuoso layout.

functions.name: vsaShowAllResistors
functions.description: When specified, displays all resistors on the Voltus-Fi GUI including those for which there are no layout shapes matching the specified resistor coordinates. These resistors are displayed using stick diagrams.

functions.name: vsrDeletePreset
functions.signature: vsrDeletePreset(t_fileName[ ?directory t_directory ][ ?path t_path ][ ?confirmation g_confirmation ]) ;=> t / nil
functions.description: Deletes a preset file.

functions.name: vsrLoadPreset
functions.signature: vsrLoadPreset(t_fileName[ ?directory t_directory ][ ?execMode s_execMode ][ ?path t_path ]) ;=> t / nil
functions.description: Loads a preset file to the Wire Assistant form and the Virtuoso Space-based Router Options form.

functions.name: vsrSavePreset
functions.signature: vsrSavePreset(t_PresetLabelt_fileName[ ?directory t_directory ][ ?path t_path ][ ?tooltip t_tooltip ][ ?description t_description ][ ?iconFileName t_iconFileName ][ ?iconText t_iconText ][ ?location s_location ][ ?mode s_mode ][ ?envGroups l_envGroups ]) ;=> t / nil
functions.description: Saves the current settings to a preset file for later re-use.

functions.name: vswr
functions.description: Computes the voltage standing wave ratio.

functions.name: vtime
functions.description: Returns the voltage of a net at a specified time point or at all time points in the time domain.

functions.name: vtimeterm
functions.signature: vtimeterm(s_anat_terminal[ time n_time ])=> o_waveform | g_value | nil
functions.description: Returns the voltage of a terminal at a specified time point or at all time points in the time domain.

functions.name: vvDisplayBrowser
functions.description: Invokes the Results Browser within a window.

functions.name: vvDisplayCalculator
functions.description: Opens Calculator within a window. The function also displays the expression, if specified, in the buffer.

functions.name: vvGetGraphBackground
functions.description: Returns the background color of the specified Waveform window or the current Waveform window.

functions.name: vvSetGraphBackground
functions.description: Sets the specified background color to the specified Waveform window or the current Waveform window.

functions.name: vxfiLoadEMIRResults
functions.description: Specifies to load the EMIR results database file (.wdb) in the Voltus-XFi Result Browser. This function should be called after the vxfiOpenLayout function.

functions.name: vxfiLoadNets
functions.description: Specifies to load the nets in the Voltus-XFi Result Browser. This function should be called after the vxfiOpenLayout and vxfiLoadEMIRResults functions.

functions.name: vxfiOpenLayout
functions.description: Opens the design in the Virtuoso layout and launches Voltus-XFi Results Browser.

functions.name: vxfiSaveNetSummaryInfoToCSV
functions.description: Specifies to write the net summary given in the Voltus-XFi Results Browser interface to a text file in the current working directory.

functions.name: vxfiSessionConnect
functions.description: Registers a SKILL callback to be connected to a known signal or trigger emitted from a Voltus-XFi session. This function supports event-based trigger callbacks for pre-extraction, post-extraction, and pre-simulation. The function can be used to run LVS before running extraction, after running extraction, and before running simulation by registering the LVS run callback for these three events.

functions.name: vxfiSessionRegisterCreationCallback
functions.description: Registers a SKILL function as callback to be called whenever the event for which it is registered is occurred.

functions.name: vxfiSetLVSQueryOutputDirectory
functions.description: Specifies the path to the LVS output directory in which the input data is stored for extraction.

functions.name: vxfiSetLVSRunName
functions.description: Specifies the LVS run name to be used for extraction.

functions.name: wait
functions.signature: wait([ ?queue t_queueName ]jobName [ jobName2 jobName3 ... jobNameN ])=> t / nil
functions.description: Postpones processing of a script until the specified jobs complete. This command is ignored if distributed processing is not available.

functions.name: warn
functions.description: Buffers a warning message with given arguments inserted using the same format specification as sprintf, printf, and fprintf.

functions.name: watch
functions.description: Sets watchpoints on the specified variables. If watch() is called without arguments, it returns the list of variables being watched. If no variables are being watched, it returns nil.

functions.name: waveVsWave
functions.signature: waveVsWave([ ?x o_waveX ][ ?y o_waveY ][ ?xName t_xName ][ ?xUnits g_xUnits ][ ?yName t_yName ][ ?yUnits g_yUnits ])=> o_waveform / nil
functions.description: Creates an output waveform that uses y axes of the specified input waveforms as its x and y axes. When the specified input waveforms have different x axes, this function performs the interpolation.

functions.name: weAddCustomTransitionMenuItem
functions.description: Adds a menu item to the context-sensitive menu of the Create Bus command. You can use the added menu item to call the customer SKILL API. A bindkey is also assigned to the menu item.

functions.name: weCWHoldWidth
functions.description: This function is used for the create wire command when smart snapping is active. The width that is highlighted by smart snapping is used by the next wire that is being created even if the wire is created at another position than the current one.

functions.name: weCycleCutColorVia
functions.description: Cycles color of each cut when a via is inserted.

functions.name: weCyclePatternGravityLayerTransitionType
functions.description: In a WSP design, the wires are snapped to the layer up or down WSPs, which is the default behavior. However, if you want the wire only to snap to layer up or layer down a WSP, then you can use the patternGravityLayerTransitionType environment variable to cycle the layer for snapping. The environment variable has three values: patternGravityLayerUp, patternGravityLayerDown, and patternGravityLayerAny. The default value is patternGravityLayerAny.

functions.name: weGatherBusWires
functions.description: This function is used when the leHiCreateBus command is running. If the gap between the bus wires does not match the minSpacing rule, then the wires are gathered at the minimum spacing. If the wires are already at minSpacing, they will be spread to use the initial gap, which is the gap before executing the weGatherBusWires function.

functions.name: weGetAdjustedWidthForTracks
functions.description: Returns the Width Spacing Pattern (WSP) track information based on the inputs specified, such as layers, purposes, preferred directions, and shape dimensions, at a specific location.The purpose of the function is to check whether or not there are tracks at the given location.

functions.name: weGetCustomTransitionMenuItems
functions.description: Returns a list of custom transitions that were added to the Create Bus context-sensitive menu.

functions.name: weGetPathSegWidth
functions.description: Automatically handles the sqrt(2) conversion for diagonal path segments when their width is being queried. Unlike dbGetPathSegWidth which returns the value stored in the OpenAccess database for the width of diagonal pathSegs, this API does the sqrt(2) conversion appropriately and return the width value as it appears in the property editor form or object inspector assistant.

functions.name: weHiCopyRoute
functions.description: Starts the Edit - Wiring - Copy Route command. Press F3 in the canvas to open the Copy Route form. The command lets you copy layout geometries similar to a bus from a single routed net.

functions.name: weHiCycleViaDefDown
functions.description: Returns the current via definition for the pending vias when you start either the Create Wire, Create Stranded Wire, or the Create Bus command.

functions.name: weHiCycleViaDefUp
functions.description: Automatically cycles up the via definition for the pending vias, while using the Create Wire, Create Stranded Wire, or the Create Bus command.

functions.name: weHiEditBus
functions.description: Starts the Edit - Wiring - Bus command in Layout XL and higher tiers. The command lets you edit the width and spacing of bus bits. If no window ID is specified, the current window is used.

functions.name: weHiInteractiveRouting
functions.description: Maps the function to the leHiCreateGeometricWire (paths mode) SKILL function when the technology file is one of the fabric types, package, module, or board, and the active application is Virtuoso RF. Otherwise, the function is mapped to leHiCreateWire when the technology file is of the fabric type IC or the active application is not Virtuoso RF.

functions.name: weHiWireTo45
functions.description: Starts the interactive command that lets you select wire corners to create chamfering.

functions.name: weRemoveCustomTransitionMenuItem
functions.description: Removes a custom transition menu item from the Create Bus context-sensitive menu.

functions.name: weScaleMagnifierOrDecreaseWidth
functions.description: If the magnifier is opened, it performs a zoom out in the magnifier. Else if Create Bus, Create Wire, or Reshape command is being executed, decrease the width of the current wire.

functions.name: weScaleMagnifierOrIncreaseWidth
functions.description: If the magnifier is opened, it performs a zoom in the magnifier. Else if Create Bus, Create Wire, or Reshape command is being executed, increase the width of the current wire.

functions.name: weScrollOrCycleDownWireViaAlignment
functions.description: Lets you cycle through the wire and via alignment settings when a via is being dragged in the layout canvas. Else, the weScrollOrCycleDownWireViaAlignment SKILL API scroll down the layout canvas by pressing the Ctrl key and clicking the mouse wheel. This function works only in the Create Bus, Create Wire, and Reshape commands.

functions.name: weScrollOrCycleUpWireViaAlignment
functions.description: Lets you cycle through the wire and via alignment settings when a via is being dragged in the layout canvas. Else, the weScrollOrCycleUpWireViaAlignment SKILL API scrolls up the layout canvas by pressing the Ctrl key and clicking the mouse wheel. This function works only in the Create Bus, Create Wire, and Reshape commands.

functions.name: weSetPathSegWidth
functions.description: Automatically handles the sqrt(2) conversion for diagonal pathseg when the width is being changed. In addition, it also supports diagonal pathseg with custom extension and appropriately updates the values when the width is being changed.

functions.name: when
functions.description: Evaluates a condition.

functions.name: where
functions.signature: where([ g_unevaluated ][ x_depth ][ x_skip ][ p_port ])=> x_result
functions.description: Prints the functions on the stack and their arguments to the depth specified, or to the bottom of the stack, including the local variables and their bindings.

functions.name: whereIs
functions.description: Prints the last file loaded in debug mode in which a function was defined, as well as the starting line number.

functions.name: which
functions.description: Returns the absolute path of the given context file, or regular file or directory.

functions.name: while
functions.description: Repeatedly evaluates g_condition and the sequence of expressionsg_expr1 ... if the condition is true.

functions.name: window
functions.description: Given a window number, gets the window ID.

functions.name: windowp
functions.description: Checks whether the specified object is a valid window.

functions.name: write
functions.description: Prints a SKILL object using the default format for the data type of the value.

functions.name: writeTable
functions.description: Writes the contents of an association table to a file with one key/value pair per line.

functions.name: wspCheckActive
functions.signature: wspCheckActive(d_cellviewIdt_layerName | ?shapes g_selSetId[ ?region l_bBox ][ ?purpose t_purposeName ][ ?hilightSet g_hlSetId ][ ?markers g_markers [ ?vioLimit g_limit ] ][ ?checkColor g_checkColor ][ ?checkWidth g_checkWidth ][ ?checkWireType g_checkWireType ][ ?depth x_depth ][ ?mergeShapes g_mergeShapes [ ?ignoreColorOnMerge g_ignoreColor ] ][ ?mergePurposes l_mergePurposes ][ ?returnVioShapes g_returnVioShapes ][ ?excludeBlockageCheck g_excludeBlockageCheck ][ ?ignoreValidJogs g_ignoreValidJogs ])=> t / l_dbID / nil
functions.description: Checks shapes and blockages for width, color, and wireType conformance to the active width spacing pattern (WSP) on the specified layer or in the specified set. The active WSP can be for the global grid or a pattern region.

functions.name: wspCreateWSP
functions.signature: wspCreateWSP (d_cellViewIdt_name[ ?offset n_offset ][ ?repeatOffset g_repeatOffset ][ ?shiftColor g_shiftColor ][ ?allowedRepeatMode t_allowedRepeatMode ][ ?defaultRepeatMode t_defaultRepeatMode ][ ?wsspDef t_wsspDefName ]n_width n_space [ repeat n_repeats ] [ wireType t_wireType ] [ color n_mask ] [ displayPacket t_displayPacket ])=> d_wspId
functions.description: Creates a width spacing pattern (WSP) in the specified cellview. If the WSP already exists, it is replaced. This function creates simple WSPs and not nested lists. It checks the shapes for width, color, and wire type conformance to the active WSP on the specified layer or set. The active WSP can be for the global grid or a pattern region.

functions.name: wspCreateWSPByAttr
functions.signature: wspCreateWSPByAttr (d_cellViewIdlist (nil'name t_name'offset n_offset'shiftColor g_shiftColor'repeatOffset g_repeatOffset'allowedRepeatMode t_allowedRepeatMode'defaultRepeatMode t_defaultRepeatModetracks ( list(nil'width n_width'space n_space[ 'wireType t_wireType ][ 'color t_color ][ 'displayPacket t_displayPacket ])))=> d_wspId
functions.description: Creates a width spacing pattern (WSP). The pattern attributes are specified as a DPL. This function is specified with the wspGetFlatAttr function, which returns an existing pattern as a DPL. It lets you convert the existing patterns to a DPL, modify them, and recreate them.

functions.name: wspCreateWSPGroup
functions.description: Creates a width spacing pattern (WSP) group in the specified cellview. The argument after t_name are interpreted as group members.

functions.name: wspCreateWSSPDef
functions.signature: wspCreateWSSPDef (d_cellViewIdt_nametx_layert_directionn_period[ ?defaultActive t_defaultActive ][ ?allowedPatterns l_patterns ][ ?allowedPatternGroups l_groups ][ ?defPurpose tx_purpose ][ ?offset n_offset ][ ?orthogonalGrid t_orthogonalGrid])=> d_wsspDefId
functions.description: Creates a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview. If t_defaultActive is specified, the WSSPDef is created immediately. If it is not specified, the creation of WSSPDef is deferred until the first call to the function wspCreateWSP that references this WSSPDef. This enables all WSSPDefs to be specified first, followed by calls to wspCreateWSP that reference the WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspCreateWSSPDefByAttr
functions.description: Creates a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) using an attribute DPL.

functions.name: wspDeleteCellViewAllWSPData
functions.description: Deletes all the width spacing pattern (WSP) data from the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspDeleteMetalFill
functions.signature: wspDeleteMetalFill (d_cellViewIdt_LayerName?removeTrim g_removeTrim?removePatch g_removePatch?removePassive g_removePassive)=> t / nil
functions.description: Deletes the shapes created by the wspMetalFillTrim() function.

functions.name: wspDumpToFile
functions.description: Creates a SKILL file that can be used to recreate the width spacing pattern (WSP) information in the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspGetLineEndGrids
functions.description: Returns a list of line-end grid names for the specified layer.

functions.name: wspGetWSSPDefLP
functions.description: Returns the layer and purpose name of a widthSpacingSnapPatternDef.

functions.name: wspRegionFindByLayer
functions.description: Returns a list of the width spacing pattern (WSP) region IDs for the specified routing layer name in a cellview.

functions.name: wspRegionFindByWSSPDef
functions.description: Returns a list of region IDs in the specified cellview for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef).

functions.name: wspRegionGetActivePattern
functions.description: Returns the name of the active pattern for a width spacing pattern (WSP) region.

functions.name: wspRegionGetAllowedPatternGroups
functions.description: Returns a list of names of allowed pattern groups for the specified width spacing pattern (WSP) region.

functions.name: wspRegionGetAllowedPatterns
functions.description: Returns a list with the names of the allowed patterns for a width spacing pattern (WSP) region. By default, this function returns the effective set of patterns by combining the allowed patterns and allowed pattern groups. You can use the g_excludeGroups argument to ignore the allowed pattern groups.

functions.name: wspRegionGetWSSPDef
functions.description: Returns the ID of the widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) to which the specified region is bound.

functions.name: wspSPDefFind
functions.description: Finds all the snapPatternDefs (SPDefs) that apply to the specified routing layer name. In a cellview, one SPDef or widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) per layer is enabled as a global grid. With the optional argument g_enabledOnly set to t, WSSPDefs that are enabled as global for the specified routing layer are returned.

functions.name: wspSetWSSPDefRegionPurpose
functions.description: Overrides the region purpose attribute for the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef).

functions.name: wspWSPFindByName
functions.description: Finds a width spacing pattern (WSP) by name in a cellview or in the technology database.

functions.name: wspWSPGetFlatAttr
functions.description: Returns the attributes of a width spacing pattern (WSP) as a DPL.

functions.name: wspWSPGroupFindByName
functions.description: Finds a width spacing pattern (WSP) group by its name in a cellview or in the technology database.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefAddToAllowedPatternGroups
functions.description: Adds a width spacing pattern (WSP) group to the list of allowed pattern groups for a WSSPDef.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefAddToAllowedPatterns
functions.description: Adds a width spacing pattern (WSP) to the allowed patterns for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef).

functions.name: wspWSSPDefAddToEnabled
functions.description: Adds a list of widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDefs) to the list of WSSPDefs enabled as global grids in the specified cellview. This will filter out any duplicate, undefined wsspDefs, and wsspDefs with direction mis-match.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefClearEnabledOverrides
functions.description: Removes any global grid overrides from the specified cellview.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefFind
functions.description: Returns a list of widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDefs) that apply to a given routing layer name. The WSSPDefs may exist in the cellview or in the technology database. With the optional argument g_enabledOnly set to t, routing WSSPDefs that are enabled as global for the given layer are returned.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefFindByName
functions.description: Finds a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) by its name in a cellview or technology database.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetActivePattern
functions.description: Returns the active pattern name for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview. The active pattern may be set by a constraint in the cellview or from the WSSPDef in the cellview or technology database.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetAllowedPatternGroups
functions.description: Returns a list with the names of the allowed pattern groups for the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef).

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetAllowedPatterns
functions.description: Returns a list of names of allowed width spacing patterns (WSPs) for a given widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview. A WSSPDef has a list of allowed patterns and allowed pattern groups. The effective set of allowed patterns is a combination of the allowed WSPs and a WSP that is a member of an allowed pattern group. By default, this function returns the effective set of allowed patterns. You can use the g_excludeGroups argument to get only the directly allowed WSPs.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetAttr
functions.description: The attributes of the specified widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) are converted to a DPL format. All the attribute representations are the same as the source representation, except the snappingLayers attribute, which is stored as an association table for layer-purpose pair lookup.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefGetEnabledOverrides
functions.description: Returns the names of all the widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDefs) in the specified direction that are enabled as global grids. The WSSPDef direction is orthogonal to the routing direction. This filters out any duplicates, undefined wsspDefs, and wsspDefs with a direction mis-match.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefRemoveFromAllowedPatternGroups

functions.name: wspWSSPDefRemoveFromEnabled

functions.name: wspWSSPDefSetAllowedPatterns
functions.description: Sets the allowed patterns for a widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDef) in the specified cellview. If the WSSPDef is enabled as global, the patterns apply to the global grid of the WSSPDef and to any regions for the WSSPDef for which the allowed patterns are not overridden.

functions.name: wspWSSPDefSetEnabledOverrides
functions.description: Overrides the global grid in the specified cellview and by enabling the specified list of widthSpacingSnapPatternDefs (WSSPDefs) as global grids. If the l_wsspDefNames argument does not contain any WSSPDef in a direction, there is no global grid for that direction even if the technology database specifies a global grid for that direction.
